beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman by the Baldwin Street storefronts switches a stockpot to her other hand. Its handle sticks out into the walking space.
beats.chinese: 鲍德温街的店面前，一个女人换手拎着深锅。锅把伸到了行人走的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind the handle. Sorry, that sounded like your fault.
beats.chinese: 小心锅把。哎，听着像我在怪你似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the handle towards her leg. A lid rattles inside.
beats.chinese: 她把锅把转向自己的腿，锅盖在里面撞了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm returning it. I swear it weighed less when I came to borrow it.
beats.chinese: 我来还锅。借的时候拎着可没这么沉。

choices.english: Ask what she cooked in it.
choices.chinese: 问她用这锅做了什么。

choices.english: Give her the space to put it down.
choices.chinese: 往旁边让让，方便她把锅放下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the pot from underneath long enough to flex the fingers she had on the handle.
beats.chinese: 她换只手托住锅底，伸了伸刚才攥锅把的几根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chickpeas. Fed eight. I only own a saucepan, and that one's already got nowhere to go.
beats.chinese: 鹰嘴豆，八个人吃。我家就一口小锅，还愁没地儿放呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She grabs the handle again as a couple passes.
beats.chinese: 一对路人经过，她又握紧了锅把。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Every time I feed people, somebody tells me to buy a bigger pot.
beats.chinese: 每次我叫人来吃饭，总有人劝我买口大的。

choices.english: Ask whether she would borrow this one again.
choices.chinese: 问她下次还借不借这口。

choices.english: Suggest cooking in two smaller pots.
choices.chinese: 说也可以分两口小锅做。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rests the stockpot beside her feet, close to the storefront.
beats.chinese: 她把锅放在脚旁，朝店面那边贴了贴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I told my friend I'd wait out here, which seemed clever before I got here.
beats.chinese: 谢了。我跟朋友说在外头等。来之前还觉得这个安排挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She steps in beside the pot and tucks her elbows in to let someone pass.
beats.chinese: 她贴着锅站，收住胳膊肘让过一个人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's room for me or the pot. I'm trying to squeeze in both.
beats.chinese: 站我一个够，放口锅也够。两个一起就有点挤了。

choices.english: Point out the space by her feet and leave her to wait.
choices.chinese: 示意锅在脚边没挡路，让她自己等。

choices.english: Ask whether she could bring it back another time.
choices.chinese: 问她能不能换个时间来还。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She nudges the lid flat with a fingertip.
beats.chinese: 她伸根手指，把锅盖拨平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This exact one. I know how much it'll hold and I know where it goes afterwards.
beats.chinese: 就借这一口。能装多少我心里有数，用完也知道还哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She picks up the pot and turns to face the street beside you.
beats.chinese: 她提起锅，在你旁边转过身，也面朝街上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Stay a minute if you like. I'm waiting anyway.
beats.chinese: 想站会儿就站会儿吧。反正我也得等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts to answer, then uses two fingers to mark two spots in the air.
beats.chinese: 她刚要张嘴，又伸两根手指在空中比了两处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One spicy, one plain. I could actually do that. I'd have to borrow the second one, though.
beats.chinese: 一锅辣的，一锅不辣的。还真行。不过第二口还是得借。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises the stockpot as she looks along the storefronts.
beats.chinese: 她提起大锅，沿着一排店面望过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to see if she's coming. Thanks for the two pot idea.
beats.chinese: 我去看看她来了没有。分两锅这招，我记下了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slides one shoe under the handle to check how far it sticks out.
beats.chinese: 她把一只鞋伸到锅把下，比了比它伸出来多远。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. It's out of the way now.
beats.chinese: 嗯，这就不挡路了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts her weight back and opens the message thread on her phone.
beats.chinese: 她往后站了站，低头打开手机里的聊天记录。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait right here. Go on, I won't keep you.
beats.chinese: 我就在这儿等。你忙你的，我不耽误你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She reads the last message on her phone, then types with both thumbs.
beats.chinese: 她看了眼手机上最后一条消息，两手拇指敲起字来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can pick it up tomorrow. I should've offered that in the first place.
beats.chinese: 她可以明天来拿。我一开始就该这么说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hooks her fingers under the handle and lifts the pot.
beats.chinese: 她勾住锅把，把锅提起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Me and my enormous carry on are going home.
beats.chinese: 行。我要带着这件大行李回家了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on Baldwin Street, Beatriz is holding a saucepan lid up to her face. She lowers it when she spots you.
beats.chinese: 另一天在鲍德温街，贝娅特丽丝把一只小锅盖举到脸前。看见你，她就把盖子放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hey. This is mine. The actual pan is at somebody else's place.
beats.chinese: 哎，是你啊。盖是我的，锅还在别人家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the lid into the side of her bag. It sticks out past the zip.
beats.chinese: 她把盖塞到袋子一侧，边缘露在拉链外面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It was an even trade. I got lunch. I might still have to go get the pan, though.
beats.chinese: 没亏，我蹭了顿午饭。就是锅还得我自己去拿。

causality.presenceReason: 来鲍德温街还炖锅
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢走着过来，怕锅挡路
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友还没出来
causality.currentGoal: 连锅带盖当面还回去
causality.currentState: 锅提久了胳膊酸，说话一上来有点冲
causality.contactTrigger: 锅柄伸到行人经过的地方，她先提醒
causality.characterContinuity: 愿意招待朋友，家里却不肯多囤东西，直白归直白也肯说软话
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 想下回再借，结伴等人。ab 决定用两口小锅，彼此分开。ba 她退到一旁自己等。bb 街上等太占地方，她提锅改个时间还
causality.spatialContinuity: 一直在街面，锅没离手，盖子始终在锅里
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 从前只认得彼此，丢配套锅盖是今天的事

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside a Baldwin Street storefront, a man cups his phone. A voice from the speaker says there are twelve calendars left.
beats.chinese: 鲍德温街的一家店面外，一个男人拢着手机。扬声器里有人说，还剩十二本日历。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Twelve. Can I borrow a guess from you? They're my friend's, for a fundraiser.
beats.chinese: 十二本。能请你猜个数吗？我朋友拿日历做义卖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the volume down and steps towards the building as two people pass.
beats.chinese: 两个人走过，他调低声音，往店面这侧靠了靠。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I reckon there'll still be six left tonight. She reckons two.
beats.chinese: 我猜今晚还剩六本。她说两本。

choices.english: Ask what could make them sell quicker.
choices.chinese: 问他什么情况下会卖得更快。

choices.english: Ask whether his friend wanted a guess in the first place.
choices.chinese: 问他朋友是不是想听他猜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds up the phone without unlocking it.
beats.chinese: 他抬了抬手机，没有解锁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The rain holding off would help. Nobody wants to carry a paper calendar in a downpour.
beats.chinese: 雨能晚点下就好。下大雨谁还想拎着本纸日历走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs a crumb off his sleeve and looks at his phone again.
beats.chinese: 他抹掉袖口一点碎屑，又看了眼手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind you, she makes things people actually want. I didn't put that in my little calculation.
beats.chinese: 不过，她做的东西确实有人喜欢。我算那笔小账的时候把这点漏了。

choices.english: Suggest giving her a dry day and a wet day guess.
choices.chinese: 建议他按下雨和不下雨各猜一次。

choices.english: Ask whether she told her friends about the sale.
choices.chinese: 问她有没有通知朋友来买。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a second look at the messages above the voice note.
beats.chinese: 他重新看了看语音消息上面的几句话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. She said she'd sold eight already. I skipped right over that bit, didn't I?
beats.chinese: 没。她说她已经卖了八本。我刚才直接跳过这句了，是吧？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the phone in both hands and starts a reply, then stops.
beats.chinese: 他双手捧着手机，刚开始回消息，又停住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can tell her that's good news. I can also keep my six to myself.
beats.chinese: 我可以先说这挺好的。至于六本嘛，我自己记着也行。

choices.english: Let him send the congratulations and drop the bet.
choices.chinese: 让他发句祝贺，猜数的事就算了。

choices.english: Ask whether he wants to remember the number for himself.
choices.chinese: 问他自己要不要记住猜的数。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He unlocks the phone and adds a second line to his note.
beats.chinese: 他解锁手机，在备忘里多记了一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six if it pours. Two if it doesn't. Oh, she'll hate me taking her number.
beats.chinese: 下大雨就六本，不下就两本。哎，我抄她的数，她准不乐意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shows you both lines with the phone held between you.
beats.chinese: 他把手机举到两人中间，给你看那两行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave her name beside the two. She can collect on it later.
beats.chinese: 我把她的名字写在两本旁边。到时候算她猜对。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He scrolls back to the photograph in the chat. A stack of calendars sits on a table.
beats.chinese: 他往回翻到聊天里的照片。桌上叠着一摞日历。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Her sister's in the photo. If her sister's there, half the people she knows will hear about it.
beats.chinese: 照片里有她姐姐。她姐都去了，还不得把认识的人叫去一半。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives the phone screen a light tap with the side of a finger.
beats.chinese: 他用手指侧面轻轻碰了一下屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There goes my six. I'm changing mine to three.
beats.chinese: 得，我那六本算不准了。我改成三本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a short reply, taps send and puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 他打了句短的，点下发送，把手机放回口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eight's good. That's all I sent.
beats.chinese: 八本已经挺好了。我就回了这句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down Baldwin Street, then moves closer to the storefront.
beats.chinese: 他往鲍德温街那头看了看，又朝店面挪了点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My lunch date should be along. If we get started on the weather, we'll both miss ours.
beats.chinese: 跟我吃午饭的人应该快到了。咱俩要是再聊起天气，饭都得耽误。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the notes app and types a single digit.
beats.chinese: 他打开备忘录，敲下一个数字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I don't write it down, I'll swear I said four by dinner. I like winning more than I should.
beats.chinese: 要是不记，到了晚饭我准说自己猜的是四本。我是有点太想赢了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He locks the phone without going back to the chat.
beats.chinese: 他没再切回聊天，直接锁了屏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll tell her well done. If she asks, I never showed you that note.
beats.chinese: 我去夸她一句。她要问，你就当没瞧过我那条备忘。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on Baldwin Street, Gordon spots you as he slides a patterned cup into a bag.
beats.chinese: 另一天在鲍德温街，戈登正往袋里放一只带花纹的杯子，一抬头看见了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I said I'd bring my own cup to lunch. Apparently that wasn't the hard part.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我说午饭自己带杯子。原来带杯子还算简单的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the cup out again, checking the lip with a thumb.
beats.chinese: 他又把杯子拿出来，拇指摸过杯口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend asked if I'd use the nice one or keep it nice in the bag. Fair question.
beats.chinese: 朋友问我，这么好看的杯子到底拿不拿出来喝，还是留袋里继续好看。这话问得挺准。

causality.presenceReason: 来街区和朋友吃饭，先在公共街面等
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢这片街上有人走过，能让他打发等人的时间
causality.stayingConstraint: 饭约还没到
causality.currentGoal: 验证自己关于朋友义卖日历的判断
causality.currentState: 一开口习惯找反例，却舍不得随口押注
causality.contactTrigger: 同一段路上他听见手机语音回执，自己开口问玩家
causality.characterContinuity: 不探他人隐私，只在可选择的生活小事上找反例，被说服也乐意
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 改按天气分两种估计。ab 承认自己漏算亲友捧场。ba 祝贺完把账收起来。bb 把数字记在自己手机上，承认想赢
causality.spatialContinuity: 一直在店面外公共街道，手机由本人操作，日历是语音消息中的物件
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 只认得对方，杯子和当天组织的聚餐另起一件事

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Baldwin Street, a woman with a cotton bag looks from one storefront to the next. She stops to let you pass.
beats.chinese: 鲍德温街上，一个拎棉袋的女人挨个看店面。见你过来，她停下来让路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you see a number from there? I told a friend I'd meet her by the green door.
beats.chinese: 你站那儿能瞧见门号吗？我跟朋友说在绿门那儿见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks along the storefronts again. The handles of her bag are twisted together.
beats.chinese: 她又往那排店面看了一遍。棉袋的提手在手里拧着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've been saying green door for years. It's entirely possible the door got on with its life.
beats.chinese: 我都叫它绿门叫了好几年了。也没准人家早换样了，就我还这么叫。

choices.english: Ask what she remembers about the old door.
choices.chinese: 问问她还记得那扇门什么样。

choices.english: Suggest she wait for her friend to send a number.
choices.chinese: 提议等朋友把门号发过来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens two fingers against the side of her bag.
beats.chinese: 她伸出两根手指，在袋子侧面比了比。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Narrow frame. The green went up one side but not the other. You could pick it out from halfway down the street.
beats.chinese: 门框挺窄。绿漆只刷到一边，另一边没刷。离老远就认得出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls a folded slip from the pocket of the bag. There are a few door numbers on it.
beats.chinese: 她从袋子的口袋里抽出一张折过的纸条，上面记着几个门号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got numbers here for deliveries. Of course I didn't write the one I thought I'd always know.
beats.chinese: 这是我送货记的。当然了，我觉得自己这辈子都认得的那个，偏偏没记。

choices.english: Ask her to check the message for a number now.
choices.chinese: 问她要不要先看看消息里有没有门号。

choices.english: Ask if the two doorframes in view would help jog her memory.
choices.chinese: 指给她看眼前两边的门框，问能不能想起点什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the cotton bag against her leg and pulls out her phone.
beats.chinese: 她把棉袋贴着腿拎住，腾出手拿手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can ask. She's coming to see my wax wraps, anyway. She hasn't got a great attachment to the door.
beats.chinese: 我问问吧。她本来就是来看我的蜂蜡布，对那扇门倒没什么感情。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As she types, she shifts the bag out of the way of people passing.
beats.chinese: 她边打字边把袋子往里挪，给路过的人让开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to tell her I've stopped walking. That should narrow it down.
beats.chinese: 我跟她说我站住不走了。这样总好找一点。

choices.english: Give her room to wait by the storefront.
choices.chinese: 给她让点地方，让她在店面旁等。

choices.english: Ask whether she'd rather look a little farther along.
choices.chinese: 问她想不想再往前找一小段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She brings up the text thread and runs one finger up it.
beats.chinese: 她点开消息，用一根手指往上翻。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nope. Just me saying green and her saying okay. That's the two of us thoroughly lost, then.
beats.chinese: 没有。就我说绿门，她说行。得，我俩都没说清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends a new text and drops the slip back into the bag.
beats.chinese: 她又发了条消息，把纸条放回袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait for a number. Forget the green for now.
beats.chinese: 我等她发门号吧。今天就先不管那扇绿门了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She compares the nearer frame with the one beyond it, then turns the slip over.
beats.chinese: 她看看近处的门框，又看看远一点的，把纸条翻了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Neither's what I had in my head. But that little gap there, I think I do remember that.
beats.chinese: 都跟我想的不一样。不过中间那点空儿，我好像倒有印象。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws two thin rectangles side by side.
beats.chinese: 她并排画了两个细长的方框。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a minute. You see anything different from where you're standing?
beats.chinese: 我还不急。你从你那边看过去，有没有什么不一样的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stands by the storefront with the bag hanging close to her coat.
beats.chinese: 她靠着店面站好，棉袋贴着外套垂下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay put. Last thing she needs is me walking away every time she gets close.
beats.chinese: 我就在这儿等。人家好不容易快走到，我再换地方，那还怎么找。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone buzzes once in her hand. She lowers her eyes to it.
beats.chinese: 手机在她手里振了一下，她低头去看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll be her. Thanks for letting me get out of everybody's way.
beats.chinese: 多半是她。多谢啊，这下我也不挡人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks one storefront farther along and types a second message.
beats.chinese: 她朝前面那家店望了望，又打了条消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll look one door down. I ought to tell her that while I'm still in the same place.
beats.chinese: 我就往前找一家。趁我还站在这儿，先跟她说清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the bag by both handles and waits for a passerby to clear the way.
beats.chinese: 她把两个提手一起拎起来，等面前的人走过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, I'm going to go slow. I'll see you around.
beats.chinese: 我走得慢，你先走吧。回头见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on Baldwin Street, Aud recognizes you as she brushes a pale mark on her bag.
beats.chinese: 另一天在鲍德温街，奥德正掸袋子上的一块浅印子，一抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I thought I got lunch on it. It's wax from just one of my samples.
beats.chinese: 哎，你好。我还当是午饭蹭上去了。原来就一块样布上的蜡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the bag a little. A square of folded cloth is wedged against the side.
beats.chinese: 她把袋口扒开一点。一块叠成方形的布正抵在袋壁上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll turn that one over. Same wrap either way, less of it on the bag.
beats.chinese: 我把这块翻个面吧。一样能包东西，袋子上还能少蹭点。

causality.presenceReason: 拎蜂蜡布样品给朋友看
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意走老路，也容易被变化牵住注意

causality.currentGoal: 确认要在哪个店面前碰头
causality.currentState: 原先记颜色的把握落了空，还想辩两句
causality.contactTrigger: 她对着两处店面发愣，再问玩家能否从街面看见门号
causality.characterContinuity: 对旧地标有感情，不抢玩家手机也不催别人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 承认旧颜色今天帮不上忙，等短信。ab 画下两片门框，一起看变化。ba 靠店面等朋友来找。bb 沿街再找一下，把等人地点说清
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程在鲍德温街公共步行空间，棉袋和样品保持近身，未出现营业消息
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 再次遇见而已，当天从棉袋上的蜡痕另起

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man by a Baldwin Street window opens his coat to look at a bright green vest in the reflection.
beats.chinese: 鲍德温街一家店的玻璃窗边，一个男人敞开外套，照了照里头那件亮绿背心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Come on, stand up straight. Oh, hey. I was talking to the vest.
beats.chinese: 起来点，别趴着。哦，你好。我跟背心说呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pinches up a corner that has folded under the coat.
beats.chinese: 他捏住被外套压进去的一角，往外扯了扯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just put that green strip on. I didn't get dressed like this to cover the whole thing up.
beats.chinese: 绿边是我刚缝的。好不容易穿出来，总不能全给盖上吧。

choices.english: Ask how cold he is standing there.
choices.chinese: 问他站在这儿冷不冷。

choices.english: Ask what the green strip is made of.
choices.chinese: 问他那条绿边是用什么做的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls the collar up, then leaves the front open.
beats.chinese: 他竖起领子，前襟还是敞着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cold enough. I was hoping you'd tell me I looked too good to feel it.
beats.chinese: 冷啊。我本来还指望你说，我穿得这么好看，肯定顾不上冷。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks his chin down into the collar.
beats.chinese: 他把下巴缩进领子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Better now. Still got about half a foot of vest showing.
beats.chinese: 这下好点。还能露出半英尺呢。

choices.english: Suggest doing up just the middle button.
choices.chinese: 建议他只扣中间那颗。

choices.english: Say he can button up and enjoy the green himself.
choices.chinese: 说扣严实也行，亮绿色留给自己看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the corner flat between two fingers without pulling the vest off.
beats.chinese: 他两根手指夹住背心一角，把边压平，衣服还穿在身上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Leather off an old sofa. You can't sit on it any more, but you can certainly make people look at it.
beats.chinese: 旧沙发拆下来的皮。坐是坐不了了，拿来让人多看一眼还行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He follows your glance towards the corner, then drops his hand.
beats.chinese: 他顺着你的目光看了看那一角，把手放下了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was about to tell you what colour you ought to wear. You didn't ask me that at all.
beats.chinese: 我刚差点就想告诉你该穿什么颜色。你压根没问这个。

choices.english: Ask how he got the old leather flat.
choices.chinese: 问他怎么让旧皮子平下来的。

choices.english: Leave the colour to him and pass on the look in the window.
choices.chinese: 颜色让他自己定，也不凑过去照玻璃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He does up the middle button and checks the window again.
beats.chinese: 他扣上中间那颗纽扣，又往玻璃上看了眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There it is. Just enough green at the top. My coat can take it from here.
beats.chinese: 喏，上头露这点绿正好。别的就交给外套了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a step away from the glass as someone approaches the storefront.
beats.chinese: 有人朝店面走来，他从窗前往外让了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was blocking half the window. Here, let's give it back.
beats.chinese: 刚才半扇窗都让我挡了。来，给人家让出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He does up the coat all the way to his throat.
beats.chinese: 他把外套一路扣到脖子下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm warm already. Green's still in there. I know where I put it.
beats.chinese: 这就暖了。绿的还在里头，我又没忘放哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks one sleeve cuff and starts off along Baldwin Street.
beats.chinese: 他捋了捋一边袖口，顺着鲍德温街走起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend's going to make me show her anyway. I'll survive till then.
beats.chinese: 反正我朋友准要我给她看。我先撑到见面再说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns just enough to show the back of the sewn edge.
beats.chinese: 他稍微转了点身，露出缝边的背面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Kept it under a pile of books overnight. The books don't look any different. The leather does.
beats.chinese: 拿一摞书压了一宿。书倒还是原样，皮子平多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets the edge drop and looks at your face instead of your clothes.
beats.chinese: 他松开皮边，抬眼看你，也没再瞄你的衣服。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's how I did mine. I wouldn't put your good books through it without asking.
beats.chinese: 我自己是这么弄的。要压你那几本好书，我肯定先问一声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns back to the glass and runs a finger down the strip in the reflection.
beats.chinese: 他转回玻璃前，对着倒影顺了一下那条绿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair. I can have a whole argument with this thing on my own.
beats.chinese: 行啊。这条边我一个人就够跟它较劲的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets the coat fall over the vest and moves out of the walking space.
beats.chinese: 他让外套盖住背心，退到不挡路的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I can fuss with it when I get inside.
beats.chinese: 好了。我进去再跟它慢慢较劲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on Baldwin Street, Emile recognizes you while rubbing a dark mark on a leather cuff.
beats.chinese: 另一天在鲍德温街，埃米尔正搓皮袖口上一道深印子，一抬眼认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I thought this was fresh. It's where the sofa used to fold.
beats.chinese: 哎。我还以为刚蹭上的。原来是沙发以前折在这儿的印。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops rubbing and turns the cuff so the mark faces out.
beats.chinese: 他不搓了，把袖口一转，让印子朝外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Took me long enough to notice. I'm leaving it right there.
beats.chinese: 我折腾半天才看出来。就留它在这儿得了。

causality.presenceReason: 穿自己改过的旧背心走街，准备去见朋友
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢街面上有人正好看到衣服，也会觉得冷
causality.stayingConstraint: 和朋友碰头前有空
causality.currentGoal: 决定要不要把外套扣起来
causality.currentState: 本来着急挡风，又舍不得遮住改好的颜色
causality.contactTrigger: 站在店面的玻璃外照背心，察觉玩家也在这段路上
causality.characterContinuity: 喜欢大胆配色，说得太快会把别人的意见当成邀请，知道了马上收回来
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 扣中间一颗，腾出路。ab 选择保暖，承认里头给自己看。ba 话题转向修理，讲自己的用法。bb 不聊搭配，他自己把皮边理平
causality.spatialContinuity: 从店铺玻璃旁挪到不碍路的位置，衣物没脱下来，背心皮边一直缝着
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 今天才看到新皮边有印子，未假定记得上次衣服

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman on the boards by the lake lifts one finger, then stops the recording on her phone. A rush of water comes from the open side.
beats.chinese: 湖边木栈道上，一个女人竖起一根手指，接着停掉手机录音。临湖那边涌过一阵水声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Were you saying something to me? I only heard the end of it.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，你刚是在跟我说话吗？我就听着个尾巴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out one earbud. Her thumb stays still on the side of the phone.
beats.chinese: 她摘下一只耳机，拇指停在手机边上没动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm trying to leave my sister a message. I might've heard myself coming back through the earbud.
beats.chinese: 我想给我姐留条语音。也可能是耳机里把我自己的声音送回来了。

choices.english: Let the noise pass before answering.
choices.chinese: 等这一阵水声过去再回话。

choices.english: Tell her it's fine and she can finish the recording.
choices.chinese: 跟她说没事，请她先把语音录完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The water falls back. She looks at you and waits through the next couple of footsteps.
beats.chinese: 水声退下去。她看着你，又等旁边那几步脚步声过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. If I try to listen while I'm talking, I come away with about four words of each.
beats.chinese: 谢了。我一边说一边听，到头来两边都只剩四个字。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the phone down so it catches none of what you say next.
beats.chinese: 她把手机垂下来，没录进去你接下来要说的话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I only need to ask what time she's coming. I've made three goes at saying it.
beats.chinese: 我就想问她几点来。为这一句，我都录三遍了。

choices.english: Wait nearby while she tries once more.
choices.chinese: 在旁边等她再试一次。

choices.english: Suggest sending the question as a text.
choices.chinese: 建议就把这一句打成字发过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts both earbuds into their case without starting the recording again.
beats.chinese: 她没再录，直接把两只耳机都收进盒里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I think I'd rather leave it. We both get somebody's voice and the sound of water and neither of us knows what the other one said.
beats.chinese: 还是先不录了吧。水声掺人声，两边听，谁也说不清对方讲了啥。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stands close to the shore wall to let a group file past.
beats.chinese: 她站到靠岸墙那一侧，让一拨人过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She'll ring back. I can leave the phone alone till then.
beats.chinese: 她会打过来的。那之前我先不折腾手机了。

choices.english: Let her get back to her walk.
choices.chinese: 让她接着走。

choices.english: Ask if now is a better time to talk for a minute.
choices.chinese: 问她现在方不方便聊一小会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits with the phone down until the next patch of foot traffic has gone. Then she lifts it.
beats.chinese: 她垂着手机，又等一拨行人过去才举起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: What time are you coming over? There. Four seconds, and you can hear the whole thing.
beats.chinese: 姐，你几点过来？好了，四秒，这回从头到尾都听得清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She plays it once with the phone close to her ear and sends it.
beats.chinese: 她把手机贴到耳朵边放了一遍，按下发送。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can have the lake back now.
beats.chinese: 这下能踏踏实实看会儿水了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She taps out a line and leaves the phone face down in her palm.
beats.chinese: 她敲了一行，把手机倒扣在手心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Text was fine. I wanted to hear how she was doing, but I can get that from her when she's there.
beats.chinese: 打字也行。我是想听听她人怎么样。等见了面再问也来得及。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises her head when another rush of water comes up from the lake.
beats.chinese: 又一阵水声从湖上涌来，她这才抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I hear that a lot better without the earbud in.
beats.chinese: 摘了耳机，这声听着真清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her phone away next to the earbud case and looks along the run of boards.
beats.chinese: 她把手机和耳机盒揣到一起，沿木栈道往前看了看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. I'll call when I get home if she hasn't rung by then.
beats.chinese: 嗯。到家她还没打的话，我再给她打。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She walks on with both hands in her coat pockets.
beats.chinese: 她两手插在外套兜里，接着往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. Can I get through on this side?
beats.chinese: 借过一下，我能从这边走吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks at the phone once, then sets it to silent. She shifts closer so you don't have to raise your voice.
beats.chinese: 她看了眼手机，调成静音，又站近了一点儿，你不用抬高声音也听得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. It's on silent. Tell me the bit I missed, if there was a bit.
beats.chinese: 行，静音了。刚才有哪句我没听见的话，你再跟我说一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A group passes. She keeps her eyes on you until their steps have moved away.
beats.chinese: 一行人走过。她一直看着你，等脚步声走远。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, one more second. Okay, now I've got you.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，再等一秒。好了，现在能听见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another walk along the lake, Sacha recognizes you just as her phone lights up. She lets the screen go dark on its own.
beats.chinese: 改天沿湖走，你又碰到萨沙。她手机刚亮，一抬眼认出你，没去按，任它自己暗下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. My brother sent me a three minute voice note about a drawer that won't close.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我弟那个抽屉关不上，给我发了三分钟语音。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She steps off to the side of the walking line and drops her phone into a pocket.
beats.chinese: 她往栈道边上让了让，把手机揣回兜里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll listen after. I kind of want to know why he's called it an emergency.
beats.chinese: 我等会儿再听。还挺想知道他怎么就把这事定成紧急情况了。

causality.presenceReason: 来岛上沿湖走走，给家里打电话前找安静
causality.placeAttitude: 湖面开阔，板上脚步和水声躲不过
causality.stayingConstraint: 要等姐姐回电才能问清家事
causality.currentGoal: 发给姐姐一段能听清的话
causality.currentState: 连录两遍被外界打断，听见误会就会急
causality.contactTrigger: 大声音盖过录音，她以为路人的话是在跟她说，主动确认
causality.characterContinuity: 不一心二用，复杂处要等一等，也会先确认而非指责
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 留下等安静后再录。ab 把话缩成一行发出。ba 结束交谈，回家前再打。bb 接受短聊，把电话推后
causality.spatialContinuity: 站在岸墙边的木栈道，水在开阔面，未下岸墙
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 见面只认得彼此，当天的新语音与旧电话无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol stands to one side of the boards with a short length of tape measure stretched between her hands. She lets it snap shut when you pass.
beats.chinese: 玛丽索尔站在木栈道一边，双手撑开一小截卷尺。你经过时，她把尺啪地收了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, I need both hands till it goes in. There. Do you hang a wet sheet folded, or all the way open?
beats.chinese: 抱歉，卷尺收进去前我得用两只手。好了。你晾湿床单一般对折晾，还是全摊开？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lays a folded sheet of graph paper against her forearm.
beats.chinese: 她把折过的方格纸摊在前臂上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm waiting for my sister. She says my clothes rack is great till she washes the sheets.
beats.chinese: 我在等我姐。她说我做的晾衣架挺好，一洗床单就不行了。

choices.english: Ask what happens when the sheet goes on the rack.
choices.chinese: 问床单一挂上去会怎么着。

choices.english: Ask whether her sister is coming to show her what went wrong.
choices.chinese: 问她姐是不是打算过来比画给她看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol opens the paper at the first fold. There are two little circles near one edge.
beats.chinese: 她把方格纸掀开一道折痕。边儿上有两个小圆圈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Folded, it's too thick. Open, it drags. She put it on the rack on day three and got water all over her feet.
beats.chinese: 折起来太厚，摊开又拖地。她试到第三天才挂床单，滴了一脚水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol presses the blunt end of a pencil against the circles.
beats.chinese: 她拿铅笔没尖的那头压着两个圆圈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could move those two. But the real thing can sit in my shop till she wants it.
beats.chinese: 这两个孔倒能挪。不过真的那副可以一直放我工间，等她说要再拿过去。

choices.english: Ask which part she'll change first.
choices.chinese: 问她准备先改哪一处。

choices.english: Suggest giving her sister another week with the trial rack.
choices.chinese: 提议让她姐再用一周试做的架子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol folds the plan over her thumb and looks along the boards by the shore wall.
beats.chinese: 她把图纸折到拇指上，沿着岸墙这侧的木板路看过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She said she'd show me with her arms, then sent a picture anyway. I got the wall, most of her elbow and none of the sheet.
beats.chinese: 她说见面比给我看，后来还是发了张照片。我瞧见一面墙、大半个胳膊肘，就是没有床单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The tape goes into a coat pocket. She keeps the paper in her hand.
beats.chinese: 卷尺进了大衣兜，纸还拿在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can wait. It doesn't stop my hands wanting to fix it now.
beats.chinese: 我能等，就是两只手现在就想去改。

choices.english: Leave the measurements until her sister gets there.
choices.chinese: 让她等姐姐到了再量。

choices.english: Ask whether she'd try hanging one herself.
choices.chinese: 问她要不要自己试着晾一回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts a cross through both holes, then hesitates with the pencil above the first one.
beats.chinese: 她把两个孔都划上了叉，铅笔停在第一个孔上没落下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll move the wall end. The other one might be fine. I'll draw that back in while I still remember why.
beats.chinese: 我先挪靠墙那头。另一个没准不用动。我趁还记得怎么回事，先给它画回来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She redraws the small circle and holds the page down flat for you to see.
beats.chinese: 她重新画好小圆圈，把纸放平了给你看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The pencil job's done. The drill can wait.
beats.chinese: 笔上先改到这儿。钻头再等等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out her phone and makes a brief call, holding the drawing under one arm.
beats.chinese: 她把图纸往胳膊下一夹，拿出手机拨了个短电话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Keep it up another week, will you? I know. I don't want you catching the drips twice either.
beats.chinese: 再挂一星期成吗？我知道。我也不想你还得接两回滴下来的水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She listens for a little while, then unfolds the paper again.
beats.chinese: 她听了一会儿，把图纸又打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's going to use a towel under it. I've been told very clearly who'll wash the towel.
beats.chinese: 她说底下先铺块毛巾。毛巾归谁洗，她也说得明明白白了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the sheet small enough to fit in with the tape, then puts both hands in her pockets.
beats.chinese: 她把图纸叠小，塞进放卷尺那个兜，两手也插了进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I've got two hands free for a walk. She can have both of them for measuring later.
beats.chinese: 好了，这会儿两只手可以空着散步。等会儿要量再都借给她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves along the boards a few paces, slowly enough to keep the approach in view.
beats.chinese: 她在木栈道上往前走了几步，速度不快，还能看着人会从哪边来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you see somebody doing this with her elbows, that'll be her.
beats.chinese: 你要看见有人拿胳膊肘这么比画，就是她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the pencil still for a moment, then writes sheet, wet in the margin.
beats.chinese: 她拿铅笔停了一会儿，在纸边上写下湿床单三个字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wash one of mine. I've only hung the dry one to see how it fits. You could carry that with a finger.
beats.chinese: 我拿自己的洗一条。我只晾过干的，比一下尺寸。一根手指提着都成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the list of measurements closed and wraps a rubber band round it.
beats.chinese: 她把写尺寸的纸折起来，拿一根橡皮筋绑好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll call her after I've got my own socks wet.
beats.chinese: 等我自己的袜子也滴湿了，再给我姐打电话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Late on another day, Marisol spots you by the lake with a paddle case tucked under her arm. Something ticks against its zip.
beats.chinese: 改天傍晚，玛丽索尔在湖边遇见你，胳膊底下夹着个球拍套。有个东西在拉链上哒哒地撞。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. Two weeks I thought I lost that ball. It's wedged under the grip of the spare bat.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我以为那个球丢了，找了两礼拜。原来卡在备用球拍的拍柄下边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the case upright and the ball drops to the other end.
beats.chinese: 她把球拍套竖过来，球掉到另一头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep bringing a spare of everything except a second person who can beat that man on Thursdays.
beats.chinese: 我什么都爱带份备用的。就没多带个人来，好在周四替我赢那个家伙。

causality.presenceReason: 和姐姐约在岛上走一圈，说说在家试用的晾衣架
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢散步时没人催着把东西装上
causality.stayingConstraint: 等姐姐走来，先别替她把方案定了
causality.currentGoal: 把姐姐发的试用情况弄明白
causality.currentState: 自认算得准，发现漏算湿床单有点发愣
causality.contactTrigger: 她手拿卷尺比出宽度，先让路，再随口问晾的是什么
causality.characterContinuity: 量的时候不聊天，自家的东西先试用，耐得住家人嫌弃
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 在纸上划掉要返工的孔。ab 主动给姐姐说还要再试。ba 放下测量，等人当面说。bb 自己试一次拎湿重物
causality.spatialContinuity: 栈道岸墙旁站稳后才比卷尺，不碰公共设施
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢从当天球拍袋里找乒乓球开始

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey has a little notebook open by the shore wall. The wind keeps lifting a receipt out of its fold, and they keep pinning it down.
beats.chinese: 湖边岸墙旁，凯西摊开一本小本子。风老把折进去的收据掀起来，凯西就一次次按回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you see that line at the bottom from there? I can't tell if the ink has gone or if I'm holding it in my own shadow.
beats.chinese: 你站那儿看得清最底下一行吗？我分不清是字掉了，还是自己的影子挡着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the receipt a fraction. The water beyond the boards is white at the tips.
beats.chinese: 凯西把收据转了个小角度。木板路外头，湖水翻着白尖儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's just a date. I want to be able to read it again.
beats.chinese: 就是个日期。我想以后还能看清。

choices.english: Ask what the date is for.
choices.chinese: 问这日期是做什么用的。

choices.english: Suggest turning the receipt into the light instead.
choices.chinese: 提议只把收据再转到亮一点的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey keeps a finger over the other page, where a few lines of different handwriting show near the spine.
beats.chinese: 凯西拿指尖盖着另一页，页脊边露着几行笔迹不一样的字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend wanted to learn bass. She had a bass player written down who she wanted to hear live. She didn't get to go. I went on Tuesday, and I've still got the bill.
beats.chinese: 我朋友说想学弹贝斯，还记了一个贝斯手的名字。她说想去听那人现场弹。她没赶上。我周二去了，单子还在。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They edge the receipt away from the old writing.
beats.chinese: 凯西把收据从原来那几行字上慢慢移开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't want to tick anything off in her handwriting. Somehow I hadn't thought about where my part goes.
beats.chinese: 她写的那些，我一个勾也不想打。就是没想过，我做的这点事往哪儿记。

choices.english: Suggest leaving her page alone and writing on a separate one.
choices.chinese: 提议别动朋友那页，另找张纸写。

choices.english: Suggest keeping the receipt somewhere outside the notebook.
choices.chinese: 提议把收据单独放到本子外面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey turns to face more of the lake. The numbers at the edge of the receipt come into the light.
beats.chinese: 凯西转向开阔湖面那边，收据边的数字照亮了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. Tuesday. It's still there, then. I don't need you to make sense of the rest of it.
beats.chinese: 噢，星期二。那还看得见。别的不用劳你看明白。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They slip a finger between the pages to keep their place.
beats.chinese: 凯西夹了根手指在书页间，免得翻丢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came out because I had a bit of time before work. Suddenly I feel like I'd rather spend it walking.
beats.chinese: 离上班还有会儿，我才过来的。想想，剩下这点时间我更想接着走走。

choices.english: Suggest taking a photo before putting it away.
choices.chinese: 建议收起来前拍一下留底。

choices.english: Give Casey room to finish the walk alone.
choices.chinese: 让出地方，让凯西自己走一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey turns past the old handwriting until a plain page comes up. They write Tuesday at the top.
beats.chinese: 凯西翻过原来那些字，找着空白页，在顶上写了星期二。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There were three of us at the front. You could hear the strings rattle in the gap between the songs. I'll put that in.
beats.chinese: 最前头就三个人。两首歌中间，还听得到弦在响。我把这个记进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the receipt between the blank page and the back cover.
beats.chinese: 凯西把收据夹进空白页和封底中间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's mine, now. Her page stays the way it was.
beats.chinese: 这段就算我写的。她那页还照原样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey reads the date once more, folds the paper and works it into the thin pocket of a wallet.
beats.chinese: 凯西又看了一眼日期，把票折小，塞进钱包的薄夹层。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can find it there. I don't need it touching her page to remember where I went.
beats.chinese: 放那儿找得到。这张票又不用非挨着她那页，我才记得我去哪儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They close the notebook with their palm flat across the cover.
beats.chinese: 凯西一手平压着封皮，把本子合起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm glad I went. I was pretty angry the whole time.
beats.chinese: 我是庆幸自己去了。可从头到尾，我还挺生气的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey takes a photo with the receipt pressed to the closed cover. Only the bottom of the slip shows on the screen.
beats.chinese: 凯西把收据按在合上的本子上拍了张照。画面里只露着纸的最底下一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There it is. I'll keep both. That phone of mine loses anything I actually look for.
beats.chinese: 拍着了。两份都留着吧。我那手机，正经想找什么就找不着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the phone and notebook into separate coat pockets.
beats.chinese: 凯西把手机和本子分别放进两边衣兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to walk a bit. I can do that without the phone, at least.
beats.chinese: 我再走会儿。这点事至少不用手机。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey folds the receipt in and keeps the whole notebook closed in one hand.
beats.chinese: 凯西把票折进去，单手把合好的本子攥住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I don't really want to talk about her to somebody who didn't know her. I only needed to see the date.
beats.chinese: 谢了。跟没见过她的人说她，我不大说得下去。刚才就想看清日期。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They wait for the boards ahead to clear and set off close to the shore wall.
beats.chinese: 凯西等前面的栈道空开，贴着岸墙走了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take this side. There's less wind down here.
beats.chinese: 我走这边。这头风小点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a different day, Casey sees you on the boards and stops with a small jar cradled in both hands.
beats.chinese: 隔天，凯西在木栈道上一眼看到你，停住了。两手捧着一个小瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. These are pickles. I tried making one jar without garlic and now I can't remember which jar I brought.
beats.chinese: 嗨。是腌黄瓜。我有一罐试了不放蒜，这会儿忘了带的是哪罐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the jar to its label. The glass makes a little wet ring against their sleeve.
beats.chinese: 凯西把瓶转到标签那面。玻璃在袖子上压出一小圈湿印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It just says Thursday. That's me telling me to mind my business, I guess.
beats.chinese: 就写了个星期四。得，自己还跟自己卖关子呢。

causality.presenceReason: 带已做完一桩约定留下的收据来湖边静一静
causality.placeAttitude: 水天开阔，用来缓一下再回城
causality.stayingConstraint: 还有要排的电台曲目，迟些得回去
causality.currentGoal: 决定把收据放哪，清单照旧
causality.currentState: 刚替朋友做完一件只有自己记得的事，惦念却不想煽情
causality.contactTrigger: 风把票晃到纸页边，自己按住后问旁边的人借一眼看墨迹
causality.characterContinuity: 不划掉朋友原清单，也不会把这事说成玩得有趣，不逼玩家听旧事
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 夹到后面记具体事。ab 记住日期，把票收在别处。ba 用手机留一份，原件收好。bb 停止谈话，自己去湖边走
causality.spatialContinuity: 纸和票不离手，沿栈道停走，不借现场设施
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢从当天自家小瓶腌菜开始，无需知晓笔记本

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman on the lakeside boards stops with one foot still turned over her shoulder. She brings it back beside the other when she sees you coming.
beats.chinese: 湖边木栈道上，一个女人停了下来，一只脚还朝着身后。见你过来，她才把脚收回来站好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You've come from that end, right? What's it like a little farther on? I want to turn around before I've seen too much of it this way.
beats.chinese: 你是从那头过来的吧？再往前一点什么样？我得趁还没从这边看太多，先回个头。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks her watch and tips her head towards the lake.
beats.chinese: 她看了眼表，朝湖那边偏了偏头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've been down this bit plenty. Somehow I've always had the lake off the same shoulder.
beats.chinese: 这段我都走多少回了。反正每回湖都在同一边肩膀外头。

choices.english: Ask what she notices when she goes the other way.
choices.chinese: 问换个方向走，她会留意到什么。

choices.english: Ask whether she's on her way to meet somebody.
choices.chinese: 问她是不是还约了人见面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns back far enough for the lake to move from one side of her view to the other.
beats.chinese: 她回过身，直到湖从视野一边换到另一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That gap in the trees. Coming up to it from here, I actually see the water open up. The other way I only see it disappear.
beats.chinese: 树中间那一豁。从这头走，水面一下就敞开了。从另一头经过，只看见它又被挡没了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks back to where her last step landed on the boards.
beats.chinese: 她回头瞧了眼自己刚才在木板上的落脚处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got enough time to do it once. I might want to go on my own and not talk through the good bit.
beats.chinese: 时间够我再走一回。我可能想自己走，那段好看的地方就先别聊天了。

choices.english: Offer to walk that short part together in silence.
choices.chinese: 提议那一小段可以一起走，先不讲话。

choices.english: Tell her you'll stay here and let her try it alone.
choices.chinese: 说你留在这儿，让她自己走一回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pushes her sleeve up off the watch and checks it again.
beats.chinese: 她推开挡着表的袖子，又看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend gets here at eleven. I said I'd be there. I turned up early on purpose so I could do something as daft as walk the same boards twice.
beats.chinese: 我朋友十一点到，我说了我会去。我故意早来，好干点傻事，比如一块木板踩两遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She faces the front again, letting people come through between her and the shore wall.
beats.chinese: 她又转回前头，留出和岸墙之间的空当给人走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got some of my spare time left. I don't have to use every last minute of it.
beats.chinese: 我预留的时间还剩点。也不一定非得用光才行。

choices.english: Suggest waiting a little before deciding which way to walk.
choices.chinese: 建议在这儿停一下，再想往哪边走。

choices.english: Ask if she might enjoy getting to her friend early.
choices.chinese: 问她现在早点去见朋友，会不会也挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She walks back at your pace and doesn't speak as the trees thin. Her thumb taps once against the seam of her coat.
beats.chinese: 她按你的步子往回走。走到树稀下去的那一段，她一直没讲话，拇指在大衣缝边轻敲了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That's the bit I always miss.
beats.chinese: 喏。就这儿，我每次都错过去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A moment later she stops. She looks along the boards in both directions.
beats.chinese: 又过一会儿她站住了，朝木板路两头都望了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can talk again. I didn't think anybody would actually do the quiet bit with me.
beats.chinese: 可以说话了。我还真没想到有人肯陪我安静这么一段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a quick nod and takes the first few steps facing the other way.
beats.chinese: 她朝你点了下头，自己掉头走出几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll slow down when I get to the gap. I missed it last week trying to get ahead of somebody.
beats.chinese: 到那一豁我走慢点。上礼拜我光顾着想超过一个人，又走漏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes another step and puts her hands into her pockets.
beats.chinese: 她再迈一步，把手揣进兜里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See you. I'm going to look up this time.
beats.chinese: 回头见。这回我得抬头走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves to the edge of the boards and pulls the watch back under her sleeve.
beats.chinese: 她站到木栈道边，把表重新收到袖口里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stand here for a minute. I don't actually have to spend my whole morning getting somewhere.
beats.chinese: 我在这儿站会儿。也不用一上午都在忙着去哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks across the lake as a little patch of sun shifts over the water.
beats.chinese: 有一小块日光在湖面上晃过去，她越过水面望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I know when I've got to go. I'm fine here till then.
beats.chinese: 什么时候该动身我心里有数。之前就搁这儿待着挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She fastens her watch strap one hole tighter and starts walking in the direction she was already facing.
beats.chinese: 她把表带扣紧一格，照刚才面朝的方向走了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, she always gets there early too. The two of us pretend we don't know that about each other.
beats.chinese: 也是，她每次也早到。我俩还都装作不知道对方有这习惯。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few steps on, she looks back over the shoulder with the lake behind it.
beats.chinese: 走了几步，她从朝湖的那边肩膀上回头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm leaving this way today. I've got another day for the other one.
beats.chinese: 今天就走这头。另一头留到改天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One morning a few days later, Sasha recognizes you on the lakeside boards with a folded paper bag tucked against her wrist.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，清早，萨莎在湖边木栈道上认出了你。她拿手腕夹着一只叠起来的纸袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I'm early for breakfast and I've already got half a bun in here. Reckon I've messed up the order of things.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我来吃早饭，又到早了。袋里现在已经剩半个面包了。我这顺序好像反了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the top tight enough to keep the crumbs in and slips the bag into her coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 她把袋口折严，不让碎屑掉出来，再揣进大衣兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, I'm on time. That's all I promised anybody.
beats.chinese: 反正没迟到。我答应人家的也就这一条。

causality.presenceReason: 赴岛上约见之前预留了绕行时间
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢走同一个目的地但换一个先后
causality.stayingConstraint: 到点前可以绕回去，见面不能迟
causality.currentGoal: 在湖边找到一段没从相反方向走过的板路
causality.currentState: 心情好，不介意别人当她走冤枉路，也不轻易跟着走
causality.contactTrigger: 走来时数板接缝，停下转身前问玩家从另一边来是否宽敞
causality.characterContinuity: 做事准，不为玩耽误约，不因别人讲效率就丢掉绕行
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 同走眼前一小截。ab 变更走法自己试。ba 停在这里预留回程。bb 直接先去见面
causality.spatialContinuity: 都在可见栈道内，没给时刻表或编支路
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 只认得彼此，重逢的早餐和时间约束是当日的

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon traces a bell in the air with a finger, watching the silver and gold decorations above the fish counters.
beats.chinese: 德文仰脸看着鱼档上头金银色的挂饰，拿指尖在空中描了个钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Do those bells look like they'd fit on a grid? I've got half a skyline at home and an awful lot of empty pegboard.
beats.chinese: 你看那几个钟，放到方格里好画吗？我家钉板上有半截天际线，另外半截还空着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fish a loose peg out of a coat pocket and hold it in the palm of a hand.
beats.chinese: 德文从外套口袋摸出一根散钉，摊在手心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Came in for fish. Now I'm trying to spend Saturday on a building nobody asked me to make.
beats.chinese: 我本来是来买鱼的。现在满脑子想把周六搭进去，拼一栋谁也没托我拼的楼。

choices.english: Ask how they'd make a bell out of pegs.
choices.chinese: 问问用钉子怎么拼出钟来。

choices.english: Ask what they wanted to do on Saturday before seeing the bells.
choices.chinese: 问他们看见这些钟之前，周六打算干什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon taps the peg against two spots on a shopping list, leaving a gap between them.
beats.chinese: 德文拿钉子在购物单上点了两下，中间隔着一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A little crown up top, then you widen it. The bottom's the part I never get even.
beats.chinese: 上头先收个尖，再一排排放宽。我最拼不平的就是下面那一截。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The list turns over. The blank side is creased down the middle.
beats.chinese: 购物单翻了个面，空白那面中间有道折痕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Three rows would tell me if it works. I've already used up two weekends this month, though.
beats.chinese: 拼三排就知道行不行。可我这个月已经花了两个周末在这上头。

choices.english: Ask if they have enough pegs already.
choices.chinese: 问他们现成的钉子够不够用。

choices.english: Suggest saving only the test of three rows for another day.
choices.chinese: 提议改天只试那三排。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon folds the list lengthwise and slips the peg into the fold.
beats.chinese: 德文把单子对折，将钉子夹进折缝。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wanted to sleep. Then make something with potatoes that takes all afternoon. God, now I'm hungry.
beats.chinese: 想睡个懒觉，再拿土豆弄点吃的，炖它一下午。哎呀，我现在就饿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A shopper stops at the fish counter. Devon moves to the edge of the aisle.
beats.chinese: 有位顾客停在鱼档前。德文往过道边让了让。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I start drawing now I'll go home with half a list and nothing to eat.
beats.chinese: 我现在要是一画起来，回去准是单子上还有半截没买，饭也吃不上。

choices.english: Suggest getting the food first and seeing what happens later.
choices.chinese: 提议先买吃的，别的回头再说。

choices.english: Ask if they can take Saturday off even if the picture stays unfinished.
choices.chinese: 问那幅画就算没拼完，周六能不能照样歇着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon counts on three fingers, then puts the shopping list back in a pocket.
beats.chinese: 德文掰了三根手指，又把购物单揣回兜里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got enough if I pull a few out of the roof. I was going to buy a whole bag for that one corner.
beats.chinese: 把屋顶上的拔几根下来就够了。我刚还想为了那一角再买一袋呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They glance up at the silver bell once more. The phone stays down.
beats.chinese: 德文又抬头看了眼那只银钟，手机没再举起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. Roof can have a hole for a week.
beats.chinese: 成。屋顶先缺一礼拜吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon uses a fingernail to crease three lines into the back of the shopping list.
beats.chinese: 德文用指甲在购物单背面压出三条线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Three rows, next month. I'll stick it to the board, so I don't get all the pegs out on Saturday.
beats.chinese: 三排，下个月来。我把这张贴板上，省得周六手一痒，又把钉全掏出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They show you the three lines, then fold the paper with the creases on the inside.
beats.chinese: 给你看过那三条线，德文就把纸对折，把折出来的线盖进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't let me buy a whole bag of pegs for three lines.
beats.chinese: 我可不能又为了三条线去买一整袋钉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon opens the list at the crease and puts a finger on the first line.
beats.chinese: 德文摊开单子，手指落在第一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Potatoes. Look at that, I actually wrote it down.
beats.chinese: 土豆。你看，我还真记了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the note around the peg and turn back towards the counters.
beats.chinese: 德文拿单子裹着钉子，转回柜台那边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll get the fish last. I can think about little bells once I've eaten.
beats.chinese: 鱼留到最后买。等吃上饭，我再想那几个小钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon puts the peg back in the coat pocket and closes the open shopping tab on the phone.
beats.chinese: 德文把钉子放回衣兜，关掉手机上开着的购物页面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can. I might have to spend a minute looking at the big hole first.
beats.chinese: 能啊。就是得先盯着那块空的难受一小会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pick up the shopping bag and turn its opening towards the fish counter.
beats.chinese: 德文提起购物袋，袋口转向鱼档。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Saturday's mine. The board can sulk.
beats.chinese: 周六归我。让钉板自己晾着吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another market day you see Devon trying to turn a takeout carton inside a paper bag. They look up over the corner.
beats.chinese: 改天逛市场，你看见德文在纸袋里转一个外卖盒。盒角翘出来，德文越过去抬眼看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. They packed it flat, then handed it to me sideways. I've been holding my breath since the counter.
beats.chinese: 嗨。人家平着装好，递给我时又竖起来。从柜台走这几步，我大气都不敢出。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon supports the bottom with both hands. The carton settles flat.
beats.chinese: 德文两手托住袋底，盒子终于摆平了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If there's a bit missing from the pie, it'll be up in that corner. I'll find out at home.
beats.chinese: 馅饼要是缺一块，准挂在那一角。回家再看吧。

causality.presenceReason: 买自己周末吃的菜，顺手带了软尺
causality.placeAttitude: 市场里不用久留
causality.stayingConstraint: 鱼要最后买，买完回家
causality.currentGoal: 决定还要不要为半张图买材料
causality.currentState: 早起空肚子，算账越算越烦
causality.contactTrigger: 端详柜台上方挂饰时顺口向在旁的人求证图形
causality.characterContinuity: 不拿缺席的人取乐，周末早划出的空档不再随便让掉
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 只记现成材料。ab 定下一个可做的小块。ba 先吃饭不动图。bb 取消今晚的动手计划
causality.spatialContinuity: 只在柜台顾客侧看挂饰与比画，工具和袋子都不跨柜台
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 认得对方，取菜途中才看到袋角顶出来

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the fish counters a woman holds a shopping bag open with one elbow and reads a message on her phone.
beats.chinese: 鱼档前，一个女人用胳膊肘撑着购物袋，低头读手机上的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Silly question. If somebody says put me down for that ladder, have they booked it or are they just thinking about it?
beats.chinese: 问你个傻问题。人家说梯子帮我留一下，你觉得是定了，还是就随口问问？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers her phone below the counter edge so the screen faces her bag.
beats.chinese: 她把手机放低到柜台沿下面，屏幕对着自己的袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm here splitting a fish with my neighbour. Meanwhile there's a ladder on our block with three people treating it like it's theirs.
beats.chinese: 我是来跟邻居分条鱼的。结果我们那条街上有把梯子，三个人都当是自家的。

choices.english: Ask whose message she's reading.
choices.chinese: 问谁发的消息。

choices.english: Say you wouldn't book anything based on that line alone.
choices.chinese: 说光凭这一句还不敢替人定下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pinches the shopping bag shut before she looks down again.
beats.chinese: 她先捏住购物袋口，才低头接着看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Elaine wants to paint a fence. I found out from somebody who isn't Elaine, which is exactly how I get in trouble.
beats.chinese: 伊莱恩说要刷围栏。可跟我说这事的不是她。每次麻烦都是这么来的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her thumb hovers over a different name in the message list.
beats.chinese: 她的拇指悬在消息列表里另一个名字上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I need it Sunday morning. I could ask her what she wants or tell her when I'll be done with it.
beats.chinese: 我周日早上得用。可以问问她要哪会儿，也可以只说我几点用完。

choices.english: Ask Elaine what she had in mind.
choices.chinese: 提议直接问伊莱恩打算什么时候用。

choices.english: Suggest putting down only her own time.
choices.chinese: 建议先只报她自己要用的时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the screen off. A gold bell hangs above the counter at the edge of her view.
beats.chinese: 她把屏幕关了。柜台上头一只金钟，就在她眼梢能看见的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. And next thing I know I'm telling a fourth person when I think Elaine's painting. Elaine would rightly tell me to get lost.
beats.chinese: 是啊。再往下我就该跟第四个人说，我猜伊莱恩要几点刷漆。她知道了肯定叫我少管。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws the bag up against her hip as someone steps towards the fish counter.
beats.chinese: 有人走向鱼档，她收了收袋子，把它贴到胯边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My neighbour should be here any minute. She's going to ask if I remembered which fish she wanted.
beats.chinese: 我邻居一会儿该来了。她肯定先问我，还记不记得她要哪种鱼。

choices.english: Let her get back to ordering the fish.
choices.chinese: 让她先去买鱼。

choices.english: Ask how long she's been keeping track of the ladder.
choices.chinese: 问她管这把梯子的事管多久了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens a conversation with Elaine and types a question, leaving it there on the screen for a second.
beats.chinese: 她点开跟伊莱恩的聊天，写了个问句，在屏幕上留了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: When do you need it? Look at me, asking the person who actually knows.
beats.chinese: 你什么时候用？瞧我，居然想起来问知道的人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends it. When the fishmonger turns towards her, she puts the phone all the way away.
beats.chinese: 她发了出去。摊主转向她，她干脆把手机收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. We're splitting one. Could you show me that one at the front?
beats.chinese: 你好，我们两家分一条。能给我看看最前面那条吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her time in the message and deletes the next line before sending it.
beats.chinese: 她填上自己要用的时间，又把下一行删掉，才点了发送。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sunday till eleven. Had to take out the part about the fence. I don't even know if she's bought paint.
beats.chinese: 周日，用到十一点。我把围栏那句删了。我连人家买没买漆都不知道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She drops the phone into the shopping bag, then takes it back out at once.
beats.chinese: 她把手机扔进购物袋，立刻又捞了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly put that where the fish is going. It's been that sort of morning.
beats.chinese: 差点把手机放到等会儿装鱼的地方。我这一上午真是的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the bag and brings up a message with a picture of a fish in it.
beats.chinese: 她放低袋子，翻出一条消息。里头有张鱼的照片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, she sent me this. I should look at it before I confidently ask for the wrong one.
beats.chinese: 对了，她发过图。我得先看一眼，省得信心十足买错鱼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the picture at chest height, facing the counter now.
beats.chinese: 她把手机拿到胸口高，转身面向柜台。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me, have you got any of this today?
beats.chinese: 麻烦问一下，今天有这种吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lets out a short breath and pulls one bag handle over the other.
beats.chinese: 她短短地出了口气，两只袋把往一起拢了拢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Since somebody left it behind my bins. I'm going to keep the names to myself. There's a fish in this for me if I stop talking.
beats.chinese: 从有人往我家垃圾桶后一搁那天算吧。谁放的我就不说了。我少说两句，今天还能买上鱼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She makes room at the counter end, then raises a hand towards someone farther down the aisle.
beats.chinese: 她从柜台头让开，朝过道那头一个人抬了抬手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is. Did you send me the whole fish or the bit you wanted?
beats.chinese: 她来了。哎，你发我的图是整条鱼，还是你要的那一截？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later visit to the market, Rosalind recognizes you with an empty shopping bag folded under her arm.
beats.chinese: 隔了几天，你在市场又碰到罗莎琳德。她胳膊底下夹着叠好的空购物袋，一眼就认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hi. I came for fish and got asked if I knew who took the folding chairs out of the hall.
beats.chinese: 哎，你好。我来买鱼的，倒有人问我知不知道谁把活动室的折叠椅搬走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls the bag open. A little paper list slides to the bottom.
beats.chinese: 她把袋子拉开，一小张纸单滑到了袋底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do know. They're back already. I'm going to buy my dinner before anybody asks me to count them.
beats.chinese: 我还真知道。早搬回去了。趁还没人让我数，我先把晚饭买了。

causality.presenceReason: 买和邻居合分的鱼
causality.placeAttitude: 乐意在人多处碰着熟面孔
causality.stayingConstraint: 邻居稍后就来取自己的份
causality.currentGoal: 搞清公用梯子是不是已经有人要
causality.currentState: 话到嘴边想把半听来的消息当真，勉强忍住
causality.contactTrigger: 她念叨手机里的预借消息，见有人停住就问词义
causality.characterContinuity: 擅长串事，但没核实的坏消息不传，晚间是自己的
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 直接问本人。ab 暂时只留自己的时段。ba 说回买鱼。bb 不举例也不谈邻居私事
causality.spatialContinuity: 顾客侧等鱼，梯子远在住家并未出现
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 只认得彼此，今天的椅子没有前置

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman on the customer side of the fish counters has her phone pointed up at two of the bells hanging overhead.
beats.chinese: 鱼档的顾客这边，一个女人正把手机朝上，对着头顶两只钟形挂饰。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, I'm trying to leave everybody's head out of the picture. Have I caught yours?
beats.chinese: 不好意思，我尽量不拍到别人的脑袋。没把你拍进去吧？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the screen before touching the shutter. The phone in her hand buzzes twice.
beats.chinese: 她看清屏幕才要按快门，手机在手里振了两下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my friend. We're seeing a film in a bit. She can't save anything till after the credits.
beats.chinese: 我朋友。等会儿我俩看电影。她那人什么话都等不到字幕放完再说。

choices.english: Point out where the two bells clear the crowd.
choices.chinese: 指给她看往哪儿抬一点，人就不会入镜。

choices.english: Ask whether her friend is waiting to hear back.
choices.chinese: 问她朋友是不是在等她回消息。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the phone another inch. Two bells sit at the top of the screen with an empty strip between them.
beats.chinese: 她把手机又抬高一点，两只钟到了画面顶端，中间空着一条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's it. I spent thirty years moving parsley by about that much. Never put my name on a photo.
beats.chinese: 对，就这个位置。我以前干了三十年这种活儿，把欧芹往旁边挪这么一点。照片上一回也没署过我的名。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her finger stays above the shutter. Someone passes very close on the counter side.
beats.chinese: 她手指悬在快门上。柜台这边，有人贴得很近地走了过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And I'm doing it again now. I could just take it or buy my fish like I came to do.
beats.chinese: 我现在又来了。拍了算了也行，按原计划买我的鱼也行。

choices.english: Tell her the frame is clear for a quick picture.
choices.chinese: 提醒她现在画面里没人，可以拍一张。

choices.english: Suggest keeping the phone down and buying the fish.
choices.chinese: 建议放下手机，先买鱼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the phone and reads the line above the voice message.
beats.chinese: 她放下手机，读了读语音上头那行字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's sent me forty seconds about the ending. We haven't even sat down yet.
beats.chinese: 她发了四十秒给我讲结局。我俩连座位还没坐上呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pushes her glasses up her nose with the knuckle of her index finger.
beats.chinese: 她用食指关节把眼镜往鼻梁上推了推。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I want to find out in the cinema. Knowing her, she might just be telling me how much she hates it when the lights stay up.
beats.chinese: 我想在电影院自己看出来。不过以我对她的了解，说不定她只是在抱怨灯老不关。

choices.english: Suggest leaving the voice message until after the film.
choices.chinese: 建议等散场才听那条语音。

choices.english: Suggest asking whether it contains a spoiler first.
choices.chinese: 建议先发一句问问有没有剧透。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses the shutter once and turns the phone around. Two bells and a strip of ceiling fill the screen.
beats.chinese: 她按了一次快门，翻过手机。屏幕里是两只钟和中间一条顶棚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. No heads, no parsley. I can live with the wonky one on the left.
beats.chinese: 成了，没拍着脑袋，也没摆欧芹。左边那只歪就让它歪着吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks at it for another second, then sets the phone in her bag.
beats.chinese: 她又看了一秒，把手机放回袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might send it to her without a word. See how much she can get out of that.
beats.chinese: 我可以光把图发给她，一个字不写。看她能念叨出些什么来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the camera in one motion and puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 她顺手关掉相机，把手机收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't need it in my phone. I can still see it from here.
beats.chinese: 我也不用非存手机里。我就在这儿看得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits for the shopper beside her to finish at the counter.
beats.chinese: 她站在旁边，等另一位顾客买完。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now. If I get something that fits in my smallest pan, I might actually cook when I get home.
beats.chinese: 好了。我要是挑块能塞进我那口小锅的，回家没准还真会开火。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She marks the message unread and slips the phone away.
beats.chinese: 她把语音标回未读，收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll hear it after. If she tries to tell me in the dark, she knows what face she's getting.
beats.chinese: 我散场再听。她要是敢在黑里跟我讲，她知道我会给她个什么脸色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves a step towards the fish counter and turns her empty bag right side out.
beats.chinese: 她朝鱼档走近一步，把空袋子翻回正面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We'll talk all the way home. She's got that to look forward to.
beats.chinese: 回家一路让她说个够。这会儿就先盼着吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She types a short question. A reply lights up the screen before she has put the phone down.
beats.chinese: 她打了一句短话。还没放下手机，回复就亮起来了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No spoilers. It's about the ticket she can't find. Well, that's a whole different problem.
beats.chinese: 没剧透。她说的是票找不着了。哎哟，那就两码事了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She steps out of the queue and holds the phone to her ear.
beats.chinese: 她从队里退出来，把手机贴到耳边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fish in a minute. Let me hear where she last had it.
beats.chinese: 鱼等会儿再买。我先听听她最后在哪儿见过那张票。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another morning, Gloria sees you by the market's fish counters. She's folding a paper ticket to fit inside her purse.
beats.chinese: 又一天早上，格洛丽亚在市场鱼档边看见你。她正把张纸票折小，好放进钱包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I saw a film yesterday that made me furious. Sat there like a saint for ninety minutes.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我昨天看了部片，气死我了。在里头规规矩矩坐了九十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slots the ticket in behind a card and pushes the purse shut with both thumbs.
beats.chinese: 她把票插进一张卡后面，两根拇指把钱包按紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Then I talked for an hour in the lobby. My friend had to buy us both a drink just to get me to stop for a sip.
beats.chinese: 然后我在大厅里一说就是一个钟头。我朋友还得给我俩各买杯喝的，才让我停下来喝了口水。

causality.presenceReason: 电影前买自己晚饭用的鱼
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢室内光落在柜台在这一会儿的样子
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友在等着汇合去看电影
causality.currentGoal: 选完鱼，免得又迟到
causality.currentState: 上午一刻没闲下，想安静，却忍不住为拍照争一句
causality.contactTrigger: 架手机想拍挂钟，路人恰在取景里，她主动问能不能朝上拍
causality.characterContinuity: 电影放映时不说话，电影外面可以聊个够，不教训没有过错的人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 只拍了顶上两只钟。ab 果断不拍。ba 放过朋友的语音等见面说。bb 自己先听消息，回头再买鱼
causality.spatialContinuity: 柜台顾客侧，只拍上方，不动商品和挂饰
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 只认得对方，今天另约的电影和散场话题不需要先前经历

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: White huts stand in front of the red brick on Trinity Street. A man's phone plays his own voice back at him: One more round, right now.
beats.chinese: 特里尼蒂街的红砖墙前立着白色小屋。一部手机放出了主人自己的声音：再来一局，就现在。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that was loud. Did it sound like I was telling him off?
beats.chinese: 哟，这么大声。听着像我在训人吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the volume down, then looks past the huts and back at the screen.
beats.chinese: 他调低音量，越过小屋望了眼街上，又看回屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's for my nephew. He just beat me at a rhythm game and I want another go. I've only got half a song before Dot gets here, mind.
beats.chinese: 发给我外甥的。他刚玩音游赢了我，我想再打一局。不过多特马上就来，我顶多还能打半首。

choices.english: Ask how close the score was.
choices.chinese: 问他俩差了多少分。

choices.english: Tell him it did sound a bit sharp.
choices.chinese: 跟他说听着是有点冲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He zooms in on a screenshot. Two scores sit one above the other.
beats.chinese: 他放大一张截屏。两个分数一上一下挨着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six points. That's close enough to be annoying. You ought to have seen what I used to do for six seconds of air time.
beats.chinese: 就差六分。差多点我还没这么烦。以前在台里，为了多挤六秒出来，我能忙成什么样，你是没见过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts a gloved thumb over the microphone button.
beats.chinese: 他戴着手套，把拇指搁在录音键上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He would get a kick out of hearing me admit it. I can do that in six seconds.
beats.chinese: 我要是亲口认输，他能乐半天。六秒够我说了。

choices.english: Ask him to give his nephew the win out loud.
choices.chinese: 请他真给外甥认个输。

choices.english: Suggest arranging the rematch for when he's home.
choices.chinese: 提议他回家再约下一局。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He plays the first second back with the speaker close to his ear.
beats.chinese: 他把扬声器贴近耳朵，又放了一秒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, that's my studio voice. We used it when a presenter missed a cue. My nephew just sent me a score. Poor kid.
beats.chinese: 嗯，是我棚里那声音。主持人漏看提示，我就这么喊。我外甥就给我发了个分，招谁惹谁了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the time on his phone and lets that recording sit on the screen.
beats.chinese: 他看了眼手机上的时间，那条录音还在屏幕上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dot won't thank me if I've got my headphones in when she shows up. I can send a text, or leave the boy in peace.
beats.chinese: 多特来的时候我要是还戴着耳机，她可要嫌我。我打个字也行，也可以先不烦那小子。

choices.english: Let him drop it and get back to waiting.
choices.chinese: 让他先算了，专心等人。

choices.english: Suggest a short text telling his nephew he did well.
choices.chinese: 建议就回几个字，夸外甥打得好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps record, holds the phone lower this time and throws a quick look in your direction.
beats.chinese: 他点下录音，这回把手机拿低了，还飞快瞟了你一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six points. You got me. I've even got a witness, if you don't believe I said it.
beats.chinese: 六分。算你赢。我这儿还有人听见呢，你可别说我没认。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends it and squints at the screen. A laughing face comes back before he can lock it.
beats.chinese: 他说完点了发送，眯眼看着屏幕。还没来得及锁屏，那头就回了张笑脸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That didn't take him six seconds.
beats.chinese: 他回得可比六秒快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His thumb comes off the microphone. He types with one glove tucked under his arm.
beats.chinese: 他松开录音键，把一只手套夹在胳膊底下，腾手打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said after supper, at mine. I'll even let him pick the song. I never said I'd like it.
beats.chinese: 我说吃过晚饭来我家打。歌都让他挑。不好听我可照样说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the glove back on and turns towards the street.
beats.chinese: 他把手套重新戴好，转身望向街上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you are, Dot. I'm ready.
beats.chinese: 多特，你来啦。走吧，我好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He clears the recording, locks his phone and slips it into his coat.
beats.chinese: 他删掉录音，锁了手机，往大衣里一揣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Let him enjoy his six points. He'll bring them up himself next time.
beats.chinese: 让他得意去吧，就那六分。下回他自己准还提。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stamps the snow off the toes of his boots and shifts to face up the street.
beats.chinese: 他跺掉靴尖上的雪，换了个方向，朝街上望过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait here. Dot went that way.
beats.chinese: 我就在这儿等。多特往那头去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He clears the recording and moves his phone towards you, just far enough to show a line of type.
beats.chinese: 他删掉录音，把手机往你这儿递了点，刚好看得见一行字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All I've got is nice work. Does that look like I'm being sarcastic now?
beats.chinese: 我就写了个打得好。这回不会又像阴阳怪气吧？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down at the line himself, adds a little clapping icon and presses send.
beats.chinese: 他自己低头又瞧了眼，加了个鼓掌的小图标，按下发送。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. He'll know it's me from the terrible emoji.
beats.chinese: 行了。这么土的表情，他一看就知道是我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another winter afternoon on Trinity Street, Gus holds a small drawing at arm's length. He lowers it when he sees you.
beats.chinese: 又一个冬天的下午，格斯在特里尼蒂街伸着胳膊看一张小画。见到你，他把画放低了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hi. I'd drawn the bricks, then rubbed most of them out. Have a look if you like.
beats.chinese: 哎，你好。我本来画了砖，后来又擦掉大半。想看就看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Two thick pencil strokes remain beneath the top edge of the drawing. He brushes eraser crumbs off the paper.
beats.chinese: 画纸上沿下边留下了两道粗铅笔线。他掸掉纸上的橡皮屑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came out for the bit that holds the weight. Somehow I'd spent twenty minutes drawing everything round it.
beats.chinese: 我本来就想画那两根撑东西的。结果旁边那些倒先画了二十分钟。

causality.presenceReason: 陪多特来冬日街区，等她走完自己想走的一段
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢把冬天的外出安排得有点准头
causality.stayingConstraint: 得守和多特约好的时间
causality.currentGoal: 发语音跟外甥争节奏游戏的成绩
causality.currentState: 被外甥赶上分数，想掰扯，又怕听着太认真
causality.contactTrigger: 他把录音误放出声，停下问路过的人听清了哪句
causality.characterContinuity: 守时肯接茬，别人要挪动时间先问清多久，不把安排强塞给人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 录成公开认输的玩笑。ab 把复赛推回家里，按时走。ba 删掉语音，不继续。bb 接受玩家指出语气太硬，改发短消息
causality.spatialContinuity: 始终在特里尼蒂街的冬日室外，白色小屋和红砖只作背景
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢从当天的速写起，与录音和多特无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside the white huts on Trinity Street, a man has a flat box tucked under one arm. A strand of string is caught in the wet wool of his glove.
beats.chinese: 特里尼蒂街的白色小屋旁，一个男人胳膊底下夹着个扁盒子。盒上的细绳勾在他湿乎乎的毛线手套上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on, am I in your way? I can't move this arm without taking the lid with it.
beats.chinese: 等一下，我挡着你了？我这胳膊一动，盒盖也得跟着走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the box towards his chest and edges out of the stream of people.
beats.chinese: 他把盒子往胸口搂了搂，从人流里退到一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's crackers for a friend. I was going to check how many survived the walk.
beats.chinese: 给朋友带的薄脆。我想看看走了这一路，还剩几块是整的。

choices.english: Offer to point out where the string is caught.
choices.chinese: 说可以指给他看绳勾在哪儿。

choices.english: Leave his hands to him and give him more room.
choices.chinese: 再腾点地方，让他自己弄。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tilts the box towards you and stops before the lid slips.
beats.chinese: 他把盒子朝你这边斜了点，赶在盖子滑开前停住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here? Oh, I see it now. It's gone through two loops in the glove.
beats.chinese: 这儿吗？噢，看见了，穿过手套上两个线圈了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the glove still, with the heel of that hand tucked against the box.
beats.chinese: 他把那只戴手套的手抵在盒子边上，先不动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can get at it from this end. Or if you've got a better way, could you show me from there?
beats.chinese: 我能从这头解。你要有更顺手的办法，能站那儿给我比一下吗？

choices.english: Give him time to work it loose himself.
choices.chinese: 让他自己慢慢解。

choices.english: Show him the direction to pull with your own fingers.
choices.chinese: 用自己的手比给他看往哪边抽。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He steps back and puts his bare hand underneath the box.
beats.chinese: 他往回退了一步，用没戴手套的那只手托住盒底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I nearly asked you to hold it, and nobody comes out in this cold to hold my crackers.
beats.chinese: 谢了。我差点还想请你帮我拿。大冷天出来，谁是为了帮我端饼啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the string again. The corner of the lid lifts with his glove.
beats.chinese: 他又看了看细绳。手套稍微一动，盒盖也翘起来一角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can keep my hand like this till he gets here. I just won't look very clever doing it.
beats.chinese: 这么端着等他来也行。就是看着有点傻。

choices.english: Tell him there's room farther along to wait on his own.
choices.chinese: 告诉他可以去前面宽点的地方自己等。

choices.english: Ask if the crackers really need checking now.
choices.chinese: 问他薄脆非得现在检查吗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He works the string back through the wool and holds his free hand up when it comes loose.
beats.chinese: 他把细绳从毛线里原路抽出来。手一脱开，他就举起来给你看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, got it. See, I do occasionally finish a job without asking the whole room.
beats.chinese: 哎，成了。看吧，我偶尔也能不问遍一屋子人，自己弄好一件事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the lid just enough to look in, then turns the gap towards you.
beats.chinese: 他掀开条缝往里看，又把那道缝转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One broke. That one's mine.
beats.chinese: 碎了一块。那块归我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He watches your fingers, then moves his own in the same direction. The string comes away.
beats.chinese: 他看着你比画，照那个方向动了动手。绳解开了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, right. I was pulling it tighter. That's why it kept grabbing.
beats.chinese: 哦，懂了。我刚才越拽越紧，难怪老勾着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a step closer, catches himself, and puts the box back under his arm without opening it.
beats.chinese: 他往前凑了一步，又站住了，把盒子原样夹回胳膊底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was about to get right in your face to see how you did it. I saw it fine from here.
beats.chinese: 我差点又贴过来看你手怎么动的。我站这儿明明也看清了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gets the box level and takes a few slow steps towards a clear bit of pavement.
beats.chinese: 他把盒子端平，慢慢走到前面一块空点儿的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here works. I can put it down on my knee if I have to.
beats.chinese: 这儿行。实在不行我拿膝盖垫一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops there, pulls the glove off with his teeth and leaves the string where it is.
beats.chinese: 他站定，用牙把手套拖下来，绳还留在原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sort it. Thanks for the room.
beats.chinese: 我自己弄就成。谢你给我让地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his arm, leaving the glove pinned flat against the lid.
beats.chinese: 他放低胳膊，把手套平压在盖上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. If they're broken, a look from me isn't putting them back together.
beats.chinese: 倒也不用。真碎了，我看一眼也拼不回去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Someone lifts a hand at the other end of the huts. He lifts his bare hand in reply.
beats.chinese: 小屋那头有人举手，他也举起没戴手套的那只手回应。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There he is. He can do the big reveal.
beats.chinese: 人来了。等他自己揭盖吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a different morning on Trinity Street, Marcus is scrolling through his phone with one hand deep in a pocket. He nods when he spots you.
beats.chinese: 改天早上，马库斯在特里尼蒂街一手揣兜，一手翻手机。他看见你，点了个头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. One of the students made a little wooden stool. It stood better than anything I built when I was learning.
beats.chinese: 嗨。有个学员做了张小木凳。比我刚学那会儿做的稳多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finds the photo, then angles his screen back towards himself.
beats.chinese: 他翻到照片，又把屏幕转回自己这边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a picture. Mind if I show you? It's fine if you've got somewhere to be.
beats.chinese: 我拍下来了。给你看一眼？你要赶路就先走。

causality.presenceReason: 冬日来街区赴饭约，等人时拿一盒薄脆去见同事
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢看东西怎么装起来，今天站外头冻得手笨
causality.stayingConstraint: 同事还没到，东西不能撒在街上
causality.currentGoal: 把绷紧的细绳松开，确认饼没碎
causality.currentState: 跃跃欲试又怕一扯全翻，遇人先征询
causality.contactTrigger: 盒子细绳卡在湿手套上，他一抬头请玩家看是否把通路挡了
causality.characterContinuity: 看到手上活就想凑近看，先问，听到拒绝就后退，不碰他人东西
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 给对方看他自己松绳。ab 问过后从原地看示意。ba 收盒走开等同事。bb 让盒维持原状，见同事再开
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程在街上靠边，盒子是他自己的，未用任何场地设施
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 只认得，照片是今天才找出来的同事作品

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside the row of white huts, a person holds down the voice button on their phone, says three words, then lets go without sending.
beats.chinese: 白色小屋外，有个人按住手机的语音键，说了三个字，又松手取消了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can I ask you something? If somebody says you two go ahead, does that sound like they're joining you for lunch or going home?
beats.chinese: 问你个事。有人说你俩先去，你听着会觉得这人中午也来，还是打算回家？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They rub the edge of the phone against a sleeve. People keep walking between the brick buildings.
beats.chinese: 那人拿手机边蹭了蹭袖子。两旁红砖楼之间，人还在一拨拨地走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I introduced two friends. They're both coming here and I've got as far as talking myself out of lunch.
beats.chinese: 我约了俩朋友，想让他们认识认识。人都说过来了，我倒快把自己说得不用去吃饭了。

choices.english: Ask whether they want to eat with the friends.
choices.chinese: 问他们自己想不想一起吃。

choices.english: Say you can't tell what the friends expect.
choices.chinese: 说听不出来那俩朋友是怎么想的。

beats.speaker: narrator
