beats.english: Their eyes go back to the group message. They keep still until two walkers have passed close by.
beats.chinese: 他们又低头看那几条群消息，等贴身经过的两个人走远了才开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. I've already looked at what I want to order. Then I started doing that thing where I make it easy for everyone and go eat at my desk.
beats.chinese: 想啊。我菜都看好了。后来又犯老毛病，想着干脆给别人省点事，我回工位吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pull one glove off and hold it against the back of the phone.
beats.chinese: 他们脱掉一只手套，垫在手机背面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got half an hour left. I think I've been making this bigger than lunch between three people.
beats.chinese: 我还剩半小时。就三个人吃顿饭，我自己倒想了一大堆。

choices.english: Suggest just telling the group they're coming too.
choices.chinese: 建议直接在群里说自己也去。

choices.english: Suggest saying up front they can stay for half an hour.
choices.chinese: 建议一开始就说自己只能坐半小时。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the phone into an inside pocket. A second later they pull it out again.
beats.chinese: 他们往内兜里塞了手机，刚塞进去，又摸了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Neither of them asked me to go home. I somehow got all the way there by myself.
beats.chinese: 也对。谁都没说让我回去。我自己倒一路想到那儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their thumb rests on the group name without opening the conversation.
beats.chinese: 他们拇指搁在群名上，没点进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Actually, I'm cold and running out of break. I could go. I'd just have to say it's because I'm cold and running out of break.
beats.chinese: 不过我真有点冻得慌，午休也快完了。要走也行，把这俩事说清楚就成。

choices.english: Suggest leaving now and sending that explanation.
choices.chinese: 建议趁现在先走，把原因发给两人。

choices.english: Ask whether they'll want to leave once everybody is there.
choices.chinese: 问人真到齐了，他们还想走吗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon types a line and sends it before putting the glove back on.
beats.chinese: 德文打完一行，先发了才把手套戴回来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said save me a menu. There. The two of them can manage meeting each other while I work out what to eat.
beats.chinese: 我说给我留份菜单。好了。让他俩先认认人，我可以慢慢挑菜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone buzzes. They read the reply almost immediately and puff out a laugh.
beats.chinese: 手机一振，他们几乎立刻低头看了，扑地笑出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They'd already saved me a chair. Of course they had.
beats.chinese: 人家都替我留好椅子了。可不嘛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They type with bare fingers, pausing once to tuck them under the opposite arm.
beats.chinese: 他们光着手打字，中途把手夹到另一边胳膊底下暖了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Half an hour, with me leaving halfway through if the food takes ages. I put the last bit in. Might as well say it.
beats.chinese: 就半小时。上菜太慢，我可能吃到一半就得走。后面那句也发了，这总得讲明白。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the phone away and step up to get a better view along Trinity Street.
beats.chinese: 他们收起手机，往前站了些，好看清特里尼蒂街上过来的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can sit down with them for half an hour. That was all I wanted.
beats.chinese: 能跟他俩坐半小时就行。我本来也就想这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tap out two lines, read them back and press send.
beats.chinese: 他们敲了两行，读了一遍，点下发送。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I told them I need to get back, and gave them each other's names again. They're grown. They can take it from here.
beats.chinese: 我说我得回去，又把他俩名字各说了一遍。都这么大的人了，自己能聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck both hands into their sleeves and start down the street.
beats.chinese: 他们把两只手都缩进袖口，顺街走起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I've got to get lunch before I end up eating the emergency biscuits in my drawer.
beats.chinese: 我得赶紧找口吃的。再不去就只能吃抽屉里的救命饼干了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift their head. Footsteps slow by the huts, but the walker keeps going.
beats.chinese: 他们抬起头。小屋旁的脚步缓了一下，来人又走过去了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, I'd probably stay. I don't need to send them a speech about it, do I? I could just say hi when they get here.
beats.chinese: 应该就不走了。我也不用特地发个长篇大论吧？人来了打个招呼就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They switch off the screen and hold the phone flat in one palm.
beats.chinese: 他们摁灭屏幕，把手机平搁在手心里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give it another minute here. If they both get here, nice. If they don't, I'm going somewhere warm.
beats.chinese: 我再等一分钟。人齐了挺好，再不来我就找个暖和地方去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few days later, Devon is walking along Trinity Street with the bowl of a metal spoon poking out of a paper lunch bag. Devon sees you and lifts the bag in greeting.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，德文提着个午饭纸袋走过特里尼蒂街，一把金属勺的勺头露在外面。见了你，德文抬了抬袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hey. I'm bringing soup to a friend's. Last time I went without a spoon I ate yoghurt with a breadstick.
beats.chinese: 哎，是你。今天给朋友带汤。我有一回没带勺，拿根面包棍蘸着吃的酸奶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They push the spoon deeper into the bag. The handle slips against the paper.
beats.chinese: 他们把勺往袋里按了按，勺柄蹭过纸面，滑下去一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I only brought one. If my friend wants some they'll have to use their own spoon. They do have one, don't they?
beats.chinese: 我就带了一把。我朋友要也想喝，就得动用家里的勺了。家里总有一把吧？

causality.presenceReason: 在特里尼蒂街等一场小聚，替两个朋友搭了线
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢找两人能聊起来的机会，低温使等待更显漫长
causality.stayingConstraint: 三人都没到齐，自己的午休也有结束时间
causality.currentGoal: 决定要不要留下吃饭
causality.currentState: 主动撮合之后怕自己又被落下，有点不自在
causality.contactTrigger: 用语音想给群里解释谁跟谁坐，最后转头问玩家这话听着是否像在退出
causality.characterContinuity: 爱做介绍，不当调解员，自己也想有人陪，没人要求玩家站队
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 明说自己想吃饭。ab 把时间限到半小时。ba 不替别人决定，自己先走。bb 说想留下，但把介绍留到见面之后
causality.spatialContinuity: 始终在红砖街边白屋旁等，聊天只发生在本人手机
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢是另一次小范围聚餐，勺子和当日安排未曾提过

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The steam clock lets out a whistle. At the same instant a paper bag bursts under somebody's arm.
beats.chinese: 蒸汽钟一响，有人夹在胳膊底下的纸袋也在同一刻啪地破了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nice. I couldn't tell which noise was which for a second.
beats.chinese: 妙啊。我有一秒都没分出来哪声是哪声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor opens her phone. A new message pushes the notes screen out of view.
beats.chinese: 努尔打开手机，一条新消息把备忘挡住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. And now a cousin wants me to fix her printer. She hasn't even told me what it did.
beats.chinese: 哦，我表妹又喊我修打印机。出什么毛病也不说。

choices.english: The little pop was the bag. I heard it right here.
choices.chinese: 啪那点声音是纸袋，就在我这儿听见的。

choices.english: Do you have to fix the printer tonight?
choices.chinese: 打印机非得你今晚修吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor holds a finger over the message until it disappears.
beats.chinese: 努尔一根手指悬在消息上，等它自己消失。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The bag was exactly the right length. Whole sound went up at the end.
beats.chinese: 纸袋响得正是时候。尾巴一下就上去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She leaves a line open in her notes.
beats.chinese: 她在备忘里给自己留了一空行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a list at home of things that happened. That might go on. Printer won't.
beats.chinese: 我家有张单子，专记碰上的事儿。这一下可以写。打印机就算了。

choices.english: Write both sounds down together.
choices.chinese: 让她把两声挨着记。

choices.english: Leave it as a noise you heard once.
choices.chinese: 听过这一回也就够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor taps the message without leaving the pavement.
beats.chinese: 努尔站在人行道上点开消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I fixed it once. Now I'm apparently the nearest branch of printer support.
beats.chinese: 不用。我给修好过一回。现在人家当我开了间打印机维修点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Steam clears from the air by the clock. A patch of the sky comes back into view.
beats.chinese: 钟边的白汽散开，原本遮住的一片天又露了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a little time to myself. I'd prefer to be the branch that's closed.
beats.chinese: 今天好不容易空会儿。我这维修点还是歇业吧。

choices.english: Let her say she can't come over.
choices.chinese: 就回一句，今天过不去。

choices.english: Ask if there's one thing she can tell her cousin to check.
choices.chinese: 问她能不能给表妹说个自己能先检查的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She types a line and holds it out for you to read.
beats.chinese: 她写了一行，把屏幕轻轻正过来给你看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Whistle, pop. If I add the time it'll look like an errand. I'm not adding the time.
beats.chinese: 呜，啪。再写几点就跟待办似的。时间就不写了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She saves it and waits until the last steam has thinned.
beats.chinese: 她存下来，站着把最后那点白汽看散。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nobody's going to pay me for listening to that. Thank God.
beats.chinese: 还好听这个没人给我发工资。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the empty note and rests her phone against her leg.
beats.chinese: 她关掉空备忘，把手机贴到腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. It's got a better sound than a description anyway.
beats.chinese: 也是。本来就比写出来的好听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A trolley rolls by, rattling against a seam in the bricks.
beats.chinese: 一辆小推车经过，轮子在砖缝上颠得咯噔响。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We're not writing that one down either.
beats.chinese: 这声也不写。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She types one sentence and turns the phone face down.
beats.chinese: 她敲完一句，把手机翻得屏幕朝下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can't come tonight. Look, I haven't even put sorry on the end yet.
beats.chinese: 今晚去不了。你看，我连不好意思都还没往后加。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks along Water Street through the space left by the clearing steam.
beats.chinese: 白汽散了，她从空出来的地方沿水街望过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I think I'll go and get myself dinner.
beats.chinese: 我去找口吃的吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the conversation and taps out a short question.
beats.chinese: 她点开聊天，敲了个短问句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Is the light on. If she says yes, I'll tell her to call the place that sold it.
beats.chinese: 灯亮了吗。她要说亮的，我就让她给卖机器的打电话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor sends it and puts the phone into the zipped pocket of her jacket.
beats.chinese: 努尔发完，手机放回外套有拉链的兜里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can do one question. It won't become six.
beats.chinese: 只问一句可以。别问着问着变六句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Some days later on Water Street, Noor holds up a small lopsided balloon dog by one ear when she spots you.
beats.chinese: 过几天在水街，努尔一只手拎着个歪歪扭扭的气球小狗，捏着一边耳朵的时候瞧见了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. This is the second ear. First one went straight into my nephew's juice.
beats.chinese: 嗨。这是后来做的耳朵。头一个一脱手，直接飞我外甥果汁里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the dog and presses its feet level with her fingers.
beats.chinese: 她把小狗放低，用手指把几只脚按平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He asked me to make the other side wrong too. He has a point.
beats.chinese: 他叫我干脆把另一边也做歪。有道理。

causality.presenceReason: 下班走水街给自己放会儿空
causality.placeAttitude: 钟边的小事可以记在家里墙上
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友还不能立刻找她改东西
causality.currentGoal: 记录同时冒出的两个声音
causality.currentState: 工作消息追来，实在不想搭理
causality.contactTrigger: 蒸汽钟喷响时眼前纸袋也响，她瞧过来同玩家交换听到的声音
causality.characterContinuity: 不当随叫随到的救火队，愿意讲好玩的事
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 留下两声记录。ab 保留空白。ba 直截了当拒绝修东西。bb 自愿做一点远程提醒
causality.spatialContinuity: 店窗外砖路，不进室内
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢话题是当天做的气球

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A scrap of paper curls up beside Marlowe's thumb on the Water Street pavement. There's a black shape printed on it.
beats.chinese: 水街人行道上，马洛拇指边一张纸片卷了起来，上头印一个黑乎乎的形状。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look at the corner. There's a piece out of it. That's the nicest part.
beats.chinese: 看那个角，缺了一块。就这儿最好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe puts the paper on top of a soft block that fits in one hand.
beats.chinese: 马洛把纸盖到一手握得住的软刻块上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I spend all week putting a number on a missing corner. This one I'm allowed to keep.
beats.chinese: 平常一礼拜都在给缺掉的角报个数。这一个倒可以留着。

choices.english: Ask what the print was supposed to be.
choices.chinese: 问原来想印什么。

choices.english: Ask whether the missing piece changes the whole thing.
choices.chinese: 问缺了这一角，整个是不是就不一样了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe turns the paper until the straight edge is on the bottom.
beats.chinese: 马洛慢慢转动纸片，把直边放到下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A gutter. One from my neighbour's roof. Comes out like a little animal if you put it this way.
beats.chinese: 檐沟，我邻居家房顶那个。这么放又像只小动物。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The block goes into a bag with its carved face up.
beats.chinese: 刻块放进包，刻出来的一面朝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's room to put another one on the envelope. I haven't decided which way up.
beats.chinese: 信封上还能再印一个。我没想好哪边朝上。

choices.english: Leave it with the piece missing.
choices.chinese: 就留下缺那块的样子。

choices.english: Turn the animal the right way up on the envelope.
choices.chinese: 在信封上把小动物转正。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe lifts the paper off the block again.
beats.chinese: 马洛把纸从刻块上再次揭开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It does. Without it, it's a rectangle with a job. I've got enough of those.
beats.chinese: 变了。没这个缺口，它就是个规规矩矩的长方块。那种我见够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The steam clock hisses farther down the pavement.
beats.chinese: 人行道那头蒸汽钟嘶了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can keep it to show my neighbour. I can also just put it in this bag and walk a little.
beats.chinese: 可以留着给我邻居看，或者直接塞包里，再走一段。

choices.english: Save the print for the neighbour.
choices.chinese: 小印留着给邻居。

choices.english: Keep the envelope bare and carry on.
choices.chinese: 信封就空着，接着走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe lifts the paper by its edge and lets the corner curl again.
beats.chinese: 马洛捏起那张纸的边，又让纸角自己卷起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I did that by eye. Nobody needs to ask if it was square to start with.
beats.chinese: 好。凭眼睛刻的，也不用问一开始方不方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The scrap sits loose on top of the other things in the bag.
beats.chinese: 那纸片松松搁在包里其他东西上头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's for looking at when I'm done being accurate.
beats.chinese: 留到我不必再讲精确的时候翻出来看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe turns the block once, presses it against the paper on the envelope and lifts it away.
beats.chinese: 马洛把刻块转了一次，抵在信封的纸上压了一下，又提起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Now it's got a head. Don't ask which part I cut last.
beats.chinese: 瞧，这下有脑袋了。别问我哪儿是最后刻的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe holds out the envelope with the wet ink facing upwards.
beats.chinese: 马洛托着信封，把没干的墨朝上递近一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I never remember that part. I'm not working.
beats.chinese: 那种事我不记的。已经下班了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe folds the scrap in a sheet of used tissue so the ink won't rub off.
beats.chinese: 马洛拿用过的薄纸裹起纸样，免得蹭掉墨。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She'll say I've got the roof wrong. She knows. She's the one who empties it.
beats.chinese: 她会说屋顶刻错了。也就她知道，那上头都是她清的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The wrapped paper goes into a separate pocket.
beats.chinese: 包好的纸另进了一只兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give it to her before we argue about the fig pot again.
beats.chinese: 等会儿为那盆无花果又争起来以前，先拿给她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe slides both the block and the paper into the bag.
beats.chinese: 马洛把刻块和纸都塞进包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I can carry the bit I made. I don't need to make more of it while I'm standing here.
beats.chinese: 也是，把做好的拿着就行。不用站在这儿又接着做。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe takes the open side of the pavement, leaving the shop window clear.
beats.chinese: 马洛沿人行道空着的一侧走，让店窗前头不被挡着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's a decent walk left in the afternoon.
beats.chinese: 这下午还够我走好一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another evening on Water Street, Marlowe recognises you and pockets an old table hockey token.
beats.chinese: 换一天傍晚，马洛在水街认出你，把桌上冰球用的旧游戏币揣起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I beat my neighbour at one game. She asked by how much. Told her I don't remember.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我桌上冰球赢了邻居一把。她问我赢多少，我说不记得。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe rolls the token through the cloth with one thumb.
beats.chinese: 马洛隔着布用拇指滚了滚那枚币。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do. I'm leaving it at won.
beats.chinese: 我记着呢。就说赢了，别的算了。

causality.presenceReason: 约邻居换钥匙代浇水，顺路拓一片图形做印章
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢外面砖面和光影，不想下班再做精确报价
causality.stayingConstraint: 邻居一会儿还要走
causality.currentGoal: 确定这次手工要留下哪个缺角
causality.currentState: 对玩还要量数有点心烦
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家停近钟旁时，印好的边角被风卷起，自己掩住后请看一眼形状
causality.characterContinuity: 报价照规矩，私人东西凭手感，不用讲方法赢人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 让缺口留在纸上。ab 转个角印到封套。ba 给邻居看就行。bb 继续散步让纸留白
causality.spatialContinuity: 水街室外，不在餐桌或钟上拓印
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天说桌上冰球的一次输赢

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Just outside the window, Ren holds a rectangle cut out of a piece of card towards the steam clock.
beats.chinese: 窗外的人行道上，伦拿着一片中间裁成方框的硬纸，对着蒸汽钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Funny. I had a whole picture with a person in this corner. Then you walked through it and that wasn't the corner at all.
beats.chinese: 怪了，原来我想好整张图了，那人站这个角。你一走过去，人根本不在那个角上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren lowers the frame and looks at the pavement beside their shoes.
beats.chinese: 伦放低纸框，看着脚旁边的砖面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you mind standing where you were for a second? I want to see what I'd drawn wrong.
beats.chinese: 方便在刚才那儿再站一秒吗？我想看看自己哪里画岔了。

choices.english: Stand there for a second.
choices.chinese: 回刚才的地方站一秒。

choices.english: Tell them you have to keep moving.
choices.chinese: 说你不能停，得接着走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren lets the real clock sit outside the square and follows the outline of your reflection with their eyes.
beats.chinese: 伦把真钟留在纸框外，视线循着你的倒影走了一段。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's it. I was drawing for somebody looking out of the window. You're already out here.
beats.chinese: 就这个差别。我画的是人在店里往外看。你本来就在外面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren drops the frame and lifts one piece of collage paper.
beats.chinese: 伦把纸框放下，举起一片拼贴纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One change and it gets room to breathe. I don't know if I want to make that change before lunch.
beats.chinese: 改一处，整张就不挤了。也不知道我还想不想赶在吃饭前改。

choices.english: Keep the person's actual position in the picture.
choices.chinese: 照刚才看见的站位，把那个人留进图里。

choices.english: Don't put the person in until they're sure.
choices.chinese: 人先不往里放，等想明白再说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren folds the frame in half with no attempt to follow the moving reflection.
beats.chinese: 伦把框一折，没用它追着倒影走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. You aren't a lamp I can borrow for the shot. I was meant to stop at noon anyway.
beats.chinese: 好。你又不是我能借来打光的灯。本来也说好做到中午就停。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren puts the frame against a sketchbook and checks an unmarked strip at its edge.
beats.chinese: 伦把纸框贴在速写本上，看看靠边还没画过的一条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could mark where I stopped. Or I could just stop.
beats.chinese: 可以记做到哪儿了，也可以就停在这儿。

choices.english: Let them stop on time.
choices.chinese: 到点就收。

choices.english: Mark the unfinished edge so they can come back another day.
choices.chinese: 留个没画完的记号，等改天再接。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren puts a tiny dot where the shadow had crossed the pavement.
beats.chinese: 伦在影子刚越过人行道的位置点个小点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough for a person. I don't have to make it look like you.
beats.chinese: 这么点儿也可以代表一个人，不用非得画得像你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The window catches another walker before Ren closes the book.
beats.chinese: 伦阖上本子前，玻璃里又闪过一个行人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now there are two ways to see it. That was worth standing here.
beats.chinese: 这就能从两个位置看那张图了。没白站。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren moves the scrap of person shaped paper to the unglued margin.
beats.chinese: 伦把那片人形的纸移到没上胶的页边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take it out. If I miss it when I open this again, I've got it right here.
beats.chinese: 先拿掉。改天打开觉得还少了它，纸片就在这儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren shuts the book before putting the frame back in the cover.
beats.chinese: 伦先把本子合上，再把框插进封皮。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going for lunch. I've thought about a corner enough for one morning.
beats.chinese: 吃饭去。一个上午光想一个角，够久了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren pushes the frame into the bag with the square still empty.
beats.chinese: 伦把纸框塞进包，中间还是空的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I'll come back without the drawing and see if I look at the same thing.
beats.chinese: 行。下回不带画过来，看看我还盯不盯同一处。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren lets the bag hang loose from one arm.
beats.chinese: 伦让袋子松松地挂在一边胳膊上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's lighter when I'm not taking it back out.
beats.chinese: 不老往出掏，背着倒还轻点儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren draws a little bracket outside the edge instead of filling it in.
beats.chinese: 伦在页边外画个小括号，里头没添东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's where it ends for today. I can come back and find the same pages when I've got the whole afternoon.
beats.chinese: 今天画到这儿。下回有一整个下午，再翻这几页。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren slides the pencil into a pocket without opening the drawing again.
beats.chinese: 伦把铅笔插进兜，没再翻开画。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good walk. I'll have one without a frame round it.
beats.chinese: 你慢慢走。我也走一段，这回不拿框到处套。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later on a Sunday outside the shop glass, Ren spots you and folds a piece of glossy collage paper into the notebook.
beats.chinese: 后来一个周日，伦在店窗外瞧见你，把一片光面的拼贴纸合进本里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. One minute to noon. I can make that line fit in a minute. I can also eat.
beats.chinese: 嗨。还有一分钟到正午。一分钟也够把那条线贴进去。我也可以去吃饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren shuts the notebook before the phone clock changes.
beats.chinese: 还没等手机上时间跳过去，伦就合上了本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eating wins. The line will be there when I get home.
beats.chinese: 吃饭赢了。回了家那条线还在。

causality.presenceReason: 来找拼贴用的街景，后来察觉自己画熟了就没看人
causality.placeAttitude: 玻璃里的内外反光有不同用途，但行人只在室外
causality.stayingConstraint: 午时收工，哪怕纸上没画完
causality.currentGoal: 确定这张街角图本来要给谁
causality.currentState: 被问到画给谁时，不会武断抢答
causality.contactTrigger: 倒影穿过未完成的取景框，玩家走过时先征求可否借一瞬站位
causality.characterContinuity: 从实际用者的视角琢磨，周日正午之后不做爱好
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 改判断，保留人应在的位置。ab 撤掉自己猜测。ba 拒绝临时延长。bb 划下未完成边界
causality.spatialContinuity: 在 Water Street 店窗外，没有走进倒影中的房内
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 这次说的是另一件拼贴快到时间

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A book slides halfway out of a backpack near the steam clock. Gordon catches it with his elbow.
beats.chinese: 蒸汽钟旁，一本书从背包里滑出半截。戈登用胳膊肘接住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oof. That's my daughter's. I'd have heard about it if I dropped it on those bricks.
beats.chinese: 哎哟，我女儿的。真掉砖头上，我可有得听了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the book against the open bag. A drawing of noodles fills part of the cover.
beats.chinese: 他拿书抵住开着的包。封面一半画的是面条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: D'you read these? Or cook? Anybody in your family put ginger in that kind of broth?
beats.chinese: 你看这种书吗？做饭呢？你家有人给这种汤里放姜吗？

choices.english: Talk about the broth, if we're talking about the broth.
choices.chinese: 就聊汤的话，咱可以聊这个。

choices.english: I'd rather leave my family out of it.
choices.chinese: 我不太想说家里的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the top of the bag outwards so the book can sit in it upright.
beats.chinese: 他把包顶朝外翻开，腾地方让书直着进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's good. The drawing's got two fat slices on the board. I'd take the second out before I served it.
beats.chinese: 这样也好。图里案板上有两片厚姜。换我，第二片上桌前就给捞了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets a finger on the drawing and keeps the book open without pushing it towards you.
beats.chinese: 他一根手指点在图上，本子摊着，没一个劲朝你递。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She lent me this one because she said there'd be fewer things for me to complain about. Not a safe prediction.
beats.chinese: 我女儿借我这本，说里头总该少几处给我挑了。我看这话不好担保。

choices.english: Ask about one detail he liked in the comic.
choices.chinese: 问漫画有哪处他是真喜欢的。

choices.english: Leave the book for his daughter and carry on.
choices.chinese: 把书留给他女儿，先走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops halfway through closing the zip.
beats.chinese: 他拉到一半，拉链停了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Understood. That was rather a personal question. I do apologise.
beats.chinese: 明白。这问得有点私人了。我真不是故意的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets out a short breath and finishes closing the bag.
beats.chinese: 他短短吐了口气，把拉链拉完。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've gone all polite on you now. We can start again with the picture on the book. We can also stop.
beats.chinese: 我现在又开始跟你一套一套客气了。可以就从书皮那碗面说起，也可以不聊了。

choices.english: Stay and talk about the drawing instead.
choices.chinese: 留下，只聊那张画。

choices.english: Let him get back to waiting for his daughter.
choices.chinese: 让他接着等女儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves back to the shop side, leaving the walking line clear.
beats.chinese: 他往店面那头让，行人走的线空了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The cook eats over the sink first. My daughter made me go back to that page. Looked like my kitchen apart from being tidy.
beats.chinese: 厨子先在水槽那儿站着吃。我女儿还叫我翻回去看那一页。也就厨房比我家整齐点，别的真像。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts a finger in the book to keep the page for her.
beats.chinese: 他夹了一根手指在书里，要给她留着这页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm glad she got me reading these. I won't say it where she can hear.
beats.chinese: 她拉我看这个，还真挺好。她本人在我可不说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the book shut and checks both straps on his backpack.
beats.chinese: 他把书合着拿好，两根背带都检查了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. She might want to actually read her own book again at some point.
beats.chinese: 也是。总有一会儿她想自己把自己的书再读一遍呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets the book inside and pulls the zip all the way across.
beats.chinese: 他把书放进去，将拉链一拉到底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give it back without a note full of soup corrections.
beats.chinese: 这回还她，就不附一张全是汤该怎么改的单子了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the book out and turns to the page with the bowl on it.
beats.chinese: 他抽出书，翻到画碗的那页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. Look at that dirty ring where they set it down. That's what got me. I wipe mine and it does that anyway.
beats.chinese: 好啊。看那碗搁下之后，这里一圈脏印。我就喜欢这一处。我家碗擦过，搁下还是那样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the book low so you can look without stepping into the stream of people.
beats.chinese: 他把书拿低，你不用迈进人流也看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I can say something without asking you another thing.
beats.chinese: 瞧，不再问你一遍，我也会说话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rolls his shoulders once and faces down the pavement.
beats.chinese: 他转了下肩膀，朝人行道望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. She'll be here when she gets here. I'll put the book in my hands so she can tell I've found it.
beats.chinese: 行。她来了自然就来了。我把书拿手上，她一看就知道找着了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the book out by the spine and stands a little farther from the clock.
beats.chinese: 他捏着书脊抽出来，站得离钟远了一些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for telling me straight.
beats.chinese: 谢你肯直接跟我说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a different day, Gordon sees you outside the shopfronts and pulls a clean racquet cover a little farther up his shoulder.
beats.chinese: 后来有一天，戈登在沿街店面外看见你，把干干净净的球拍套又往肩上提了一提。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. Went for soup after badminton. Balanced this on my knee for twenty minutes to keep it clean.
beats.chinese: 嗨。打完羽毛球去喝汤。为了别沾着，拍子我放膝盖上端了二十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the cover over. His own trouser leg has a little dark circle on it.
beats.chinese: 他翻过球拍套。自己一边裤腿上倒有小小一圈深印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got the important thing clean. I can wash the other one.
beats.chinese: 要紧的东西是干净的。另一个我还能洗。

causality.presenceReason: 来水街等女儿，刚读过借来的漫画
causality.placeAttitude: 爱在外头边等边聊，容易不知不觉问太细
causality.stayingConstraint: 女儿没到，他该先把借出的书放好
causality.currentGoal: 接住别人拒聊的信号，不冷脸
causality.currentState: 工作少有人说话，一开口又说多了
causality.contactTrigger: 背包张口露出别人的书，玩家正经过，他主动敲敲露出的那角
causality.characterContinuity: 愿意承认越界，给人留退路，不乱保证
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 接受转讲食品疑问。ab 给人留下一位置。ba 少问一句照样聊天。bb 收好书离开
causality.spatialContinuity: 室外砖面，未编店名或蒸汽钟时刻
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另日故事是打球后喝汤

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa reaches over a lunch box just as a phone rises across from her on the path.
beats.chinese: 海堤步道边，对面一只手机刚举起来，蕾娅就伸手挡在饭盒上头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, no. Do it after I've tasted it. I made that hot on purpose.
beats.chinese: 别别。等我尝完你再拍，我特地弄得热乎着呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other person puts the phone down. Léa laughs, then glances your way.
beats.chinese: 那人放下手机。蕾娅笑了，转眼瞧过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Family habit. At every meal growing up, the food had to sit there while somebody made a speech.
beats.chinese: 吵到你啦，我家带出来的习惯。从小到大，一吃饭就有人讲一大通，菜只能搁旁边晾着。

choices.english: Tell her it smells ready to eat.
choices.chinese: 告诉她闻着已经可以开吃了。

choices.english: Ask if they are waiting for anybody else.
choices.chinese: 问他们是不是还在等谁。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the first container. A thin breath of steam crosses her wrist.
beats.chinese: 她打开头一个饭盒。一缕热气从她手腕上过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mm. It is. I made three portions. Our third person's still looking for a place to leave the bike.
beats.chinese: 嗯，早该吃了。我带了三人份。第三个人还在找把自行车放哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips a spare lid under the hot one.
beats.chinese: 她拿一个空盖垫住烫的那个。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put one aside. I don't think we all have to let ours get cold together.
beats.chinese: 我可以单留一份嘛。也用不着大家的非得一块儿凉了。

choices.english: Encourage the two who are there to start.
choices.chinese: 请已经到了的两个人先开吃。

choices.english: Close the third portion tight for the friend.
choices.chinese: 建议把第三份扣严了留给朋友。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the line of the path, then looks at her friend instead.
beats.chinese: 她沿步道望了一眼，又转回来看同伴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, one more. The person here can have theirs any way they like. I don't want to make a speech about not making speeches.
beats.chinese: 还等一个。已经到这位，自己爱怎么吃都行。又不能为了不讲话，先讲一通话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone moves once on top of the spare bag, but stays screen down.
beats.chinese: 备用袋上手机动了一下，仍旧扣着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Somebody else can make the big decision about the camera.
beats.chinese: 好了，拍不拍这种天大的事，也可以交给别人想。

choices.english: Ask the friend if they want a quick photo of their own lunch.
choices.chinese: 问旁边那位要不要拍一张自己的午饭。

choices.english: Leave the camera down and let the two eat.
choices.chinese: 手机就那么放着，让两个人先吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa takes the first spoonful, then puts the lid beneath the box so it stays steady in her lap.
beats.chinese: 蕾娅先吃了一勺，把盖垫在盒底，让盒稳在腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that's good. Now if we took a photo there'd be a great hole in it.
beats.chinese: 哇，真好吃。现在拍的话，中间可挖了一大块了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her friend opens their own box and scrapes a spoon along the corner.
beats.chinese: 朋友也打开自己的盒，拿勺沿盒角刮了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can do another hole next to it.
beats.chinese: 还可以在旁边再挖一个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pushes down on each corner of the third lid, listening for three little snaps and then a fourth.
beats.chinese: 她把第三个盒盖的角挨个按下去。听着咔、咔、咔了三下，又响第四下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, I'll keep that inside my jacket a little while. The rest is fair game.
beats.chinese: 好了，这份先贴我外套捂会儿。剩下的可以开动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slides the closed portion into her bag and leaves the other boxes out.
beats.chinese: 她把扣住的那份滑进袋里，其他盒都留在外头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's going to think we had enormous restraint.
beats.chinese: 那位来了会以为我们忍了好久呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend raises the phone over their own box. Léa has already got a spoon in hers.
beats.chinese: 朋友把手机举到自己盒上头。蕾娅自己这盒里已经插了勺。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Perfect. Mine's got the nice browned bit underneath and I'm not turning it out for proof.
beats.chinese: 好极了。我这盒底下还有块煎焦脆的，就不倒出来给你们证明了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A shutter sound comes just as Léa closes her eyes over the first bite.
beats.chinese: 蕾娅吃上头一口，闭了闭眼，刚好响一声快门。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I hope that was just the stew.
beats.chinese: 但愿就拍了炖菜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other person's fingers move away from the phone. Two lids come off almost together.
beats.chinese: 旁边人的手指离开手机。两个盖差不多同时打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay, before we talk. One bite. Oh, that's spicier than I meant it to be.
beats.chinese: 行，咱先别说。一口。哟，比我想的辣好多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa reaches into the side of her bag and holds up a bottle of water.
beats.chinese: 蕾娅手伸进袋子侧面，拿了瓶水出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tell me the rest after I get my mouth back.
beats.chinese: 等我嘴缓过来，你再接着说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week Léa sees you on the seawall and lifts an empty bowl by two fingertips.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，蕾娅在海堤上见到你，俩指尖捏着举起一只空碗。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. My friend gave this back washed. I feel as if I ought to fill it again before either of us changes our mind.
beats.chinese: 嗨，我朋友洗干净还我的。我都觉得，得趁我俩谁也没改主意，再给人装满一次。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the bowl in against her folded jacket.
beats.chinese: 她把碗贴着叠好的外套收住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No picture this time either. We're going to have it with bread.
beats.chinese: 这回也不拍。弄点面包蘸着吃。

causality.presenceReason: 骑到弯道旁正常停留，带三人份小炖菜给工友
causality.placeAttitude: 海堤方便说上话，但不想让饭在风里凉了
causality.stayingConstraint: 一人迟来，不必让已到的人守着
causality.currentGoal: 把热的先松盖分出，不拖着说场面话
causality.currentState: 赶半天装饭，听见要拍照就急
causality.contactTrigger: 一位朋友举手机，莱娅护住盒笑出声，被近旁玩家听见
causality.characterContinuity: 热情分享，绝不评别人吃多少，不让美食变摆拍
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 先吃一份。ab 把迟到一份盖好。ba 留给朋友自己拍。bb 放过合照，继续随朋友边吃边聊
causality.spatialContinuity: 人和车停在铺装步道旁，未下石岸
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新的邀请是另一天，碗不来自初遇

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A little card lands face down on the seawall path. Ingrid puts the toe of her shoe on it before it can reach the stones.
beats.chinese: 一张小卡片扣在海堤步道上。还没滑到石岸，英格丽先拿鞋尖踩住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got it. It's a name. My sister would probably say it's the wrong name to keep.
beats.chinese: 踩住了，是个人名。我妹大概会说，这名字就不该留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She picks up the card and knocks a small stone off its corner.
beats.chinese: 她捡起卡片，从角上弹掉一粒小石子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fourteen for dinner. Two cousins haven't spoken since February. Funny how they can both manage to ring me.
beats.chinese: 十四个人来吃饭。有两个表亲从二月就不说话了，倒是都知道打给我。

choices.english: Ask if she wants both of them there.
choices.chinese: 问她是不是希望俩人都来。

choices.english: Ask if either one actually said they weren't coming.
choices.chinese: 问其中有没有谁真的说了不来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the card onto a stack the same size.
beats.chinese: 她把卡片放到同样大的一叠上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. They've each got a chair. They can decide what to do with their mouths.
beats.chinese: 想。椅子一人一把。嘴怎么用，人家自己决定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks which names are on top.
beats.chinese: 她看看哪几个名字在最上面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My son says put them at opposite ends. I make dinner at one end of the kitchen. I can't keep moving the kitchen.
beats.chinese: 我儿子说把他俩分到两头。我就在厨房一头做饭。总不能再把厨房也跟着挪。

choices.english: Leave both names on the stack.
choices.chinese: 两个名字都留着。

choices.english: Let them pick where to sit.
choices.chinese: 来了自己挑地方坐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rubs a patch of damp off the side of the card.
beats.chinese: 她抹掉卡片侧面一小块水印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. One asked what the other would be eating. I said whatever everybody else is eating.
beats.chinese: 没有。有个问另外那个打算吃什么。我说大家吃什么，那人就吃什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The wind presses her sleeve flat against her arm.
beats.chinese: 风把她的袖子平平地压在胳膊上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not ringing anybody a third time. I've got vegetables to peel when I get home.
beats.chinese: 我不打第三通电话。到家还一堆菜得削皮。

choices.english: Leave the two cousins to sort out whether they come.
choices.chinese: 来不来，让俩表亲自己去想。

choices.english: Suggest putting the cards away and enjoying the walk.
choices.chinese: 建议卡片先收起来，踏实走一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens both cards against her palm and tucks them together.
beats.chinese: 她用手掌托齐两张卡，挨着收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's it. If either chair's empty I'll put the bread on it.
beats.chinese: 就这样。哪把椅子没人，我拿来放面包。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks across the bend towards the buildings.
beats.chinese: 她越过水边弯道瞧了眼对面一排楼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like both of them. I'd rather not forget that while I make the potatoes.
beats.chinese: 我俩人都喜欢。总不能煮着土豆，把这个给忘了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She wipes one little seating mark from the back of a card.
beats.chinese: 她从卡背后擦掉一个标座位的小记号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. I'll put fourteen plates down. I know how to do that.
beats.chinese: 好，我摆十四个盘子。这事我会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The cards go into her inside pocket, all the same way up.
beats.chinese: 卡片都朝一个方向，进了她的内兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If they both want the chair by the radiator, I expect I'll hear them talk at last.
beats.chinese: 俩人要都想坐暖气边，到时候我估计终于能听见他俩说话了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops rubbing the mark and puts the card straight back.
beats.chinese: 她不再擦那一块，直接把卡放回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. They know where the door is. I'm not walking the afternoon calling about a chair.
beats.chinese: 嗯，门在哪儿他们知道。我不为了一把椅子，整个下午边走边打电话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts both hands in her pockets and looks ahead along the curve by the water.
beats.chinese: 她两手放进兜，沿临水的弯道往前看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have the quiet now, before all fourteen get here.
beats.chinese: 趁十四个人还没来，我先清静点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses the stack of cards flat into her pocket and takes her hand away.
beats.chinese: 她把那叠卡片在口袋里压平，抽出了手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I'd only got as far as two cousins and the person who doesn't like draughts.
beats.chinese: 也好，我总共就排了俩表亲和一个怕风的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts along the path at a steady walking pace.
beats.chinese: 她顺着步道慢慢走起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's a perfectly decent bit of water here. I might see it now.
beats.chinese: 眼前这片水看着挺好。这会儿总算能看看了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another evening, Ingrid recognizes you on the seawall with a harmonica turned on its edge in her hand.
beats.chinese: 又一天傍晚，英格丽在海堤上认出了你，把口琴竖拿在手上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I tried a new tune today. It has eight bars. The neighbours have had four.
beats.chinese: 你好，今天试了首新的。一共八小节。邻居已经听了四小节。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the harmonica into a coat pocket and leaves her hand there.
beats.chinese: 她把口琴放进大衣兜，手也留在里头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough for Tuesday. For both of us, I think.
beats.chinese: 周二听这点够了。我和邻居都够了。

causality.presenceReason: 沿熟悉海堤走，想好家宴要不要撤席
causality.placeAttitude: 未起人潮前喜欢在水边慢下来
causality.stayingConstraint: 不为家庭争执回家重新排
causality.currentGoal: 让两位闹别扭的亲戚各有座
causality.currentState: 不想当和事佬，听见别人替她想和气就直说
causality.contactTrigger: 手写席位的一张掉落，自己先用脚压在铺装上，玩家停下后开口
causality.characterContinuity: 愿尽心做菜，亲戚矛盾归本人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 两席都保留。ab 不指定挨着。ba 退出调解。bb 把画一半的座位收起来
causality.spatialContinuity: 铺装步道，石岸和住宅只作背景
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天练口琴，跟宴席无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter stops his old bike by the curve. A recorded bicycle bell rings once from his pocket.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特把旧自行车停在弯道边。兜里响了一声录下来的车铃。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, nobody's behind you. That's a bell I recorded and forgot to switch off.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，你身后没人。是我录的铃，刚忘关了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out the recorder and turns it off properly.
beats.chinese: 他掏出录音机，把它彻底关掉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's meant to be water after the bell. I put it on a tape for a friend. They never said if they'd want it.
beats.chinese: 铃之后还有水声。我给朋友录了盒带子，人家没说要还是不要。

choices.english: Ask what he wanted his friend to hear.
choices.chinese: 问他想叫朋友听到什么。

choices.english: Ask whether he'd leave the tape without asking again.
choices.chinese: 问能不能不再追问，就把带子留给对方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He traces the outside of the cassette case with a thumb instead of opening it.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指沿磁带盒外边划了一圈，没打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Somebody coming past. Then fifteen seconds where nobody does. We used to stop talking on that bend without deciding to.
beats.chinese: 有人走过。然后十五秒，一个人也没来。我俩走到那段弯道，有时不用商量，就一块安静了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the case on top of the bike bag.
beats.chinese: 他把磁带盒搁在自行车包顶上，放妥。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I thought I'd ask him to listen here. He might like it better at home.
beats.chinese: 原想请他当场听。他也许更想在家自己听。

choices.english: Tell him to mention who he thought of when he recorded it.
choices.chinese: 建议直接说录的时候想到谁了。

choices.english: Leave it up to the friend where to listen.
choices.chinese: 让朋友自己挑在哪儿听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the cassette halfway back into the bike bag.
beats.chinese: 他把磁带塞回车包一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I asked if he'd come on the ride. He said maybe. If he wants the tape, that's a different question.
beats.chinese: 问他来不来骑车，说也许吧。至于要不要听磁带，那又是一码事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pats the top of the bag once.
beats.chinese: 他在车包顶上拍了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't want to turn those into two maybes in a row.
beats.chinese: 我不想让人家连着说俩也许。

choices.english: Put a note on the tape and let him find it later.
choices.chinese: 在带子上留句话，等朋友以后看。

choices.english: Keep the tape for himself today.
choices.chinese: 今天自己留着带子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the case and takes the little pencilled card out.
beats.chinese: 他打开盒，把里面铅笔写的小卡抽出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's got Tuesday on it. I could put his name. I was the one who wanted him there.
beats.chinese: 上面只写了星期二。还可以添他名字。原本就是我想他在。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He writes slowly, with the case balanced on the bag.
beats.chinese: 他把盒架在包上，慢慢写。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I can give him that much without asking him to come anywhere.
beats.chinese: 好了。不必再约他去哪儿，也能给他听这一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the case with his thumb on its hinge.
beats.chinese: 他拇指搭着铰链，把盒盖扣下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'll give it to him and go back out. I don't stay in the room when people listen to mine. I can hear myself waiting.
beats.chinese: 成，给他我就再出来。别人听我录的，我从不留在屋里。自己干等的声音我都听得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He wraps the case in a bit of cloth before putting it away.
beats.chinese: 他把盒拿一小块布包好，才收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The bell's on side one. Everything else can be his surprise.
beats.chinese: 铃在第一面，别的让他自己听出来吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds a blank corner of the label away from the cassette.
beats.chinese: 他把贴纸空着的一个角沿着磁带折开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: For when you've got a quiet minute. No question mark. That'll do.
beats.chinese: 有空安静会儿再听。末尾不加问号。成了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He zips the bag and looks along the seawall.
beats.chinese: 他拉上包，沿海堤望过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can take a ride now that I'm not waiting on an answer.
beats.chinese: 这会儿不用等回话，可以去骑一段了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pushes the tape the rest of the way in and rests a hand on the bicycle seat.
beats.chinese: 他把带子全塞进去，手搭在自行车座上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might listen to the water myself first. I haven't done that since cutting it.
beats.chinese: 我也许先自己听一遍那段水声。剪完之后自己还没放过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He switches the recorder off again, though its light was already dark.
beats.chinese: 录音机的灯已经暗着，他又把开关拨到关。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can go on ahead. I need to fiddle with this by myself a bit longer.
beats.chinese: 你可以先走，我在这儿自己多摆弄会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a different morning, Walter sees you alongside the seawall. He has a cassette with a crooked label.
beats.chinese: 后来有个早上，沃尔特在海堤旁瞧见你。他手里一盒磁带，标签贴歪了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Somebody made me one. Eight minutes of the oven at his bakery. He said I could skip his singing at the end.
beats.chinese: 你好。有人给我录了一盒。他面包店烤炉的声儿，八分钟。他说他最后唱的那段，我可以跳过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns it over and looks carefully at the opposite label.
beats.chinese: 他翻过带子，把另一面的标签细细看过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I played that bit twice.
beats.chinese: 就那段我放了两回。

causality.presenceReason: 沿海堤骑到暂停处，公放前戴好耳机等人
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢记录水声，但不录别人当素材
causality.stayingConstraint: 录音已收，朋友没对邀请给准话
causality.currentGoal: 决定要不要留下这盒磁带作一句问候
causality.currentState: 把犹豫当拒绝比开口容易，一时不知说什么
causality.contactTrigger: 声音发出来不是水，是自行车铃，他误放了几秒，看见玩家就笑
causality.characterContinuity: 问过一次不会再问，送磁带让人在自己想听时听
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 说出想录给谁。ab 把共听变单听。ba 留纸不催回。bb 不托话，自己去走
causality.spatialContinuity: 铺装道侧，其余人在正常通行处，未靠近石岸
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢播放盒上明确的新内容

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald takes out a plain wooden handle near the bend in the seawall. A shiny patch catches the light at the thumb end.
beats.chinese: 海堤的弯道旁，埃瓦尔德拿出一个素木柄。拇指那头磨亮的一块正好反了下光。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd know that one in the dark. My friend says he needs a make. I can tell him where the thumb goes.
beats.chinese: 摸黑我都认得。我朋友说得报牌子，我能告诉他的是拇指放哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rolls it once in his hand, then rests it flat.
beats.chinese: 他在手里滚了一下，把木柄平托住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He'll look for another one. Then he'll say I owe him one. We've argued about that for twenty years.
beats.chinese: 他会去帮我找一根，然后说我欠他一次。这事我俩扯了二十年。

choices.english: Ask what he wants a new handle to feel like.
choices.chinese: 问他换一根以后，握着要是什么感觉。

choices.english: Ask whether his friend would really keep score.
choices.chinese: 问他朋友是不是还真会记账。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald sets his thumb in the shiny place.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德把拇指摁进发亮那一块。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Like this. Bit flatter on this side. I can show him the mark without sending him a whole catalogue.
beats.chinese: 就这样，这边扁一点儿。给他看这道印，犯不着把整份目录发过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds it still against the palm of the other hand.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄贴另一手掌，托稳了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's no writing left. A photograph might be more use than my memory.
beats.chinese: 已经没字了。拍一张兴许比我记得准。

choices.english: Show the flattened bit first.
choices.chinese: 先把磨扁那块给朋友看。

choices.english: Take a picture with the thumb in place.
choices.chinese: 把拇指放原位拍一张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald pushes the handle farther into his hand until most of it is covered.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德把木柄往手心深处一送，挡住了大半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. He'd forget the minute I left. I still don't want to say I owe him.
beats.chinese: 不会。我一走，他转头就忘。我还是不想说我欠他的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at the curve of the stones from the paving.
beats.chinese: 他站在铺装道上，看下面石岸绕过去的线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can do something for somebody if I see it needs doing. I don't need the old number.
beats.chinese: 哪天看别人哪儿要帮，我也可以搭把手。甭记原来那个数。

choices.english: Tell him that's all he needs to say.
choices.chinese: 跟他说，说到这儿就够了。

choices.english: Ask what he'd do if the friend does find another one.
choices.chinese: 问朋友真找到了，他会怎么做。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises the handle palm upwards and points with the thumb of his empty hand.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄托起来，用空着那只手的拇指指了指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll show him this. If he can't find it I can use this one another year.
beats.chinese: 就给他看这点。实在找不着，这个再用一年也成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the handle away without getting his phone out.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄收好，手机没拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I was halfway to buying something I can still use.
beats.chinese: 好。差点就为了个还能用的，又买一个回来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald photographs his thumb on the wood. The rest of his hand takes up half the frame.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德照了张自己在木头上按拇指的样子。手有一半都在画面里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. This bit, I can write. He won't need to know the name of my thumb.
beats.chinese: 好了。我就写这里。拇指可不用报型号吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends the picture and pushes his phone deep into his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他把图发了，手机塞进兜底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now we can both forget what the thing's called.
beats.chinese: 这下我俩都可以忘了它叫什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the handle away and leaves both hands where they were, deep in the coat.
beats.chinese: 他把柄收起来，手也原样留在大衣深处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. He can help and still go home without a receipt.
beats.chinese: 也是。帮个忙，回家也不用带张小票。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives the bend ahead an unhurried look.
beats.chinese: 他不紧不慢地望了望前面的弯道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going around the long way. It's bright on the water.
beats.chinese: 我绕远一点儿走。水上亮着呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the handle until it hangs comfortably by his leg.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄放低，舒服地垂在腿旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd take it. Probably bring him something to eat when I've made too much. I'd do that anyway.
beats.chinese: 那就收下。哪回做多了，就给他捎口吃的。本来也会捎。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the handle in his pocket and keeps the thumb outside.
beats.chinese: 他把木柄塞进兜，只把大拇指露在外头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Never know when you've made too much till you've sat down.
beats.chinese: 饭有没有做多，得坐到桌边才知道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One evening later, Evald spots you on the paved walk with a covered bowl held flat against his stomach.
beats.chinese: 后来一个傍晚，埃瓦尔德在铺装步道上看到你，把扣了盖的碗平托在肚子前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Made barley enough for two. I was the only one at home. Again.
beats.chinese: 你好。煮了两人份的大麦。家里就我一个，又做多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks his fingers farther beneath the bowl, where the fabric is warm.
beats.chinese: 他把手指往碗底下垫了垫，托着的布还是暖的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm taking this to a friend. If he calls it even I'll bring less next time.
beats.chinese: 给朋友送去。他要敢说这就算还清了，下回我就少送点。

causality.presenceReason: 带旧柄去跟人比配件前在海堤走路
causality.placeAttitude: 沿城散步不想被手机当作办事时钟
causality.stayingConstraint: 等朋友前可看清手里的物件但不会许人情债
causality.currentGoal: 确认掉漆的工具能认出来还是要拍照
causality.currentState: 懒得记牌名，对邻居把帮忙记账有点不舒服
causality.contactTrigger: 他在石岸上方铺路侧量另一只手掌的宽，看见玩家手空着便伸出自己的柄
causality.characterContinuity: 好用才重要，不把帮忙记账，不拿别人的物件打磨
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 给人看磨损处。ab 拍无牌的指向。ba 退回记账。bb 以后再帮别人一点
causality.spatialContinuity: 只在铺路上，人与旧工具留在石岸内
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 这天是在家多做的一碗

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the end of a table, a woman starts to move her elbow in a slow arc. Her companion puts a napkin over the spot she would have hit.
beats.chinese: 桌头一个女人正要拿胳膊肘慢慢划个弧。同伴拿餐巾盖在她差一点就要碰到的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Not a debate. I heard you.
beats.chinese: 行，不争。我听见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers her arm and sees you on the other side of the aisle.
beats.chinese: 她收了胳膊，看见过道另一边的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry you got the end of that. I throw sandbags with her. Apparently there's a time and a place to wave your arm near lunch.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，叫你听见半句。我跟她一队扔沙包的。看来胳膊可以抡，但得看什么时候，桌上有饭的时候就算了。

choices.english: Ask what made her try her teammate's throw.
choices.chinese: 问她怎么会开始学搭档那一抛。

choices.english: Leave the debate there. What's for lunch?
choices.chinese: 别说扔法了，中午吃什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille sets her forearm flat on the table beside the napkin.
beats.chinese: 米蕾伊把前臂平放到桌上，就搁在餐巾旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It works for her. I got curious. Half a month later my shoulder's still telling me what it thinks.
beats.chinese: 她那么扔还真扔得好，我就想试。都半个月了，这边肩还天天跟我抗议。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops halfway to repeating the swing.
beats.chinese: 她抡到一半，自己停住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can tell her I want my old throw back. I don't have to tell her hers is wrong.
beats.chinese: 可以直说我还想用原来的扔法。不用把她那套说成错的。

choices.english: Say that to her while she's here.
choices.chinese: 人就在这儿，告诉她吧。

choices.english: Keep your next practice for trying your own way.
choices.chinese: 下回去练，用自己的扔法再试。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves the napkin back to its owner's side of the table.
beats.chinese: 她把餐巾移回同伴那一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sandwich. I'm hungry enough not to tell you how to hold it. She's got an hour off and I've used some of it on my elbow.
beats.chinese: 三明治。饿得都顾不上管你怎么拿了。她就歇一钟头，已经陪我说了半天胳膊肘。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other woman glances up from the food counter across the aisle.
beats.chinese: 另一个女人朝过道对面的熟食柜看了眼，抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look, I can change the subject before she has to give me that face again.
beats.chinese: 瞧，我可以先换一个话题，省得她还得再给我那种脸色。

choices.english: Give them a chance to eat.
choices.chinese: 给她们留点空吃饭。

choices.english: Ask her teammate to choose the next subject.
choices.chinese: 让她同伴挑下一个话题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille turns her chair a little towards her companion without moving it into the aisle.
beats.chinese: 米蕾伊把椅子朝同伴转了一点，没挪到过道里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I gave it two weeks. It hurts. I'm switching back.
beats.chinese: 我试了两礼拜，疼。我打算换回去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her companion slides the napkin back towards her without saying anything.
beats.chinese: 同伴把餐巾往她这边又推了推，没讲话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, there's sauce on my sleeve. That had nothing to do with how I throw.
beats.chinese: 哦，袖子上有酱。这个跟我怎么扔可一点关系没有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts her elbow just enough to tuck the napkin under it.
beats.chinese: 她只抬一点胳膊肘，把餐巾塞到下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Next time I'll throw like me and see where it lands. I'll give her way a rest.
beats.chinese: 下回按我自己的来，看落哪儿。她的办法先歇歇。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the bread in her hand where it has come apart at the corner.
beats.chinese: 她瞧了眼手里三明治，角上两片面包分开了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My left hand can hold two things at once. It can start with this.
beats.chinese: 我左手还是能一手拿两样的。先从把这两片夹牢开始。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts two napkins side by side and gets her sandwich out of the paper.
beats.chinese: 她并排放好两张纸巾，把三明治从裹纸里拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I've got other things to use my mouth for.
beats.chinese: 好啊，我这张嘴还有别的用处。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her companion takes a bite first. Mireille follows and does not speak with her mouth full.
beats.chinese: 同伴先咬了一口，米蕾伊跟着吃了一口，嘴里有东西时没再说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's better.
beats.chinese: 这下好多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to her companion and leaves both hands on the table.
beats.chinese: 她转向同伴，两手都留在桌上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Your turn. No sports. Did the man upstairs stop sanding his floor yet?
beats.chinese: 轮到你了。不说比赛。楼上那人地板磨完了没？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her companion opens both hands wide, and Mireille lets out a laugh before the answer starts.
beats.chinese: 同伴两只手一张，还没说话，米蕾伊先笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Here we go.
beats.chinese: 啊，看来有得说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later market day, Mireille spots you and turns a palm sized plastic case so you can see the little screen.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，米蕾伊在市场瞧见你，把个巴掌大的塑料小盒转了转，让你看小屏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I made a weather station. It's doing a very good job predicting rain inside my bag.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我做了个气象站。包里要下雨，它已经预报得特别准了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She blots a spot on the inside of her bag with an old receipt.
beats.chinese: 她拿张旧小票往包里一小片湿痕上按了按。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or I left a bottle open. I'm still collecting evidence.
beats.chinese: 也有可能是我水瓶没拧紧。我还在找证据。

causality.presenceReason: 来市场跟比赛搭档碰头，商量吃点东西再走
causality.placeAttitude: 人多的时候适合停住争执
causality.stayingConstraint: 搭档说这一局不争，必须停
causality.currentGoal: 把练半个月但肩不舒服的事说清
causality.currentState: 很想赢回来，也知道朋友有别的烦心
causality.contactTrigger: 争执被叫停，转身对玩家讲害得人家听了半句
causality.characterContinuity: 被告知不讨论即止，不装同意，对新尝试有兴趣
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 承认耗了半个月。ab 下回自己改。ba 只吃饭。bb 求对方聊别的
causality.spatialContinuity: 熟食通道边，不丢沙包，不进摊面
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来拿自制气象盒，独立于比赛

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren sets his tray in the shade at a shared table. The person across from him covers their eyes with one hand.
beats.chinese: 索伦把托盘往共用桌背阴那侧一放。对面的同伴拿一只手遮住眼睛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I did it again. Got the one seat where you can see your lunch.
beats.chinese: 我又来了。一坐下就挑了个能看清午饭的好位子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He catches your eye on the other side of the table, and moves the tray off the corner.
beats.chinese: 他看见你在桌子另一边，把托盘往里挪，桌角空了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Is it that bright all along that side, or have I found a particularly bad spot for my mate?
beats.chinese: 那一侧整个都这么晃吗？还是我正好给我朋友剩了最差的那个？

choices.english: Look from the bright side before he moves.
choices.chinese: 先从亮的那一侧看看，再挪。

choices.english: Ask his friend what would suit them.
choices.chinese: 问他同伴想坐哪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren comes around his chair and stands where his companion is sitting.
beats.chinese: 索伦绕过椅子，站到同伴坐的那一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh! Straight off the table. I can't read the little receipt from here.
beats.chinese: 哎哟，桌子反上来的。我站这儿，连小票都读不清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts the tray a few inches to see where the reflection goes.
beats.chinese: 他把托盘挪了一小截，看看那片反光跑哪儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It lands on me if we swap. If I turn my tray, it might take the worst off.
beats.chinese: 换个位子就照我。转一下托盘，兴许不至于那么扎眼。

choices.english: Swap seats for this meal.
choices.chinese: 这顿俩人换着坐。

choices.english: Turn the tray until the glare moves.
choices.chinese: 把托盘转到反光偏开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks over the top of the stack of napkins at his friend.
beats.chinese: 他越过叠着的一沓纸巾，看向同伴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Where do you actually want to sit? I thought I got us both a spot. I got me a spot.
beats.chinese: 你真想坐哪儿？我刚以为给咱俩都挑好了，就给自己挑了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other person points towards a quieter table. Soren moves his hands off the tray.
beats.chinese: 另一人指向不那么吵的一桌。索伦两手从托盘上拿开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a good one. I can live without seeing everybody come in.
beats.chinese: 那儿挺好。不看谁进门我也能吃饭。

choices.english: Move to the quieter table together.
choices.chinese: 俩人一起移到安静那桌。

choices.english: Let his friend have the shaded seat here.
choices.chinese: 让他同伴在这桌背阴的那边坐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren pulls his chair clear, waits for his friend to stand, then takes the seat across the table.
beats.chinese: 索伦把椅子拉开，等同伴起身，再坐到对面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay. Bright. Very bright. I can see the underside of my eyebrows.
beats.chinese: 成。亮，特别亮。我连自己眉毛底下都看见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings the menu card up and sets it on his side like a little wall.
beats.chinese: 他把菜单卡竖到自己这边，当一堵小墙摆好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll do. They can have the good corner.
beats.chinese: 这样成。好角落归人家了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rotates the tray until the bright rectangle on his friend's face goes away.
beats.chinese: 他转动托盘，直到同伴脸上那块亮方印消失。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Oh, now it's in my soup. That's a fair place for it.
beats.chinese: 喏，挪开了。现在照我汤里，搁这儿还算公道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves the soup nearer his chest and goes back to his seat.
beats.chinese: 他把汤往自己胸前端了端，重新坐下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can look up now. Tell me if I do it again.
beats.chinese: 现在能抬头了。我再弄出来，你就告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts both trays in turn so their friend can take the lighter one.
beats.chinese: 索伦分别抬了抬两只托盘，让同伴拿轻的那个。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lead on. I followed the light like it was going to pick my lunch for me.
beats.chinese: 你带路。我刚跟着光走，好像还能让光替我挑午饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits for a clear line in the aisle before following his friend.
beats.chinese: 他等过道空出一条线，才跟在同伴身后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Next one I notice can be what you like about it.
beats.chinese: 下一桌先让我看看，你喜欢的是哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the shaded chair out a little and moves his tray to the other side.
beats.chinese: 他把阴处的椅子往外拉一点，自己的托盘挪去对面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's yours. I'm not going to spend lunch telling you how selfless I am about it.
beats.chinese: 这归你了。我不会用整顿饭跟你讲，我让得有多无私。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His friend sits and pushes a napkin towards his new side.
beats.chinese: 同伴坐下，往他新的一侧推来一张餐巾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I can stand the light a lot better if my sleeve's clean.
beats.chinese: 谢了。袖子干净一点，我就更忍得住晃眼了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day at the market, Soren sees you and lifts his tray from a place in the shade.
beats.chinese: 又一天在市场，索伦瞧见你，把托盘从背阴的位置举起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I like this table. I asked first today. Nobody wants it because they can't hear each other over the cooler.
beats.chinese: 你好，我喜欢这桌。今天先问过了，没人想坐。冷柜那么响，说话听不清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps his tray up while a shopper sets a glass down at the end.
beats.chinese: 又一位顾客在桌头搁了个杯子，他先把盘子举着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sit here if I'm on my own. My sandwich hasn't got much to say.
beats.chinese: 我一个人倒可以坐。我的三明治也没什么话要跟我讲。

causality.presenceReason: 来市场与同伴吃顿饭才继续工作
causality.placeAttitude: 对共用桌边光、风和声敏感
causality.stayingConstraint: 一张桌上有好位置，两个位置可以换
causality.currentGoal: 承认自己抢了好座位，商量换
causality.currentState: 一屁股坐下才反应过来光压在哪边
causality.contactTrigger: 他坐下又起，托盘朝玩家腾出的口挪，直接发问
causality.characterContinuity: 肯换座也肯说不舒服，不把小习惯抬成品格判决
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 自己去坐亮的一边。ab 转掉托盘方向。ba 俩人选别桌。bb 把好角让出去这一餐
