beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya clears a space at the shared table. A crossword page opens itself right over the spot.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅刚在共用桌空出一块，填字纸自己展开，正盖在那儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, sit if you like. This thinks it's got an invitation. My neighbour said any day would be fine.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，你坐吧。这张纸还以为自己已经有人约了。我邻居说，哪天都成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya lays the pencilled clues flat against the lunch bag.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把写了铅笔字的那页压在午饭袋边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Any day usually turns out to be the one day neither of us lives in.
beats.chinese: 说哪天都成，最后就会变成，没有这么一天。

choices.english: Ask which day Priya would actually choose.
choices.chinese: 问普丽娅自己真想选哪天。

choices.english: Ask if they feel like doing it alone this time.
choices.chinese: 问这回想不想自己做掉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya draws a little circle round the clue number.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅在题号周围圈了一个小圈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sunday at lunch. She can do the top half and leave before she says I'm putting in words that don't exist.
beats.chinese: 周日中午。她做上半页，趁着还没开始说我瞎造词就走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya folds the lower half out of sight.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把下半张折到看不见的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can ask her for a short one. Or I can get one of my own and stop treating that one like it has two signatures.
beats.chinese: 可以就约小半场。要不我换一份自己做，别老把这张当我俩都签了字。

choices.english: Ask her for half a lunch on Sunday.
choices.chinese: 约周日中午半个午休。

choices.english: Save the bottom half for another time.
choices.chinese: 下半页另留下，改天再填。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya keeps the pen horizontal on the table without writing.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把笔横在桌上，没落字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not this one. I like her sounding out a clue like it's got a stone in it. I might have liked that more than the puzzle.
beats.chinese: 这张不想。我喜欢听她念题，一字一字拗得像嘴里有颗石头。没准我喜欢那个比喜欢填字还多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya draws the paper out from under the bag and folds it once.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把纸从袋底抽出来，折好一回。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's fine if she can't come. I'd rather know that and have my Sunday.
beats.chinese: 她来不了也成。我宁愿知道来不了，好过自己的周日。

choices.english: Let the puzzle wait through this weekend.
choices.chinese: 这周末先不做这题。

choices.english: Ask her for one day she can really make.
choices.chinese: 请她给个真能来的日子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya types out a time and a short question, then pushes send.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅打出时间，再写个短问句，点了发送。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sunday, twelve, twenty minutes. I nearly added or whenever. I held back.
beats.chinese: 周日十二点，二十分钟。我差点又加一句不然随你，忍住了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya pulls the bag off the corner and frees a bit more space at the table.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把袋子从桌角拖回来，又腾出一片桌面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I can eat while she thinks about it.
beats.chinese: 这会儿她可以慢慢想，我可以吃饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya separates the page at its old fold and keeps the upper part in hand.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅沿旧折痕把纸分开，上半页留在手上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take this round later. She can't tell me I've filled her half in if I've put mine in a different pocket.
beats.chinese: 晚一点拿给她。我这半放另一只兜，就不会被说我把她那半给填了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya slips the other part behind the lunch bag.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把另一半塞到午饭袋后头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could be quite a while before either half has a full answer.
beats.chinese: 两边要全填完，没准都得好一阵子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya puts the page inside a blank folder and closes it.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把纸放进空文件夹，一下合拢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I can make plans with the person who is already here. That's me.
beats.chinese: 也好。我可以跟已经到齐的那个人定个安排。是我自己。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya picks up the fork and opens the lunch box.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅拿了叉子，掀开饭盒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm very sure I'll be here for this.
beats.chinese: 这顿饭我相当有把握，准到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya writes one line, stops and adds a question at the end.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅打完一句，停了下，又加了个问句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I miss hearing you read them. Is there a day you can come for one cup? There. She can say no to one cup.
beats.chinese: 有点想听你念题了。哪天能来喝一杯吗？好了。一杯的话，她说不也容易。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya sends it and brings the food back to the middle of the space.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅点了发送，把饭端回面前空出来的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I get any day again, I'll leave the page in the drawer.
beats.chinese: 回头要还说哪天都成，我就把这页放抽屉里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Several days later at the market, Priya recognises you and holds a puzzle sheet up by a clean corner.
beats.chinese: 又过几天，在市场碰见你，普丽娅拎着没写字的一角举起张题纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. My neighbour and I put down two different words. Neither of us could get the last letter in the box.
beats.chinese: 你好。我跟邻居填了两个不一样的词。最后一个字母，谁都没填得进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya shows the pencil marks hanging off opposite sides of one square.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅让你看看，同一格旁边，两道铅笔字从不同边写了出去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We stopped and ate. I like the food here better when we're both wrong.
beats.chinese: 我俩就放着，吃东西了。俩人都猜错的时候，这儿的东西吃着还更香。

causality.presenceReason: 来拱棚市场等邻居，带着一份谜题和朋友吃点东西
causality.placeAttitude: 适合短时间分开各玩各接话
causality.stayingConstraint: 要与邻居重新把哪天拼填字题说定
causality.currentGoal: 不要把随时当个定下来的时间
causality.currentState: 其实有点被冷落，一开始只肯说都行
causality.contactTrigger: 同一桌往一边腾东西时，把一条填字题连一起碰掉在桌边，玩家看过去
causality.characterContinuity: 愿意共享，但要有具体的日子，不用玩家填补原位
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 约成半个午饭。ab 留单人题给自己。ba 这周不开局。bb 收到肯定日子才再约
causality.spatialContinuity: 共用桌上，没编额外设施
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 隔天的两份猜错各自有来历

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Between two trees on Tatlow Walk, a low note begins, wobbles and stops. Bex is looking up at the branches.
beats.chinese: 塔特洛步道两棵树中间，有个低音刚起来就颤一下、断了。贝克丝正抬头瞧树枝。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was me. I wasn't calling for help.
beats.chinese: 刚才是我。没在喊救命。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tries the same note again at half the volume.
beats.chinese: 她用一半的声音重新试了那个音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Choir starts right there. I've started right beside it six times today.
beats.chinese: 合唱第一个音就是这个。我今天已经连着六回唱在旁边了。

choices.english: Offer to count her in once.
choices.chinese: 说可以帮她喊一遍起拍。

choices.english: Ask if she always comes to sing here.
choices.chinese: 问她平常也来这儿唱吗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves one boot a little so it isn't on a root at the edge of the path.
beats.chinese: 她把一只靴子挪了挪，没再踩在路边那截树根上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Three beats. You can put your hand down on three. Don't make a special face if I miss it.
beats.chinese: 三拍。数到三，你手放下来就行。我要没唱准，你别特地给我个什么脸色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops between breaths to let the walkers behind you go by.
beats.chinese: 后面有行人，她先没吸下一口气，等人过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or I'll try it as a hum. I don't lose where I am as often that way.
beats.chinese: 要不就只哼一声。这样没那么容易找不着调。

choices.english: Count three as agreed.
choices.chinese: 照说好的数三拍。

choices.english: Let the first note come out as a hum.
choices.chinese: 让她先把头一个音哼出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps her mouth closed through the next stretch of footsteps.
beats.chinese: 接下来几声脚步，她都一直闭着嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I usually go straight home. I didn't want the first noise I heard there to be the work phone today.
beats.chinese: 不啊。平常直接回家。今天不想进门头一个听见的就是单位打来电话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a note out of her coat and keeps it folded.
beats.chinese: 她从外套抽出张纸，没打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway. I came to sing a little. I might do that better without an audience.
beats.chinese: 先不说了。我是来唱一点的。没观众兴许唱得还好点儿。

choices.english: Respect that and keep the conversation on the song.
choices.chinese: 不追问单位的事，只聊这首歌。

choices.english: Give her a stretch of the path to herself.
choices.chinese: 把这一段路留给她一个人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bex breathes in on the second beat. The note comes out steadier this time.
beats.chinese: 贝克丝第二拍吸气，这回出来的音稳多了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got it. Don't do another one. I want to get to the door with a one hundred per cent success rate.
beats.chinese: 中了。别再来一回。我要一路保持百分之百的成功率进门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds her sheet smaller and puts it into an inside pocket.
beats.chinese: 她把纸再叠小些，放到内兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You counted well. Very little else was required.
beats.chinese: 数得好。真不用再干别的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hums with her eyes open, looking at the path, and lets the note go when a walker comes up.
beats.chinese: 她睁眼望着步道哼，见有人走近才停下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not as wobbly. I'll take it. I can sing an actual word at rehearsal.
beats.chinese: 没那么抖了。可以了，真要唱词，排练再唱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rubs the cold tip of her nose once with her wrist.
beats.chinese: 她拿手腕蹭了一下冷冰冰的鼻尖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: More fun than I expected. I was having a very good sulk before.
beats.chinese: 比我想的好玩，刚才我还在这儿生闷气呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the folded sheet a little with one hand, then brings it down again.
beats.chinese: 她一手把折纸提起来一点，又放了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's an alto part. You don't hear it on its own much. Probably for a reason.
beats.chinese: 是女低音的声部。平常没几回分开听，大概也是有道理的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the paper away, smiling just on one side.
beats.chinese: 她把纸收了，一边嘴角笑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll do the rest with the other voices. They don't ask where I've been all day.
beats.chinese: 别的等有人一块唱吧。我一天去哪儿了，他们倒从来不问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She steps between the last two trees beside the path without leaving the path itself.
beats.chinese: 她走到步道旁最后两棵树之间，脚还留在路上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ta. I'll have one more go after that pair's gone through.
beats.chinese: 谢了，等那俩人走过去，我再试一次。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps her eyes on their feet until the steps have faded.
beats.chinese: 她望着那两人的脚，直到脚步声听不见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or none. I can still go home.
beats.chinese: 或者不试了。我照样能回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another morning on Tatlow Walk, Bex sees you and turns a small whittled spoon over in her palm.
beats.chinese: 又一个早上，贝克丝在塔特洛步道看见你，拿掌心翻了翻一把手削的小勺。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. The bowl's on a slight angle. My grandad would've called that a left handed spoon and got on with lunch.
beats.chinese: 你好。勺头有点斜。我姥爷准说这是左撇子勺，然后接着吃他的午饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She grips the handle from both sides, trying each thumb in the little hollow.
beats.chinese: 她两边都握了一遍，试着把两手的拇指分别放进那个小凹里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Might make a right handed one and keep them both.
beats.chinese: 还可以削把右撇子的，两把都留着。

causality.presenceReason: 沿 Tatlow Walk 回去，想趁空复习合唱起音
causality.placeAttitude: 树木把外头声隔开，能听见自己的声
causality.stayingConstraint: 今晚离集合还早，不想接工作电话
causality.currentGoal: 把唱不好的第一个音先试一遍
causality.currentState: 在单位忙到有点顶不住，但自己没开口不谈压力
causality.contactTrigger: 哼错一声正撞上脚步，笑了下，告诉玩家刚才不是谁叫
causality.characterContinuity: 薄面子，能接受具体搭手，不吃同情
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 接一次合唱起拍。ab 改成不求准的哼唱。ba 不谈工作。bb 止步让人过，自己转回家
causality.spatialContinuity: Tatlow Walk 两侧树之间，不抄林地小路
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来问用木勺，首次唱歌无关联

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A walker calls out that nobody should go any farther. He has both feet on the open path and nothing in his hands.
beats.chinese: 一个散步的人喊着叫大伙儿别再往前了。他两脚踩在敞开的路上，两手空空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Says who?
beats.chinese: 谁说的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette stays to the side of Tatlow Walk, looking from his face to the trees ahead.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特站在塔特洛步道边，先看他的脸，又看前面的树。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You saw him turn up, didn't you? I thought he was walking the same as us a second ago.
beats.chinese: 你看见他走过来的吧？我刚瞧着，他跟咱俩一样在散步呢。

choices.english: Ask what he actually saw from farther up the path.
choices.chinese: 问他从前面过来，究竟看见了什么。

choices.english: Wait here without arguing.
choices.chinese: 不和他争，先站一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The man shows the place with an open hand. A branch lies along the path's edge.
beats.chinese: 男人摊开手指出地方。路沿躺着截树枝。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, I see the branch. Is that what he meant? I can believe a tree fell over without believing the whole park shut down.
beats.chinese: 啊，枝子看见了。说的就是那个？说树倒了我信，整个公园都关了我可不信。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette moves one shoe back from the patch of wet ground.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特把一只鞋从一片湿地边退回来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He might have seen something else. I'll let him get to the end of the sentence this time.
beats.chinese: 他兴许还看见别的了。这回我让人把话讲完。

choices.english: Stop if he has a concrete reason to ask.
choices.chinese: 他要说得出具体的事，就等等。

choices.english: Let him describe the problem without calling it a closure.
choices.chinese: 让他把问题说清，先别叫它封路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette stills her hand mid gesture. She watches two other people slow down ahead.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特一下停住手势。前面又有两个人放慢脚步，她看着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. There's no medal for being the first one past him. I came to walk, not outvote a man.
beats.chinese: 也行。第一个从他跟前过去又不发奖牌。我来走个路，也不是来压他一票的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps a space open for people moving up behind her.
beats.chinese: 身后还有人上来，她留着一条空隙。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can go the way we came, or wait while he tells those folks what he knows.
beats.chinese: 可以原路走，也能等他把知道的告诉那几个人。

choices.english: Turn back while there's still room.
choices.chinese: 趁还有地方，原路返回。

choices.english: Let the new walkers hear him out first.
choices.chinese: 先让刚过来的人听他说完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The man points out a wet branch split across the path farther on. Odette stops moving her front foot.
beats.chinese: 男人指出更前面横拦着一道湿树枝，是劈裂的。奥黛特停下正要往前的那只脚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. You saw that and I didn't. I should've started by asking where.
beats.chinese: 是该等。你看见了，我没有。我刚该先问在哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lets one other walker come level with her before turning back.
beats.chinese: 她等另一个人走到齐肩的位置才转身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll go the long way home. It'll do my table tennis legs good.
beats.chinese: 我绕远点回去吧。打乒乓那双腿正好还能多动动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The man walks back a couple of paces and points at the branch again. Odette leaves him a clear view.
beats.chinese: 男人往回走了几步，再指那截枝。奥黛特让开，让他看清。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. So about three feet of branch. That I can check from here.
beats.chinese: 好，差不多三英尺长一截枝子。这从这儿倒能看清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds both arms and stays at the tree side of the path.
beats.chinese: 她抱起胳膊，仍站在步道靠树这侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. We can each look before we decide.
beats.chinese: 谢了。大伙儿先自己看一眼，再决定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette changes direction without looking for another way through the trees.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特调了个方向，没去树之间瞧还有什么路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I won't have to serve dinner fifteen minutes early just because I got home.
beats.chinese: 也成。也不用就因为我先到家，把晚饭提早一刻钟开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps to the open strip of the path as more people slow down.
beats.chinese: 有人继续放慢，她还是留在步道敞开的那一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll let him keep his audience.
beats.chinese: 观众留给他吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette waits until the walker has spoken to the next pair. Her mouth moves once, but she doesn't interrupt.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特等着那人把话讲给后来的一对。她嘴动了一下，没打断。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I asked my one question. They heard him. They get to ask theirs if they like.
beats.chinese: 我那一句已经问了。人家也听着了，真想问什么自己会问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to you with a small lift of her shoulders.
beats.chinese: 她转向你，轻耸了一下肩。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Want to stand on the other side while they're talking? Somebody still has to get through.
beats.chinese: 他们还说着，咱先站另一边去？后头人还得过呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon, Odette sees you on Tatlow Walk with a pot lid sticking out of a cloth bag.
beats.chinese: 改天下午，奥黛特在塔特洛步道看见你。她布袋里冒出一只锅盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. My housemates said they'd do the dishes. I'm not bringing anything home that's hard to wash.
beats.chinese: 嘿，合租的说今天他们洗盘子。我不会带那种不好洗的东西回去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the lid out and taps the underside, which is perfectly clean.
beats.chinese: 她取出盖子，敲一下反面，干干净净的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can hold up my end of a bargain. I am absolutely going to leave them the big pot, though.
beats.chinese: 说好的事我能做到。不过那口大锅肯定留给他们。

causality.presenceReason: 在公园走一圈等晚饭时间，手中无器材
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢普通散步说几句，只有别人摆专家架势才追问
causality.stayingConstraint: 不用提前回家代洗盘子
causality.currentGoal: 判断人家领读的是确切消息还是口头传来
causality.currentState: 不耐烦对方用肯定句替人安排，没要求她主持
causality.contactTrigger: 另一个人用很肯定的口气喊大家别经过，奥黛特先问出处，随后侧身跟玩家交流
causality.characterContinuity: 只针对先摆专家立场的人，一次后放过，不对没发言的人盘问
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 有依据就接着走。ab 空口就让他自己说明。ba 礼貌离开。bb 不追着理论但留给人确认机会
causality.spatialContinuity: Tatlow Walk 树间步道，没有封锁或改线路
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天做自家晚饭的碗勺

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald walks a little way behind you on Tatlow Walk. At the next tree he comes level and lowers a small notebook.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德跟在你身后，沿塔特洛步道走了一小段。到了下一棵树旁，他走到齐肩的位置，放低一本小本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you mind a question? I'll ask one first and see if you want the other two.
beats.chinese: 方便问一句吗？我先问一个，看看你还愿不愿听后面两个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns down the top of a page with exactly three question marks on it.
beats.chinese: 他把一页纸的顶端折下去。那页不多不少三个问号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My neighbour says I ask why before I've heard what. I think I may have proved her point before I got here.
beats.chinese: 我邻居说，我还没听清是什么，就开始问为什么。我一路走过来，倒好像已经证明她说得对了。

choices.english: Ask him your own question first.
choices.chinese: 先反问他一句。

choices.english: Say you don't have time for three questions.
choices.chinese: 告诉他自己没时间聊三个问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the notebook loosely and looks sideways long enough to hear you.
beats.chinese: 他虚合上本子，侧脸留出时间听你说。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I'd have to answer before I got to the second one. Fair enough.
beats.chinese: 是啊，轮到我答了，也得答完才能问第二句。这很公平。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the pen clipped to the front instead of taking it off.
beats.chinese: 他手里的笔还是别在封面，没取下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can tell you what I was going to ask. Or I can see if it still seems worth asking at the end of the walk.
beats.chinese: 我可以说刚想问什么。也可以走到头再看看，那话还值不值得问。

choices.english: Ask him why he changed his mind about the questions.
choices.chinese: 问他为什么对那几句改了主意。

choices.english: Let him pick only one before he starts.
choices.chinese: 让他开口前只挑一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the pen under the front cover and slows enough to leave space between you.
beats.chinese: 他把笔塞到封面下面，放慢两步，两人拉开一点空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I usually need a whole walk to answer my own questions.
beats.chinese: 当然。我答自己那些问题，通常也得走一路才答得完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets one of the walkers behind catch up.
beats.chinese: 他让后头的人先赶上来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can go on. I'll have a word with myself about it first.
beats.chinese: 你可以先走了。我先自己跟自己说说。

choices.english: Continue on without a question.
choices.chinese: 不问什么，接着走。

choices.english: Ask what he might answer if he tries it himself.
choices.chinese: 问他自己答的话，大概怎么说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald watches the foot of a tree go past before he replies.
beats.chinese: 埃瓦尔德看着走过一棵树根底下，才回话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My neighbour asked what I'd planted. I asked how much light she gets. She looked down at the pot for about ten seconds. Then I finally said mint.
beats.chinese: 我邻居问种的什么，我问她家光照多久。她就低头盯着盆看了约十秒钟。我才总算说了薄荷。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slows again and taps the three marks through the paper.
beats.chinese: 他又放慢了些，隔着纸轻敲那三个印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That didn't feel very good once I heard it back.
beats.chinese: 自己倒过头来一听，也不大舒服。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts a finger over the bottom two question marks.
beats.chinese: 他用一根手指盖住下头两个问号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: First one, then. Have you seen any light come down through those trees today?
beats.chinese: 那就头一个。你今天看到有光从那几棵树间漏下来过吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Instead of asking why, he lifts his eyes to the canopy and waits.
beats.chinese: 他抬眼看树冠，等着，没接着问为什么。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give you more than a second for that one.
beats.chinese: 这次我肯定给你多过一秒想。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He steps to the edge and turns a page after you have walked on a little way.
beats.chinese: 他让到路边。等你走远一点，才翻过去一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's all right. A walk's a walk.
beats.chinese: 没事，散步嘛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves the paper open on a blank page and takes a step of his own.
beats.chinese: 他把本子停在空白那一页，自己也迈了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I won't make a test of it.
beats.chinese: 不非得考个什么出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the folded page but doesn't turn it round to you.
beats.chinese: 他低头看了那张折过的页，没转给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd answer yes to the first and I don't know to the next two. That took a long time for very little information.
beats.chinese: 第一句我会答有。后两句，不知道。花这么半天，倒也没说出什么来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the fold back up and shuts the notebook.
beats.chinese: 他把折痕抚回去，合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd rather have given that last bit of time to the trees.
beats.chinese: 刚才那点时间，我还不如看看树。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week Evald recognises you on Tatlow Walk. He lowers a drawing with seven circles in it.
beats.chinese: 过几天，埃瓦尔德在塔特洛步道认出你，放低一张画了七个圈的纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I have six pots, with numbers. This is the seventh, growing in a crack in the balcony where I put nothing.
beats.chinese: 你好。我有六盆，编过号。这是第七盆，阳台缝里自己长的。我在那儿什么都没种。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He traces the one circle without a mark inside.
beats.chinese: 他沿着唯一里面没写东西的那个圈描了一道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm leaving that one out of the experiment. It managed without me this far.
beats.chinese: 这个就不拉进试验了。没我，它都活到现在了。

causality.presenceReason: 沿 Tatlow Walk 去和邻居换共同笔记，短时停留
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢树间走到某处正好能想清一件事
causality.stayingConstraint: 邻居迟些才来，不追问路人自家情况
causality.currentGoal: 决定要不要把练过一遍的问句改成只有一句
causality.currentState: 习惯连问三件，察觉问太多肯撤
causality.contactTrigger: 他在旁数没写下的空位，玩家放低脚步时问能不能先借一个意见
causality.characterContinuity: 问了也肯答，不宣扬对方话，不靠问句困住人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 接受被反问。ab 选一个问题。ba 放过走路的人。bb 不问对方，让他自己试
causality.spatialContinuity: 沿可见公共步道不进入树丛
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新的一天是阳台盆栽里自己长出来的第七盆

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ainsley tilts a jar by the bridge wall. A purple leaf floats up against the glass.
beats.chinese: 安斯利在桥边矮墙旁侧了侧瓶子。一片紫叶浮起来，贴到玻璃上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you see a bubble in that? Don't take the jar. I've made the lid worse once already.
beats.chinese: 看得见里头有个泡吗？瓶不用接。我已经把盖越弄越松过一次了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They bring it upright and dry the rim against a cloth.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把瓶扶正，拿布擦干边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said I'd take this to my sister. That's before I put it in a bag with a perfectly good book.
beats.chinese: 我说好给我妹带去的。说这话时，我还没把它和一本好好的书搁进一个包里。

choices.english: Check whether there is liquid at the rim.
choices.chinese: 看看瓶口有没有水。

choices.english: Suggest keeping the jar closed until they get home.
choices.chinese: 建议先别开，等回家再说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They hold it still enough to show a clear line between the cloth and the lid.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把瓶拿稳，好让你看清布和盖之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's dry now. The bubble moves when I make it move. I think I spent five minutes solving the bit I'd done myself.
beats.chinese: 现在干了。泡是我一晃才跟着动。我怕是花了五分钟查自己晃出来的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The leaf slides back below the surface.
beats.chinese: 那片叶又滑回液面下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it upright or take it home. The book can travel on its own either way.
beats.chinese: 要么竖着带，要么带回家。书反正要另外拿了。

choices.english: Let them carry it upright by itself.
choices.chinese: 让安斯利竖着单拿罐子。

choices.english: Suggest a closer look back at home.
choices.chinese: 建议拿回家细看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They cover the top of the jar with the dry part of the cloth.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把布干的那面盖到瓶顶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. My sister likes the cabbage. I don't think she particularly wants it poured into her hallway.
beats.chinese: 也是，我妹爱吃甘蓝。估计不是特别想要浇在她家走廊里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They feel along a seam inside the bag without putting the jar back.
beats.chinese: 安斯利沿着包里一道接缝摸了摸，没把罐放回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got another at home. She's not waiting on this one to eat.
beats.chinese: 我家还有一罐。她又不至于等这个开饭。

choices.english: Put the problem aside and let them continue the walk.
choices.chinese: 先放下这事，让安斯利接着走。

choices.english: Ask if they'd rather take the other jar next time.
choices.chinese: 问下回要不要带另一罐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the book under one arm and wrap the cloth just round the bottom of the jar.
beats.chinese: 安斯利用胳膊夹住书，只拿布裹了罐底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That keeps it level. I'll take her the jar and let her decide whether she wants a fault report.
beats.chinese: 这样端得平。瓶先给她，想不想听故障报告由她选。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They take two steps, watching to see if the leaf moves again.
beats.chinese: 安斯利走两步，瞧那片叶还动不动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. It's doing less when I do less.
beats.chinese: 瞧。我少折腾，它倒也少动了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They place the jar carefully in an outer pocket with its top showing.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把罐端端正正放进外袋，盖子还露在口上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll set it on a clean page at home. If it leaves a circle, I'd rather see it there.
beats.chinese: 回家我拿张干净纸垫着。要是渗一圈，也比在这儿看出来好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn back along the connected path.
beats.chinese: 安斯利沿连着桥的路掉头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll tell her to put her lunch on first.
beats.chinese: 我叫她先做午饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They keep the jar wrapped and put the book on the other side of the bag.
beats.chinese: 安斯利让瓶仍裹着，把书放到袋子另一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I came out to see the river as well. Hadn't looked at it yet.
beats.chinese: 也是，我也是来看河的。到现在一眼都没往那儿瞧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn towards the water with both feet on the path.
beats.chinese: 安斯利双脚留在步道上，身子朝向河水。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have a minute here.
beats.chinese: 就在这儿待会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tie the cloth round the jar lid and check the knot without twisting the lid itself.
beats.chinese: 安斯利拿布在瓶盖外绑住，检查结时没去拧盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take her the other one. It's beetroot. She can be quite rude about my beetroot.
beats.chinese: 给她换我家另一罐吧。甜菜根的。她说起我腌的甜菜根，可一点儿不客气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the jar tight against their coat.
beats.chinese: 安斯利把瓶贴着大衣抱好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might get this one opened after supper. On my own counter.
beats.chinese: 这瓶晚饭后再开吧。在我自己厨房台面上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day by the bridge, Ainsley recognises you as they slide a bent spoon under a lunchbox clip.
beats.chinese: 后来有天在桥边，安斯利认出了你，正把一把弯勺插进饭盒的卡扣底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. That's not a broken spoon. I bent it for this.
beats.chinese: 你好。勺没坏，我就为了开这个才把它掰弯的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The clip pops up. They wipe the handle on a sleeve.
beats.chinese: 卡扣啪一声弹起来。安斯利用袖子擦了擦勺柄。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The box is hers. I'll be keeping the spoon.
beats.chinese: 盒归她。勺我还要用。

causality.placeAttitude: 在河边光下看清玻璃，喜欢不过多解释

causality.currentGoal: 判断里面是漏了还是温差
causality.currentState: 手上有工具也不随便开人家的东西

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum stands where the bridge joins the path, checking a short list on his phone.
beats.chinese: 卡勒姆在桥接上步道的地方，低头看手机上短短一列字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Morning. If I send bridge, ten, do you read that as a question or an order?
beats.chinese: 早。我发桥头，十点，你看是问一句，还是下命令？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He scrolls to another message and laughs out loud.
beats.chinese: 他翻到另一条消息，出了声地笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Our drummer actually wants to meet later. Took him four texts to get to the part where he said later.
beats.chinese: 我们打鼓的那人其实想晚点见。发到第四条，才把晚点两个字说出来。

choices.english: Ask if anybody else is already on their way.
choices.chinese: 问别人有没有已经动身的。

choices.english: Ask whether he would mind a later walk himself.
choices.chinese: 问他自己介不介意晚点走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the phone up to see the time without putting his glasses on.
beats.chinese: 他把手机举高看时间，没忙着戴眼镜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We've got an hour. Nobody's left, unless they've come out to buy bread. That's loads of warning.
beats.chinese: 还有一个钟头。没人出了门吧，除非人家出来买面包。这给得够早了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He makes a new message, leaving the old one visible above it.
beats.chinese: 他新开一条消息，旧的还在上头露着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put the new time to everybody, or say he's welcome to catch us after.
beats.chinese: 我可以问大家改到那会儿行不行，也可以让他晚一点追上我们。

choices.english: Give everyone time to reply to the new time.
choices.chinese: 提议先把新时间发下去，让几个人回话。

choices.english: Let the friend join later without moving the meeting.
choices.chinese: 原时间照旧，朋友可以晚点加入。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets his phone and leans his head away from a passing pair.
beats.chinese: 他揣起手机，一对人路过，他偏了偏头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've already had my breakfast. Happy enough to walk now. Happy enough to do it later if we're all doing that.
beats.chinese: 我早饭都吃过了。现在走也行。大伙儿要都改晚点，我也能等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks along the path without changing where he's standing.
beats.chinese: 他脚还站在原地，朝步道上看了看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: What I won't do is tell him he didn't mean it. He said it. Grand.
beats.chinese: 我总不会再说他不是那个意思。人家都明说了，挺好。

choices.english: Keep the original meeting unless the others reply.
choices.chinese: 别人没回之前，先按原来约的走。

choices.english: Say he can acknowledge the message without redoing the plan yet.
choices.chinese: 建议先告诉对方看到了，安排不必马上改完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a new time, then puts still checking on the next line.
beats.chinese: 他打出新时间，又另起一行说先问问。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Nobody moves till they've seen both lines.
beats.chinese: 成了。两行都得看明白，再出门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the screen off and gives the bridge a good look at last.
beats.chinese: 他关掉屏幕，总算好好瞧了眼这座桥。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We've got a bit before ten. Are you here for the walk or the view?
beats.chinese: 离十点还有会儿，你是专门来走路，还是来看景的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends his friend a new message outside the group chat.
beats.chinese: 他退出群聊，另给朋友发一句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take your time. Ring when you're out. We'll say where we've got to by then.
beats.chinese: 你慢慢来。出来了给我打个电话，到时候告诉你我们走到哪儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the phone into his pocket without touching the group's time.
beats.chinese: 他把手机滑进兜，群里的时间没改。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's two good walks, if he never catches up.
beats.chinese: 他要一直没追上，那也是各自走得舒服。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves the message open but taps no keys.
beats.chinese: 他开着那条消息，没打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten as agreed, then. I don't have to put three people on standby because I've got my phone out.
beats.chinese: 那就还是十点。也不能因为我手机拿手上，就让三个人都等我消息。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a step viewwards on the pavement, away from the crossing line.
beats.chinese: 他在人走过去的路线外又走了一步，朝景那头站了站。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be here when they turn up.
beats.chinese: 他们来了就能在这儿找着我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types with his forefinger and looks up after sending it.
beats.chinese: 他用食指一点点打字，发完就抬了头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got you. That's what I said. The rest isn't going to expire in the next minute.
beats.chinese: 我回的明白了。别的又不是再过一分钟就作废。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives the river a look and takes the phone out of his hand.
beats.chinese: 他瞧瞧河面，把手机收得手里不剩东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm glad he asked. He used to just stand there looking pained.
beats.chinese: 他肯问挺好的。以前就光站那儿，脸看着都难受。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Days later, Callum greets you by the bridge with one finger holding open a page of a quiz book.
beats.chinese: 隔了几天，卡勒姆在桥边招呼你，用一根手指撑着问答书的一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Afternoon. That's an island they put in the wrong water. I got it wrong last Thursday for exactly that reason.
beats.chinese: 下午好。有个岛他们给画到另一片水域里去了。上周四我就是为这个答错的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shuts the book on the map and grins.
beats.chinese: 他把地图那页合上，咧嘴一笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They gave the point back. Didn't get the map fixed, but you can't have everything.
beats.chinese: 那一分倒还我了。图没改。也不能什么都想要。

causality.presenceReason: 在桥头等同伴做已约好的运河步行
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢条款早点说，不喜欢到了跟前把所有人往另一头带
causality.stayingConstraint: 下一拨人未到，尚可提前通知

causality.currentState: 一听新主意先高兴，等不及别人绕弯
causality.contactTrigger: 停下来问玩家自己手上的箭头是不是像命令
causality.characterContinuity: 明确约见，不在最后一秒翻案，接受别人明说不要
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 把改动发给所有人。ab 各走各的。ba 守原定汇合。bb 先给朋友回旋，不另猜动机

causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天此处讨论地理题书的图

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eilidh holds a recorder low on the bridge, its microphone towards the water. The red light goes out before you reach them.
beats.chinese: 艾莉在桥上把录音机拿得很低，麦朝着水。你走到近处之前，红灯先灭了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're fine. I stopped it. It's the river I'm back for.
beats.chinese: 没事，我已经停了。我是回来录河的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They let the last few footsteps go by and tip an ear towards the bridge wall.
beats.chinese: 最后几声脚步过去，艾莉侧着耳朵听桥墙那头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still bright sounding along here. The rest of the year it doesn't catch as much on the stone.
beats.chinese: 这一截听起来还是透亮。换别的季节，声音没这么往石头上撞。

choices.english: Ask what they want to hear in the next take.
choices.chinese: 问这一回想录到什么。

choices.english: Ask whether they could get it from farther down the path.
choices.chinese: 问往步道另一头走走，能不能也录到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They listen through a quiet beat, then point to the top of the recorder without offering it over.
beats.chinese: 艾莉等一声静下来，指了指录音机上端，没往外递。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Water on the far side of this wall. It gets a short rattle in it when the level's this high.
beats.chinese: 这道墙另一侧的水。水涨到这么高的时候，里头带一小声咯啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They glance at the dark light.
beats.chinese: 艾莉看了眼已经灭掉的灯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can wait for it. Or just write down I was here and the bridge was busy.
beats.chinese: 我可以等。也可以记我来过，桥上人多，没录。

choices.english: Wait for the next quiet interval without holding anyone up.
choices.chinese: 在边上等下一个空当，别拦人。

choices.english: Suggest trying a note about the river instead.
choices.chinese: 建议先写一句今天的河声怎样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look down the path, then bring the recorder back against their chest.
beats.chinese: 艾莉朝步道下头望了望，把录音机重新拿回胸前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd get different water. I've got this piece in January and in May. That's why I stand here even when I'd rather be elsewhere.
beats.chinese: 录出来就是另一截水了。我有一月的，也有五月的，就是这儿。所以想走的时候，我还得在这儿站着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A heel clicks on the bridge. They watch the passing shoe go by.
beats.chinese: 有人鞋跟在桥上一磕。艾莉看着那只鞋经过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Today's allowed to be the day I couldn't record it.
beats.chinese: 今天也可以就是我没录成的那一天。

choices.english: Let today's visit stay unrecorded.
choices.chinese: 今天让它留白。

choices.english: Ask if you should move so they can try again.
choices.chinese: 问是不是该让开，好让艾莉再试。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They move against the bridge side to clear the path, wait, then press a small button.
beats.chinese: 艾莉靠到桥边留出通道，等了一阵，按下一个小键。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's it. Keep going if you need to. It's nobody's job to stand still for a river.
beats.chinese: 来了。你有事就走，不用为了条河站这儿别动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The light goes out again. They listen to a short sample very quietly.
beats.chinese: 灯又灭了。艾莉把音量开得很低，听了一小段。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got the rattle before anybody's heels. I'll keep that.
beats.chinese: 鞋跟响前头先录到那一下了。就留这段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They take out a narrow notebook and write once through the centre of an open page.
beats.chinese: 艾莉拿出一本窄本子，在摊开的一页中间写了一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bridge, river high, people didn't stop. They wouldn't, would they? They've a place to be.
beats.chinese: 桥，水涨了，人来人往。人家干吗要停，对吧。还有事呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the recorder away and read the line back without changing it.
beats.chinese: 艾莉收好录音机，把那行又看一遍，一个字没改。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a fair enough record of the morning.
beats.chinese: 这也算把今天早上记下来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They slip the recorder into a fabric pouch and tuck the cable beside it.
beats.chinese: 艾莉把录音机滑进布套，线在旁边塞好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. I'll stand here without getting anything out of it for once.
beats.chinese: 也是。难得就站一回，不从这儿录点什么走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look down at the water, following a ripple until it crosses the stone.
beats.chinese: 艾莉低头看水，视线跟着一道水纹，直到淌过石头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That bit's loud enough without me.
beats.chinese: 那一块没我录，也响得很。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They shake their head and cover the recorder with one hand.
beats.chinese: 艾莉摇头，用一手覆住录音机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. First I don't ask you to hang about, then I don't ask you to go away. Same deal.
beats.chinese: 不用。我不特意留你，也不特意赶你。一个道理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They step back to clear a little more of the path.
beats.chinese: 艾莉往后撤了撤，让出稍宽一点的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can both hear it and go about your business.
beats.chinese: 你听着水，也照样忙你的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One morning later, Eilidh spots you on the bridge with a cassette held flat in their palm.
beats.chinese: 后来有个早上，艾莉在桥上瞧见你，掌心平托一卷磁带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Same tape I used to think I'd lost. I kept it in the case of a record I never play.
beats.chinese: 你好。就是那卷我以为丢了的带子，让我塞进一张从来不听的唱片盒了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn it over. Both labels are empty.
beats.chinese: 艾莉翻过去。两张标签都是空白。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Might keep the labels blank till I've actually heard what's on it.
beats.chinese: 我还是先听听里面是什么，再往上头写字吧。

causality.stayingConstraint: 有人说话或桥上脚步重时主动停机器
causality.currentGoal: 找一段真能和上次对照的水声
causality.currentState: 来了两次都盖掉，今天仍愿等
causality.contactTrigger: 看到人近了先停，再问声音有没有妨碍经过
causality.characterContinuity: 不录陌生人，不把器材借给没学过的人，不想换地点图省事
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 等一阵空隙完成录音。ab 只做笔记。ba 今天留白。bb 说清不用旁人迁就

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Angus is on the bridge, holding a phone loosely enough for the last ring to carry. When it stops he takes it away from his ear.
beats.chinese: 安格斯在桥上，手机拿得松，最后一声响铃传了出来。铃停了，他把手机拿离耳边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No answer. That's one call. I'll take the hint even if nobody meant to give me one.
beats.chinese: 没接。一遍。就当人家有事吧，不管他是不是那个意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns his back to the water long enough to read a text.
beats.chinese: 他背朝水站了一下，读了眼短信。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Said he'd meet me here sometime before lunch. We're into the sometime now.
beats.chinese: 他说午饭前找个时候在这儿碰面。现在已经到那个找个时候了。

choices.english: Ask what he'd put in a text to his friend.
choices.chinese: 问他会怎么给朋友留短信。

choices.english: Ask if he'd be happy to walk by himself.
choices.chinese: 问他自己走会不会也挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the reply box and holds the phone a long way from his glasses.
beats.chinese: 他点开回复框，把手机拿到离眼镜挺远的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here a while. That's where the two of us get into trouble. I've got an hour in my head, and he's got three minutes.
beats.chinese: 在这儿待会儿。我俩容易就坏在这种话上。我心里是一小时，他心里是三分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the phone to make space for two people crossing the bridge.
beats.chinese: 桥上两个人走过，他放低手机让路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put a time in. Or ask him when he'd like me to ring tomorrow.
beats.chinese: 可以写个时间。也可以问他，我明天什么时候给他打。

choices.english: Put a clear leaving time in the message.
choices.chinese: 建议写明几点离开。

choices.english: Suggest agreeing a time to call another day.
choices.chinese: 改约一个不用彼此猜的通话时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down towards the stone houses and watches a patch of river turn dark.
beats.chinese: 他望向石屋下面，瞧着有一片河水暗了下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. Would have done it if he'd told me he couldn't come. I can do it if he hasn't told me anything.
beats.chinese: 会啊。他说来不了，我会去走。他什么都没跟我说，我也照样能去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His thumb stays on the edge of the phone, away from the call button.
beats.chinese: 他的拇指停在手机边上，没往拨号键上挨。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: First I should let him know where I'm not going to be.
beats.chinese: 我得先说一声，到时候别还在这儿找我。

choices.english: Leave him to his walk and his own message.
choices.chinese: 留他自己走、自己回消息。

choices.english: Suggest a short note instead of a second call.
choices.chinese: 建议别再拨第二遍，就写句短的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types slowly, moving his mouth once as he checks a number.
beats.chinese: 他打得慢。核对数字时，嘴动了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: By the bridge till half eleven. After that I'll be walking. That much text I can live with.
beats.chinese: 十一点半前在桥边。过了我就走。这么长的短信，我还发得出去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends and puts the phone in the coat pocket with the button done up.
beats.chinese: 他发了，手机塞进有纽扣的大衣兜，顺手扣上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got five minutes to have nothing expected of me, then.
beats.chinese: 那还有五分钟，谁都不用指望我干什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the call number away and types with his forefinger.
beats.chinese: 他关掉号码页，拿食指打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He can pick when. I'll make the call. We don't both have to sit here looking for the three wee dots.
beats.chinese: 让他定时间，我来打。俩人犯不着都坐等那三个小点冒出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He copies the draft reply into the chat and sends it once.
beats.chinese: 他把写好的那句贴进聊天，发了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might even get there before the kettle tomorrow.
beats.chinese: 明天没准能比烧水还先拨出去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Angus tucks the phone away after sending a short note and walks as far as the end of the bridge.
beats.chinese: 安格斯发句短话，把手机收好，走到桥那一头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I'll look at the river from there, too. I nearly missed it from here.
beats.chinese: 那我也过去看看那边的河。在这儿都差点没顾上瞧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits for the next walker to come off the bridge before continuing.
beats.chinese: 他等下一个行人下了桥才接着走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Let him find me another day.
beats.chinese: 让他改天再找我吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings up the empty text box and writes just one line.
beats.chinese: 他点开空白短信框，就写了一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Away for a walk. There'll be less to misunderstand if I don't write a second sentence.
beats.chinese: 我先走走。只要别又往下添一句，也就少点误会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses send himself. His eyes stay on the water a moment before he leaves.
beats.chinese: 他自己按的发送。动身前，眼睛还在水面留了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can hear him tell me he got it. That's usually all I've got to go on.
beats.chinese: 我都能想出他说收到了那声音。平时差不多也就靠这一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon by the bridge, Angus sees you with a square sleeve under one arm. He draws it nearly out of a plain bag.
beats.chinese: 另一个下午，安格斯在桥边看见你，胳膊下挟着个方方的唱片封。他把封套从素纸袋里抽出来大半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. This crease has been there since the first owner folded it to get home in the rain.
beats.chinese: 你好。这道折是头一个主人下雨天带回家时折的，一直在。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He props the bottom on his hand so the crease doesn't bend.
beats.chinese: 他用手托住底，没让那道折再弯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The new owner's asked me to leave it. Glad someone has.
beats.chinese: 新主人让我留着。总算也有人这么想。

causality.presenceReason: 和老同事约好在河边走一段，对方还没接电话
causality.placeAttitude: 石屋对着水的这一面安静，等人也能待得住
causality.stayingConstraint: 只打一次，后面照自己的路走
causality.currentGoal: 看要不要给不爱接电话的朋友留字
causality.currentState: 手指想再播号码，心里不想催人
causality.contactTrigger: 打完第一遍拿起收回又看一眼时间，主动问玩家觉得哪句话有歧义
causality.characterContinuity: 肯迁就文字，拒绝催促，愿意独处，也愿意有人来
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 留清楚散步方向和时限。ab 晚些再约电话。ba 继续走。bb 不用外人替发，自己说一句
causality.spatialContinuity: 留在桥或连通步道，未给未核实时刻
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天看的唱片封面与那次约人无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: An open bag flaps against a woman's leg on the Royal Mile. She grabs its loose flap and steps back onto the broad part of the pavement.
beats.chinese: 皇家英里街上，一个女人腿边的袋口拍打起来。她赶忙抓住那片松边，退到人行道宽一点的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You saw that coming. Cheers. Have you feet about this size?
beats.chinese: 你刚看出来它要飞了。谢啦。你脚是不是这么大？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts two rolled socks out of the bag, pinching them together by their cuffs.
beats.chinese: 她取出卷成团的两只袜子，捏着袜口拢在一起。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Made them for the rehearsal room. Someone always turns up with wet shoes. If you want them, I'd rather give you a pair than owe you a bag.
beats.chinese: 排练室用的，总有人鞋全湿了还是照来。你用得上的话，我宁愿给你一双，也不想欠你一个袋子的人情。

choices.english: Ask who usually wears the pairs at the studio.
choices.chinese: 问排练室平常谁拿这些袜子穿。

choices.english: Tell her that she doesn't owe you for pointing out the bag.
choices.chinese: 跟她说提醒一声，不用还人情。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the socks so the longer heel of one shows.
beats.chinese: 她转动袜子，露出其中一只长些的后跟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Whoever saw them first. I had a kid wear two different sizes once because he liked the yellow on one and the black on the other.
beats.chinese: 谁先瞧见谁拿。有个孩子穿过一大一小两只，就因为一只黄的他喜欢，一只黑的他也喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the socks across the open top of the bag.
beats.chinese: 她把袜子横搁在袋口上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: These can go on the peg or with you. I'm afraid I have very little change on me, if you'd rather have that.
beats.chinese: 这双能挂到那儿的钉子上，也能给你。你要更想要零钱，我身上倒没几个。

choices.english: Leave the socks for the rehearsal room.
choices.chinese: 把袜子留给排练用的人。

choices.english: Ask if she'd offer these to you even without the bag incident.
choices.chinese: 问要是根本没风吹袋子这回事，她还会不会提出送你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tips her head and slips the socks back into the bag halfway.
beats.chinese: 她偏了偏头，把袜子塞回袋口一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. That is a stupid price for one look across the pavement, come to think.
beats.chinese: 对，想想也是。隔着人行道看一眼，拿双袜子换也太离谱了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She secures both handles with one hand.
beats.chinese: 她用一只手握住两根提手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can say thanks. I can also get these socks to somebody with wet shoes. Those are separate jobs.
beats.chinese: 我可以说声谢谢。袜子也可以照样给鞋湿了的人。这是两回事。

choices.english: Accept the thanks and carry on.
choices.chinese: 收下这声谢谢，接着走。

choices.english: Ask if she'd still like to give somebody the socks today.
choices.chinese: 问她今天是不是还想把袜子给个用得上的人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the socks back on top instead of rolling them farther down.
beats.chinese: 她把袜子搁回袋子的最上边，没往底下塞。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. They'll be the first thing anyone sees. I can put them out before the drummers come in.
beats.chinese: 行。打开第一个就能瞧见。打鼓那几个来之前我就能把它挂上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns her shoulder against the wind coming down the street.
beats.chinese: 沿街吹过来一股风，她侧过肩去挡。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got it now. Go on, I'll keep hold of it this time.
beats.chinese: 攥住了。你忙你的，这回我能拿稳。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the size at the edge of one cuff and puts the pair back in her hand.
beats.chinese: 她沿着一只袜口比了比大小，又把一双拿回手上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you asked now, yes. I'd give them to you. You can look first. The toes are a bit round.
beats.chinese: 你现在愿意问的话，会给。先看看也行，袜尖有点圆。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the pair out without moving it any closer when you don't reach immediately.
beats.chinese: 她把那双托出来，你没立刻伸手，她就没往近处递。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No swap. I do occasionally make more socks than I have feet.
beats.chinese: 不用拿别的换。我偶尔也会织得比自己的脚多些嘛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the bag tight and lowers it to her side.
beats.chinese: 她攥紧袋口，垂到身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks, then. I'll leave it there.
beats.chinese: 那就谢谢啦。别的就不说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A bicycle goes past on the street while she waits on the pavement for a figure coming from the other side.
beats.chinese: 街上过了一辆自行车。她站在人行区，等对面那个人过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is. I can get those keys off her now.
beats.chinese: 人来了，可以把钥匙拿回来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the bag so its mouth is out of the wind, then takes the socks back out.
beats.chinese: 她先转动袋子，让口背着风，再把袜子抽出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do. If you've got use for them, have them. If you haven't, I know where I'll leave them.
beats.chinese: 还想。你用得着就拿去。用不着，我也知道留在哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the small bundle loose in her hand and looks once at your shoes.
beats.chinese: 她把那一小卷松松地托在手里，看了你鞋子一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The colour's honestly worse once you've seen both of them. I'll give you a second.
beats.chinese: 说真的，两只一起看，颜色更难看。你多看一秒再说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another Thursday on the Royal Mile, Isobel notices you and tucks a flat frisbee under one arm.
beats.chinese: 后来一个周四，伊泽贝尔在皇家英里街瞧见你，把个扁飞盘夹到胳膊下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I'm not throwing today. I brought the frisbee for someone else. That's the whole announcement.
beats.chinese: 你好。我今天不玩。就给别人把飞盘送来。要说的就这些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips her wrist free of the edge and checks that it will stay tucked under her coat.
beats.chinese: 她把手腕从盘边抽出来，看看外套能不能把它夹稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They'll ask me how the cat is, if they're asking anything. The cat can make up his own excuses.
beats.chinese: 他们真要问，就问我家猫怎么样。它的理由它自己编。

causality.presenceReason: 去给排练室找街上朋友拿回钥匙，自己戴着一双织好的袜子带备用一双
causality.placeAttitude: 习惯争分清楚，不想被占等人时间
causality.stayingConstraint: 等朋友走到同一街角，手上袋子不开太久
causality.currentGoal: 还顺手搭把手的情分，最后不把双方扯进还人情
causality.currentState: 对方说不用回报，她一时不知道怎么接
causality.contactTrigger: 塑料袋要被风刮走，玩家提醒，她压住后找能回送的物品
causality.characterContinuity: 收到好处立刻想折给价，不解释谁缺席，朋友不该欠她
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 把袜子留给排练室。ab 用准备送人的另一个来对换。ba 说谢但不过分客套。bb 把袜子照原意给玩家选择
causality.spatialContinuity: 公共人行道上，没有走上临街车行面
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天谈的是自己缺席，没有要求说明原因

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: By the pavement near St Giles', a man tests the width of a bag against his sideways shoulder. He moves in when he sees you.
beats.chinese: 圣吉尔斯附近的人行道上，一个男人侧着肩膀，比划手里袋子有多宽。看你过来，他往里站了站。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's room. I promise you're not about to be asked to move a table.
beats.chinese: 路够宽。放心，没人要请你搬桌。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the bag flat against his coat. A pot lid prints a circle in the cloth.
beats.chinese: 他把袋子贴着大衣夹平。锅盖在布上顶出一个圆圈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got dinner at mine. This'll fit through the door. It's the table I bought that people have to turn sideways for.
beats.chinese: 我家今晚有人来吃饭。这口锅过得了门。反倒是我买的那张桌子，到家的人得侧着走才能坐下。

choices.english: Ask if everybody would fit better with the chairs rearranged.
choices.chinese: 问换换椅子的位置，人是不是能好坐点。

choices.english: Ask whether he's thinking of getting rid of the table.
choices.chinese: 问他是不是打算不要那桌子了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts his free hand against the bag as if checking the reach across the table.
beats.chinese: 他拿空着的手抵在袋子上，像在比桌这头够到那头多远。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seats fit. It's getting to them. Last time my sister sent her plate round first with somebody else.
beats.chinese: 都坐得下，就是走过去费劲。上回我姐先让别人替她把盘子传过去，人才挤进座。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls the bag higher under his arm.
beats.chinese: 他把袋子往胳膊下提了提。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can leave the door end empty or tell people how to get round before they come.
beats.chinese: 可以把门口那头空着。要不就来之前跟人讲好怎么绕。

choices.english: Try leaving the seat nearest the door free.
choices.chinese: 建议门边那把椅子空着。

choices.english: Tell everyone about the squeeze in advance.
choices.chinese: 建议提前告诉来的人，要侧着走一段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pats the round outline of the lid through the bag.
beats.chinese: 他隔着袋子拍拍锅盖鼓出来的那一圈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thought about selling it. Then nobody went home after we'd eaten. They sat there for three hours. I can't put that in the advert.
beats.chinese: 想过卖。后来那回吃完饭没一个走的，大伙儿又坐了三个钟头。这也不能写进卖桌子的广告里呀。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stands away from the kerb when a passing group comes up behind him.
beats.chinese: 后头来了一拨人，他朝离路缘远一点的地方站过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've already got one pot at home as well. This one was a moment of weakness, like the table.
beats.chinese: 我家也已经有一只锅了。这口又是看着喜欢，脑子热了一下。买桌那回也这样。

choices.english: Ask if he'd be happier giving the pot back.
choices.chinese: 问把锅退了会不会更舒服。

choices.english: Let the table stay where it is.
choices.chinese: 桌子就让它留原位。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds three fingers up, puts one down and looks at the two left standing.
beats.chinese: 他竖起三根手指，又弯下去一根，瞧剩下的那两根。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Chair by the door can go before they get there. I'm not letting a guest do it while they're holding a potato.
beats.chinese: 成。人来以前我先把门口的椅子移走。不能让客人一手拿土豆还得帮我挪椅子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He steadies the pot lid and shifts the bag to the other side.
beats.chinese: 他扶住锅盖，把袋子换到另一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And my sister can carry her own plate in. She'll think I've bought a bigger flat.
beats.chinese: 我姐也能自己端盘子进去了。她准以为我换了个大房子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings out his phone, takes a short breath, and holds the recording button.
beats.chinese: 他拿出手机，吸了小口气，按住语音键。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind the table when you come. Big awkward thing. We like it. There's no need to help move it.
beats.chinese: 来的时候小心桌子，又大又碍事。我们是挺喜欢，也不用谁帮忙搬。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends the note and puts the phone into the bag beside the pot.
beats.chinese: 他发完消息，把手机放到装锅的袋子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Nobody can say they've been ambushed by furniture.
beats.chinese: 好了。这回家具可没伏击谁。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the receipt and turns towards the way he came.
beats.chinese: 他看看小票，转向自己刚才过来的那头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask if she'll take it back. I wanted to buy something to fit round the table, and it turns out the people already fit.
beats.chinese: 我问问人家肯不肯退。我原来总想再买点东西配我的桌子，仔细想想，人都能坐下了呀。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He regrips the bag with just one hand.
beats.chinese: 他重新把袋子换成单手拎着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Might keep the lid. I actually need a lid.
beats.chinese: 也许盖留下，我还真缺个盖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the receipt in his pocket and presses the pot steady through the bag.
beats.chinese: 他把小票留在口袋里，隔着袋子按稳锅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I'll keep it where I know all the bruises are. I used to bang the wrong knee first for about a year.
beats.chinese: 行，还是放原来的地方。哪儿会磕我都熟了。有一年我每回还先撞另一边膝盖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets a little group pass, then starts down the same pavement.
beats.chinese: 他让一小拨人过去，接着沿这侧人行道走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've stopped leaving myself a smaller table to look at online.
beats.chinese: 我把网上看中的那张小桌也从收藏里撤了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day outside St Giles', Dougal lifts a small salt pot when he sees you.
beats.chinese: 另一天在圣吉尔斯外头，道格尔看见你，举了举手里一小罐盐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. That's my sister's. She tried seasoning a potato from the far edge of my table and got the salt most of the way across.
beats.chinese: 你好。这是我姐的。她从我桌子最外头给土豆撒盐，盐撒了大半张桌。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives the pot a small shake and screws the lid down.
beats.chinese: 他摇了下小罐，把盖拧紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll put it within reach next time. Or she'll come with her own table.
beats.chinese: 下回我搁她够得着的地方。不然她该自己扛桌子来了。

causality.presenceReason: 在皇家英里等人顺道取一只二手锅，正躲开买错东西的念头
causality.placeAttitude: 人行道能留着锅不挡脚
causality.stayingConstraint: 得由朋友先看锅大小，自己晚些还有家宴
causality.currentGoal: 决定如何给客人讲清楚大桌子只能侧着进
causality.currentState: 想到自己买桌的事会认栽，有点舍不得被笑
causality.contactTrigger: 拿包擦到外套时先让开，顺口问从人行道过去需不需要侧身
causality.characterContinuity: 不接受同情，客人不能帮他硬挪桌，留人吃饭的心是真的
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 调座不用动桌。ab 先把话告诉来的人。ba 不买锅。bb 只带锅，不开始换桌
causality.spatialContinuity: 圣吉尔斯附近同侧人行道，桌在家中
