beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Near the cathedral, Callum holds a cut paper square towards the grey sky. A sliver of red appears at its edge.
beats.chinese: 大教堂附近，卡勒姆把一块刻过的方纸举向灰蒙蒙的天。纸边露出一线红。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can see that red, can't you? I could see it on my kitchen table. Took it outside and it disappeared.
beats.chinese: 你看得见那条红的吧？在我家厨房桌上还看得见。拿出来倒一下没了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the paper and steps out of the line of people on the pavement.
beats.chinese: 他放低纸，避开人行道上的一列人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It isn't painted. There's a layer underneath. I've cut halfway through the top and now I can't tell what I'm looking at.
beats.chinese: 不是涂的，底下还有一层。我把上面裁开一半了，这会儿倒看不出自己看的是哪层。

choices.english: Ask him to turn the paper towards you.
choices.chinese: 请他把纸朝你这边转过来。

choices.english: Ask what he meant to make with all the layers.
choices.chinese: 问他原本想用这几层纸做个什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the cut away from the sky and lays it flat against his other hand.
beats.chinese: 他不让切口朝天，把纸平平贴在另一只手上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There it goes. If the top edge casts a shadow, the red only shows from one side.
beats.chinese: 这不，又没了。上面边儿要是有影，红色就只能从一头看见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the other corner. The edge opens slightly.
beats.chinese: 他抬起对面的一个角，纸边轻轻张开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can leave the shadow. Might be the only thing I got right.
beats.chinese: 这道影也能留。搞不好就它弄对了。

choices.english: Look from the side where the red was visible.
choices.chinese: 从刚才能看见红的那一侧再看。

choices.english: Suggest leaving both appearances in the finished piece.
choices.chinese: 建议保留两面看着不一样的效果。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets the paper rest on his palm. The thickest layer curves up.
beats.chinese: 他把纸搁在手心。最厚的那层向上卷了点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A corner of a building I made up. Started with a red wall, then gave it six floors I couldn't fit in.
beats.chinese: 想的是一栋瞎编的楼，刻个角。开头是红墙，后来又添了六层，根本装不进来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the square in his palm rather than lifting it back up for you.
beats.chinese: 他还把方纸搁手心里，没往你面前又举一次。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you were going to ask me about the real building behind us, I'll be no use at all.
beats.chinese: 你要本来想问身后这座真的，我可一点忙都帮不上。

choices.english: Ask to hear only one detail of the imaginary building.
choices.chinese: 只问假楼里一处有意思的地方。

choices.english: Tell him it's fine to leave it there.
choices.chinese: 说这件事先聊到这儿就好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns it far enough for the red to show. A little cut at the edge picks up the light.
beats.chinese: 他把方纸转到红色出现。纸边一道小切口正好照亮了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. It's the tiny cut that's letting the light through. I thought I'd ruined that bit.
beats.chinese: 对了，是那道小口子放进来的光。我原来还以为那儿刻坏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves the square a little farther into the light so you can see the change.
beats.chinese: 他把纸又往亮处挪了一点儿，好让你看见变色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. It disappears at about there. That's much better than a plain wall.
beats.chinese: 就这个角度没的。比一块光墙好看多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops moving the paper once it goes dark again.
beats.chinese: 红色一暗，他就停住不再转纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. I'll leave it with both. I can do a flat version later if I start missing it.
beats.chinese: 行，两样都留着。回头非想念原来平的那版，再做一张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the square into a large envelope without pushing its corners flat.
beats.chinese: 他把方纸放进大信封，没硬把卷起的角压平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Might go home before I get another good idea and start cutting.
beats.chinese: 我得趁又想到个好办法要下刀以前，先回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the square against a plain envelope and uses one thumb to mark a corner.
beats.chinese: 他把纸贴在一个素信封上，用拇指抵着一角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nobody's put a window right here. There is one on the other side. You'd have to come out of the lift to see anything.
beats.chinese: 这儿没给窗。另一边才有一扇。得先出了电梯才看得到外面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He drops his thumb and doesn't turn the paper any farther.
beats.chinese: 他放下手指，没接着给你转别的面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my favourite bit. I've never lived anywhere with the lift I want.
beats.chinese: 就这块我最喜欢。我还真没住过哪栋楼，电梯称我的心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the square away with the red layer turned to the back.
beats.chinese: 他把方纸收好，有红的那一层朝后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Alright. I'm going to leave the actual church to the people who know it, and this one to me.
beats.chinese: 行。真教堂留给熟悉的人讲吧，这栋我自己留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a step past the corner and looks for a clear line along the pavement.
beats.chinese: 他过了拐角一步，沿人行道找了条能直着走的线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Should have let my eyes get used to outside first.
beats.chinese: 我刚真该让眼睛先习惯习惯外头的光。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week, Callum sees you on the Royal Mile with a folded drawing pressed to his coat.
beats.chinese: 过几天，卡勒姆在皇家英里街看见你，外套前压着张折起来的画。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I put a road on this island without any way to get a car onto it. That's bothered nobody except my brother.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我在这个小岛上画了条公路，又没画车能开上岛的地方。除了我弟，压根没人在乎。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the map only as far as the little island.
beats.chinese: 他把图只打开到小岛那一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm leaving it. He can get there in his head like everybody else.
beats.chinese: 就这么留着。他跟别人一样，自己想象着过去吧。

causality.presenceReason: 来市内见同事买一叠纸，手里持有自制的试刻
causality.placeAttitude: 街上自然光改变同一层纸的颜色
causality.stayingConstraint: 等送纸的人要在约好时段到
causality.currentGoal: 确认一处阴影如何和压痕分开
causality.currentState: 谈自己的物件容易以为别人跟得上
causality.contactTrigger: 举起纸刻后，转手让出路又把空中的对象指给玩家
causality.characterContinuity: 讲清楚而非道歉，知道没兴趣时不追着讲
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 从另一向看出刻边。ab 自己接受不知道。ba 不假装喜欢对方想聊的话题。bb 收好走自己的路
causality.spatialContinuity: 皇家英里人行区，大教堂外立面只作光源方向标记
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另有地图成品，不引用试刻经历

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A young man on the Royal Mile sets a chipped cup upright in the side of his bag. It tips over the moment he lets go.
beats.chinese: 皇家英里街上，一个年轻人把缺了口的杯子竖进袋子侧兜。手一松，杯就歪了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's been doing my head in. At work I'd wedge it with tissue and tell everybody it was meant to look like that.
beats.chinese: 把我烦死了。换在店里，就拿纸垫起来，再跟人说特意摆成这样的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls the cup out and hooks a finger through the handle.
beats.chinese: 他把杯子拿出来，一根手指勾着杯把。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's for my flat. It'll have spring onions in it. My mate wants me to send her a photo when I've got the nice side facing out.
beats.chinese: 给我家用的，到时候栽点小葱。我朋友还说，把好看的那一面朝外，给她发张照。

choices.english: Ask whether he even likes the nice side best.
choices.chinese: 问好看的那面是不是他自己最喜欢的。

choices.english: Ask where the cup will have to go at home.
choices.chinese: 问杯子到家会放在哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the chip into the light. It's a little gap with no sharp edge sticking out.
beats.chinese: 他把缺口转到光下。那儿只缺了一块，没有支出来的尖边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like this. Looks as if somebody used it. That's never the side I'm supposed to put to the glass.
beats.chinese: 我喜欢这儿。看着像真有人用过。在橱窗里，这面可从来不能朝外。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the heel of his hand under the cup to see how it sits straight.
beats.chinese: 他把掌根托到杯底下，看杯子怎么能放平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can show the chip. Or put the whole thing behind the kettle where I can actually get at it.
beats.chinese: 可以就给她看缺口。也能整个放水壶后头，伸手还能拿得到。

choices.english: Let the chipped side face out for once.
choices.chinese: 这回让缺口对着自己看得见的一边。

choices.english: Tell him to put it where he'll use it.
choices.chinese: 建议就放顺手的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He covers the cup with the palm of his hand while a group goes by.
beats.chinese: 一群人经过，他用掌心盖住杯口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Somewhere the football boots aren't. That might be the windowsill, if I move the laundry.
beats.chinese: 放足球鞋碰不着的地方。把衣服挪一下，也许窗台就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks a message. The little cup stays in his hand.
beats.chinese: 他看了眼消息，破口杯还握手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's coming round later and I think she expects it to look like the window I do on Tuesdays.
beats.chinese: 她晚点来我家。我看她指着我家也跟我周二布置的橱窗一个样。

choices.english: Suggest asking when she's actually coming over.
choices.chinese: 建议先问清几点过来。

choices.english: Say it's okay if she never gets a staged photo.
choices.chinese: 说不特意摆好了拍张照片，也没事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the chip round again and points it towards his own body.
beats.chinese: 他又把缺口转了转，这次朝自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll see that when I put the kettle on. Better than lining it up for somebody at the window.
beats.chinese: 往后我一烧水就看得见。比对着窗外给人摆齐有意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the handle into the bag strap where it can't flop.
beats.chinese: 他把杯把勾进包带里，这回歪不了了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll get it home. The good side can have the wall.
beats.chinese: 这样能带到家了。好看的那面就看墙吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He wraps the cup in a spare shirt from the bag.
beats.chinese: 他从袋里抽出备用衬衣，把杯子裹上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Behind the kettle. If she takes a picture of the kettle instead I'll leave that up to her.
beats.chinese: 就放水壶后。她想改拍水壶也随她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the wrapped shape down among the other things.
beats.chinese: 他把裹出来的那一团塞进袋里旁的东西中间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I put the pretty bits out for forty hours a week. This one's for grabbing in the dark.
beats.chinese: 我一个礼拜有四十个钟头都在往外摆好看的东西。这杯就留着摸黑也能拿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a time with the cup balanced on his forearm.
beats.chinese: 他拿胳膊托着杯，在手机上敲了个时间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said seven, come in, excuse the boots. The picture will happen if there's a picture worth taking.
beats.chinese: 我说七点来吧，地上有球鞋别介意。到时候有东西值得拍，拍就是了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He hits send and transfers the cup back into his hand.
beats.chinese: 他点了发送，又把杯子拿回手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seven gives me time to put water in it. That's all I've planned.
beats.chinese: 七点前够我给里头倒点水。我也就这一个安排。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts his phone away without opening the camera.
beats.chinese: 他电话一收，相机都没开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. She can have a cup of tea when she gets there. Nobody needs to see the rest of the cups first.
beats.chinese: 也是。她来了可以喝杯茶。又不用来之前先把我家别的杯子都看一轮。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the chipped cup upside down so it stops catching on the bag.
beats.chinese: 他把缺口杯倒过来放，终于不再勾袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's going to live upside down till I get home. That'll be a scandal.
beats.chinese: 在我到家之前，它非得倒着过日子了。传出去可不得了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another morning on the Royal Mile, Callum sees you with a strip of cardboard folded to the size of his hand.
beats.chinese: 又一个早上，卡勒姆在皇家英里街看见你，手里一截硬纸板叠到手掌大小。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I drew three versions of a coaster on this. Folded it over four times and used the cardboard.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我在这上面画了三种杯垫。最后折了四下，直接拿纸板垫了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the drawn side in again and pats the top to flatten it.
beats.chinese: 他把画过的那边又折进去，拍平了上头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Doesn't look like much. Didn't get a wet table once.
beats.chinese: 不怎么好看。桌子倒一滴水也没沾。

causality.presenceReason: 来皇家英里过手一只缺角小杯给合租朋友种葱
causality.placeAttitude: 在街上没需求把生活摆成橱窗
causality.stayingConstraint: 对方路过来拿，不耽误送给自己用
causality.currentGoal: 把杯子是自用还是作为摆设这点说清
causality.currentState: 被朋友用工作眼光打量住处有点嫌烦
causality.contactTrigger: 杯子从便当包侧面露着，问经过的人看着是不是像特地摆的
causality.characterContinuity: 懂展示也懂休息，不为别人把自己的家摆拍
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 缺口正对自己。ab 放平杯不拿去陈列。ba 约见先问能不能来。bb 坚持照片可以不要
causality.spatialContinuity: 人行道上不把杯放地上，门后空间没发生
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一日自制临时杯垫与旧杯不相同

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman by the Dugald Stewart monument says one sentence towards the city below. She folds the page in half and says it again.
beats.chinese: 杜格尔德·斯图尔特纪念亭旁，一个女人对着山下说了句话。把纸折半，又说了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. I'll leave the light on. Did that sound angry from where you are?
beats.chinese: 行吧，我给你留灯。你站那儿听，像生气了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The wind presses the folded page against her jacket. She lets it lie there.
beats.chinese: 风把折纸压在她外套上，她索性就那么贴着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's one line for a show my mates make. I'm meant to have a day off. Look how well I'm doing.
beats.chinese: 给朋友做的广播剧念一句。我今天本来歇着。歇得可好了，你看。

choices.english: A bit angry. Let me hear it the other way.
choices.chinese: 是有点。换个语气我听听呢？

choices.english: Put it away. What did you come up here for?
choices.chinese: 先收着吧。你上来是为了什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps her eyes on the roofs while she reads the line a third time.
beats.chinese: 她看着山下的屋顶，又念了第三遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. I'll leave the light on. Now I sound like somebody doing a good deed and wanting you to know about it.
beats.chinese: 行吧，我给你留灯。这回又跟做了好事生怕你不知道一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down at the page and draws a fingernail under the first word.
beats.chinese: 她低头看稿，指甲在头一个词底下划过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Funny, my friend never put fine in the script. That's mine.
beats.chinese: 怪了，稿里没写行吧。这两个字我自己加的。

choices.english: Try the line without the first word.
choices.chinese: 开头俩字去掉，再试一次。

choices.english: Let it sound angry for a minute. What happens if it does?
choices.chinese: 先让她有点火气吧。说出来又怎么着呢？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the page on the same crease and pinches it shut.
beats.chinese: 她沿原来那条折痕合起稿子，手指捏严。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was going to meet Nia and have a look down there. She said she'd draw and I'd do nothing. I'd agreed to nothing.
beats.chinese: 本来和妮娅约这儿，看看山底下。她说她画画，我什么也不干。我答应的就是什么也不干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A bus far below appears briefly between two buildings.
beats.chinese: 山下远远一辆公交从两栋楼间闪过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's harder to do nothing when you've got one sentence left and everybody knows you can fix it.
beats.chinese: 就剩一句，还谁都知道你能弄好，这时候最难什么都不干。

choices.english: Look at the city with her for a moment.
choices.chinese: 和她在这儿看看城里。

choices.english: Ask if one more thing always turns into more work.
choices.chinese: 问她是不是每回顺手做一件，又跟着来一串活儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks up from the page before the sentence starts this time.
beats.chinese: 这回她要说那句之前，先把头抬了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave the light on. Oh, that's all I needed. It can sound like she still cares and hasn't got much else to say.
beats.chinese: 我给你留灯。哎，就这样。她还挂念那个人，又没那么多话好说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the page into her pocket without getting the recorder out.
beats.chinese: 她把稿叠进兜，录音设备也没掏出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll remember it. I have to go and do nothing now.
beats.chinese: 我记得住。现在得去什么也不干了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She says the whole line quietly without looking at the paper.
beats.chinese: 她不看稿，压着声音把整句说完。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That sounds like my sister. Furious. Still leaves the light on.
beats.chinese: 这下像我姐了。气得要命，灯还是给你留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her finger lands twice against the fold. She puts the page away.
beats.chinese: 她手指在折痕上敲两下，把纸收走了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll let them hear that version at rehearsal. They can ask her to be nicer if they want.
beats.chinese: 排练给他们听这版。非想让这人好说话一点，让他们自己来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She drops the page right down into her coat pocket and turns towards the view.
beats.chinese: 她把稿整个按到大衣兜底，转过去看山下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. No script. That patch of roof looks blue from up here.
beats.chinese: 好了，没稿了。那一片屋顶从这儿看还挺蓝。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stands still until a bit of light slides across the town.
beats.chinese: 她站着没动，直到一片亮光从城里移过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's why I came. I did know at the bottom of the hill.
beats.chinese: 就为这个上来的。我还在山脚下的时候倒记得清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sees a message light up and tucks the phone away without opening it.
beats.chinese: 手机亮了一条消息，她没点开就揣回去了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually. I can give them one read tonight. I'm not editing the whole scene because I'm the one who answered first.
beats.chinese: 通常是。今晚可以给他们念一遍。总不能就因为我第一个回消息，整场就都让我剪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses her hands flat against the coat pockets.
beats.chinese: 她双手平按大衣口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's what I'll say tonight. I'd like to be off till tonight.
beats.chinese: 今晚再跟他们说。我想踏实歇到晚上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few days later up on the hill, Isla sees you while listening to a clip, and stops it with a laugh.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，又在山上，艾拉边听一段声音边看见你，笑着按了暂停。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. We've got a lovely sound of somebody coming home at night. Then I yawn straight into the microphone.
beats.chinese: 嗨，录到个特别好的晚上回家声。然后我对着麦克风，哈欠打了个结结实实。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves the phone away from her mouth and rolls it once in her palm.
beats.chinese: 她把手机拿得离嘴远一点，在手心里转了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might keep the yawn. She has had a long day.
beats.chinese: 哈欠兴许能留。剧里那人也忙一天了。

causality.presenceReason: 和朋友见面各做各的，带了待改的两句稿
causality.placeAttitude: 纪念亭旁能看城景，来这儿就愿意把录音的事放下
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友还没到，只改一句不接活
causality.currentGoal: 判断一句台词靠语气能不能听懂
causality.currentState: 一开聊很来劲，听见要加工作马上减速
causality.contactTrigger: 风顶住纸稿，她将纸抱回来主动请人听一句
causality.characterContinuity: 起劲也不承诺弄不完的活，不修别人半途冒出的项目
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 用户指出票卡上的错句后当场试。ab 容许更直的说法。ba 放下稿聊城景。bb 明确不承担临时工作
causality.spatialContinuity: 山顶亭前同一层步道，不下坡不探身
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 当天出现意外哈欠录音，不依赖初遇

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A little bell sounds beside the lookout path. Ewan takes the phone out of his coat, making it stop mid ring.
beats.chinese: 观景步道旁响了一声小铃。尤恩把手机从大衣里拿出来，铃在半声里断了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. That's mine. It sounds better when it's an actual bell.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，是我的。真铃响起来比这好听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reads the new message. His mouth stays open for a beat.
beats.chinese: 他读了新来的消息，嘴张着停了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Apparently I'm free to play on Sunday. I was due to find out if I was free at seven tonight.
beats.chinese: 看来我周日有空演奏了。我原本今晚七点才知道自己有没有空。

choices.english: Who told them you could do it?
choices.chinese: 谁替你说能去的？

choices.english: Do they really need to know before seven?
choices.chinese: 他们非得七点之前知道吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the screen low beside his leg.
beats.chinese: 他把屏幕转到腿旁，拿低了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My flatmate. He asked me yesterday, and I said I'd tell him before rehearsal. He got as far as hearing I'd tell him.
beats.chinese: 我室友。昨天问的，我说排练之前告诉他。他就听到我会告诉他，后面没了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts one thumb on the phone without hitting send.
beats.chinese: 他一根拇指搁到手机上，没按发送。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If they need another pair of hands they can ask now. If they only want mine they can wait.
beats.chinese: 他们急着找人，现在就能找别人。非要我去，那可以等等。

choices.english: Ask them to wait until the time you agreed.
choices.chinese: 请他们等到先前说好的时间。

choices.english: Tell them you won't mind if they fill the spot now.
choices.chinese: 告诉他们现在找别人也行，你不介意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks up towards the monument and blinks once into the light.
beats.chinese: 他抬头朝纪念亭望了一眼，迎着光眨了下眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If somebody else needs to get away early, I can see it. He didn't say that. He said he figured I'd come round.
beats.chinese: 要是别人得早走，我能明白。他又没那么说。他说反正我想着想着就答应了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the phone on his palm with nothing typed yet.
beats.chinese: 他把手机放平在掌上，一字还没打。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can go. I haven't said I will. I'm allowed to be in between those things for a bit.
beats.chinese: 我能去，也还没说会去。这中间我总能停一小会儿吧。

choices.english: Ask him to correct what his flatmate said first.
choices.chinese: 请他先把室友替他说的那句纠正过来。

choices.english: If you'd rather skip it, tell them now.
choices.chinese: 你要本来就不想去，现在就说吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types seven and leaves the next line blank.
beats.chinese: 他打了个七点，下一行空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At seven, I'll give you an answer. That's what we agreed. I didn't say I wouldn't like it.
beats.chinese: 七点，我给你个准话。原先就这么说的。我也没说我不喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reads his reply once before sending it and takes a deep breath as he locks the screen.
beats.chinese: 他发前读了一遍，把屏幕一锁，吸了口深气。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was leaning yes. I want to be the person who turns up with it.
beats.chinese: 我原来还偏想答应。也得由我自己开那句口啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends one message to the ensemble rather than to his flatmate.
beats.chinese: 他直接在手铃小组里发了条消息，没发给室友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you need my part covered now, cover it. I can still come and listen if I've got the evening.
beats.chinese: 急着找人接我的声部，那就先找。我要那晚上有空，还是能来听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a few steps away from the busy part of the lookout.
beats.chinese: 他从观景人多的那段走开几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I quite fancy hearing what the whole thing sounds like from the chairs.
beats.chinese: 我倒挺想坐下面听听，整首到底什么样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls up the first message and types a small correction underneath it.
beats.chinese: 他把第一条翻出来，在底下补了一小句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you take my name back off it for now. That'll do. He can put an empty space where I was.
beats.chinese: 你先把我的名字去掉，行吗。这样就行。原来我在的地方先空着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the sounds off on his phone. He stays looking across the roofs.
beats.chinese: 他把手机调成静音，眼睛还越过一片屋顶看着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I thought he knew me better than that. He usually does.
beats.chinese: 我以为他懂我来着。平常是挺懂的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the phone a little higher and types with both hands.
beats.chinese: 他把手机举高一点，两手开始打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No this Sunday. I can tell him that much now. I was going to give it another hour because I didn't like sending it.
beats.chinese: 这周日不行。这句现在就能告诉他。原想再拖一个钟头，是我自己不想把它发出去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends it and looks at the screen until the reply begins.
beats.chinese: 他点了发送，一直看着屏幕，直到那边开始回。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. All right, he says. Took him about a second.
beats.chinese: 哦，他说成。人家就花了一秒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later afternoon, Ewan notices you by the monument while rolling a little scrap of carpet in his hand.
beats.chinese: 后来有天下午，尤恩在纪念亭边瞧见你，手里滚着一小条地毯样品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I picked the rug on Saturday. Left the shop without buying it on Sunday. That's a sort of decision.
beats.chinese: 你好。我周六挑好了地毯。周日进了店又没买。这也算做了个决定吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the offcut over. There is one pale square on the back where a label used to be.
beats.chinese: 他翻过布样。背后有一块浅方印，原来贴过标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give the sample back tomorrow. I can keep the bare floor.
beats.chinese: 明天把样品还了。地板就继续光着吧。

causality.presenceReason: 上山等手铃排练前见室友，考虑是否加吹一遍聚会曲
causality.placeAttitude: 在开阔处能暂时隔开急催
causality.stayingConstraint: 等自己说过的七点再决定
causality.currentGoal: 留有决定权，也不吊着需要回家的人
causality.currentState: 室友替他说可以，脸上不快，声音很低
causality.contactTrigger: 口袋里铃响起不是乐器，抬头确认别人没被惊到
causality.characterContinuity: 习惯快到截止才确认，不能让别人代选，会体谅真实硬时间
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 保住约定的时限。ab 改成不耽误全组的安排。ba 要求删掉先答应的。bb 愿意直接说不而非拖住
causality.spatialContinuity: 纪念亭前公共观景步道，钟和排练只在手机和话里
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天提到没买地毯，没有牵连上一轮

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan hands a phone back to a walker by the monument. Three people lean in to see the photo. Rowan steps out of the huddle.
beats.chinese: 纪念亭旁，罗文把手机还给一位散步的人。三个人凑头看照片，罗文先从圈里退出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a good last picture. Which is why somebody's about to say let's do another.
beats.chinese: 当最后一张挺好。所以马上就该有人说，再来一张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A voice behind Rowan does just that. Rowan looks at you, eyebrows up.
beats.chinese: 罗文背后真有人这么说了。罗文挑起眉毛看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I liked the walk. Had a great time. That bit was true the first time I said it.
beats.chinese: 这一路我挺喜欢，玩得真不错。头一次这么说的时候，我可是真心的。

choices.english: Tell them it's fine to call it there.
choices.chinese: 跟罗文说，到这儿停也挺好。

choices.english: Ask whether they still want a minute on the hill.
choices.chinese: 问还想不想在山上多待一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan rubs their hands once, then lets them drop.
beats.chinese: 罗文搓一下手，又放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can go with that picture in my head. Or I can have one more up here without moving everybody around like a chess set.
beats.chinese: 可以脑子里留着那张图就走。也可以再多待一会儿，又不必把全组人当棋子挪来挪去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look back at one friend who's still laughing at the screen.
beats.chinese: 罗文回头看还有一个对着屏幕在笑的朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to say bye before they set me up in a different place.
beats.chinese: 得趁他们又给我安排个新位置之前，先说声我走了。

choices.english: Say goodbye when the group is still laughing.
choices.chinese: 就趁大伙儿还在笑的时候道别。

choices.english: Take a minute by the view without getting everyone to pose.
choices.chinese: 先再看一小会儿景，不张罗合影。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan watches the group fan out across the paving.
beats.chinese: 罗文看着那群人在石铺路面上散开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I want about five minutes. They want to get chips and go somewhere else for coffee and put a bit more day on the end of the day.
beats.chinese: 我还想待五分钟左右。他们想吃薯条，还想换地方喝咖啡，一天过完还得在后头接一截。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One of the group calls back to check who's coming. Rowan lifts a hand without calling out.
beats.chinese: 有个人回头喊还有谁来。罗文抬了下手，没喊回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could just stay up here for now. Then I've only got to tell them once.
beats.chinese: 我可以自己在这儿待着。跟他们说一遍就够了。

choices.english: Let the others go ahead.
choices.chinese: 让他们接着去。

choices.english: Ask Rowan to say what they actually want to do next.
choices.chinese: 请罗文直接说自己接下来想做什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan turns round towards the group, takes one step, and calls just loud enough to be heard.
beats.chinese: 罗文转向那群人，走近一步，刚好喊到听得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my lot. Send me the one where we all look like ourselves.
beats.chinese: 我先走啦。把大伙儿都拍得像自己那张发给我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One of the walkers waves, still holding the phone in their other hand.
beats.chinese: 一个散步的人挥手，另一手还攥着手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I like that bit too.
beats.chinese: 喏，最后这一下我也挺喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan makes an open space beside the monument and stands looking over the city.
beats.chinese: 罗文在纪念亭边腾出一块地方，站着看城里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Nobody needs to turn round for this picture.
beats.chinese: 行。这画面不用谁调个头对着镜头。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They don't speak again until a bright spot below moves out of sight.
beats.chinese: 山下的一个亮点移出了视野，罗文才再开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's plenty. I can get home warm now.
beats.chinese: 这就够啦。还能趁身上热乎走回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan shakes their head once at the caller and keeps their hand raised while the others move off.
beats.chinese: 罗文朝招呼的人摇了下头，等其他人走远，手才放下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm staying five. Get chips hot. I mean it, don't wait for me.
beats.chinese: 我再待五分钟。赶紧趁热吃薯条，真不用等我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One walker slows, then carries on after Rowan gives a quick nod.
beats.chinese: 有个人慢下来，罗文朝那人赶紧点了个头，对方接着走了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nice. I can still smell the chips in my head and I haven't got to have one.
beats.chinese: 挺好。我光想都能闻到薯条味，又不用真吃一根。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan puts their hands back by their sides and speaks to the person who asked.
beats.chinese: 罗文把手垂回身边，转向刚那位喊人的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going home in a minute. Walk was lovely. Coffee for you lot if you still want it.
beats.chinese: 我一会儿回家。走这一趟挺好。你们还想喝咖啡就去吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: An answer comes back. Rowan waits without picking their things up yet.
beats.chinese: 有人回了一句，罗文没急着拿自己的东西，还站着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They haven't minded once since I stopped making a big thing of it.
beats.chinese: 我不再把这事弄得多了不得之后，人家一次也没介意过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later one morning, Rowan spots you by the lookout path and opens a little lunch tin just far enough to see what's folded inside.
beats.chinese: 后来一个早上，罗文在观景步道旁认出你，把小饭盒打开一点，刚能看清里面叠着什么。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. That was the first crêpe. I tore it right across where I'd got it thin enough to turn.
beats.chinese: 嗨。头一张薄饼。好不容易摊薄到能翻面，正从那儿扯成了两截。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They eat one torn corner and close the tin.
beats.chinese: 罗文吃了扯掉的一个角，盖回盒子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't think I'm getting better. I'm getting quicker at eating the evidence.
beats.chinese: 手艺好像没长进。倒是销毁证据越来越快了。

causality.presenceReason: 和邻居约在山顶散一阵步，自己先来
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢停在风景最好的时候
causality.stayingConstraint: 没答应再往下一处走
causality.currentGoal: 把合照与下一摊是否要去分开
causality.currentState: 刚开开心心逛完，有点怕好气氛又拖没
causality.contactTrigger: 替一组人按快门，放回站位顺口跟玩家说不想续
causality.characterContinuity: 可以玩得很好也可以离开，接受别人想继续，不装出还很开心
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 真正做个收尾。ab 留在原地再少待一会儿。ba 和邻居分开。bb 说清自己想走并不干扰别人
causality.spatialContinuity: 山顶同一层，镜头和站位在公共道
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新的一天说煎饼，与山顶老照片无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man by the monument points at one row of roofs, draws his finger back, then points at another.
beats.chinese: 纪念亭旁，一个男人指向一排屋顶。手指收回，又去指另一排。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Which one did you think I meant?
beats.chinese: 好。你以为我指的是哪排？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts both hands down and looks at you instead of the view.
beats.chinese: 他两手放下来，转头看你，不再望山底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I told a friend I'd catch him down there somewhere. Somewhere was the part I got right.
beats.chinese: 我跟朋友说在底下哪个地方能碰上。哪个地方这几个字是说对了。

choices.english: Look for one landmark you can both see.
choices.chinese: 先找个两个人都瞧得见的参照。

choices.english: Ask if he's actually agreed to meet at a particular place.
choices.chinese: 问他俩有没有说定在哪儿碰头。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leans just far enough along the paving to see past a person in front.
beats.chinese: 他沿石路侧了侧身，刚好能看过前面站着的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That white bit I had in mind is farther left. I was looking at something else with extreme confidence.
beats.chinese: 我脑子里那片白的还得往左。我倒特别有把握，盯着另一处瞧了半天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He doesn't point again. His eyes stay on the nearer path along the hill.
beats.chinese: 他没再伸手指，只看眼前沿山顶这一段路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I know this bit where we're standing. Can prove that much to myself standing here.
beats.chinese: 就咱站的这一截我认得。站这儿倒可以跟自己证明这一点。

choices.english: Ask what he mistook for the white roofs.
choices.chinese: 问他把什么看成那片白的了。

choices.english: Start with the part he can actually see from here.
choices.chinese: 从在这儿确实能看见的那一截想起。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls his cap down several inches against the wind.
beats.chinese: 他迎着风把帽子压低些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. He said see you if I see you. I took that as an order to get lost in a new place.
beats.chinese: 没有。他说碰得上就见。我听成了，找个新地方把自己走丢吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at his watch. The second hand has stopped.
beats.chinese: 他瞧了眼腕表。秒针停着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I haven't managed to be late yet. I could leave it like that.
beats.chinese: 到现在还能没迟到呢。照这样也挺好。

choices.english: Stay on the hill while there's a view.
choices.chinese: 趁现在还能看景，就在山上待着。

choices.english: Leave it open and go our separate ways.
choices.chinese: 那也别定了，各走各的吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns just enough for both rows to line up in his view.
beats.chinese: 他转了一点身，两排屋顶都能从现在这个角度看见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The wrong one's a lot nearer. I've been describing it to people for years as though I'd stood on it.
beats.chinese: 认错的那排近好多。我拿它给人讲了几年，讲得跟自己上去站过似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He spreads two fingers to show the gap, then drops his hand.
beats.chinese: 他分开两根指头，比出中间隔开那一截，又把手放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll tell my friend to forget the directions I sent. Especially any that sounded definite.
beats.chinese: 让朋友把我发的路线都忘了吧。越像有把握的，越别听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes two steps along the open part of the path and waits for you to come level.
beats.chinese: 他沿空着的那块步道走两步，等你站齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can get this far. There's a first sensible decision. I'll make the second when I get there.
beats.chinese: 能走到这儿。第一个主意还算靠谱，第二个到那儿再想。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns once to make sure he can still see the monument.
beats.chinese: 他回了一次头，确认纪念亭还看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I see the very same patch again fifteen minutes from now, I'll just say I like it.
beats.chinese: 一刻钟后要又走回同一块地儿，我就说我喜欢这儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets both feet flat and watches the light on the city below.
beats.chinese: 他两脚踩平，望着城底下的亮光。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Got up here and almost talked myself back down without seeing a thing.
beats.chinese: 也是。人都上来了，差点啥也没看，又把自己说下山了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A gap opens on the open side of the walkway. He makes no move towards it.
beats.chinese: 步道空的一侧又腾开了点位置。他没往那儿动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be up here ten minutes. Roughly.
beats.chinese: 我在上头再待十分钟。大概。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves back from the place he'd been pointing and turns down the clear side of the path.
beats.chinese: 他从刚才指来指去的地方退开，往步道没人挡的一侧转。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. If he's where I'm going, we'll both think I knew the way.
beats.chinese: 好啊。朋友要在我走到的地方，我俩都可以当我认识路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He passes slowly enough for a pair of walkers to go ahead.
beats.chinese: 他走得不急，让两个散步的人先过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good thing I haven't given you directions.
beats.chinese: 幸好没给你指过路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon at the top, Rowan recognises you with a folded gala programme in his hand.
beats.chinese: 另一个下午在山顶，罗文认出了你，手里攥着份折过的游泳赛秩序册。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Heat three, lane six. Been a week and I can still tell you what happened in it. Couldn't tell you the name of the street I came up.
beats.chinese: 你好。第三组，第六道。都过一个礼拜了，我还讲得出那场发生了什么。你问我顺哪条街上来的，我连名都叫不出。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the programme over to find the blank back and writes something small.
beats.chinese: 他把秩序册翻到没字的背面，在上头写了点小字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll write where I am now. That's one less thing to guess when I get home.
beats.chinese: 我先把现在在哪儿写上。到家能少猜一件事。

causality.presenceReason: 上山看一眼城里，再往没定下来的地方走
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢绕路有空和人说话，辨方向很容易过度自信
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友只说碰得上就碰，不是带队
causality.currentGoal: 不把路线又讲得十拿九稳
causality.currentState: 对弄错方向有点自嘲，放松后会接陌生人的招呼
causality.contactTrigger: 转身确认方向时听见玩家走近，先收回自己手指

causality.reactionAndChange: aa 发现认错一片屋顶。ab 学到确认过的一个开头。ba 留在山顶。bb 照一同看得到的路各走各的
causality.spatialContinuity: 山顶同层步道，没人跨到下方，路线只作为他个人打算

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman on the stone path in Parliament Square holds two cups up level with her face.
beats.chinese: 议会广场的石铺路上，一个女人把两杯东西举到眼前比了比。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Is that a dot on this lid or a bit of coffee? There's milk in one. I don't want to take my niece's by mistake.
beats.chinese: 你看这是画了个点儿，还是溅的咖啡？有一杯放了奶，我怕喝成我外甥女那杯。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers both cups. She sets her thumbs away from the holes in the lids.
beats.chinese: 她放低两个杯子，拇指都挪开，没堵着盖上的小孔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The fellow who sold them to me asked if I was sure I didn't want tea. That's how you know you've spent too long at the same job.
beats.chinese: 卖咖啡的还问我，确定不要茶吗？让人这么一问，就知道自己在一个地方干太久了。

choices.english: Look for a mark on both lids.
choices.chinese: 帮她看看两个盖子有没有记号。

choices.english: Ask why somebody would expect her to order tea.
choices.chinese: 问人家怎么会以为她要茶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the cups again, with the rims turned towards you.
beats.chinese: 她重新举起杯子，把杯沿转过来给你看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One coffee black, one with milk. I said mine first. That means nothing if he filled them in the other order.
beats.chinese: 一杯纯的，一杯加奶。我先报的我的。可他要是倒着装，我还是什么都不知道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slides one cup's cardboard sleeve down a little. A small mark shows on the side.
beats.chinese: 她把其中一杯的纸套往下推了推，杯身露出一点记号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He did write on it. God love him, I spent all this time looking at the lid.
beats.chinese: 人家写了。哎哟，我在这儿盯盖子盯了半天。

choices.english: Read the mark on the cup sleeve side.
choices.chinese: 看看纸套遮住的是个什么记号。

choices.english: Let her niece decide which cup is hers.
choices.chinese: 建议等她外甥女到了自己认。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls one corner of her mouth in and looks towards the stone path by the lawn.
beats.chinese: 她抿住一边嘴角，瞧了瞧草坪边的石路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep the blend records at a tea place. Took me twenty years to be left alone with my own instant coffee.
beats.chinese: 我在茶行管拼配记录。干了二十年才争取到自己喝杯速溶，旁边没人指点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She balances the cups apart on her palms.
beats.chinese: 她把两只杯子分开托在掌心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you're about to ask me what tea to buy, I'm going to ask you what you're watching on the telly.
beats.chinese: 你要打算问我茶买哪种，我可要反问你最近电视上看什么。

choices.english: Ask what she's watching lately.
choices.chinese: 问她最近在追什么剧。

choices.english: Give her a minute to watch for her niece.
choices.chinese: 给她留点空，让她看着外甥女来没来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She follows the stroke on the cup with her eyes. Then she pulls the sleeve back up.
beats.chinese: 她沿杯身那一道瞧了瞧，把纸套推了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's an M. Grand. Here, I'll move it to my right so I don't drink it while I'm looking for her.
beats.chinese: 写的是个 M。成。我换到右手，免得找人的时候顺嘴喝了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She switches the cups carefully, one pressed against her coat while the other passes across.
beats.chinese: 她把一只杯抵在大衣上，小心腾手换过另一只。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's a system. I'll forget the system before she gets here.
beats.chinese: 这就有规矩了。她人还没到，我准先把规矩忘了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the sleeves level so both cups look alike again.
beats.chinese: 她把两边的纸套推齐，两杯又长得一模一样了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She'll smell the milk from halfway over here. I'm the one making a ceremony of it.
beats.chinese: 她离老远就闻得出哪杯有奶。就我一个人在这儿搞得多大个事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A young woman lifts her fingers in greeting from the path. Bridie holds one cup forward, then the other.
beats.chinese: 石路上有个年轻姑娘抬手打招呼。布里迪先把一杯递出去，又把另一杯也递过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pick one. Apparently I've got none of the senses people pay me for after five.
beats.chinese: 你挑。五点以后，我拿工资练出来的那些本事就都不灵了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts both cups into one hand long enough to push her sleeve back.
beats.chinese: 她把两个杯子暂且归到一只手里，腾出手推开袖子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The one with the sister who keeps phoning from the car. She left a message on Monday that would curl your hair.
beats.chinese: 就那个老在车里打电话的姐姐。她周一留的那条语音，能吓掉你半条命。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sees your face and lifts the second cup back off her knuckles.
beats.chinese: 她瞧了眼你的脸，把第二杯从手指节上托起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You haven't seen it. Good. I'll shut up about the message. Have you time for how she got the car?
beats.chinese: 你没看过啊。好，我先不讲语音了。她那车是怎么来的，你有空听吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to give herself a better view of the path as people come past the lawn.
beats.chinese: 草坪边有人经过，她转了个向，好看清那条路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's what I ought to do. Last week she found me talking to a man about loose leaf and went straight past.
beats.chinese: 我是该好好看着。上礼拜她见我跟一个人聊散茶，从我旁边直接走过去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises the cups a little when someone she knows comes into sight.
beats.chinese: 看见熟人走来，她把两杯咖啡往上举了举。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Over here. I got coffee, like a normal aunt.
beats.chinese: 这边！我买的咖啡。这回总算有点姨妈样了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few days later, Bridie spots you on the paving in Parliament Square with a crossword folded to one clue.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，布里迪在议会广场的石路上瞧见你，把填字题折到只露出一条提示。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Would you believe they moved my show for the football? I get Monday evening off and the whole family on the telly gets the evening off as well.
beats.chinese: 嗨。你敢信吗，为了播球，我那部剧挪时间了。我周一晚上好不容易有空，电视里那一家子也跟着放假。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the puzzle back up without filling in the clue.
beats.chinese: 她那格没填，把题又折了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could watch the football, I suppose. No. Look at me, desperate.
beats.chinese: 球也不是不能看。算了吧，给我闲成什么样了。

causality.presenceReason: 给结束排练的外甥女送咖啡
causality.placeAttitude: 庭院适合见一面又走
causality.stayingConstraint: 不耽误自己回家看剧
causality.currentGoal: 把手里两杯分清
causality.currentState: 上了一天班，听见问茶就烦
causality.contactTrigger: 杯子没标，顺口请玩家帮忙看杯盖上的标记
causality.characterContinuity: 对工作认真，私人时间拒绝给茶评味，聊电视剧能回暖

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: By the lawn in Parliament Square, Aoife laughs at a phone with the sound off. They move a step out of the way.
beats.chinese: 议会广场草坪边，艾芙看着没开声音的手机笑了。见你来，往边上撤了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Are you waiting too? I've got about half a minute of a silent film here. My friend says I'm laughing at the wrong bit.
beats.chinese: 你也等人？我这儿有半分钟默片。我朋友说我笑的地方不对。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They hold the phone down between both hands, screen against one palm.
beats.chinese: 艾芙把手机放低，两手拿着，屏幕靠着一边手心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's a man trying to steal his own hat. The words come up after he's already got it back.
beats.chinese: 里头有个人想偷回自己的帽子。帽子都已经拿回来了，字幕才出来。

choices.english: Ask what the words say.
choices.chinese: 问字幕写的什么。

choices.english: Ask why they're only watching half a minute.
choices.chinese: 问怎么只看这半分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife brings the clip up to the still with words on it. They turn it just far enough for you to look.
beats.chinese: 艾芙把片段停在那张有字的画面，转到刚好能给你看的角度。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I have my reasons. That's what it says. The man in the hat's already run off when you read it.
beats.chinese: 我有我的理由。就这个。等你读到字，戴帽子的人早跑了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their finger slips back to the frame where the man nudges the hat over his eyes.
beats.chinese: 手指又滑到前一帧。男人把帽子往下拨了点，挡住眼睛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I reckon they could take the words out. My friend would say that's the funniest part gone.
beats.chinese: 我觉得干脆别放字幕。我朋友准说，全片就这儿最好笑，你还给剪了。

choices.english: Watch it once with the words covered.
choices.chinese: 试着挡住字幕看一遍。

choices.english: Offer two readings for their friend to choose between.
choices.chinese: 留两种说法，等朋友来了自己选。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife checks the time at the top of the phone, then keeps the clip paused.
beats.chinese: 艾芙看了眼手机上头的时间，没再放片段。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My old housemate's coming through here. We've said half a minute to each other about six times. There's a whole film still to go at home.
beats.chinese: 以前跟我合租的人一会儿从这儿来。我俩都互相说了六回再等半分钟了。家里还有整部片等着呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone buzzes once and Aoife reads the first line of the message.
beats.chinese: 手机振了一下，艾芙读了消息的第一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's them. I can spare you the plot. I haven't even got it straight myself.
beats.chinese: 人来了。我先不跟你讲剧情了吧，我自己还没看明白。

choices.english: Leave the rest of the clip for the two of them.
choices.chinese: 把余下的片段留给他们俩。

choices.english: Ask for one line they can use to restart the disagreement later.
choices.chinese: 问能不能留一句好让他俩回头接着争。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife slides a finger over the part of the screen where the words will be. The hat jerks down over the man's face.
beats.chinese: 艾芙用手指挡住要出字的地方。男人脸上的帽子猛地往下一滑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that's the man it belongs to. I'd been looking at his friend.
beats.chinese: 噢，原来帽子是这个人的。我刚才一直在看他朋友。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They let the words come back, then pause on the man's fingers at the brim.
beats.chinese: 艾芙放开手让字出来，又定格在男人的手指扒着帽沿那一幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've been arguing my side for two days and I didn't see him take it. That's going to cost me.
beats.chinese: 我坚持这么说都两天了，愣没看见原来是他拿的。这回我有苦头吃了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife types both possibilities into a note, leaving a blank line between them.
beats.chinese: 艾芙把两种说法都打到备忘里，中间留了一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's hiding or he's cross. I won't put which one you said. I don't want my friend voting for you just because you're new.
beats.chinese: 他在躲，或者他生气了。我不写哪句是你说的。省得我朋友看你是新来的，就偏要站你那边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They hold up the phone to show both lines, then put it away.
beats.chinese: 艾芙举起手机让你看过两行字，就收起来了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eat first, I think. If we argue about it hungry, neither of us will ever have the hat back.
beats.chinese: 我看先吃饭。我俩要饿着肚子争起来，谁也别想拿回那帽子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife locks the phone and puts it into a pocket with a careful push.
beats.chinese: 艾芙锁了屏，把手机推回兜里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I think I've got enough of the middle to be thoroughly wrong about the end.
beats.chinese: 也是。中间看这点已经够我把结尾猜个全错了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the phone away, they raise a hand towards the path by the lawn.
beats.chinese: 手机收了，艾芙朝草坪边的路上抬起手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you are. No, I've been very good. I didn't play the bit after.
beats.chinese: 你来啦。没，我可守规矩了，一点都没往下放。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife looks at the paused image and writes one line without opening the video again.
beats.chinese: 艾芙看着那个定格画面，记了一句，没再点开视频。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would he leave without the hat? That ought to do it. It'll take them a solid minute to tell me it's a stupid question.
beats.chinese: 没帽子他会走吗？就这句吧。我朋友得用上整整一分钟告诉我，这问题有多傻。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They scan the path and make room for a couple walking side by side.
beats.chinese: 艾芙朝石路上看了一圈，又给并排走过来的一对人让路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got to meet them at the other end. If they bring it up first, I win.
beats.chinese: 我得去那头跟人碰面。我朋友要先提这个，就算我赢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day in the square Aoife sees you and raises a small lunch box.
beats.chinese: 改天又到广场，艾芙看见你，举了下手里的小饭盒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hi. I'm carrying three leftover bits of turnip across town. I told my friend there was enough for both of us.
beats.chinese: 哎，你好。我带着剩下的三块萝卜横穿都柏林。我跟朋友说够我俩吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tilt the box in one hand. Something very light slips to the lower end.
beats.chinese: 艾芙单手把饭盒一歪。很轻的几小块东西滑到盒底那头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There is, if we have a very small opinion of lunch.
beats.chinese: 够是够，我俩要是对午饭没什么要求的话。

causality.presenceReason: 黄昏和老室友取道校园会合
causality.placeAttitude: 走几步聊几句比大事更对他们胃口
causality.stayingConstraint: 室友先去办事，须等自己这边消息

causality.contactTrigger: 手机接到截屏，玩家经过时他们有意把手机放低，先问愿不愿意看一个片段

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the paving near the bell tower, Dara lets out an ah as a message reaches their phone, then reads it again.
beats.chinese: 钟楼旁的石路上，达拉接到条消息，啊了一声，又重新读了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm first on a standby list. First person who might get in, which also makes me first person who might not.
beats.chinese: 候补排第一个。有空座第一个轮到我。没有的话，我就第一个白等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the phone into a pocket but leave the top of it showing.
beats.chinese: 达拉把手机揣回兜，上头还露着一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend's already got a ticket somewhere else. I said I'd see her after. I say a lot of might before the bit I'm actually doing.
beats.chinese: 我朋友买的是别处的票。我俩说好散了之后见。我这人啊，一到真要定下来以前，能说出一串也许。

choices.english: Ask what they'd do if a seat doesn't come up.
choices.chinese: 问今晚没空座的话，打算干什么。

choices.english: Ask whether their friend is counting on seeing them afterwards.
choices.chinese: 问他朋友散场后是不是指着碰面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara scrapes a shoe lightly across a line between two stones.
beats.chinese: 达拉用鞋底轻轻蹭了下两块铺石之间的缝。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Air hockey, possibly. There's a table I know. I'm good enough to score, bad enough to remember the whole point is to keep the thing on the table.
beats.chinese: 兴许打桌上冰球，我知道哪儿有台子。能进球，但没好到能忘了这东西是不能打飞出桌的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pull the phone halfway out, stop and slide it down again.
beats.chinese: 达拉把手机掏到一半，停了停，又塞了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They'll tell me if there's a seat. Me looking forty times won't clear one.
beats.chinese: 有座会通知我。我看四十遍，也看不出个座来。

choices.english: Suggest waiting for a message without checking again.
choices.chinese: 建议等消息自己来，先别再刷。

choices.english: Suggest making the air hockey plan now.
choices.chinese: 建议现在就定下去打桌上冰球。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara looks at the bell tower, then presses one hand flat against the phone pocket.
beats.chinese: 达拉瞧了眼钟楼，一手平按住装手机的兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. Chips. She bought her ticket weeks ago. I'm not going to ask her to come out early just because I can't get into mine.
beats.chinese: 是啊，说了去吃薯条。她几周前就买票了。我可不能因为我自己的进不去，就叫她早点出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They bring the phone back out and open a conversation with their friend.
beats.chinese: 达拉又摸出手机，点开跟朋友的聊天。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can tell her I'll be there. Or say let's do it another night. She hasn't got a good word left for might.
beats.chinese: 可以直接告诉她我会到。要不就改天。她现在一听我说也许就火。

choices.english: Confirm the chips after her show.
choices.chinese: 建议就定下朋友散场后吃薯条。

choices.english: Call off the second plan early if they don't feel like going.
choices.chinese: 如果今天不想约第二摊，建议趁早讲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They mute the group conversations, leave the ticket thread alone and sit the phone upright in the pocket.
beats.chinese: 达拉把群聊都静音了，票的消息没动，把手机立着塞回兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll feel one buzz, if there's one. Look at that. I can see the sky above the tower again.
beats.chinese: 有的话，兜里振一下我就知道。哎，这下才瞧见钟楼上头还有天呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They move to the side of the path and stand with both hands free.
beats.chinese: 达拉走到石路边，两手空着站住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait here a little. Don't tell the theatre I've started to enjoy waiting.
beats.chinese: 我在这儿再等会儿。我有点喜欢等着了，可别告诉戏院。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They decline the standby place and turn the phone over in their hand.
beats.chinese: 达拉把候补退了，手机在手里翻了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Air hockey. I'll have the evening I can actually get into.
beats.chinese: 好，桌上冰球。今晚我去个肯定进得去的场。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They set off along the edge of the lawn and look back once.
beats.chinese: 达拉沿草坪边走起来，又回头看了一次。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I win against somebody worse than me, you're still hearing about it.
beats.chinese: 就算赢的是比我还菜的，下回我也要跟你说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara types a time, thinks a second and changes it by ten minutes.
beats.chinese: 达拉打了个时间，想了一下，往后改了十分钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be there after. I added ten minutes so she doesn't have to leg it while the credits are on.
beats.chinese: 我说散了场我在。我加了十分钟，省得她字幕还没看完就得往外跑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A thumbs up appears beneath the message. Dara puts the phone down at their side.
beats.chinese: 消息下面冒出个竖拇指的表情，达拉把手机垂到身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See? The thumb came straight back. She's been starving since four, probably.
beats.chinese: 瞧，拇指立马就回来了。她八成四点就饿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They type, delete the first line and send the second one by itself.
beats.chinese: 达拉打完字，把头一行删了，只发出去第二行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I just said I'm wrecked. I might still play one game, but I don't want her looking for me at ten.
beats.chinese: 我就说我累趴了。我兴许还自己打一局，可不想晚上十点还让她找我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They stand for a while with the phone screen dark.
beats.chinese: 达拉把手机屏幕摁灭，原地站了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was easier to send than I thought.
beats.chinese: 还以为这句得憋半天才发得出去呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon near the lawn, Dara recognizes you over the top of a scrap of paper.
beats.chinese: 换一天的下午，达拉在草坪边从一张废纸上头抬眼，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. That's supposed to be a river. It's flowing up the map, away from where I put the sea.
beats.chinese: 嗨。这画的是条河。本来得朝海里流，结果给我画得往地图另一头去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the paper upside down. The station names are upside down too.
beats.chinese: 达拉把纸倒过来。站名也全倒了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Everything's better except the writing. I'll pretend it's the other half of the city.
beats.chinese: 喏，除了字全都对了。就当我画的是城的另外一半吧。

causality.presenceReason: 进城赴一周没见的朋友散场后的饭约
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢在校园通道边歇脚，自己没有提前买票
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友已买票，不能要求她走开
causality.currentGoal: 决定晚一点自己去试试候补
causality.currentState: 心情还好，说随缘却也怕连续三次没约成
causality.contactTrigger: 一边看朋友的散场时间一边接到候补回信，主动问在旁玩家怎么看
causality.characterContinuity: 预订工作守规矩，私下不要求别人弃票，接受别人把或许当成或许
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 留下等候补。ab 转去自己打球。ba 给朋友发吃饭准话。bb 今天不约第二摊

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha stands at the edge of the stone path holding a very low stool. They move it in against their stomach when you pass.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡在石路边抱了张很低的小凳。见你要走过，便把它往肚子前收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're not doing anything with this space, are you? I've been asked to consult the public about a stool.
beats.chinese: 你不急着用这块地方吧？我受人所托，要就一张凳子征求公众意见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They show one stool leg and a strip of paper folded over it.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡转出一根凳腿，腿上折着条纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My teammate left it at mine. He wrote approved for corridor use on that. I never approved anything.
beats.chinese: 我队友落我家了。他写的，准许放走廊。我可没准过。

choices.english: Ask whether it actually fits in their hallway.
choices.chinese: 问放走廊里到底碍不碍事。

choices.english: Ask if they can keep the path clear first.
choices.chinese: 提醒索尔卡先别把石路占上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They measure the seat against the width of their forearm, keeping it off the paving.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡用前臂比了比凳面宽度，没往路上放。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It fits. So do my knees, unless you want both things there at the same time.
beats.chinese: 放得下。我膝盖也过得去。两样可不能同时过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the strip of paper over and find a blank side.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把那条纸翻过来，有一面还没写字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put an actual measurement on the back. Or put accepted, pending another eleven drawings.
beats.chinese: 背面可以填个真量出来的数。也可以写初步同意，再等十一张图。

choices.english: Give them a practical test they can do at home.
choices.chinese: 建议回家沿走廊走一趟试试。

choices.english: Encourage extending the joke on the back of the label.
choices.chinese: 建议在纸背面顺着队友的话再逗一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift the stool with its legs facing in, leaving the paving clear.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡凳腿朝里把凳提高，让石路全空出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Fair. I brought it here to give it back, not to have the council round about it.
beats.chinese: 是，应该的。我过来就为还张凳，又没打算请市议会开会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A group comes towards the lawn corner. They wait for the group to pass.
beats.chinese: 一群人往草坪角上过来，索尔卡等着他们都走过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I won't try to make you stop if you're on your way somewhere.
beats.chinese: 好了。你要赶着去哪儿，不用停下来听我说。

choices.english: Go on and leave them to return the stool.
choices.chinese: 继续走，留索尔卡自己去还凳。

choices.english: Point out where it's easier for people with bags to pass.
choices.chinese: 指出提着包的人从哪边经过更宽敞。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the blank strip into a pocket and keep the stool in both hands.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把那张空白面朝外的纸条揣进兜，两手托好凳子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll borrow it back one evening. Carry the washing past it. If I lose a sock on the way, it fails.
beats.chinese: 找天晚上我再借回去。抱着一盆衣服走一趟。路上掉只袜子就算没通过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift the stool a few inches to show where a bag would hit it.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把凳子往上抬一点，示意提着包会撞在哪儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My hallway may be exactly wide enough for my hallway.
beats.chinese: 我家走廊没准就正好够当条走廊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They take out a pen and write on the back of the slip, which is folded flat against the seat.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡摸出支笔，把字写在折平贴在凳面上的纸背面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seat accepted. Legs under review.
beats.chinese: 凳面准了。凳腿还在审。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the label back around the leg and hold the stool up for somebody approaching.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把纸条套回凳腿，人走近时，把凳举了举让对方看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's all here. I haven't hidden the fourth leg.
beats.chinese: 都在呢。我没偷偷藏掉第四条腿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They settle the stool under one arm and take a step down the clear side of the path.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡把凳夹在胳膊下，朝没人挡的那一侧走了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take it down to him. If he tries leaving me another one, I'm not taking delivery.
beats.chinese: 我拿过去给他。他要再留个什么给我，我不签收。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look past you to a figure approaching from the tower and wave with the free hand.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡越过你看向钟楼那边走来的人，空着的手挥了挥。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's him with the bag. Good. He can carry it himself.
beats.chinese: 拎包那个就是。好啊，让他自己拿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look down the open side of the path and shift the stool a bit higher against their coat.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡朝石路空的一侧看看，又把凳往大衣上托高一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're right. The legs are sticking out farther than I thought.
beats.chinese: 你说得对。凳腿比我以为的伸出来得远。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They wait for two people with bags to pass before moving again.
beats.chinese: 两个提包的人经过，索尔卡等他们走完，才准备动身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. That's a real answer. I'll keep that one in mind when I get it home again.
beats.chinese: 谢了，你这说的管用。下回再把凳弄回家，我记着这事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a different day, Sorcha spots you near the lawn with a bundle of folded jerseys. One sleeve hangs below the rest.
beats.chinese: 改天，索尔卡抱着一摞叠好的球衣在草坪边看见你。一截袖子从底下垂下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. There are eight in here. I didn't hide the ninth. There genuinely isn't a ninth.
beats.chinese: 你好。这是八件。第九件我没藏。这回是真没有第九件。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They catch the sleeve with two fingers and fold it back up over the top.
beats.chinese: 索尔卡用两根手指夹起袖子，把它抄到最上头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's what happens when you do it once for a joke. You sound like you're lying for the next eight years.
beats.chinese: 就一次开个玩笑。往后八年说实话，别人都觉得你在编。

causality.presenceReason: 带队友午间碰头时遗落的小板凳来还，在庭院讨论拍照
causality.placeAttitude: 行人留出空间就好，喜欢当面看人反应
causality.stayingConstraint: 凳子等队友来拿，不能长期摆石路上
causality.currentGoal: 知道窄凳有多碍事，顺便核对家里走廊方案
causality.currentState: 兴致好可以逗人，看到人真赶忙会收起玩笑
causality.contactTrigger: 凳子仍抱手里，先向经过的人问占多少宽
causality.characterContinuity: 能认真听清别人要说的，不拿家里的事也不在别人忙时开玩笑
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 写下并采纳实测。ab 把测量当笑话但不乱改。ba 提起凳离开。bb 认真解决行路，停下咨询
causality.spatialContinuity: 石路与草坪分开，凳未放在通道中间
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 只认得，不预设参加过咨询或记得那张凳

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Under the trees by the Grand Canal, a man snaps a folded card against his palm. The sound carries along the path.
beats.chinese: 都柏林大运河树下，一个男人用折过的硬纸片在掌心一拍。那声响沿步道传出去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. What did that sound like from there?
beats.chinese: 不好意思，你站那儿听，刚才那声像什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He flattens the crease with his thumb, examining it without looking up.
beats.chinese: 他低着头，用拇指把折痕压平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's supposed to be a door, heard through another door. In my friend's kitchen it sounds like somebody hitting a packet of biscuits.
beats.chinese: 我想要的是隔一扇门听见另一扇门关上。在我朋友家厨房，听着跟拍了包饼干似的。

choices.english: Say which part of the sound you heard first.
choices.chinese: 说先听到的那一下是什么样。

choices.english: Ask why he has to get the sound here.
choices.chinese: 问他为什么要来这儿试这声音。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds up the paper like a tiny partition.
beats.chinese: 他把纸立起来，像一堵小隔板。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The slap, right? There's a second click, but I'd have to ask every listener to stand three feet away to get it.
beats.chinese: 是那声啪吧？还有一下咔嗒。可非得让每个听众都站到三英尺外，才听得清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets the card over two handwritten lines.
beats.chinese: 他把纸片盖在手写的两行字上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could take one sound out. Or give the actor something to do at the door.
beats.chinese: 可以拿掉一声。也可以给演员在门边添个动作。

choices.english: Ask him to try it with a single sound.
choices.chinese: 请他试试只留一声。

choices.english: Ask what the actor could do instead.
choices.chinese: 问演员在门边还能做点什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gathers the card in close as a walker comes up behind him.
beats.chinese: 后面有人走近，他把纸片往身前一收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's quieter than my street, usually. Today people keep coming past, like they're entitled to use their own canal or something.
beats.chinese: 平常比我家那条街静。今天倒不停有人走过去，好像这运河也有他们一份儿似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down at the two lines again, then glances at your face.
beats.chinese: 他低头又看了眼那两行，才抬眼瞧你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You don't have to guess. I can get out of everybody's way and do another take at home.
beats.chinese: 你不用猜。我可以先别堵着人家，回家再录一次。

choices.english: Give him room to pack up and walk.
choices.chinese: 让出路，留他自己收拾了走。

choices.english: Tell him you'd never have guessed it was a door.
choices.chinese: 直说你根本听不出是门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the card shut this time and taps it once against his palm.
beats.chinese: 这回他把纸片捏合，只往掌心拍了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Much closer. I was putting the loud bit on top of the bit I wanted you to hear.
beats.chinese: 啊，这下像多了。我刚把最大的一声盖到真想让人听的那声上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws one line through a short note without wiping it out entirely.
beats.chinese: 他在一条短注上划了道线，原字还是看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep the wrong one written down. My friend'll ask what took me all afternoon.
beats.chinese: 错的也留着。我朋友准要问我一下午干什么去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the card into a coat pocket and writes directly underneath the two lines.
beats.chinese: 他把硬纸片揣进外套兜，直接在那两行下面添字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can try the handle and find it's already locked. Then I don't need anybody to hear the other door at all.
beats.chinese: 可以让她按把手，发现门已经锁上了。那另一扇门的声音根本就不用听见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reads what he has written, lifts the pencil and crosses the original sound out.
beats.chinese: 他读了遍新添的字，抬起铅笔，把原来的音效划了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The actor'll like that. She wouldn't have to go up against a packet of biscuits.
beats.chinese: 演员准喜欢。总不用跟一包饼干抢戏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the card and the script into the same inside pocket.
beats.chinese: 他把硬纸片和剧本都塞进同一个里兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. The wardrobe at home doesn't go anywhere. I can use that.
beats.chinese: 也是。我家衣柜又跑不了。用那个就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He heads off on the same side of the water and checks the pocket once with his hand.
beats.chinese: 他沿这一侧的岸走了，手又按了下兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm done making that racket here.
beats.chinese: 不在这儿弄那动静了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the card still for a beat and looks along the paths on either side of the water.
beats.chinese: 他把纸片拿稳了片刻，沿运河两岸望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair. I told you what it was meant to be too early. I should play it to somebody who hasn't heard a word about it.
beats.chinese: 也是。我太早跟你说得像什么了。得找一个压根没听过这事的人放给他听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the card and waits for a space on this bank of the canal.
beats.chinese: 他揣好纸片，等这一侧岸边腾出空当。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No offence if I don't play it a fourth time.
beats.chinese: 第四遍我就不放给你听了，别介意啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few mornings later, Cian sees you on the canal path and turns off his phone with a short laugh.
beats.chinese: 又过了几天，清早在运河步道上，基安看见你，笑了一下把手机摁灭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I wrote down a thing I was sure of on Wednesday. Changed my mind by Thursday. I've got both dates right there.
beats.chinese: 你好。我周三记了一条自己肯定没错的事。周四就改口了。俩日期都记在那儿呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the phone into his inside pocket and pats it once.
beats.chinese: 他把手机滑进里兜，在外头拍了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to give myself till Friday before I form another opinion.
beats.chinese: 下一个事，我先忍到周五再表态。

causality.presenceReason: 给今晚要录的短剧想一个关门音效，提早沿运河试听
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢树下能把声音拉开
causality.stayingConstraint: 和朋友约了回去录音
causality.currentGoal: 想让观众听明白人隔着门
causality.currentState: 第三版还听不出来，有点钻牛角尖
causality.contactTrigger: 他攥着纸折出一声响，见玩家停下便问听像什么
causality.characterContinuity: 校准要准确，对不同意见先问具体，不会抢人时间
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 听证后削掉一层声响。ab 改写剧本。ba 停止占用这段路。bb 接受答不上来的意见，自己换地方听
causality.spatialContinuity: 同岸树荫下用自己纸张与耳机，未取景对岸细节
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来在运河边提到当天手机笔记

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside the canal a woman stops walking and reads a line from her phone. She gets as far as I've decided and pulls a face.
beats.chinese: 运河边，一个女人停下来读手机上的一行字。刚读到我已经决定了，就皱起了脸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's for a woman I play with. Listen to me, like I'm resigning from cabinet.
beats.chinese: 给一块儿打球的朋友。你听我这腔，跟要从内阁辞职似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rolls the phone once between her hands.
beats.chinese: 她把手机在两手间翻了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The taster's over. She wants to do the next class. I want my Tuesdays back and maybe a game if it's dry.
beats.chinese: 体验课上完了。她想接着上。我想把周二拿回来，天晴的话也许还能打打球。

choices.english: Ask whether they'd still play together without the class.
choices.chinese: 问不上课了，两个人还能不能一起打。

choices.english: Ask if she actually wants to give up Tuesdays.
choices.chinese: 问她自己是不是真舍得把周二交出去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She wipes a spot off the screen with the heel of her hand.
beats.chinese: 她用手掌根抹了下屏幕上的一点印子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We could. We both have a bat. She's miles better already, and I can make her laugh hard enough to miss.
beats.chinese: 能啊，拍子都有。她已经比我强一大截了。我倒能把她逗得漏球。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down the path and steps closer to the trees.
beats.chinese: 她沿路看了看，往树这一侧站了站。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd love to ask. I don't want it to sound as if I'm asking her not to go on.
beats.chinese: 我当然想约。就怕听着像不许她接着上。

choices.english: Suggest inviting the friend to one game with no strings.
choices.chinese: 建议单约一场球，不搭上课的事。

choices.english: Suggest saying each can keep the part she likes.
choices.chinese: 建议直接说她俩各玩自己喜欢的那部分。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the phone face down on her palm.
beats.chinese: 她把手机扣在手心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I can spend Tuesday blowing three bad notes on the harmonica. Just don't give me a fourth one for homework.
beats.chinese: 不想。我周二可以在家用口琴吹三个破音。就别给我留第四个音当作业了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops smiling for a second and looks down at the water.
beats.chinese: 她有那么一下没笑，低头看着水。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's nice. I'm going to miss her. That's all I've actually got to say, isn't it?
beats.chinese: 她人挺好。我会想她。我要说的其实就这个吧？

choices.english: Let her leave the class without explaining why.
choices.chinese: 让她不报就不报，不用给个原因。

choices.english: Ask if she could simply tell her friend she'll miss her.
choices.chinese: 问她能不能单说一句，以后少见面会想她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She deletes the first line and types a day and a question mark.
beats.chinese: 她删了第一行，只打了个日子，加个问号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Saturday, if it stays dry? That's an invitation. Look how short they are when you don't write a speech first.
beats.chinese: 周六，天不下雨就来？这不就约上了。前头不写稿子，能省这么多字呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends it and slides the phone into her sleeve until it reaches her hand.
beats.chinese: 她点了发送，让手机沿袖口滑到手边，再抓牢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I hope she brings the good bat. I want to borrow it when she's not looking.
beats.chinese: 但愿她带那把好的。我想等她没看见的时候偷借一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She jams a thumb against the space bar, deletes a long line and starts over.
beats.chinese: 她的拇指在空格上按了按，删掉一长行，从头来过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tell me how it goes. I wrote that. I actually want to know. I don't want a place in the class.
beats.chinese: 上得怎么样跟我说一声。我写这个。是真想听，就不想给我也报个名。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses send and turns to take a step farther along the bank.
beats.chinese: 她发完消息，转身沿岸边走了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can meet out of spite next time there's a rain day.
beats.chinese: 下回偏赶上下雨，我俩还要见一面，气死那个天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the phone away without opening the sign up form again.
beats.chinese: 她没再点进报名表，就把手机收了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Grand. I don't ask her to give up her course. She doesn't need my Tuesday either.
beats.chinese: 行。我不劝她放弃那课。她也不缺我一个周二。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a breath, looks up through the trees and starts moving.
beats.chinese: 她吸了口气，透过树枝往上瞧了眼，迈开步子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might go home and blow the three notes now. Apologies to my floor.
beats.chinese: 我可能这就回家吹那三个音。先给楼下赔个不是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the phone back out and holds down the voice button.
beats.chinese: 她又把手机拿出来，按住语音键。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll miss you on Tuesdays. I'm not paying for another class to see you. What're you doing Friday?
beats.chinese: 以后周二见不着你了，我还挺想你的。可我不想交下一期学费才见着你。周五有事吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends the message before playing it back. She raises her head and presses her lips together.
beats.chinese: 她没听回放就发了出去。她抬起头，抿了抿嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah well. She knows my voice. She'll know I meant it.
beats.chinese: 算啦。她听得出来，我是真这么想。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day, Deirdre spots you by the canal with a little harmonica resting across her knuckles.
beats.chinese: 隔天，迪尔德丽在运河边瞧见了你。她手指节上横托着一把小口琴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I can do the first note of that tune my sister likes. Imagine the pleasure of hearing only that much.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我会吹我姐喜欢的那曲子的头一个音了。你想想，只听到这儿得多高兴啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the harmonica into a cloth sleeve and pats it flat.
beats.chinese: 她把琴装进布套，拿手拍了拍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm leaving it there. She can hum the rest herself.
beats.chinese: 我见好就收。剩下的她自己哼吧。

causality.presenceReason: 来步道走过一段再回家，能当面找练球朋友说清
causality.placeAttitude: 树下像自己暂时不必达标的空当
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友要等，但报名今天就得定
causality.currentGoal: 拒绝交钱上后续级别，又不伤一块玩的朋友
causality.currentState: 说得快，听见人劝上进就不想笑了
causality.contactTrigger: 她看着退报名的页面发出声，跟经过的人借一句听听自然不自然
causality.characterContinuity: 工作计时严，爱好不考级，不拿自己的休闲方式教训别人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 送一声邀请去玩。ab 分开各玩。ba 确认不用报。bb 意识到想见朋友而不是想上课

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the canal path, Robin holds up a piece of paper with two blotches printed on it. A loose leaf rests inside the fold.
beats.chinese: 运河步道上，罗宾举着一张纸，上头印了两团斑。折缝里夹着一片散叶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Does that look like a rabbit to you? Don't worry. It's not a picture somebody's child made.
beats.chinese: 你看像兔子吗？甭担心，这不是谁家孩子画的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the paper sideways. The leaf slides against their finger.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把纸横过来。那片叶子滑到了手指边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It came off that. My friend said rabbit. I said a dog getting out of a bath. They'd like me to stop asking now.
beats.chinese: 这片叶子印的。我朋友说是兔子，我说是条从水盆里往外爬的狗。那人现在叫我别再问了。

choices.english: Have a look and say what you see in it.
choices.chinese: 端详一下，说你看出像什么。

choices.english: Ask why it matters which animal it is.
choices.chinese: 问是哪个动物有什么要紧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin looks at the two blotches from your side of the paper.
beats.chinese: 罗宾跟你从纸的同一侧看那两团斑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. We might not even be looking at the same end. I'd make a poor witness. I'd already decided which legs were wet.
beats.chinese: 也是。咱俩看的也许都不是同一头。换我做证肯定不行，我连哪几条腿是湿的都定好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pull a second scrap from the fold, printed in lighter ink.
beats.chinese: 罗宾从夹层里又抽了张纸片，上面的墨淡些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got another print that came out cleaner. Do you want another look, or have you had your fill of it?
beats.chinese: 还有张印得清楚点。想再瞧一眼，还是已经看够了？

choices.english: Compare the marks on both bits of paper.
choices.chinese: 把两张纸上印的东西比着看看。

choices.english: Leave one vote and skip the second print.
choices.chinese: 只说这一眼的看法，第二张就不看了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin holds the paper still instead of tilting it again.
beats.chinese: 罗宾拿稳那张纸，没再来回转。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It doesn't. That's the part my friend could get their head round and I couldn't.
beats.chinese: 不重要。我朋友明白的就是这一点。我偏没转过弯来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look down where the wind has pushed a little heap of leaves against the path.
beats.chinese: 风把一点落叶卷到路旁，罗宾低头看着那一小堆。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came for another leaf. I promised I wouldn't send another picture of this one.
beats.chinese: 我是来捡另一片的。答应人家这张不再拍去烦了。

choices.english: Take them at their word and leave the picture alone.
choices.chinese: 就按说好的，不接着说这幅图。

choices.english: Look at the fallen leaves instead.
choices.chinese: 改看地上的落叶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin lines up the two sheets by one edge. The fainter print shows an extra little mark beside the larger one.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把两张纸的一边对齐。印得淡的那张，大斑旁边多出一个小点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that's ink from my thumb. That's where I was getting the front leg. I'd better take the dog back.
beats.chinese: 噢，那是我拇指上的墨。我还把它当条前腿。那条狗我收回吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the lighter sheet over the dark one and let the original leaf sit loose.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把浅色那张叠到深色那张上，原来那片叶子松松地夹在里面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It doesn't have to be a rabbit now. It's definitely not getting out of a bath.
beats.chinese: 倒也不用非是兔子。反正不是从澡盆里出来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin writes a small question mark in a notebook and closes it before you see what else is there.
beats.chinese: 罗宾在本上写了个小问号，趁你还没看见别的就合起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's your vote. It's allowed to be a question mark.
beats.chinese: 这就当你这一票。可以投问号。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the lighter print out of sight behind the darker one.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把印得淡的那张往另一张背后一藏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll want to ask again tomorrow. Remind me not to, if I'm stupid enough to try it on you.
beats.chinese: 明天我还想问的。我要真傻到再来问你，记得叫我打住。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin folds the paper with the print on the inside and puts it in a coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把纸折好，印子朝里，放进外套兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Leave it. It's been a long week for the rabbit.
beats.chinese: 算啦。那兔子这礼拜也够累的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They keep to the path and move far enough for another walker to come through.
beats.chinese: 罗宾没离开步道，只往边上打了个身，让后面一个人过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to pick great big plain leaves now.
beats.chinese: 接下来我挑长得普普通通的大叶子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin crouches at the path edge and turns one fallen leaf over by the stem.
beats.chinese: 罗宾在路边蹲下来，捏着梗把一片落叶翻了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here's a good one. Hole right through it. No creature will come of that unless I get very bored.
beats.chinese: 这片好。破了个穿过去的洞。除非我实在太闲，不然印不出什么活物来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They slip it into an empty bit of the paper fold without taking out the phone.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把它塞进纸缝空着的一截，也没往出拿手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll see what comes out. I won't be canvassing the neighbourhood.
beats.chinese: 回家看看印出来什么样。这回不挨家挨户问了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another morning, Robin recognizes you along the canal with a pale leaf held by its stem.
beats.chinese: 改天早上，罗宾在运河边认出了你，手里拿着片颜色浅的叶子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I brought this all the way home yesterday and found something I'd rather not ink on the back of it.
beats.chinese: 你好。昨天我一路把它拿回家，翻过来才发现，背面有样东西我可不想沾一身墨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn it over. A thin empty snail shell sits against a crumpled edge.
beats.chinese: 罗宾把叶子翻过来。皱起来的边上卡着一枚薄薄的空蜗牛壳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I had a bit of paper ready. Some things I can just look at.
beats.chinese: 纸我都备好了。算了，有的东西看看就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife has stopped on roller skates under a tree by the canal. A stiff card rests across one wrist.
beats.chinese: 运河旁树荫下，艾芙穿着轮滑鞋站定。一张硬卡片搭在手腕上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you get past? Good. Can you see any shine on the bottom of this, while you're there?
beats.chinese: 能过去吗？那好。你站那儿顺便看看，这底下还反不反光？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She angles the card. The palm of her other hand covers the top half.
beats.chinese: 她把卡片斜过来，另一只手用掌心盖住上半截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The bit you can see is finished. I'm trying to find out if it's dry before I put it away.
beats.chinese: 露出来这部分写好了。我想看看墨干没干，好收起来。

choices.english: Look only at the finished part.
choices.chinese: 只看已经写好的部分。

choices.english: Ask if she wants to wait instead of putting it away.
choices.chinese: 问她要不要再晾一会儿才收。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the card as still as she can. One of her wheels moves an inch, then stops.
beats.chinese: 她尽量拿稳卡片。一个轮子往前移了一小截，又停下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. The curve's still shining where I went over it again. I'd rather see it smudge on a test card than on the proper one.
beats.chinese: 对。我补写那一弯还亮着。宁可在试的这张上糊，也别糊在正式那一张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a loose sheet of paper out from behind the card.
beats.chinese: 她从硬卡背后抽出一张散纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That could keep it off the rest of the packet. There's one stroke I'd like to try again when I've got a desk.
beats.chinese: 可以靠它跟别的纸隔开。还有一笔，等回去有桌子了我想再试。

choices.english: Ask her to use the divider and leave the stroke as it is for now.
choices.chinese: 请她用纸隔开，先别再动那一笔。

choices.english: Ask which stroke she'd like to redo.
choices.chinese: 问她想重写的是哪一笔。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens a knee and checks how far the shadow of the tree falls across the path.
beats.chinese: 她撑直一边膝盖，看树影一直落到步道哪儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I have a few minutes. I took it out because I liked it better than I expected to. Then I started looking for things wrong with it.
beats.chinese: 还有几分钟。我是觉得写得比我想的好，才拿出来。结果一拿出来，又开始挑毛病了。

beats.speaker: narrator
