beats.english: A phone across the path comes up at face height and she turns the card towards her coat.
beats.chinese: 步道另一侧有人把手机举到脸那么高。她转了转硬卡，朝着自己大衣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't want a picture going anywhere till I've decided what I'm showing.
beats.chinese: 我没决定给人看哪一部分之前，不希望有图传出去。

choices.english: Tell her she doesn't need to show anyone the whole sheet.
choices.chinese: 说没有必要给谁看整张。

choices.english: Offer to make room for her to skate on.
choices.chinese: 把路让开，方便她接着滑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the loose paper to make a raised edge and slips it alongside the ink.
beats.chinese: 她把散纸折出一条翘起来的边，从有墨的地方旁边塞进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. It won't touch. And I won't take it out to look while I'm moving. I've done that once.
beats.chinese: 行，这样碰不上。我也不会滑起来又抽出来看。那种事干过一回了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the packet vertically by the unmarked margin, tucked close against her side.
beats.chinese: 她拿住没字的纸边，把纸竖着贴到身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait till I'm home. Then I can decide if I still like it.
beats.chinese: 等到家再看。到时候再说还喜不喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves the covering hand only a little and touches the blank margin with a nail.
beats.chinese: 她盖着卡片的手只挪了一点，用指甲碰了碰无字的边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. The end is thicker than the next one. I'll mark the back. No point putting ink on ink here.
beats.chinese: 喏，末尾比下一笔粗。我背面记一下就好。在这儿拿墨盖墨没意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the card with the ink facing her and taps the spot on the reverse.
beats.chinese: 她转了下字卡，把字朝自己，从背面点了点那一处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for looking at the bit I meant. That helped.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你只看了我指的那一块。这下心里有数了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the top card as far as her chest and keeps the rest behind it.
beats.chinese: 她把最上面那张提到胸前，剩下的都挡在背后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I've one line here I'm happy with. That's enough to take out with me.
beats.chinese: 不用。现在有一行我自己看着舒服。带出来给人看看也够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances at that line once more, then lets the whole packet sit closed between her hands.
beats.chinese: 她又瞟了眼那一行，让纸整叠合在两手间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I used to say it was nothing. That took three evenings.
beats.chinese: 以前我准说没什么。可这花了我三个晚上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits for two walkers to clear the path before sliding the card between the papers.
beats.chinese: 她等两个行人把路走空，才把硬卡滑进纸页间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Stand there a second, if you don't mind. My first push always goes farther than I think.
beats.chinese: 谢了。方便的话你在那儿停一下。我头一下蹬出去，总比自己想得远。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pushes off along the tree side of the path. Her second glide is shorter.
beats.chinese: 她从树这一侧蹬了出去。第二下滑得短些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There we go. I've got it now.
beats.chinese: 哎，成了。我站得住了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A later Sunday by the canal, Aoife recognizes you as she holds a damp envelope away from her coat.
beats.chinese: 后来一个周日，艾芙在运河边认出了你。她拿着一只湿信封，尽量不蹭着大衣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I wrote today's date on this three times. First two were lovely. Wrong month.
beats.chinese: 你好。今天的日期我写了三遍。头两遍可漂亮了，月份写错了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tilts the envelope and watches one bead of water slip off the corner.
beats.chinese: 她把封口斜过去，看一颗水珠从角上滑下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's right. The rain can have the flourish.
beats.chinese: 这遍是对的。花笔先让雨水带走吧。

causality.presenceReason: 穿滑轮在尚宽松的时段沿湖停下看字样
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢在室外一站才看清墨色，走累了可以就此停
causality.stayingConstraint: 练完之后要收稿，随时能离开
causality.currentGoal: 检验一张还没干透的字卡，把未成篇和已完稿分开
causality.currentState: 对东西没做完就要对外展示有点戒备
causality.contactTrigger: 她站稳，问过玩家有没有挡路，再请对方看光下成品边缘
causality.characterContinuity: 手工进度自己定，不让人随便拍，听见具体意见会接
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 给成稿加垫。ab 给未成一处记号，留待回家。ba 拒拍但承认自己做得不错。bb 保持距离后继续滑
causality.spatialContinuity: 运河同岸步道，停稳后拿纸，未走近水侧
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天写糊的日期与字母完整稿无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Light comes through the arcade roof. A man folds a newspaper twice to make room as you pass a shop front.
beats.chinese: 日光从拱廊的玻璃顶照下来。你经过一家店门口，一个男人连折两下报纸，给你让了点空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. It takes up more room than I do when it's open.
beats.chinese: 不好意思。这报一摊开，比我占地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts to open it again, then sees a message on his phone.
beats.chinese: 他刚要再摊开，瞧见手机来了条消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend says we need a proper morning. Last time I read this while he fixed a reel. I thought that was a proper morning.
beats.chinese: 我朋友说，咱得好好过个早上。上回我读报，他修钓鱼轮。我觉得那早上已经挺好了呀。

choices.english: Ask if his friend might want to talk this time.
choices.chinese: 问他朋友这回是不是有话想说。

choices.english: Ask whether he wants to finish the paper first.
choices.chinese: 问他想不想先把报看完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He squares the pages against his forearm, still standing out of the flow.
beats.chinese: 他人在过道边，用前臂把报纸的毛边磕齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Might do. He uses a lot of words when he wants to say one. Take him all morning to get to it sometimes.
beats.chinese: 也许吧。他有一句想说的，前头能垫一大堆。有时候一上午才说到那一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings up the message and holds the paper steady under one arm.
beats.chinese: 他点开消息，胳膊底下把报纸牢牢夹住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could ask. Or I could leave him to say where he wants to go first.
beats.chinese: 我可以问问。也可以先让他说打算去哪儿。

choices.english: Suggest asking if he's coming to talk.
choices.chinese: 提议直接问问他想不想说说话。

choices.english: Suggest letting the friend pick where to meet.
choices.chinese: 提议让朋友先挑地方碰面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at the bit of the front page that remains visible.
beats.chinese: 他低头瞧了瞧头版还露着的那一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like ten minutes. I don't mind if he gets here first, though. I can put it away.
beats.chinese: 我想看十分钟。他先到了也没什么，可以把报收起来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Footsteps cross the tiles in front of the next shop. He draws in his elbow.
beats.chinese: 下一家店跟前有几声脚步走过。他把胳膊往里收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can wait till he turns up. It's his mouth. He'll open it when he's ready.
beats.chinese: 可以等人来了再说。他的嘴嘛，想好了自然会张。

choices.english: Leave the matter there and let him wait.
choices.chinese: 不接着猜，让他自己等。

choices.english: Suggest reading a little until his friend arrives.
choices.chinese: 提议人在来之前先看一点报。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gets the phone to his ear. The paper stays folded tight now.
beats.chinese: 他把手机贴到耳边。报纸这会儿夹得紧紧的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Are you after a chat? Yeah. No, the paper can come home with me.
beats.chinese: 想找我说说话？嗯。没事，报纸我能带回家看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He listens for a while and then ends the call without saying much more.
beats.chinese: 他听了一阵，没再多讲什么，挂了电话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He was trying to ask that since Wednesday. I'd have said yes on Wednesday.
beats.chinese: 从周三就想问我了。周三问我，我也会说行啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a short question using the paper as a rest for his wrist.
beats.chinese: 他垫着报纸的边，用手机打了句短话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You pick, I said. If we end up walking, I'll probably get told on the way.
beats.chinese: 我说你挑。要是约到一块儿走走，他准会在路上告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A reply flashes on his phone. He grips the newspaper under his arm and gets ready to go.
beats.chinese: 手机上亮了一条回复。他把报夹紧，准备走了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Grand. I'll keep my hands warm on the way over. That suits me.
beats.chinese: 行。走过去还能暖暖手，挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the phone in his pocket and leaves the newspaper folded.
beats.chinese: 他把手机放进兜，报纸还叠着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I'll just say morning when I see him. We'll get past that in our own time.
beats.chinese: 也是。见面先说声早。往下聊什么，我俩自己慢慢来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one step towards the shop side to clear the passage.
beats.chinese: 他朝店面那一侧再让了一步，把过道空出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go on through. He knows where I said I'd be.
beats.chinese: 你过去吧。他知道我说在哪儿等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens just the inner pages, making a narrow rectangle of the newspaper.
beats.chinese: 他只翻开里头两页，把报折成长长窄窄的一条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll read this. It can wait at the fold when he's ready.
beats.chinese: 我先看这篇。人一来，就折在读到的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His eyes move down the column. He holds a page down with the side of a thumb.
beats.chinese: 他沿着那栏往下看，用拇指侧面摁住一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, it's yesterday's. Still happened, I suppose.
beats.chinese: 噢，昨天的。事倒反正已经出了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One Saturday later, Ruairi sees you under the arcade's glass roof with half a newspaper rolled into a tube.
beats.chinese: 后来一个周六，鲁艾里在拱廊玻璃顶下面看见你，手里半份报卷成了筒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. Gave a friend the other half. He said he could still hear me turning the pages.
beats.chinese: 嗨。另一半给我朋友了。他说还是听得见我翻报纸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He loosens the roll and looks at the torn edge where it separates from the other half.
beats.chinese: 他把卷松开，瞧了瞧跟另一半分开的毛边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He'll live. I've listened to him untangle a fishing line for forty minutes.
beats.chinese: 没事，他受得了。我还听过他解钓鱼线，解了四十分钟呢。

causality.presenceReason: 在拱廊买份报，等老友会合
causality.placeAttitude: 经过的人不少，不妨碍一起各忙各的
causality.stayingConstraint: 老友还没到，可以临时改早上的事
causality.currentGoal: 确认今天老友想一起坐还是有话
causality.currentState: 听说有人误会，问了又怕把闲事说成规矩
causality.contactTrigger: 腾出摊前位置又把手里报纸收过去，顺口问人自己是不是显得不愿讲
causality.characterContinuity: 习惯不作声，愿意问一遍，不为交情定条款
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 主动问一句。ab 把见面地点交给对方。ba 不预演。bb 等人但先读一点报
causality.spatialContinuity: 一直在摊间的过道边，没有虚构座位
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 当天拿新报，在别处认识也能接上

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peadar stands clear of the stalls with a twisted length of cord lying across his fingers.
beats.chinese: 皮达尔在离摊面一步的地方站着，一截拧过的细绳横在手指上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you call that one knot? Don't ask the woman who sells it. I asked her twice already.
beats.chinese: 这算一个结吗？别去问摊主。我已经问过人家两回了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings two loose ends towards each other without letting go.
beats.chinese: 他把两只松散的绳头往一起靠，手没松。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said two, on account of the ends. She says I've counted a knot and its shadow.
beats.chinese: 我说是两个，你看有俩头。人家说我把一个结和它的影都数进去了。

choices.english: Check which ends belong to the same piece of cord.
choices.chinese: 看看两个头是不是同一根绳上出来的。

choices.english: Ask whether it matters if there's one or two.
choices.chinese: 问一个还是两个有什么要紧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He thumbs the cord flat. One part pulls a little against the other.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指把绳压平，一截微微牵动了另一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that's the same bit coming round again. I suppose this end could be tucked in and nobody would count it.
beats.chinese: 噢，这是同一段又绕回来了。把这一头塞进去，估计就没人会数上它。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the cord in his palm instead of tugging on it.
beats.chinese: 他只把绳托在掌心，没用手拉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to hear myself say she was right. Or I could tie my own and find out first.
beats.chinese: 我倒想听听我自己承认人家说对了。要不先拿自己的打一个看看。

choices.english: Encourage him to concede it himself.
choices.chinese: 让他自己去认个输。

choices.english: Ask him to try it later on his own cord.
choices.chinese: 建议改天拿自家的绳试一个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns one end around his finger and lets it go.
beats.chinese: 他把一头绕到指头上，又放下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, it matters if I'm paying by the knot. I'm not. I'm paying for the cord.
beats.chinese: 哎，要是按结收钱，那就重要。又不是。卖的是绳。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves a pace out of the way of two shoppers looking in at the stall.
beats.chinese: 两个顾客朝摊里看，他往外让开一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not cross. Does it look as though I'm cross? I sometimes look that way when I'm having a lovely time.
beats.chinese: 我没生气。看起来像吗？我有时候玩得可开心了，脸上也那样。

choices.english: Tell him he can keep the joke if he drops the count.
choices.chinese: 跟他说，玩笑照开，几个结就别数了。

choices.english: Let him take the cord and think it over another day.
choices.chinese: 让他先拿着绳走，改天再想。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He flattens the two ends once more and turns back to the stall.
beats.chinese: 他又压平两头，转回摊子那边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're right about the knot. I had to have a good look at the shadow, though.
beats.chinese: 结你说对了。可它那个影，我总得看明白了吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The stallholder turns her hand over once. He stands aside with a quick grin.
beats.chinese: 摊主翻了翻手掌。他飞快咧嘴一笑，让到旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't ask me what she meant by that. I'll only start on the hand now.
beats.chinese: 你别问我人家那手什么意思。不然我又该去琢磨她的手了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the cord into a coil that fits in his palm.
beats.chinese: 他把绳绕成小小一捆，收进掌心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll use two colours at home. Then I can see which one I've decided isn't really there.
beats.chinese: 我回去用两种颜色打。到时候就看得出，我把哪一根说没了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gathers the knot into a pocket without altering it.
beats.chinese: 他没动那个结，直接揣进兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have to admit it if the same thing comes out. That's between me and the cord.
beats.chinese: 打出来一样，我就得承认。这事先算我跟绳子说好的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks from one end of the cord to the other and lowers both hands.
beats.chinese: 他从一个绳头看到另一个，两手一块儿放了下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're right. That's a bit of a rotten question. All I really wanted was to untie it.
beats.chinese: 你说得对，问得挺烂的。我其实就想把它拆了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts his chin towards the stall and puts the cord away.
beats.chinese: 他朝摊子那儿抬抬下巴，收好细绳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll buy a straight one as well. Can't be too careful with a thing that already works.
beats.chinese: 我再挑根直的吧。心里有点数，别把本来好好的也折腾坏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the cord into a pocket and steps out of the unbroken line of shoppers.
beats.chinese: 他把绳揣兜，从不断经过的顾客旁边退开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I've had plenty of time here. I'll see if I even care about it tomorrow.
beats.chinese: 行。在这儿看得可够久的。看我明天还想不想得起来吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gets as far as the next shop before glancing back.
beats.chinese: 他走到下一家店门口，才回头了一次。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might. No need to tell her that now.
beats.chinese: 也没准还想。先不用告诉人家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day in the arcade, Peadar recognises you and unfolds a little list from his shirt pocket.
beats.chinese: 又一天在拱廊里，皮达尔认出了你，从衬衫口袋里摸出一张小单子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Three old film scores I'd like to hear again. I put the films in brackets because I couldn't tell the composers apart.
beats.chinese: 嗨。三部老片的配乐，我想再听听。片名写括号里了，光看作曲的人我分不清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He runs a finger down the list, stopping at the only empty pair of brackets.
beats.chinese: 他的指头沿单子往下，到唯一一对空括号那儿停住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I've forgotten the film as well. Still humming the blasted thing.
beats.chinese: 现在连片子也忘了。就那破曲子还在脑子里哼着。

causality.presenceReason: 来给自家练打花结找绳，看到不同捆扎法停住
causality.placeAttitude: 爱和人来回抬两句杠，过道挤的时候也让开
causality.stayingConstraint: 摊主接待其他人时收声
causality.currentGoal: 弄清两家在争什么再认输
causality.currentState: 开始只想闹着玩，被人当成真要挑毛病也会尴尬
causality.contactTrigger: 手里的绳头数着数着卡住，问旁边的人
causality.characterContinuity: 输自己认，不让第三方替他压人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 承认两端是一根。ab 找自己带的绳再试。ba 接受自己的问法就不成立。bb 拿绳走，等改天再聊
causality.spatialContinuity: 自己拿一截短样，站客侧，不动旁边人东西
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来带一张曲目纸，不需要知道前面的绳

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fionnuala stands off the centre of the arcade, holding the lining of a bag out through a gap at its seam.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉让开拱廊中间，把袋子的里布从开线口翻了一点出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you see daylight through that? It's mine. I turn people's bags inside out for them only by appointment.
beats.chinese: 透光吗？这是我自己的。别人的包，我可得先约好才给人翻个底朝天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the opening towards the glass roof until one thin patch lights up.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把口子转向玻璃顶，有一小块薄的地方透出亮。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I made it out of a curtain. I like how it sits now. I'd rather not make another whole bag for a hole this size.
beats.chinese: 原来拿窗帘改的。这包现在挎着正舒服。我可不想为这么大一点洞，从头再做一个。

choices.english: Ask what they'd want to keep if they changed the lining.
choices.chinese: 问换里子的话，哪些地方还想照旧。

choices.english: Ask if the outer bag needs any changes at all.
choices.chinese: 问外面这一层是不是完全可以不动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put a thumb against the corner where a seam doubles back.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉拇指按在接缝转回去的一个角上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This bit. It's got the fold from the bottom of the curtain. It's the only bit that still looks like the old thing.
beats.chinese: 这儿。留着窗帘下摆原先那道折。也就这块还能瞧出原来是什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They take a small swatch from a pocket and hold it alongside the hole.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉从兜里拿出一块小布样，对在洞旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can set something behind it, or I can just close the tear. It doesn't have to disappear.
beats.chinese: 可以在底下衬一块，也可以把口子缝上。本来也不用缝得看不出来。

choices.english: Compare their swatch with the old fabric.
choices.chinese: 拿带来的布样跟旧布比一比。

choices.english: Suggest closing only the tear and leaving the rest alone.
choices.chinese: 提议只把破口缝上，别的不动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They let the lining fall back inside and put the strap on one shoulder.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉放开里布，让它落回袋子里，带子挂到了肩上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't think so. My brother wouldn't touch the ones we grew up with. I used to think he was daft about it. Now I've got this.
beats.chinese: 我看不用。我哥连我俩从小看到大的那套东西都不肯动。我原来老觉得他犯傻，现在我自己有这么个包了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They touch a folded corner of the swatch but don't lift it.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉碰了下布样折出来的角，没拿起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's his piece of cloth. I said I'd bring it back. It isn't mine to take a corner off.
beats.chinese: 这块布还是他的呢，我说过要还。我可不能随便剪人家一角。

choices.english: Set his sample aside and plan around their own material.
choices.chinese: 建议先把哥哥的布样留好，只考虑自己的布。

choices.english: Ask if they'd rather keep looking without matching anything today.
choices.chinese: 问是不是可以先接着逛，今天不用非配上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lay the swatch along the weak seam with the folded side over the hole.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把布样沿着磨薄的接缝贴过去，让折起来那边遮住破口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That would sit lovely. I'll ask if I can have a sliver, now I've got a reason besides saving the bag.
beats.chinese: 贴在这儿挺好看。等我问能不能要一小条。这回有别的理由了，我就喜欢配成这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the swatch away without pinning it to the bag.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把布样收好，没拿什么东西别在袋上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If he tells me no, I've still got the hole. It won't get bigger before dinner.
beats.chinese: 我哥要说不给，洞还在这儿呢。吃晚饭前也大不了哪儿去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They gather the broken edges with two fingers. The old crease is still visible.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉两根手指收拢裂开的边。旧折痕还是看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A few stitches there'll do. I don't mind leaving the old bit in view.
beats.chinese: 这儿缝几针就好了。原来那块露着也没关系。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They close the bag and tug the strap straight where it crosses their shoulder.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把包口收拢，将肩头那截带子拉直。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I can get back to carrying things in it instead of making a project out of it.
beats.chinese: 得，又能拿来装东西了，不用再把它当个大工程。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the borrowed cloth inwards and put it into a separate pocket.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把借来的布往里叠，单放进另一只口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He'll have it back whole. I've got a bit of my own curtain left where the hem doubles over.
beats.chinese: 给我哥原样拿回去。我那窗帘还有点边角，正好有个折双层的下摆。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the torn lining under the bag's top edge.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把破里布塞进袋口的上沿下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll look at that at home. I know what I've got to cut now.
beats.chinese: 到家再翻翻。我现在知道该裁哪一块了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the swatch away and swing the bag back so it lies flat against one hip.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉收起布样，把袋子往后挪，让它贴着一侧胯骨。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I came because I like looking at colours. That doesn't have to end in a repair.
beats.chinese: 也是。我来是喜欢看看颜色。也不用每回看完都非修个什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They let another shopper go first, then follow the central passage towards the next row of small shops.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉让另一位顾客先过，随后沿着中央过道朝下一排小店走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might find something I like that isn't good for anything.
beats.chinese: 没准我能看上点自己喜欢、又一点用也没有的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon under the glass roof, Fionnuala sees you with a short brown envelope pinched shut in one hand.
beats.chinese: 改天午后，玻璃顶下，菲诺拉瞧见你，单手捏着一只短棕色信封。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Dried chillies. I cut one off the plant with my best scissors yesterday. Had to clean them before I could so much as touch a sleeve.
beats.chinese: 你好，干辣椒。昨天我拿最好的剪刀剪了一只。还得先擦干净，不然碰个袖子都是辣的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They ease the flap open just enough for you to see a dark red tip.
beats.chinese: 菲诺拉把封口揭开一点点，刚能让你看见露出来的一角深红。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Today I used the kitchen pair. See? I can learn when there's a decent incentive.
beats.chinese: 今天用的厨房那把。看吧，真把我辣着了，我还是能长记性的。

causality.presenceReason: 来看一块自己袋子可能用的内衬
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢看平常能拿来用的布
causality.stayingConstraint: 买不成也得先还朋友的布样
causality.currentGoal: 搞清什么部分动，什么部分原样留
causality.currentState: 提出法子快，险些又替人决定
causality.contactTrigger: 她把自己旧袋撑开，看见人走过便问是不是从一边看得更清楚
causality.characterContinuity: 改东西先征得同意，不轻贱出于喜欢保存完整的行为
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 拿旧样对自己袋子比。ab 只修外露破口。ba 不拆掉别人的顶边。bb 继续逛且不碰别人布
causality.spatialContinuity: 拱廊通道与店面外侧，没有进私人工作区
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 今天说的是剪辣椒误拿剪刀

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Saoirse stops to flip through a stack of thin publications in a bag. A loose slip sticks out of the centre.
beats.chinese: 瑟莎停下来翻包里一叠薄刊。中间支出一张没订进去的纸片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have you seen one of these today? It says this Friday. There's no date, and the copy I was sent has Tuesday written across it.
beats.chinese: 你今天见过这种单子吗？上面写这周五，不写几号。别人给我那张还划上了星期二。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the slip where the light from the arcade roof catches the print.
beats.chinese: 她把纸片举到拱廊顶的光刚好能照清字的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I promised the magazine would turn up at two shops. Nobody asked me to promise an event at either of them.
beats.chinese: 我答应两家店送刊过去。可没人叫我连活动也给人保证了。

choices.english: Ask where the slip came from.
choices.chinese: 问单子是从哪儿来的。

choices.english: Ask which part she's sure she has to deliver.
choices.chinese: 问哪些东西是她已经确定要送的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She finds a tiny name at the foot of the slip and pinches the paper there.
beats.chinese: 她在纸最底下找到一个小小的名字，用手捏住那个位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: From the printer, by way of two people. I can ask the person whose name is here. She's the one who has to stand there either way.
beats.chinese: 印厂传出来的，中间又过了两个人。我可以问名字印在这儿的这位。不管星期几，她都是那个得到场站着的人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She separates the slip from the publications and holds the two things side by side.
beats.chinese: 她把传单从刊里抽出来，两样并排拿着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I can't reach her, these can still go. The slip can stay with me.
beats.chinese: 找不着她，这些刊还是可以送。单子我留下。

choices.english: Suggest taking the slip to the person on it.
choices.chinese: 建议拿着单子直接去问上头那个人。

choices.english: Suggest delivering the magazines without the slip.
choices.chinese: 建议送刊时先别夹传单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the address on a delivery label inside the bag.
beats.chinese: 她看了看包里一张送货标贴上的地址。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: These. I can put them on the right counter today. I don't know where I'm supposed to get two people to agree about a Friday.
beats.chinese: 这些刊。今天我能放到该放的柜台上。可我上哪儿找那俩人把周五的事说成一个样？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the magazines neatly back into the bag.
beats.chinese: 她把几本刊齐齐整整地放回包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't need a guess off you either. You've probably got your own things to do.
beats.chinese: 你也用不着替我猜。你自己兴许还有事要做呢。

choices.english: Say you'll leave it with her without guessing.
choices.chinese: 说不猜了，留她自己处理。

choices.english: Ask what she'll say if a shopkeeper asks about the event.
choices.chinese: 问要是店主问起活动，她会怎么回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the notice into an outer pocket and checks that its corner is still visible.
beats.chinese: 她把通知塞进外袋，又确认还有一角露着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll put it in front of her. If she reads Friday and looks surprised, I'll know enough for this morning.
beats.chinese: 我拿给她本人看。她要瞧见周五两个字就愣住，我上午能弄清这些也就够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns away from the stall she's beside and glances down the central passage.
beats.chinese: 她从身旁的摊子转开，沿中央过道望过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's about two streets away now, if she hasn't finished her tea.
beats.chinese: 她现在离这儿差不多两条街。只要她那杯茶还没喝完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She removes the slips one at a time. She keeps the bare magazine covers face up.
beats.chinese: 她把单子一张张抽走，刊物不再夹着纸，封面朝上收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take these as they were printed. If the Friday is real, I'll come back with an actual date.
beats.chinese: 就照印出来的原样送。周五要是靠谱，我再带写明日期的来一趟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pats the stack against the side of the bag and draws the strap up to go.
beats.chinese: 她把那摞东西在袋边拍齐，提好肩带准备走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've done worse circuits for much worse paper.
beats.chinese: 比这差的纸，我还替人跑过更冤的路呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the flap over the notice and moves out of the light from the roof.
beats.chinese: 她扣好袋盖压住通知，往旁边走出顶棚照下来的那片光。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. We don't know. That's something I can work with.
beats.chinese: 行，就是还不知道。这句倒可以照实说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She passes one shop front and slows at the next without taking the slip out.
beats.chinese: 她走过一家店，又在下一家门前放慢，没把单子拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll get these into the shops first.
beats.chinese: 我先把这些刊送进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps one cover accessible with her fingers between it and the next.
beats.chinese: 她把手指隔在头两本中间，让第一本随时能抽出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll say I brought the magazines. If they want to ask about the event, I'll give them the organiser's name, if she's happy with that.
beats.chinese: 就说刊我送来了。要问活动，我可以给办活动的人名字，只要她乐意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the bag so it doesn't brush a display as she sets off.
beats.chinese: 她把包转了个向，动身时没蹭到陈列上的东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll make the bit I know about easy to find. The rest can wait.
beats.chinese: 我知道的这部分，先让人找得到就行。剩下的等着吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A later day in the arcade, Saoirse notices you and pulls out a single folded sheet instead of opening the whole bag.
beats.chinese: 后来有一天在拱廊里，瑟莎瞧见你，只抽出一张折好的纸，没把整个包都打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I've got a copy with the middle pages in the wrong order. I kept one because the joke at the end is better when it comes first.
beats.chinese: 嗨。有一份中间几页订反了。我特地留了一份，末尾那个笑话放到头上，倒更好笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shows you the corner where one page number jumps out of sequence.
beats.chinese: 她指给你看页角，正好有一个页码没接上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can have this one if you like. There's no reason for it to be in my bag going round all morning.
beats.chinese: 你想要就拿去。我也犯不着揣着它满街兜一上午。

causality.presenceReason: 逐店送纸刊，找当事人核对小印刷品送达
causality.placeAttitude: 知道哪个店喜欢何种刊物，愿意花脚力说清
causality.stayingConstraint: 今天还要再跑几个店，不做中间人的关系协调
causality.currentGoal: 把传岔的通知在送之前停下来核对
causality.currentState: 不想又遇到已经过期的消息
causality.contactTrigger: 过道放慢，亲自向拿到传单的玩家问在哪儿领的
causality.characterContinuity: 核对触达，不转述别人关系矛盾，不靠猜
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 带去询问发行者。ab 留空封面不放错传单。ba 两人都不再推断。bb 当面解释自己只送刊
causality.spatialContinuity: 沿小店这侧停，来去由过道走，传单是自带的
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢是刊物印错次序的新情况，无需读过上次传单

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man moves his elbow off the seaward railing at Sea Point when you come up beside him. His phone buzzes once.
beats.chinese: 海角区长廊上，一个男人见你走到近旁，把胳膊从海边护栏上收了回来。他手机振了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, take the view. Ah, finally. Somebody answered me about the table.
beats.chinese: 你站这儿看吧。啊，总算有人回我桌子的事了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reads the reply with one eye screwed up.
beats.chinese: 他眯起一只眼看那条回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, that's a picture of a dog. We need one folding table for a braai. I've somehow asked eight people about it.
beats.chinese: 不是，是张狗照片。烤肉也就缺一张折叠桌，我怎么就问到第八个人头上了。

choices.english: Ask what he can bring himself.
choices.chinese: 问他自己能带什么。

choices.english: Ask whether all eight people need a say on the table.
choices.chinese: 问桌子的事非得八个人都表态吗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rests the back of his phone against the rail, screen inwards.
beats.chinese: 他把手机背面靠在栏杆上，屏幕朝自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chairs. Two. The table's at my brother's. He won't mind lending it, but whoever fetches it has a drive both ways.
beats.chinese: 椅子，两把。桌子在我哥那儿。他借是肯借，找谁去拿，那人就得开车跑个来回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks back towards the buildings along the promenade.
beats.chinese: 他回头望了眼长廊这一侧的楼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep asking everybody as though that makes it fairer to the one with the car.
beats.chinese: 我老在群里挨个问，问得多了，好像对那个开车的就公平了。

choices.english: Suggest telling the group he's bringing two chairs.
choices.chinese: 建议他先跟群里说自己带两把椅子。

choices.english: Suggest asking the person offering a table what would work for him.
choices.chinese: 建议让他先问借桌子的人怎么方便。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps the group name. He counts members with a finger, stopping after the first few.
beats.chinese: 他点进群名，用手指数人，数了几个就停了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only four are coming. One of the others told me she'd muted us. I thought she was joking.
beats.chinese: 来的也就四个。还有人说早把群静音了，我还以为她在逗我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the phone down at his side.
beats.chinese: 他把手机垂到身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can cook without it. I'd rather have somewhere to put the plates, but nobody's going hungry.
beats.chinese: 没桌子也能烤。我是想有个地方搁盘子，又不至于没桌子就吃不成。

choices.english: Leave the group alone until the others get here.
choices.chinese: 建议别再发了，等其他人过来。

choices.english: Ask if the four who are coming can make do with what they have.
choices.chinese: 问来的四个人能不能拿手头的东西先凑合。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types two words, adds a number and sends it.
beats.chinese: 他敲了两个词，加上一个数字，就发了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two chairs. Done. If I leave it there for ten minutes, I reckon somebody'll tell me what they've got.
beats.chinese: 两把椅子。发了。我歇十分钟不说话，说不定就有人来说他有啥了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the screen away from himself and peers through the rails at the rocks.
beats.chinese: 他把屏幕从自己眼前转开，透过栏杆往礁石上瞧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You were here for this, hey? Stay there. I can see over your shoulder.
beats.chinese: 你是来看海的吧？你站着，我从你肩膀上面看得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens his brother's contact and takes his thumb off the group chat.
beats.chinese: 他点开哥哥的联系人，把手指从群聊那儿挪开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask if it can go in his car, and if he'd want to bring it. Two different questions, I suppose.
beats.chinese: 我先问他车装不装得下，再问他愿不愿意带。这得分开问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the phone to his ear and shifts along the railing from you.
beats.chinese: 他把手机贴到耳边，沿栏杆往旁边走了几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Have you got a minute? Don't say yes till I've told you what it is.
beats.chinese: 哥，忙不忙？我还没说什么事呢，你先别答应。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets his phone and rubs his hands together once.
beats.chinese: 他揣起手机，搓了下手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. The dog can have the last word for now.
beats.chinese: 行吧。暂时让那只狗说了算。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He watches a pair of walkers go by and lifts his chin after them.
beats.chinese: 一对散步的人走过去，他朝那两人抬了下下巴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's not them. They'd have been waving at me from there already.
beats.chinese: 不是我等的人。是他们的话，在那么远就冲我招手了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens just the conversation with the people coming and holds the screen low.
beats.chinese: 他只点进要来的几个人那个群，把手机拿得低低的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a tray. If there's one more between us, I'll stop asking about the table.
beats.chinese: 我有个托盘。咱们再凑一个，我就不提桌子了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends the message, then starts down the promenade towards two people by the rail.
beats.chinese: 他发完消息，沿长廊朝栏杆旁的两个人走过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's my lot. I can ask them with my mouth this time.
beats.chinese: 我的人到了。这回总算能直接开口问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another evening at Sea Point, Nkosi spots you next to the rail. He's got a little mark on the back of one hand.
beats.chinese: 又一天傍晚，恩科西在海角区的栏杆边瞧见你。他手背上画了一小道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Howzit. That's one goal. I tried keeping score in my head and everybody got a different number.
beats.chinese: 嘿，你好。这是一球。我试过靠脑子记分，结果问谁都是个不一样的数。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs the mark and checks his finger. A little blue ink comes off.
beats.chinese: 他搓了搓那道印子，再看手指，蹭下来一点蓝墨水。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Next time they can get somebody who wasn't playing to do it. I can't count and argue with the ref.
beats.chinese: 下回让没上场的人记。我可没法一边数，一边跟裁判吵。

causality.presenceReason: 下班后来海边等朋友集合
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢在长廊边走边说
causality.stayingConstraint: 来的人还没到齐
causality.currentGoal: 解决烤肉时谁带折叠桌
causality.currentState: 问得太勤，被朋友静了音，有点下不来台
causality.contactTrigger: 他替靠护栏停住的玩家腾地方，顺势开口
causality.characterContinuity: 会替大家争公平，没问过人不会替人做主
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 公开自己能带的东西。ab 把问题交给借桌的人。ba 暂缓张罗。bb 接受少数意见先解决桌子
causality.spatialContinuity: 都在护栏内，桌椅只在聊天中出现
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 这天说的是球局记分，和烤肉无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman inside the promenade rail makes two small steps to the side. On the third she stops just short of you.
beats.chinese: 长廊护栏内侧，一个女人往旁边挪了两小步。到第三步，她在你前头堪堪站住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I saw you. Late, but I saw you.
beats.chinese: 我看见你了。看得有点晚，还是看见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She steadies her bag with the side of her shoe. A snatch of music plays from her phone.
beats.chinese: 她用鞋侧抵住自己的包，手机放出一小截音乐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm meant to turn there. In class I turned into a woman named June. Twice.
beats.chinese: 刚该转身。上课的时候我转到一个叫琼的学员身上去了。两回。

choices.english: Ask her which beat she turns on.
choices.chinese: 问她转身是踩哪一拍。

choices.english: Give her space and ask if she wants to practise alone.
choices.chinese: 先让开，问她是不是想一个人练。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She plays the same two seconds back. The toe of her shoe lifts once and goes down again.
beats.chinese: 她又放了一次同样的两秒。鞋尖抬了一下，又放回地上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the bit. I hear two. She said go on the one just before the breath.
beats.chinese: 就这儿。我听见两下。老师说等吸气前那一下转。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rests the phone on top of her closed bag.
beats.chinese: 她把手机搁到扣好的包上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can count it slower. I can also ask her next Tuesday and stop teaching myself the wrong thing.
beats.chinese: 我可以放慢数。也可以周二去问她，省得在这儿越练越错。

choices.english: Try counting slowly without stepping.
choices.chinese: 提议只放慢数拍，脚先别动。

choices.english: Suggest saving the question to ask in class.
choices.chinese: 提议把这句留到上课去问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She touches her heel down beside her bag and straightens up.
beats.chinese: 她把脚跟落在包旁边，站直了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Watching is useful in class. Out here I just feel how much of the pavement I'm taking up.
beats.chinese: 想。上课有人看着还有用。在这儿我光想着自己占了多少路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She picks up the bag without moving the straps out of their loops.
beats.chinese: 她把包整个提起来，没把肩带从扣里扯动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll pack in for now. Unless the place empties all at once. It won't.
beats.chinese: 先不练了。除非这儿的人一下全走光。那又不可能。

choices.english: Give her room to pass and leave it there.
choices.chinese: 让出路，让她按自己的安排走。

choices.english: Ask if it was the space or being watched that bothered her.
choices.chinese: 问她是地方小，还是不爱别人看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She counts on three fingers without taking her feet off the paving.
beats.chinese: 她掰着三根手指数，脚没离开地面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One, two. There. The third sound's somebody breathing into the phone.
beats.chinese: 一、二。懂了。第三声是谁贴着手机在喘气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She replays the clip and closes her eyes until it ends.
beats.chinese: 她重新放了一回，闭着眼听完。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll try it once when you go. If I take June out again on Tuesday, I'll tell her about the breathing.
beats.chinese: 等你走了我试一次。周二要是再撞上琼，我就跟她说说那口气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She types a few words under the recording and switches the music off.
beats.chinese: 她在录音下敲了几个字，把音乐关了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Turn before whose breath. She'll know what I mean. I hope.
beats.chinese: 谁吸气之前转。老师应该知道我问什么。希望吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her hand goes through the straps and she lifts the bag onto her shoulder.
beats.chinese: 她伸手穿过肩带，把包提上肩。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My feet can do walking till then. They know that one.
beats.chinese: 那之前我这双脚就负责走路。这个会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the way ahead, then walks past with the bag on the side away from you.
beats.chinese: 她看清前面的路，把包换到离你远的一侧，走了过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Plenty of room now. Thanks.
beats.chinese: 现在宽敞了。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops once to put the phone in an outer pocket, then keeps going.
beats.chinese: 她停了一下，把手机塞进外袋，接着往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tuesday. It'll keep till Tuesday.
beats.chinese: 周二吧。能等到周二。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stands still with her elbow straight and the bag down by her side.
beats.chinese: 她站住，胳膊伸直，包垂在身边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Being watched. I don't mind saying it. I've been pretending it's the wind.
beats.chinese: 不爱别人看。直说也没什么。刚才我还装成是嫌风大。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns her phone over so the screen goes dark.
beats.chinese: 她把手机翻过去，屏幕灭了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll go home and do the turn in my socks. The floor doesn't take notes.
beats.chinese: 回家穿袜子练转身吧。地板又不会给我记下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on the promenade, Thandi sees you while working the zip of a canvas bag. It moves half an inch and stops.
beats.chinese: 隔了一天，坦迪在长廊上遇到你，正拉帆布包的拉链。拉链挪了一点就卡住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I put everything away in the right order. The handle of the screwdriver still wants to come out first.
beats.chinese: 你好。每样东西我都按顺序放的。偏偏螺丝刀的柄一定要先冒出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pushes the handle in with a finger. The zip still won't go the whole way.
beats.chinese: 她拿指尖把柄推回去。拉链还是没能拉到底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough. I'm not emptying the bag out here for half an inch.
beats.chinese: 这样得了。就差这么一点，不至于在外头把包倒空。

causality.presenceReason: 下班来吹风，路上听同学传来的舞步录音
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢站着听得清节拍，风大时也容易盖住声音
causality.stayingConstraint: 现在只试脚，不许人碰她收好的工具包
causality.currentGoal: 找准转向前的一拍
causality.currentState: 被课堂上几次踩错气得不想多说
causality.contactTrigger: 练舞退一步接近玩家，她先停步确认距离
causality.characterContinuity: 说话具体，进度不急着下结论，收工的工具自己管
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 无声试出慢拍。ab 暂不定招。ba 收脚让路不邀参与。bb 说出不想被看，等有空再试
causality.spatialContinuity: 护栏内侧，包放近身，不挡长廊
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 当天工具袋卡拉链，和舞步无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Near the Sea Point railing a woman watches a strip of cloth flutter on somebody's bag. A long moment passes before she looks over at you.
beats.chinese: 海角区护栏边，一个女人看着别人包上飘动的一截布条。过了好一会儿，她才转过来看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have you seen a man with an orange spool? Big thing. He carries it under his arm like a loaf.
beats.chinese: 看见个拿橙色卷线轴的男人了吗？老大一个。他跟夹条面包似的夹着走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She watches another walker pass without filling the silence.
beats.chinese: 又一个行人走过，她看着，没急着再说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We're meant to put names down for the next kite day. They're good at leaving me off if I don't say anything.
beats.chinese: 下回放风筝要先记个名字。我不吭声，他们准又把我落下。

choices.english: Ask whether she wants a hand spotting the spool.
choices.chinese: 问她要不要一起留意橙色卷轴。

choices.english: Ask whether she has to sign up today.
choices.chinese: 问她今天非得把名字报上去吗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lets the rail go and stands straighter, looking inland now.
beats.chinese: 她松开栏杆，站直了些，朝陆地这一侧看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can point if you see him. Don't call him over. Last time he saw me first, he gave me his clipboard.
beats.chinese: 看着了指一下就行。别喊他。上回他先看见我，直接把登记夹板塞我手里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She flattens a creased paper slip against her palm.
beats.chinese: 她把皱巴巴的纸条压在手心抚平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can hold a kite while somebody gets the line out. I am not counting heads in this wind.
beats.chinese: 人家放线，我帮忙扶个风筝可以。我可不在这风里替谁点人数。

choices.english: Offer to point him out without getting involved.
choices.chinese: 说看见了就指一下，别的交给她。

choices.english: Ask if she'll go over when she sees him herself.
choices.chinese: 问她自己看见就会过去吗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks back over the railing. Some white water breaks among the rocks below.
beats.chinese: 她又扭头越过栏杆往外看，底下礁石间拍起一点白浪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I only said I'd stop by. I can go home, and they'll ask me again or they won't.
beats.chinese: 不用。我只说来看看。我也可以回家，他们爱不爱再问，就那么回事了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the paper slip down the old crease.
beats.chinese: 她沿旧折痕把纸条折起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't want them taking it as a no just because I'm standing here with my mouth shut.
beats.chinese: 就是不想我站这儿没说话，他们就当我不去了。

choices.english: Leave her to watch the water for a bit.
choices.chinese: 留她自己看一会儿海。

choices.english: Ask if she wants you to pass on her name if you see him.
choices.chinese: 问要是见到那个人，要不要帮她报个名。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves half a pace so you both have a view along the promenade.
beats.chinese: 她挪开半步，两人都能看清长廊那头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. Doesn't have to be a big thing.
beats.chinese: 行。不用闹出多大动静。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She watches in silence until an orange shape passes behind two people. Then she steps forward.
beats.chinese: 她静静看着。直到两个行人背后闪过一块橙色，她才往前迈了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's him. I've got it from here.
beats.chinese: 就他。后面我自己来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the slip in her pocket and takes two unhurried steps away from the rail.
beats.chinese: 她把纸条放进兜，慢悠悠离开栏杆走了两步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I will. I can say my own name. I've had it long enough.
beats.chinese: 会啊。我名字我自己会报。都叫这么久了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts one open hand towards somebody coming along the walkway.
beats.chinese: 长廊上有人走来，她朝那边举起一只手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Put me down this time. Just me. Keep the clipboard.
beats.chinese: 这次算上我。就我一个。夹板你自己拿着啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She settles both hands on the rail and lets an interval of silence go by.
beats.chinese: 她两手搭上栏杆，安安静静站了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See that bit of foam? It keeps coming back round the same rock.
beats.chinese: 瞧见那块白沫没？老绕着同一块礁石回来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes her hands off the rail as a group moves past, then puts them back.
beats.chinese: 一拨人走过，她先把手收开，等人走了又放回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be here a little longer.
beats.chinese: 我再站会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shakes her head once and puts the folded slip away.
beats.chinese: 她摇了下头，把折好的纸条收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Leave my name with me. If I want to put it down today, I'll find him.
beats.chinese: 我的名我自己报。今天想报，我就去找他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She seems about to turn away, then looks over once more.
beats.chinese: 她身子都转了一半，又看回来一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I meant don't do it for me. I didn't mean go away.
beats.chinese: 我是说不用替我报。没叫你走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later morning at Sea Point, Naledi spots you and lowers a folded crossword page so the wind catches less of it.
beats.chinese: 隔了几天的早上，娜莱迪在海角区看见你。她把折过的填字纸往下拿，免得风吹得那么厉害。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I know this answer. I left the pencil at home on purpose.
beats.chinese: 你好啊。这格我会。铅笔我是特意放家里的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She reads two lines without moving her lips, then folds the puzzle inwards.
beats.chinese: 她嘴唇没动，又看了两行，将题折到纸里头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I've got one to come back to. Unless I forget what it was by lunch.
beats.chinese: 回家就有一格现成的能填。除非午饭前我就给忘了。

causality.presenceReason: 来认一认海边来放风筝的几个人，想报名参加他们另约的一次
causality.placeAttitude: 爱看风，话少的时候不想被催
causality.stayingConstraint: 留一会儿，等组织人露面才当面开口
causality.currentGoal: 让他们知道她想参加但不主持
causality.currentState: 没有生气，只是不想又被默认没兴趣
causality.contactTrigger: 看有人也在等，她隔了一会儿才主动问看没看见拎卷轴的人
causality.characterContinuity: 愿意搭把手但绝不接管，也不为沉默找借口
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 请对方认出人时顺手指一下。ab 自己当面加名字。ba 这回独处。bb 明说别替她报名
causality.spatialContinuity: 护栏内看风看岸外，不爬护栏或进入海边
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 这天做填字题，即使别处认识她也成立

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the landward side of the Sea Point walk a man holds a phone close to his face. A voice from it says they'll all be at his place at two.
beats.chinese: 海角区长廊靠陆地这边，一个男人把手机拿到脸旁。里面有人说，大伙儿两点都到他家。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You heard that bit? His place. First I'm hearing of it.
beats.chinese: 你听见那句没？他家。本人也是刚听说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He switches the speaker off and steps out of the walking line.
beats.chinese: 他关掉外放，从行人走的那条线上让了出去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd go to watch the rugby. Different thing, having them all in my front room.
beats.chinese: 橄榄球我倒可以去看。换成一屋子人全来我客厅，那是两码事。

choices.english: Ask if he wants the group to change the address.
choices.chinese: 问他想不想让群里换个地点。

choices.english: Ask what he came to the promenade for today.
choices.chinese: 问他今天来长廊是想干什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the conversation but doesn't touch the microphone button.
beats.chinese: 他点开聊天，没按录音键。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I told them they could come over once. We were already halfway through the first half and their telly went. This one's two days from now.
beats.chinese: 我是有一回说过可以过来。那次上半场都打一半了，他们电视坏了。这回可是两天以后。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses his phone flat into his palm and faces the water.
beats.chinese: 他把手机按在手心，转向海面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got no problem saying it's off. They'll ask if that means I'm not coming at all.
beats.chinese: 我说这儿不成没什么问题。回头他们又该问，我是不是彻底不来了。

choices.english: Suggest saying plainly the game can't be at his place.
choices.chinese: 建议他就直说不能在自己家看。

choices.english: Suggest leaving room to watch somewhere else.
choices.chinese: 建议说清楚自己可以去别的地方看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves to the inside of the railing and lets the phone hang in his fingers.
beats.chinese: 他走到护栏里侧，松松地拿着手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: To walk. I've been on my feet all week pulling shade cloth. First time these legs got to pick a direction.
beats.chinese: 来走路。站着拉遮阳布拉了一礼拜。这两条腿头一回能自己挑个方向走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down the promenade, then down at the unused reply box.
beats.chinese: 他沿长廊看过去，又低头看那个还空着的回复框。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've barely got going. Two words would do it if I wanted to answer now.
beats.chinese: 我才刚走开没多远。要现在回，俩字也够了。

choices.english: Suggest finishing his walk first.
choices.chinese: 建议先把自己的路走完。

choices.english: Ask him what those two words would be.
choices.chinese: 问他这俩字打算怎么说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types with one thumb, leaving his other hand in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他拿一根拇指打字，另一只手还揣在兜里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not mine this Sunday. That's all they need from me.
beats.chinese: 这周日别来我家。要我说的就这一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A reply starts coming in. He switches the screen off before it arrives.
beats.chinese: 对面刚开始打字，他已经先把屏幕摁灭了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They know other houses. They've been in them.
beats.chinese: 又不是没人家能去。大伙儿都去过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He texts, reads the words once and puts the phone under his arm.
beats.chinese: 他发完消息，把字又看了一遍，把手机夹在胳膊下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Try somewhere else. I'm happy to be asked when you've picked it. That's what I sent.
beats.chinese: 另找个地方吧。挑好了再问我，我乐意你们问。我就发的这句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His arm stays still until the phone stops buzzing against it.
beats.chinese: 他胳膊没动，直到夹着的手机不再振。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If it's one of those houses with the tiny TV I'll go anyway. Just ask me first.
beats.chinese: 就算是谁家那台小电视，我没准也去。先问我一下就成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He locks the screen with the reply still empty. Then he starts towards the mountain end of the view.
beats.chinese: 回复框还是空的，他锁了屏，朝看得见山的那一头走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I'll answer when I can feel my feet again.
beats.chinese: 行。等腿脚走舒坦了我再回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He clears the next knot of walkers and slows once he's past them.
beats.chinese: 他穿过前面一群散步的人，过去了才把步子放慢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No hurry now.
beats.chinese: 这会儿不赶了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He mouths the words once, then taps a line into the box.
beats.chinese: 他嘴里先动了一下，又在框里敲进一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not here. I've added try Gavin's. Oh, hell. Now I'm offering Gavin's place, aren't I?
beats.chinese: 别来。又加了句去加文家试试。哎呀，这不又替加文揽上了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the second line out and sends the first one.
beats.chinese: 他删掉第二行，只发了第一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I can put my shoes to work again.
beats.chinese: 得了。我这双鞋可以接着干活了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day on the promenade Pieter recognizes you. He has a pair of pliers wrapped in a kitchen towel.
beats.chinese: 改天在长廊上，彼得认出了你，手里一块厨房巾裹着把钳子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I'm taking these back. I borrowed them to fix the braai lid. Turns out the lid works if you let it shut crooked.
beats.chinese: 嗨。来还这个的。本来借来修烤炉盖，后来发现，盖歪点照样能扣上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls the towel tighter round the handles.
beats.chinese: 他拿布把钳柄又裹紧了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give him his pliers. I won't tell him his lid shuts crooked too, unless he asks.
beats.chinese: 钳子给他。他家那盖也扣不正，这我就不多嘴了，除非他问。

causality.presenceReason: 来长廊走掉一整周在花场站着的僵劲儿
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢不约人的空当
causality.stayingConstraint: 随时可以走，不必为了朋友消息停留
causality.currentGoal: 处理被默认安排为周日招待人的事
causality.currentState: 不算发火，说到别人替他排下就不客气
causality.contactTrigger: 手机播来语音叫他主人，他看向路人问刚才那句听见了没
causality.characterContinuity: 肯参加不肯被排班，讲清楚后不接手找下一个人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 明确让群改地点。ab 留下可以去看球的选择。ba 当场走完再回。bb 只回两句把时间留给自己
causality.spatialContinuity: 从陆侧走到护栏内，不下礁石
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 钳子是这天借来的，与球和聚会无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the stone passage at Greenmarket Square, Mavis gathers a long roll of paper in close. The empty bag on their shoulder flattens against a sleeve.
beats.chinese: 绿市广场的石铺通道里，梅维斯把一长卷纸往怀里拢。肩上的空袋子瘪在袖子边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. The bag's for a friend. The paper was meant to go in it. I took it back out.
beats.chinese: 不好意思。这袋子是来还朋友的。纸本来放里面，我又拿出来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They press the bottom of the roll against the toe of one shoe to line up the edges.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯用鞋尖抵着纸卷的底下，把边对齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's a map we drew. I'm giving the bag back because I'm done with the group. Funny how everybody thinks that means they can fill in my bit.
beats.chinese: 是以前一块儿画的地图。我还袋子，是因为我不跟着画了。大伙儿听完怎么就觉得，我那一块可以代画呢。

choices.english: Ask which part they want to keep.
choices.chinese: 问他们想把哪一部分留给自己。

choices.english: Ask whether the friend knows they're just there to return the bag.
choices.chinese: 问朋友知不知道他们只是来还袋子的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis lets the top of the roll uncurl slightly. One band of blue stops before the edge.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯松开纸卷上缘一点。一道蓝线在快到边上的时候断了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one. I hadn't been down the road past that corner. I left it blank because I hadn't been, not because I ran out of ink.
beats.chinese: 就这张。那个拐角再过去，我还没走过。我空着是因为没去过，不是笔没水了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They cover the opening with the heel of their hand on the next gust.
beats.chinese: 又一阵风，梅维斯拿手掌根压住开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They can start a fresh one. I'd even give them the paper. I'd rather keep this exactly here.
beats.chinese: 他们完全可以再起一张。我连纸都能给。就这张，我想留成现在这样。

choices.english: Say the old drawing can stay rolled up the way it is.
choices.chinese: 说旧的就照这样卷起来留着。

choices.english: Suggest offering a clean sheet for the next map.
choices.chinese: 建议给下一张地图留张白纸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis slides the bag strap off their shoulder and holds it by one short handle.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯把袋子从肩上滑下来，拿着那只短提手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said I had something of theirs. I didn't say come and tell me how much everybody's going to miss me.
beats.chinese: 我只说有件东西要还。可没叫人来跟我讲，大伙儿以后会多想我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They let two shoppers pass between the canvas sides of the stalls.
beats.chinese: 两个顾客从摊位的棚布之间走过，梅维斯先让他们过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We could talk about the market. There's a whole market here.
beats.chinese: 可以聊市场嘛。眼前这么大一个市场呢。

choices.english: Leave the reason for stepping back alone.
choices.chinese: 不追问为什么不接着画。

choices.english: Ask if they'd prefer to meet the friend separately.
choices.chinese: 问要不要改天单独还袋子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis tightens the roll just enough for its worn elastic to go back on.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯把纸卷收紧一点点，套回那根旧橡皮筋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. At home I can put it where I put the first one. I still remember where we stood to draw that.
beats.chinese: 成。回家跟第一张搁一块儿。我还记得画第一张时站在哪儿呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They move the roll to the crook of an elbow, with the bag on the other arm.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯把纸卷夹进臂弯，袋子另挂到一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. There's my friend. I'll give her the thing I said I'd bring.
beats.chinese: 啊，我朋友来了。说还什么就还什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis pulls a sheet from the middle of the roll and checks both sides. It's white on each.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯从纸卷中间抽出一张，两面都看了看，都是白的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here we are. Big enough to get lost on, if they want to.
beats.chinese: 有了。这么大够他们画的了。想画到找不着北都成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the sheet once and slide it in the empty bag.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯把白纸对折，塞进空袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask first. Last thing I want is to tell them what to draw as I walk away.
beats.chinese: 我会先问一声。都不跟着画了，我可不想临走还指挥人家画什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis presses the rolled map against their body, then turns it so the loose edge is out of the wind.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯把卷好的图挨着自己转了转，让松的那一边避开风。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I had a whole account ready. I don't think I'll need it.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我还准备了一套说辞。想想也用不着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look across the narrow passage at the nearest row of woven bags.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯越过窄通道看对面最近那排编织包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now which of those could you actually fit a whole cabbage in?
beats.chinese: 你说那些包，哪只真能装下一整颗卷心菜？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis makes a space between the folded bag and the paper and gets their phone out.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯把折好的袋子和纸卷错开一点，腾手拿出手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll see her after. One person. No cake.
beats.chinese: 我晚一点单独见她。就一个人，也不用蛋糕。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They type, press send and put the bag back over their shoulder.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯打完字，点了发送，又把袋子搭回肩上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can stay and look for myself now. I'd forgotten that was an option.
beats.chinese: 这下还能留在这儿自己逛逛。我都差点忘了可以这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another market day, Mavis spots you with four small envelopes fanned in one hand.
beats.chinese: 改天逛市场，梅维斯看见你时，手里扇形摊开四个小信封。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Seeds for the post. I was going to give her the whole packet. She only wanted five.
beats.chinese: 你好。要寄的种子。本来想整包给她，她说只要五粒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They raise the smallest envelope up to the light, then lower it again.
beats.chinese: 梅维斯把最小那只信封举到光下，又放低了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Five it is, then. Takes more trouble to send somebody less, sometimes.
beats.chinese: 那就五粒。有时候少给点东西，还更费工夫呢。

causality.presenceReason: 来广场还朋友当初借的装图袋
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意来走走，不想让这趟变成告别仪式
causality.stayingConstraint: 在摊与摊之间等朋友有空见
causality.currentGoal: 把旧草图和包分开放，说明自己退出来
causality.currentState: 舍不得开头那几年的事，又不愿接剩余工作
causality.contactTrigger: 纸卷支到行走空间，收进怀里时听见玩家提到袋子，补了一句
causality.characterContinuity: 未做完的东西不让人替补，不把离开说成求劝回
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 留住原稿。ab 交给对方新纸重画。ba 不解释自己退的原因。bb 单独约交还，不在广场当众说
causality.spatialContinuity: 人物只在棚布之间的石铺顾客通道活动
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 认得彼此，寄种子是后来独立的一件事

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At a stall in Greenmarket Square a man points at the strap of a woven bag. Two people farther down the stone passage turn their heads.
beats.chinese: 绿市广场的一个摊前，一个男人指着编织包的背带。隔着一段石铺通道，有两个人都回过头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a lovely strap. Ah, sorry. Did I sound cross? I was saying it's good.
beats.chinese: 这背带真好。哎，不好意思。我听着像生气了？我是在夸呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The stallholder goes back to straightening the bags. The man looks your way and speaks quite a bit lower.
beats.chinese: 摊主接着理包。男人朝你看过来，这回声音小了不少。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My cousin wants a bag she can sling over the chair at work. I could try asking how big the chair is, couldn't I?
beats.chinese: 我表妹想找个包搭单位椅背上。我是不是该先问问椅子多大？

choices.english: Ask what he likes about this one.
choices.chinese: 问他看中了眼前这只包哪一点。

choices.english: Tell him you could hear him, but he didn't sound angry.
choices.chinese: 告诉他确实听见了，但不像在发火。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds his thumb and a finger apart beside the strap without pulling on it.
beats.chinese: 他在背带旁边分开拇指和食指比了比，没伸手拽。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's wide. She puts half the office in her bag. Then she's surprised the thin straps dig in.
beats.chinese: 够宽。她恨不得把半个办公室装包里。装完又纳闷细带怎么勒肩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out his phone and glances at the bags farther along the stall.
beats.chinese: 他拿出手机，往摊子另一头的包那儿看了看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can call her. If she's at work she'll whisper, and then I'll probably shout what back at her.
beats.chinese: 我可以打给她。她要在上班，说话就得小声。我准又张口大喊你说啥。

choices.english: Suggest trying the call at speaking volume.
choices.chinese: 建议用平时聊天的音量给她打个电话。

choices.english: Suggest asking the stallholder before sending a picture.
choices.chinese: 建议先问摊主能不能拍，再给表妹发图。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs a hand across his mouth and makes an open space beside the display for another shopper.
beats.chinese: 他拿手抹了下嘴，给另一个顾客在陈列前腾出一块空来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. My neighbour thought I was fighting on my stoep once. I'd just seen a try go in.
beats.chinese: 谢了。有一回我邻居以为我在自家门廊跟人吵架。我其实刚看见有人达阵。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Someone at the stall lets out a short laugh. He waits for it to finish.
beats.chinese: 摊边有人笑了一声。他等那人笑完才开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one I can explain for myself. Nobody needs to tell the whole square I'm friendly.
beats.chinese: 这回我自己能解释。不用满广场去跟人说我这人挺和气。

choices.english: Ask him to remember the strap and come back another time.
choices.chinese: 建议他把背带的样子记住，改天再来。

choices.english: Let him speak to the stallholder himself.
choices.chinese: 留他自己跟摊主说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He makes the call with the speaker off. His first hello is quiet; the second one carries farther.
beats.chinese: 他打电话没开免提。头一声喂挺轻，第二声传得远了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: How far is it from one end of the back to the other? Yes, the chair. I don't expect you to measure the whole office.
beats.chinese: 椅背这一头到那一头多长？对，就椅子。我又没叫你量整个办公室。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He listens, lowers his voice again, and puts his hands about a forearm apart.
beats.chinese: 他听了会儿，又压低声音，两手比出差不多一小臂长。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay. Let me find her one she can actually hang up.
beats.chinese: 好。我这就给她找只能真挂得住的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the phone just high enough for the stallholder to see it. He waits for a nod.
beats.chinese: 他举起手机，让摊主看清，在那儿等人家点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Just the bag. You're all right, nobody else is in it.
beats.chinese: 谢了。就拍包。放心，没拍进去其他人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He frames the strap and bag together, takes one photo and moves aside from the stall.
beats.chinese: 他把包和背带一块儿框进画面，拍了一张，就从摊前让开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now she can tell me herself it's the wrong colour.
beats.chinese: 好了，颜色不对也让她亲口跟我说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at the weave of the strap once more and takes his phone off the camera screen.
beats.chinese: 他又看了眼背带上的编纹，把手机从拍照界面退出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Wide strap, two rows of blue. I can remember that. I could also remember to ask what she wants.
beats.chinese: 宽的，两道蓝。我记得住。还能顺便记住问问人家究竟想要什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks once at the bag and takes a step down the passage.
beats.chinese: 他再看一眼那只包，沿通道走了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I come back with something for me, don't let me claim I got confused.
beats.chinese: 我要是最后拎个自己用的回来，可别听我说我弄混了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns his shoulders back towards the stall. He speaks with his hands loose at his sides.
beats.chinese: 他重新转向摊位，两手松松垂在身侧，开了口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came out a bit loud there. You didn't do anything. Could I ask about the strap?
beats.chinese: 刚才我嗓门有点大，跟你没关系。能问问背带吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The stallholder lifts one bag by the strap from the row where it hangs. He gives you a quick nod over his shoulder.
beats.chinese: 摊主拿背带从那排里提起一只包。男人越过肩膀飞快朝你点了下头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I've got it.
beats.chinese: 谢啦。我自己来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day at Greenmarket Square, Sizwe sees you with a smear of bicycle grease over one thumb.
beats.chinese: 又一天在绿市广场，西兹韦看见了你。他一根拇指上蹭着一抹车油。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Don't shake this one. I fixed the rattle on my bike. It's moved to the gate now, somehow.
beats.chinese: 嘿，别握这只。我把车上那阵响修好了。也不知道怎么的，现在换院门响。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tries to wipe the grease with a dry corner of a paper napkin. It only moves to a different part of the thumb.
beats.chinese: 他拿纸巾干的一角去擦。油没掉，光往拇指另一边蹭开了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might leave the gate. My cousin says at least she can hear me coming without the bike now.
beats.chinese: 院门还是先不修了吧。我表妹说，以后车不响，好歹还能靠院门听见我回来。

causality.presenceReason: 来给表亲找一只有结实带子的包
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢摊子挨得近，一边看一边聊
causality.stayingConstraint: 要先把表亲提出的尺寸问明白
causality.currentGoal: 别按自己喜好乱买
causality.currentState: 想夸眼前这只，音量太大被当成抱怨
causality.contactTrigger: 自己发现卖家把话听成生气，转向邻近玩家问刚才是否喊了
causality.characterContinuity: 热情高声，提醒后会收一阵，不接没看的比赛也不谈膝盖
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 用低声问尺寸。ab 给包拍照但先找摊主同意。ba 只记带子。bb 自承刚才太大声，让玩家不必打圆场
causality.spatialContinuity: 正常顾客通道里，没有碰别人购物或堵摊
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 今天说的是修车之后仍有动静，和买包无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman in the passage between the craft stalls reads a short reply from her phone without much sound. She deletes it, then looks up at you.
beats.chinese: 工艺摊之间的过道上，一个女人压低声音念了念手机里写的一句回复。她删了，又抬头看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you be more specific? Does that sound as though I want an answer, or as though I want the person to go away?
beats.chinese: 能说具体点吗？你听着觉得我是真想知道，还是想把人打发走？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the phone off for a second. The cloth overhead moves in a small fold.
beats.chinese: 她摁灭手机。头顶棚布的一道折子动了动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A man wants me to have a quick look at his golf clubs. Last time I said yes to that, my whole Sunday went with him.
beats.chinese: 有个人想让我顺便看眼他的球杆。上回我一答应顺便看看，整个周日都赔进去了。

choices.english: Ask what part of the clubs she actually works on.
choices.chinese: 问她具体修球杆的哪一部分。

choices.english: Ask whether she wants to take the job at all.
choices.chinese: 问她到底想不想接这一单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She curls her fingers round the narrow edge of the phone without pressing any buttons.
beats.chinese: 她的手指沿手机窄边拢起来，没按到键。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Grips. If they slip, or the rubber's gone shiny, I can do something. I don't mend the shafts.
beats.chinese: 握把。打滑了，胶面磨亮了，我都能弄。杆身坏了我不修。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the reply box again and presses her thumb on the empty line.
beats.chinese: 她重新点进回复框，拇指落在空行上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can ask him what's moving. I could also tell him right away what I won't be doing.
beats.chinese: 可以问他到底哪儿在动。也可以先把我哪儿不修告诉他。

choices.english: Suggest asking exactly what slips and when.
choices.chinese: 建议问清哪儿滑、什么时候滑。

choices.english: Suggest naming the work she takes and leaving it there.
choices.chinese: 建议只说自己接什么活儿，别的先不谈。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the phone into her bag and lines up its two handles.
beats.chinese: 她把手机放进袋里，把两边提手理齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wanted to buy paper. I don't want to stand here deciding what somebody meant by a quick look.
beats.chinese: 我是来买纸的。我不想站在这儿琢磨，人家那句顺便看看是什么意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the space ahead and steps clear of two people coming down the passage.
beats.chinese: 她看看前头，往边上让开迎面走来的两个人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll do a pair of grips at the weekend if I know that's what they are. Otherwise I won't.
beats.chinese: 要知道就换两只握把，我周末可以做。别的事，不接。

choices.english: Suggest she leave the message until she's done shopping.
choices.chinese: 建议她先买完东西再回。

choices.english: Suggest telling him to wait for a reply before bringing the clubs.
choices.chinese: 建议先请对方等回复，别直接把球杆带来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She types two questions and counts them off under her breath.
beats.chinese: 她敲了两个问句，在嘴里轻声数了数。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: What slips? Does it slip while you swing? That should give us a place to start.
beats.chinese: 哪儿打滑？是挥杆的时候滑吗？这样才聊得下去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses send, slips the phone into the inner pocket and closes the tab over it.
beats.chinese: 她按了发送，把手机塞进里袋，翻盖扣上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If he writes back everything, I'm buying paper first anyway.
beats.chinese: 他要是回哪儿都滑，我也还是先买纸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves back to the stall edge and types with both thumbs.
beats.chinese: 她靠回摊位边，用两根拇指打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I replace grips. If it's the shaft, please don't bring it. There. I didn't ask him to explain his whole life.
beats.chinese: 我换握把。杆身的问题就别送来了。好了，也没叫他说他这辈子都遇着过什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends the text and leaves the screen dark.
beats.chinese: 她把消息发出去，屏幕灭了就没再打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one's easier to read than the one I had before.
beats.chinese: 这句比我头一回写的好懂多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She zips her bag shut and lifts it higher on her arm.
beats.chinese: 她拉上袋子，把提手往臂弯里提了提。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Otherwise I'll have a customer in my head all the way through buying a bit of paper.
beats.chinese: 也是。要不我就买这么一点纸，满脑子还装着一个客人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks along the row of goods rather than into the bag.
beats.chinese: 她沿着那一排东西看，没有再低头瞧袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give it ten minutes. The paper's what I came for.
beats.chinese: 我先给自己十分钟。我过来是买纸的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gets the phone out without stepping farther into the passage.
beats.chinese: 她拿出手机，人没往过道中间挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't bring them over until we've arranged it. I can say that much without deciding whether I'm doing it.
beats.chinese: 没约好之前先别拿过来。这句可以先说，不用现在答应接不接。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends it and draws back to let a shopper through.
beats.chinese: 她发出去，往后站给一位顾客让路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At least I won't come home to a bag of golf clubs at the gate.
beats.chinese: 这下回家至少不会发现门口搁着一袋球杆。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One weekend later on, Eunice spots you in the market passage and pulls an orange sock from under a folded piece of cloth.
beats.chinese: 后来一个周末，尤妮斯在市场过道瞧见你，从一块叠好的布底下抽出只橙袜子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I made two pairs to give away. Then I came out in this colour and nobody wanted it.
beats.chinese: 你好。我织了两双想送人。结果这个颜色一拿出来，一个想要的都没有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stretches the bright cuff between her thumbs and lets it spring back.
beats.chinese: 她用两只拇指撑开鲜艳的袜口，松手让它弹回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to try it with my old boots. They haven't had much news in years.
beats.chinese: 我拿旧靴子配配看。它们都多少年没碰上新鲜事了。

causality.presenceReason: 给织好的袜子挑包裹材料，接到含混的维修消息
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢早上逛人流不紧的摊
causality.stayingConstraint: 留下的只是一点挑东西的时间
causality.currentGoal: 弄清楚客户到底是握把松还是整个杆有别的问题
causality.currentState: 听过太多次顺手看看，今天懒得猜
causality.contactTrigger: 停在路边打字又全删，自己问玩家读出来像不像把人往外赶
causality.characterContinuity: 坚持具体问题，也会礼貌拒接，休息时间不应征用
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 发两个明确问题。ab 把修不到的事讲清。ba 晚点回。bb 不让这位客户拿杆就过来
causality.spatialContinuity: 一直在石铺顾客通道，球杆和工间只在对话中
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 周末重逢触及这天袜子颜色，不需要知道客户

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man waits at the customer edge of a fabric stall while the stallholder turns back the corner of a piece of cloth.
beats.chinese: 布艺摊前，一个男人站在顾客这边等着。摊主把一块布的角翻了过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look at that. Soft side's out, stiff side's in. Are you waiting to see it? There's a bit of room here.
beats.chinese: 瞧这个，软的一面朝外，硬的一面在里头。你也等着看？这儿还能站个人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves away from the narrowest part of the passage and loosens the elastic on a plain notebook.
beats.chinese: 他从过道最窄的地方退开，松开一本素面本子上的橡皮筋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I used to order the cloth for book spines. I still look at the back of everything. My sister won't take me to buy curtains any more.
beats.chinese: 以前做书脊的布都归我订。现在看什么都要翻过来。我妹都不肯带我去买窗帘了。

choices.english: Ask what he wants the back of the cloth to do.
choices.chinese: 问他想要布的背面起什么用。

choices.english: Ask whether he really needs to buy it.
choices.chinese: 问他是不是真想买。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the book on his hand and shows the bent line where the cover meets the pages.
beats.chinese: 他用手托着摊开本子，露出封皮挨着书页弯折的那一线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fold, mostly. Over and over. I bought a lovely cloth once and it split the first time somebody opened the book.
beats.chinese: 主要是经得起折，得来来回回折。我有一回买了特别好看的布，人家头一回翻书，布就裂了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves his notebook open. He hasn't taken the fabric off the stall.
beats.chinese: 他手上的本子还摊着，摊上的布没拿走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one might work. I'd use it on something of mine before I'd put it on anybody else's.
beats.chinese: 这块兴许行。给别人用以前，我肯定先拿自己的东西试。

choices.english: Ask if he can compare it with the notebook here.
choices.chinese: 问他要不要先跟手里的本子比一比。

choices.english: Ask whether a little would be enough to try at home.
choices.chinese: 问买一点回去自己试够不够。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets the elastic roll back onto the notebook and presses it down flat.
beats.chinese: 他把橡皮筋放回本子上，用手按平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Need? No. I've got a drawer I've been trying to shut since Christmas. It won't take this personally.
beats.chinese: 非买不可？不。我有个抽屉，从圣诞节起就塞得关不紧。它也不会怪我没买。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks again at the underside, keeping his hands on his own book.
beats.chinese: 他又看了眼布的反面，手还搁在自己的本子上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't know what they've put on the back. That'll bother me all the way home.
beats.chinese: 背面这个我没见过。我一路回家都得惦记它是怎么弄的。

choices.english: Suggest showing it to someone he used to work with another day.
choices.chinese: 建议哪天和以前的同事过来一起看。

choices.english: Ask whether he's going to ask the stallholder about it.
choices.chinese: 问他打不打算直接问摊主。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds up the notebook to ask first. The stallholder draws over a free corner and holds it across the spine.
beats.chinese: 他举着本子先问了一声。摊主把布空着的一角拉过来，横搭在书脊上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, it's going white when you bend it. There, just on the edge of the fold.
beats.chinese: 噢，一折就泛白了。喏，就折边这一条。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the notebook and gives the cloth corner back without creasing it further.
beats.chinese: 他合上本子，把布角还过去，没再往下压折。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it, then. Still a lovely bit of cloth.
beats.chinese: 那我不买了。布是真的挺好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds his hands a few inches apart and looks to the stallholder rather than reaching for the cloth.
beats.chinese: 他两手比出短短一截，朝摊主看，没伸手去抓布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just that much, if you sell pieces. I want to wreck it in private first.
beats.chinese: 你要零卖，就这么点儿。我想先回家糟蹋一块试试。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the notebook under his arm and waits for the stallholder to answer.
beats.chinese: 他把本子夹到胳膊底下，等摊主回话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't tell my sister this is what slowed me down. She'll guess it without any help.
beats.chinese: 别跟我妹说我又为了这个耽搁。她不用人说也猜得到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one step away from the stall and keeps the book shut in his hand.
beats.chinese: 他往摊外走了一步，手里本子一直合着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask Edmund to come by. He always reckoned I bought things before I'd finished looking. He was right about every third time.
beats.chinese: 我叫埃德蒙过来吧。他老说我还没看够就下单。差不多三回能说中一回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns towards the next patch of open paving.
beats.chinese: 他转向前面空出来的一块石铺路面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's no rush. With any luck my drawer will still be full next week.
beats.chinese: 不急。运气好的话，我那抽屉下礼拜还是满的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns back to the stallholder and points without leaning into the display.
beats.chinese: 他转回摊主这边，伸手指了指，身子没往陈列里探。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Do you know what makes that side hard? Somebody's done a job there I've never seen before.
beats.chinese: 你知道这面怎么变硬的吗？这个做法，我可真还没见过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He listens, nods and rests a finger on the spine of the notebook.
beats.chinese: 他听了一会儿，点点头，一根手指搭到自己的本子背上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd try it on a bag first, hearing that. Look at me coming for one thing and leaving with a different idea.
beats.chinese: 听完我倒想先拿它用在包上。瞧我，为一件事来的，回去又是另一件事了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day, Sipho recognizes you between the market stalls. For once his hands are empty.
beats.chinese: 改天在市场摊位之间，西福认出了你。这回难得两手空空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I finished a neighbour's book today and left it on the bench. If I'd put it in my bag, I'd have taken it out to check it every ten minutes.
beats.chinese: 哎。今天修完邻居一本书，留台子上了。我要装进袋里带来，准每十分钟拿出来检查一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pats the sides of his jacket, then crosses his arms with a little snort.
beats.chinese: 他拍了拍夹克两边，鼻子里哼了声，把胳膊抱起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I still went to check it just now. Very quiet in the pocket where it isn't.
beats.chinese: 刚才还是想掏出来看。兜里倒挺安静，什么也没有。

causality.presenceReason: 和妹妹约见之前顺路摸摸新织物
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢实际摸一摸，也愿意改用新材料
causality.stayingConstraint: 得赶在妹妹走之前会合
causality.currentGoal: 判断织法，不必立刻买来修书
causality.currentState: 碰到坚硬的背面，想讲当年用合成料的糗事
causality.contactTrigger: 摊主把边翻给他，他主动在旁退一步让玩家也看
causality.characterContinuity: 能听新意见，不接受工作间交出去，也不因晚辈用法就说老东西全该扔
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 经摊主许可把小样挂在本子上对照。ab 决定带回一小段做自有练习。ba 不买，把老同事带来。bb 碰到自己没见过的做法，留着问别人
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程在摊面外侧，经摊主同意才看布背面，未挡道
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天修好书没带出来，重逢只有认得

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man stands clear of the Afflecks entrance folding a card into progressively smaller rectangles.
beats.chinese: 一个男人站在 Afflecks 入口外不碍路的地方，把张卡片一折再折，越折越小。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Does come and try the floor sound like you have to dance? My sister says it does.
beats.chinese: 写来试试地板，听着像是一定得跳舞吗？我姐说像。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens one of the creases again. A line of blue writing is visible.
beats.chinese: 他掀开一道折痕，露出一行蓝字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We're having a dance. She was going to hand these out. Then she read one.
beats.chinese: 我们要办场舞会。她原本打算帮发卡片。拿起一张读了，就不发了。

choices.english: Ask what someone can do without dancing.
choices.chinese: 问不跳舞，到了能干点什么。

choices.english: Ask whether he's upset with his sister.
choices.chinese: 问他是不是生姐姐的气了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smooths the fold on the corner of the card.
beats.chinese: 他把卡片角上的折痕按平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Watch. Have a tea. Tell me nothing fits. I'll have some of my repaired shoes out in case people fancy it.
beats.chinese: 看。喝杯茶。跟我说鞋没一双合脚的。我会带几双修好的，有人想试就试。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He runs a finger over the line without covering it.
beats.chinese: 他的指尖沿着那行字走了一遍，字还露在外头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I didn't put any of that here.
beats.chinese: 也是，这些我一个字没往上写。

choices.english: Suggest making it clear you can come and watch.
choices.chinese: 建议写清楚，光来看看也成。

choices.english: Suggest saying people can keep their own shoes on.
choices.chinese: 建议写上，穿自己脚下那双就成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the card by opposite corners, pulling it just tight enough to flatten it.
beats.chinese: 他捏着卡片两个对角往外绷，刚好能拉平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm cross. It'll pass. She's right, which won't make it pass any faster.
beats.chinese: 我不高兴。一会儿就好了。她说得对，也不会叫我好得更快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns his head to allow two people to pass the red brick frontage.
beats.chinese: 两个行人沿红砖外墙走过，他扭了扭头给人让路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wanted a room with people in it. Didn't mean to write a test they have to pass first.
beats.chinese: 我想要的是来几个人，屋里别空着。我又没想让人进门先考试。

choices.english: Give him space to think before he changes the invitations.
choices.chinese: 留点空，让他想好了再改卡片。

choices.english: Tell him somebody might still say no after he changes it.
choices.chinese: 提醒他就算改了，还是有人不想去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls a pencil from his inside pocket and adds three words underneath the line.
beats.chinese: 他从内兜里摸支铅笔，在那行底下写了三个词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Come and watch. There. Two of the best dancers I knew used to watch everyone else for a year first.
beats.chinese: 来看看吧。好了。我认识两个跳得特别好的，刚开始先看别人跳了整整一年。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He blows a bit of graphite dust off the card.
beats.chinese: 他吹掉卡片上的一点铅笔粉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll see if my sister will take a second look. She needn't take a stack.
