beats.chinese: 问问我姐肯不肯再看一眼。不用她领一摞走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets the pencil point at the margin and writes a short addition on the card.
beats.chinese: 他在卡片边上落笔，加了一小句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Your own shoes are fine. I do remember what the first pair of somebody else's shoes felt like. Too much of somebody else's foot in them.
beats.chinese: 穿自己的鞋就行。我还记得第一次穿别人鞋什么感觉。到处都是人家脚的形状。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pushes the finished card back into the stack instead of putting it on top.
beats.chinese: 他把改好的那张塞回那摞中间，没放最上头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have to do the rest before I give them out. There's twenty.
beats.chinese: 散出去之前还得把别的改掉。一共二十张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pushes the folded card into his coat and keeps his hand in there with it.
beats.chinese: 他把折好的卡塞进大衣，手也留在里头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. I can go for a walk first. I'm no good at writing an invitation when I'm trying to win an argument.
beats.chinese: 也是。我可以先走走。一心想争赢，写不出请人来的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one step along Church Street and leaves the doorway clear behind him.
beats.chinese: 他沿教堂街走出一步，把身后的门口空了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll read it again when I've stopped hearing her voice over it.
beats.chinese: 等我看那几行字，不再满脑子是我姐的声音，我再看一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks through the entrance without moving into the doorway.
beats.chinese: 他朝入口里看，脚没挪进门口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They might. I'll still put the shoes out. If nobody tries a pair, I can check the laces again in the quiet.
beats.chinese: 是有人不来。我还是会把鞋摆出来。没一个人试，我还能趁清静把鞋带再检查一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the card away flat this time.
beats.chinese: 这回他把卡平平整整地收了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm allowed to be disappointed too. I'll be disappointed over there, out of their way.
beats.chinese: 我也能失望一会儿嘛。我去旁边失望，别叫人家看着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day outside Afflecks, Wilf spots you with a length of cord coiled in the bend of his hand.
beats.chinese: 改天在 Afflecks 门外，威尔夫看到你，手弯里盘了截绳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I made that too tight. I had one left to do and I started thinking about my dinner.
beats.chinese: 你好。这截编紧了。就差最后一点，我脑子里开始想吃晚饭了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He works a little length loose at the end without undoing the rest.
beats.chinese: 他在尾巴上松出一小截，没把剩下的全解开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It'll do for mine. I know which bit to pull.
beats.chinese: 我自己用成。我知道往哪头拽。

causality.presenceReason: 来入口和帮他发舞会消息的人碰头
causality.placeAttitude: 爱看出入的人平常穿什么，今天一眼看出并非全都会换舞鞋
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友进去取东西，他在街上等
causality.currentGoal: 改掉邀请上吓退不跳舞人的一句
causality.currentState: 朋友念原文说像上课，他有点不痛快
causality.contactTrigger: 他把邀请卡折出折痕，让路时问玩家这张会不会劝退人
causality.characterContinuity: 有心请人跳舞，拒绝不追劝，不解释或排遣自己的坏情绪
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 调整邀请给观看的人。ab 允许穿自己的鞋。ba 自己收起卡。bb 当场留下失望，也留给客人拒绝权
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程 Church Street 红砖入口外侧，并未进入楼内或舞厅
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天讲搓绳的小习惯

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kit stands outside the red brick entrance with a scrap of paper flat against his wrist. He moves it in as you come through.
beats.chinese: 基特站在红砖入口外，手腕上摊着张小纸。你经过，他往身前收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Come through. I'm taking up a doorway while working out how to clear somebody else's.
beats.chinese: 你过。我自己堵着一个门口，正琢磨怎么把别人那道门口腾出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shows a row of little squares separated by a narrow pencil line.
beats.chinese: 他转给你看一排小方块，中间隔了条细铅笔线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chairs. They want six more at the open mic. The people with the six chairs aren't coming till the show starts.
beats.chinese: 是椅子。开放麦还想加六把。有那六把椅子的人，开演了才到。

choices.english: Ask where the extra chairs are meant to fit.
choices.chinese: 问多出来的椅子打算放哪儿。

choices.english: Ask who said he'd set up the extra seats.
choices.chinese: 问谁答应放这几把椅子了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He points at a gap in the pencil drawing. It is barely wider than a square.
beats.chinese: 他指着铅笔图里一个空当，勉强比一只方格宽。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not there. That's where the door opens. I've got the number we agreed on. That number fits.
beats.chinese: 不能放那儿。门得往那儿开。原先商量好的把数我都备了，摆得下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws a dry fingernail along the line without making a mark.
beats.chinese: 他用指甲沿那道线划了划，没在纸上留下印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could ask them not to bring the six. I've got a dance class after I set up. Can't do six and a class.
beats.chinese: 可以叫他们不用带那六把了。我摆好之后还要去上舞蹈课。两样一起，来不及。

choices.english: Suggest keeping the floor plan as agreed.
choices.chinese: 建议就按说好的布局布置。

choices.english: Ask if he can stop setting up in time for class.
choices.chinese: 问他能不能到点收手去上课。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He flips the list over to the side with his name on it.
beats.chinese: 他把单子翻到签着自己名字那面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said I'd put out what's in the room. Nothing on there about staying to wait for a car full of chairs.
beats.chinese: 我说帮忙把屋里有的摆上。可没写要留下等一车椅子开来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the message from the organiser and reads the line below the one he's answered.
beats.chinese: 他打开主持人发来的消息，读了自己回过的那句下面还有什么。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look at that. It says only if you can. I've made my own problem again.
beats.chinese: 你看，写着能帮才帮。又是我自己给自己找事了。

choices.english: Suggest doing the setup that was actually promised.
choices.chinese: 建议只做说好要做的布置。

choices.english: Suggest replying that he'll leave on time.
choices.chinese: 建议回一句，他得准点走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He crosses out six small squares, one at a time.
beats.chinese: 他一个个划掉了六个小方块。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Back to the old plan. The door can open. That'll be nice for the audience.
beats.chinese: 还是照原来的。门能开了。这对观众多好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the list small and brings up the organiser's number.
beats.chinese: 他把单子折小，点出主持人的号码。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll send the photo. Less talking. More door.
beats.chinese: 我把图发过去。少说两句，多留点门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the time and tucks the drawing against his phone.
beats.chinese: 他看眼时间，把图纸压在手机边上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can. A couple of weeks back I learnt a turn. Took me the whole lesson to work out what to do with the second foot.
beats.chinese: 能。前两个礼拜我学个转身，整节课都没弄懂第二只脚怎么放。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the folded drawing away and moves out of the doorway's shadow.
beats.chinese: 他收了图，从入口的影子里往外走出一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to have another go with both feet this time.
beats.chinese: 这回我想两只脚都带上，再试一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws a little tick next to the first line and leaves the rest blank.
beats.chinese: 他在头一行旁边勾了一下，下面的都空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll do that. They know where I leave the list when I'm done.
beats.chinese: 就做这条。他们知道我做完，把单子搁哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Someone raises a hand from inside the entrance. Kit puts the list in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 门里有人举手。基特把单子放进兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the person I came for. Good. I'll be out with time for a sandwich.
beats.chinese: 就等这人。好，这下还能留点时间吃个三明治。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a line, counts out the remaining minutes on the clock and sends it.
beats.chinese: 他打了句话，看了看还剩几分钟，发了出去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can be there till six. It's not a hard thing to say once I've stopped typing sorry first.
beats.chinese: 我能待到六点。前面不忙着先写对不起，倒也不难说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the chat and puts the phone in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他关掉聊天，把手机装回兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Six o'clock belongs to whoever has the other six chairs.
beats.chinese: 成。六点以后，谁有那六把椅子归谁管。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another evening on Church Street, Kit lifts his chin when he spots you. He's got a closed notebook tucked into his jacket.
beats.chinese: 换一天傍晚，基特在教堂街看到你，抬了抬下巴。外套里夹着一本合上的本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Alright. We finished on time today. One bloke heard the bell and stopped right in the middle of a sentence.
beats.chinese: 你好。今天准点收工。有人一听铃响，一句话说到中间真就停了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps the notebook with two fingers but doesn't take it out.
beats.chinese: 他用两根手指轻敲了敲本子，没往出拿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Best laugh of the night was whatever he didn't say.
beats.chinese: 今晚最好笑的倒是他没说那半句。

causality.presenceReason: 取自己早就答应帮主持人拿的表夹，待柜员回之后进楼
causality.placeAttitude: 平常入口来回走多了，今天没精神顺便看别处
causality.stayingConstraint: 演出能按承诺布置，额外活未答应
causality.currentGoal: 把临时加来的折椅安置请求退回当事人
causality.currentState: 愿意守原承诺，气自己又差点加码
causality.contactTrigger: 他抱着清单差点堵门，往外让时接了一句提问
causality.characterContinuity: 做已经答应的事，公事不装好心，爱好有自己的慢节奏
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 找到不加任务的排法。ab 留空自己去试脚步。ba 当晚只做布置。bb 拒绝留下，守自己时间
causality.spatialContinuity: 仍在外立面，椅子在别处并未搬来
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天提到演出如期结束，没预设玩家参加

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A folded sheet shows two lines of tiny holes when Rowan holds it up outside the Afflecks entrance.
beats.chinese: 在 Afflecks 门外，罗文举起一张折纸，透着光能看见两排细孔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you look at this edge? One set of holes goes round the corner, the other's straight. I thought I knew which came first.
beats.chinese: 能帮忙看一下这个边吗？一排孔拐了个弯，一排是直的。我刚以为我知道哪排在前。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lower the sheet and move it away from the people coming through the entrance.
beats.chinese: 罗文放低纸，从刚出门的几个人身边挪开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Old dress pattern. The last person might have needed the arm to move. Or just missed the line.
beats.chinese: 是件旧裙子的纸样。后来用它的人也许想让胳膊好动些。也说不定就是缝偏了。

choices.english: Ask what the curve would change for the person wearing it.
choices.chinese: 问了那道弯，穿的人会有什么不一样。

choices.english: Ask whether the holes alone can tell which came first.
choices.chinese: 问光看针孔能不能分出先后。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan runs one finger around the curve without touching the edge of the sheet.
beats.chinese: 罗文顺着那道弯比画了一趟，手指没碰纸边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A little room under the arm. Try getting a stage costume off somebody who's gone clammy. You learn to leave room.
beats.chinese: 腋下宽一点。试试给浑身发黏的人脱演出服就知道了，该留的地方不能省。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the sheet to show the other edge with the same curve marked there.
beats.chinese: 纸转了面，另一头也标着一样的弧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's on both sides. That makes an accident less likely. I still have no idea whose idea it was.
beats.chinese: 两边都有，那就不太像弄错了。可我还是不知道谁想到的。

choices.english: Keep both lines in the notes.
choices.chinese: 建议把两条痕迹都留在记录里。

choices.english: Ask the person who brought the pattern if they know.
choices.chinese: 建议见到拿纸样来的人再问问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the page with the holes facing the brick. There is no date on the back.
beats.chinese: 罗文翻转纸页，让满是孔的那面朝着砖墙。背面没写日期。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I was about to write that down as though it did. I do like a job to be done.
beats.chinese: 分不出。我刚才差点当成确定了，就往下记。我有活儿就老想赶快做完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They hold the pattern level again, after letting a group go past.
beats.chinese: 一群人走过以后，罗文又把纸样拿平了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could say I don't know and let the new owner have a look.
beats.chinese: 我也可以就说我不知道，让现在拿着它的人瞧瞧。

choices.english: Leave the order undetermined.
choices.chinese: 两排的先后暂且不确定。

choices.english: Say you have your own guess, but it can't settle it.
choices.chinese: 说你也有个猜法，但不能当作定论。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan writes a short note at the top of a separate sheet.
beats.chinese: 罗文在另一张纸顶上写了条简注。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Both lines are staying. Somebody worked it out on a real arm. I'd like to keep whatever they left of that.
beats.chinese: 两排都留着。人家当初比着真人的胳膊改过。我想把留下的那点都收好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the note into the pattern without pressing on the old holes.
beats.chinese: 罗文把小纸条夹到纸样里面，没压在针孔上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I've put down what I saw, for once.
beats.chinese: 行。这回倒真只写了我看见的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They point a phone at the pattern while holding it low against the side of their coat.
beats.chinese: 罗文把纸样放低贴着外套，举手机对准它。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take the bit with both lines. If she's seen it used, she can tell me what the holes can't.
beats.chinese: 我只拍两排都在的那部分。她要见人用过，能说的肯定比针眼多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The photo remains open in one hand. Rowan turns to look towards the entrance again.
beats.chinese: 照片还开在手机上，罗文转过去又看入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask her before I tell her what I think.
beats.chinese: 我先问，然后再说自己怎么想。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan puts a small dash of pencil in the box where a date would go.
beats.chinese: 罗文在原本写日期的小格里轻点了一下铅笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Unknown. Fine. It's still going into the folder.
beats.chinese: 不知道先后。行，它照样可以进档案夹。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They close the fold and straighten the corner that had curled up.
beats.chinese: 罗文把纸折拢，再捋直刚翘起的一角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's as much as I've got.
beats.chinese: 我能说的就这些了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The fold opens again while Rowan looks at the line from where you stand.
beats.chinese: 罗文摊开折页，从你站的位置看那道线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can see why you'd think that. I liked when I thought I'd got the answer without ever asking.
beats.chinese: 倒也看得出你为什么那样猜。我刚才还挺享受呢，什么都不用问，居然已经知道了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They move the pencil to their other hand without writing.
beats.chinese: 罗文换了只手拿笔，还是没写字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wouldn't put either of our names beside it until we've got a reason.
beats.chinese: 没找到依据以前，我不会把咱俩的名字往上写。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week, Rowan sees you outside Afflecks and wipes white hairs off a black paper label.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，罗文在 Afflecks 门外碰到你，正在掸一张黑色纸标签上的白毛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. This was ironed flat before the cat got it. The cat isn't mine. These hairs apparently are.
beats.chinese: 你好。猫上去之前，我还熨得平平整整。猫又不是我的。这些毛倒好像成了我的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pick the last hair up by its end, then find another underneath it.
beats.chinese: 罗文捏住尾巴提起最后一根，底下又冒出一根。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll make another one. While it's awake, if possible.
beats.chinese: 再做张新的吧。最好趁猫还醒着。

causality.presenceReason: 出来等去看旧服装纸样的熟人，自带废料试一次修法
causality.placeAttitude: 外头红砖光线让旧缝好辨
causality.stayingConstraint: 约主在楼附近，见面前不照其他人的物品
causality.currentGoal: 证实老纸样是不是后来被改过
causality.currentState: 讨厌人未看全就说答错，也会承认自己看岔
causality.contactTrigger: 借室外光把手稿抬平，请在近旁的玩家看孔位置
causality.characterContinuity: 依据看得见的东西，不冒充别人专业，不把旧物全说成不能用
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 保留两套痕迹。ab 留图请原主判断。ba 知道不知道就结束。bb 不以陌生人同意为准
causality.spatialContinuity: 从店门口移到红砖外墙一边，未入楼，图纸自带
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天单讲标签上的猫毛

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Colette stops just outside the Afflecks doorway, takes one earbud out and looks at you.
beats.chinese: 科莱特在 Afflecks 门口外站住，摘下一只耳机看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Were you talking to me? I had the bit about the umbrella in one ear and I couldn't hear the other.
beats.chinese: 刚是在跟我说话吗？一边耳朵里在讲雨伞，我另一边什么也听不见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves away from the doorway and stops the podcast with a tap.
beats.chinese: 她离开门口，点一下停了播客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He went back in for it on the driest day of the year. I know that's funny to somebody. I'm still waiting to be that somebody.
beats.chinese: 一年里最干的一天，他还特意回去取伞。肯定有人觉得好笑。我还没等到自己也觉得。

choices.english: Ask her to tell it up to the umbrella.
choices.chinese: 请她讲到提雨伞那一段。

choices.english: Ask if she wants to hear the rest in peace.
choices.chinese: 问她要不要安静听完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the earbud into the crook of one knuckle and looks down at a mark on the paving.
beats.chinese: 她把耳机卡在一个手指弯里，低头盯着地上一道印子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's not afraid of rain. He's borrowed the umbrella so his neighbour won't spot him leaving his own house. Hang on. I'm not finished.
beats.chinese: 他不是怕下雨。他跟人借把伞，是怕邻居瞧见他从自己家出去。等等，我没讲完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps one finger raised for the next few seconds.
beats.chinese: 接下来几秒，她一直竖着一根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now why's he bothered who sees him leave? That's the bit that makes it work or doesn't.
beats.chinese: 可他干吗怕让人看见自己出门？好不好笑，这才是要紧的地方。

choices.english: Wait for her to finish the whole thought.
choices.chinese: 等她把这层意思讲完。

choices.english: Ask about only the part she's sure she heard.
choices.chinese: 只问她听懂了的那一段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She runs the cord of her jacket hood through her fingers, then lets it drop.
beats.chinese: 她伸手把外套的帽绳捋过指间，又任它垂下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I listen to these to laugh. I could do without the bit where I'm checking if I'm late.
beats.chinese: 我听这个就是图乐。大可不必一边笑一边寻思自己是不是又慢了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks along Church Street. The earbud stays in her hand.
beats.chinese: 她沿教堂街望过去，耳机还在她手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The person I'm meeting's heard it. She'll wait while I catch up, or I'll find it later myself.
beats.chinese: 我等的人听过。可以让她等我琢磨明白，也可以慢慢自己听出来。

choices.english: Let her finish listening on her own.
choices.chinese: 让她自己把剩下的听完。

choices.english: Suggest saving the joke for when her friend arrives.
choices.chinese: 建议等朋友到了再接着说这个笑话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Colette leans back a few inches, then suddenly opens her mouth and laughs.
beats.chinese: 科莱特仰了仰身子，突然张嘴笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. He borrowed it off the neighbour. She's the one person who'll know it's him. That's why he had to close it before he left.
beats.chinese: 噢。伞就是跟那个邻居借的。全世界就她一眼能认出是他。难怪出门前得把伞收了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the earbud loosely instead of putting it back in.
beats.chinese: 她把耳机松松捏着，没有往耳朵里戴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Better when nobody finishes it for me. I heard it that time.
beats.chinese: 没人替我说完就挺好。这回我听出来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the clip paused and listens to the footsteps for a second.
beats.chinese: 她让播客停着，听了一会儿路人的脚步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He took it out folded. That's the part I heard. Maybe it's a funny man going for a walk with a funny object.
beats.chinese: 他拿出去的时候，伞是合着的。这一句我听着了。也可能就是个可笑的人拿了件可笑的东西，出来走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the loose earbud into its case.
beats.chinese: 她把手里这只耳机装回盒里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it. If it's still funny when I get home, I can laugh then.
beats.chinese: 先放放。到家了还觉得好笑，我再笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits until you're clear of the doorway and puts the earbud back in, then takes it halfway out again.
beats.chinese: 她等你走出门口这段，把耳机戴回去，又往外摘了一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ta. I'm going to hear what he says next. I don't need to see your face while I do it.
beats.chinese: 谢了，我接着听他往下说。我听的时候就不用看你什么表情了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She finds the marker on the screen and lets the clip play.
beats.chinese: 她找到屏幕上的进度，把片段接着放了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There he is. He hasn't moved an inch while I've been talking.
beats.chinese: 就这儿。咱俩说了半天，他一步都没走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She switches the screen off and puts both earbuds in the case this time.
beats.chinese: 她把屏幕关了。这回两只耳机都收进了盒子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask her which bit she laughed at. She might tell me it was a completely different man.
beats.chinese: 我问她笑的是哪句。没准她笑的根本就不是这人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sees somebody approaching in the shop's direction and steps to one side.
beats.chinese: 见有人朝店面方向来，她往边上迈了步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is. Don't tell me. I've got a question first.
beats.chinese: 人来了。先别讲啊，我有个问题先问你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day outside Afflecks, Colette spots you while turning a little wooden figure between her fingers.
beats.chinese: 改天在 Afflecks 门外，科莱特手指间转着个小木人，转着转着看见了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I can see where the mouth ought to go. Every time I cut one it looks as though it's apologising.
beats.chinese: 你好。嘴该在哪儿我看得出来。我只要一刻，就刻得好像它在给人赔不是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the plain spot back towards herself and runs a nail over it.
beats.chinese: 她把空着的那处转回自己这边，用指甲刮过一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm giving it ears first. Least it can do is listen.
beats.chinese: 先给它装俩耳朵吧。没嘴起码也听得见。

causality.presenceReason: 来门口等一起淘工具的朋友，听完上午笑话还没回过味
causality.placeAttitude: 外头人来人往，真想说完就先退到边上
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友快来，可以先停播
causality.currentGoal: 问一句中间漏掉的意义，免得装懂
causality.currentState: 被打断会烦，懂了才肯笑
causality.contactTrigger: 耳机只剩一只还戴着，听到经过的玩家以为自己说话，她先摘下确认
causality.characterContinuity: 不为合群假笑，有问会等，没听清允许他人走
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 等她原话说完再反应。ab 分开只讲理解了的部分。ba 让她一个人听。bb 想通后把笑留到熟人来
causality.spatialContinuity: 活动发生在临街外面，不虚构楼内店铺或播音
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 今天说自己刻的木头人

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: By the warehouse wall, Priya takes a bright point of fabric out of a bag, then pulls it back as wind comes along the canal.
beats.chinese: 仓库墙边，普丽娅从袋子里拽出一角鲜布。运河上起了风，她又把它往回拉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Did you ask how much? Sorry. I hear that before anybody's even said it now.
beats.chinese: 刚是你问多少钱吗？不好意思。现在人家还没问，我自己倒先听见这句了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She eases out a second corner, orange against purple.
beats.chinese: 她又拽出另一角，橙色挨着紫色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's a kite for me. I'm taking it to show my mum. She used to ask why I'd never make one with the two sides the same.
beats.chinese: 我自己放的风筝。带去给我妈瞧瞧。她以前老问，我怎么就做不出两边长一样的。

choices.english: Ask which side she wanted to look odd.
choices.chinese: 问哪一边是她特意做歪的。

choices.english: Tell her you weren't asking to buy it.
choices.chinese: 跟她说你没想买。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya presses the fabric in against the bag so she can show the short side without unfolding it.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅把布压在袋子上，只给你看短的一边，没全摊开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one. I took a strip out and left the long side alone. Imagine doing that to an order from work.
beats.chinese: 这边，裁掉一道，长边没动。换成别人跟我订的，我敢这么干？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the bare edge of the towpath and takes a step closer to the wall.
beats.chinese: 她看了眼没护栏的水边，往墙这侧又靠了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm keeping it that shape. I've got a bit more absurd cloth at home if I ever do another.
beats.chinese: 就留成这个形状。我家还有点更离谱的布，没准哪天再做一只。

choices.english: Ask whether she's tried flying it yet.
choices.chinese: 问她放过没有。

choices.english: Ask what colour the leftover cloth is.
choices.chinese: 问剩的布是什么颜色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops pushing the fabric back in. Her other hand lies flat over the mouth of the bag.
beats.chinese: 她没再往里塞布。另一只手平盖在袋口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, I got ahead of myself. I do like people looking. I just don't want to spend Sunday making a second one for them.
beats.chinese: 也是，我抢话了。有人看我还挺乐的。就是不想星期天再给人家做一只。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks towards the ironwork up on the railway bridge, then back down at the path.
beats.chinese: 她抬头望了眼铁路桥上头的铁栏，又看回脚下的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's catching the wind even here. This is as much as I can open it.
beats.chinese: 贴着墙都能兜住风。再往开摊不成了。

choices.english: Let her pack it safely and carry on.
choices.chinese: 让她收好，接着走。

choices.english: Ask for a quick look from beside the wall.
choices.chinese: 问能不能贴着墙看这么一眼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She feels for a knot through the fabric, then leaves the kite gathered in.
beats.chinese: 她隔着布摸索了一下线结，风筝还是收在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Put it up once and it went sideways over my head. I'm going to leave the knot where it is and see if it does it twice.
beats.chinese: 放过一回，从我头顶横着飞过去了。线结先不改，我想看它下回还干不干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A breeze lifts a purple edge. She catches it without pulling the rest out.
beats.chinese: 风撩起紫布的一角。她拿手按住，没拖出剩下的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here I'll keep it in the bag. I want my Sunday back, not a swim.
beats.chinese: 在这儿还是待袋子里吧。我就想过个自己的星期天，可没想下水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens a pocket and takes out a swatch streaked with yellow.
beats.chinese: 她翻开一侧口袋，抽出块带黄条纹的小布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the one. It was sold as lemon. I'd throw that lemon away if I saw it on the counter.
beats.chinese: 就这块。卖的时候说是柠檬黄。我家台面上要有这么个柠檬，我准给扔了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the scrap next to the purple edge, looks once and takes it away.
beats.chinese: 她把布样贴着紫边比了一下，一眼就拿开了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Awful together. I'll probably use both.
beats.chinese: 搁一块儿难看死了。我八成就用这两块。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns into the wall to push the kite down into the bag.
beats.chinese: 她转向墙，把风筝往袋里按。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. It'll keep till I get there. Mum's got both hands free and she's used to saying that's ugly.
beats.chinese: 好了，等到了再拿出来。我妈两手都有空，看见什么难看她也从来不憋着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She adjusts the bag against her hip and takes the dry line close to the bricks.
beats.chinese: 她把袋子往胯边挪了挪，沿着贴砖墙的那条干路走了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll see if she says it before or after she puts the kettle on.
beats.chinese: 看看她是先说丑，还是先给我烧壶水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the orange corner towards you but pins the rest under her elbow.
beats.chinese: 她把橙色那一角转给你看，剩下的还夹在胳膊底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I pinched that colour off a bin bag. I like it best once it stops looking like one.
beats.chinese: 喏。颜色是抄垃圾袋的。等看着不像垃圾袋了，我最喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws it back at the next gust and laughs briefly.
beats.chinese: 又一阵风，她把布扯回来，短短笑了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tea, Mum and a kite. That's my lot today.
beats.chinese: 今天就喝茶、看我妈，再给她瞧这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day by the warehouse wall, Priya sees you. She smooths a piece of nylon the shape of a broad comma.
beats.chinese: 改天在仓库墙边，普丽娅看见了你，手里正摊平一块胖逗号形的尼龙布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look. It was going to be a straight piece. I cut the wrong line and I like this one better.
beats.chinese: 你看，本来要裁直的。剪错了一道，这个我倒更喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the long tip in, then lets it out again.
beats.chinese: 她把最长的角折进去，又放出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I won't try to fly it yet. I've not worked out which end is the bottom.
beats.chinese: 还不会拿去飞。我还没想明白哪一头算底。

causality.presenceReason: 走运河这段路去见妈妈，带自制的风筝给她看
causality.placeAttitude: 喜爱旧墙遮点风，能打开看一眼
causality.stayingConstraint: 筝不能往没栏杆的水边摆，不在这儿放
causality.currentGoal: 给妈妈再看一次自己的丑配色
causality.currentState: 误听见别人问价格，当场有点不高兴
causality.contactTrigger: 往仓库墙一侧收起风筝时，先问玩家是不是刚才说买
causality.characterContinuity: 本职写价牌，私下不接风筝订单，不把拒卖说成客气
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 自己留作要飞的东西。ab 给对方比较未用颜色。ba 收起来继续走。bb 允许看在手里，不许问价
causality.spatialContinuity: 仓库墙侧停留，从地面看铁路桥铁栏

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man holds a plan flat against the warehouse wall. The pencil lines show two steps and a rail.
beats.chinese: 一个男人把图纸按在仓库墙上。铅笔线画着两级台阶和一条扶手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can you tell which way you're meant to go on this? Don't mind the arrow. That's mine and apparently I draw it backwards.
beats.chinese: 你能看出来从哪边走吗？箭头先甭看。我自己画的，好像还画反了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the paper off the brick and turns it around.
beats.chinese: 他把纸从砖墙上揭下来，转了个向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My sister asked for a handrail. I've drawn everything apart from my sister.
beats.chinese: 我妹想装条扶手。图里什么都有，就差我妹这个人。

choices.english: Look for where someone would take the first step.
choices.chinese: 看看人会把第一步踩在哪儿。

choices.english: Ask when his sister will have a look at it.
choices.chinese: 问他妹什么时候能来看这张图。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the lower edge steady and taps the first step with his free thumb.
beats.chinese: 他拿稳图纸下边，用空出来的拇指点着第一级。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll be it, if she's empty handed. She's usually got the washing under the other arm.
beats.chinese: 没拿东西的话就是这儿。她平常另一边胳膊还夹着要晾的衣服。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves his thumb to the other side of the pencil rail.
beats.chinese: 他把拇指挪到铅笔画的扶手另一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can mark the step. I could also ask her what hand she puts out first.
beats.chinese: 可以把台阶记下来。也可以问她，先伸的是哪只手。

choices.english: Mark the first foot position for him to ask about.
choices.chinese: 指出图上的落脚处，让他回头问妹妹。

choices.english: Ask him to watch which arm she carries things in.
choices.chinese: 建议先看她习惯把东西夹在哪边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the paper once, keeping the pencilled rail visible.
beats.chinese: 他把纸折了一回，铅笔画的扶手还露着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: In a minute. I bought the brackets myself. I'll fit them myself. She gets to say where she wants her hand, on her own step.
beats.chinese: 一会儿就来。托架我买了，我也会装。可台阶是她家的，手想扶到哪儿，由她说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He touches the folded corner with the blunt end of his pencil.
beats.chinese: 他用铅笔钝的一头点点折角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She said she'd show me. The sheet can wait till then.
beats.chinese: 她说会比给我看。纸搁到那时候也行。

choices.english: Leave the plan alone until his sister's seen it.
choices.chinese: 等他妹看过，再动图纸。

choices.english: Give him time to meet her and put the drawing away.
choices.chinese: 让他收好图，留点时间自己等人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws a small oval where you pointed and does not trace over it.
beats.chinese: 他在你指的地方画个小椭圆，只画一圈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's where you put your foot. I'll leave hers blank till I see.
beats.chinese: 这儿是你会踩的地方。她那一下，我没看见以前先空着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds up the two steps against the brick, eyes level with the handrail on the page.
beats.chinese: 他把画着台阶的一段举到砖墙前，眼睛和纸上扶手同高。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Now I know what I don't know.
beats.chinese: 行。现在知道还漏什么了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws a small arrow by the handrail line and puts a question mark at the end.
beats.chinese: 他在扶手旁边画个小箭头，箭尾加个问号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll see what arm she uses with the washing. I asked her to show me once and she did it with nothing in her hands.
beats.chinese: 等她抱着衣服我再看是哪只手。有一回叫她比给我看，她两手都是空的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the pencil into his pocket instead of darkening the line.
beats.chinese: 他把铅笔放回兜，没有把刚才那道描实。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Haven't got to drill anything before then. That'll be a first.
beats.chinese: 那之前还不用打孔。头一回知道我也忍得住。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the drawing under his forearm and keeps hold of the pencil.
beats.chinese: 他把图纸夹进臂弯，铅笔还抓在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. If somebody draws it for me now, I'll spend tomorrow rubbing it out. We can both skip that.
beats.chinese: 好。谁现在替我改，明天我一整天就拿来擦了。咱省了这出吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns on the spot at the brick side, making room for a walker coming down the path.
beats.chinese: 他在靠墙这边转了个身，给迎面过来的行人留条路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm just waiting for Denise.
beats.chinese: 我就在这儿等丹妮丝。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the plan down to the size of his palm and tucks it away alongside the pencil.
beats.chinese: 他把图叠到手掌那么大，连铅笔一块塞好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. She might want to tell me how her morning went first.
beats.chinese: 也是。她没准想先说今天一上午都遇上什么了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks ahead along the wall rather than down at his hands.
beats.chinese: 他先沿那堵墙往前看，没再低头瞧手里的东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is, I think. Hello.
beats.chinese: 好像过来了。哎，这儿呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another afternoon, Terence sees you on the towpath with a clean empty jar in his hand.
beats.chinese: 又一天下午，特伦斯在运河边看见你，手里拿了只洗干净的空瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. My pickled beans didn't go soft. Six weeks and they still make a noise like twigs.
beats.chinese: 你好。腌豆角还是没软。六礼拜了，咬着还跟树枝一个响。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He twists the lid back on the empty glass.
beats.chinese: 他把盖子拧回空玻璃瓶上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sister ate the shallots. I should just give her the jar and let her think I made more of those.
beats.chinese: 我妹把腌葱头吃完了。下回干脆给她个瓶，让她以为我又腌了葱头。

causality.presenceReason: 和妹妹约在运河边碰面，自己先看草图等人
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢沿墙走，脑子里能过一遍自家活
causality.stayingConstraint: 妹妹亲自确认才能正式定，今天手上没工具工序
causality.currentGoal: 确定自家门槛扶手使用时的人站在哪
causality.currentState: 方案变四次，这回打算听人怎么踩，没急着动自己工具
causality.contactTrigger: 他倚仓库墙抹平图，从前面步道有人经过便问纸上能否看懂哪级
causality.characterContinuity: 问具体问题，材料跟钱由自己定，不要别人替完工
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 标脚落点。ab 记另一种握法。ba 不收别人替他改好的图。bb 暂不讨论东西，先等人
causality.spatialContinuity: 沿仓库墙，铁路桥仅见外观，没用它代作楼梯
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 当天拿的腌豆和上次图无须关联

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie stands close to the old brick with a paper bag crumpled round a few stems. A message makes them stop halfway down the path.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基拿着个揉皱的纸袋，几枝绿茎拢在里头，沿旧砖墙走到一半，被手机上的消息留住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on. I said I'd think about it. When did that turn into yes?
beats.chinese: 等等。我说我想想。怎么就成我答应了？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They move the bag clear of the walking line and look up at you.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基把袋子挪开，没占行人道，抬头瞧你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm bringing my neighbour a cutting. Now she thinks I'm putting a light up as well.
beats.chinese: 我给邻居带枝扦插用的。现在人家当我还会给她安盏灯。

choices.english: Ask what they meant to offer.
choices.chinese: 问弗兰基本来答应的是什么。

choices.english: Ask if the neighbour has already made arrangements.
choices.chinese: 问邻居是不是已经拿这话当真，另有安排了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie folds the paper in against the stems so it stops making a noise in the breeze.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基把纸沿着茎压进去，风吹起来没那么响了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This. It's got two new leaves. I know she'll keep it alive.
beats.chinese: 就这个。出了两片新叶。给她养我放心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They glance down at the time and hold the bag steady with a wrist.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基低头看时间，拿手腕稳稳抵住袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a little time Sunday. Today I haven't, no matter how fast I could put the light up.
beats.chinese: 周日我有点空。今天没有。给灯装多快都不行。

choices.english: Suggest bringing the cutting and leaving the light alone.
choices.chinese: 建议只送枝条，别动灯。

choices.english: Ask whether Sunday is a time they'd actually want to offer.
choices.chinese: 问周日这点时间，他们是不是真乐意给。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone lights again. Frankie reads, then lets the screen go dark.
beats.chinese: 手机又亮了。弗兰基读完，任屏幕自己暗下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's moved the table. That's all. I could ask her to move it back without saying a word about how the light works.
beats.chinese: 她把桌挪走了。就这一件。我可以请她挪回去，用不着跟她讲那灯怎么装。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They hold the bag nearer the wall as someone passes.
beats.chinese: 有人经过，弗兰基把袋子往墙边拿了拿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: For a second I thought moving a table was a contract.
beats.chinese: 我刚有一秒还真觉得，人家一挪桌，我这单就签了。

choices.english: Let them do nothing until they've had time to think.
choices.chinese: 让弗兰基想好了再回。

choices.english: Suggest correcting the misunderstanding now.
choices.chinese: 建议现在就把误会解开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie types one line while the paper bag rests against their coat.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基让袋子倚在外套上，打了一行字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just the plant today. Sent it. Soon as she says no problem, I'll stop feeling as if there's a ladder waiting for me.
beats.chinese: 今天只送花。发了。她一说没事，我就不用老觉得那儿还有把梯子等我爬。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few moments pass. Frankie lifts the paper bag to check the tips of the stems.
beats.chinese: 过了一会儿，弗兰基提起纸袋，又检查了一下枝条尖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See? That's plenty for a visit.
beats.chinese: 看吧，串个门带这点过去就挺够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie goes to type, then waits with the phone open and the paper held still.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基刚要打字，又等了一下。手机没关，拿纸也没动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sunday after lunch. Half an hour. I'd like her to ask me for the next bit before she pulls the room apart.
beats.chinese: 周日午饭后，半小时。别的得让她先来问我，再把屋子拆腾一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They finish the message and move their bag to the other arm.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基写完消息，把袋子换到另一只胳膊上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I mean that yes. I'll be there.
beats.chinese: 这句答应是我真想答应。那会儿我会去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie puts the phone away and checks that none of the leaves was folded under the paper.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基收了手机，先看看有没有哪片叶子压进纸底下了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it till I've walked a bit. I don't need to fill the gap with something I'll take back tomorrow.
beats.chinese: 走一段再说。我不用因为没回这么一会儿，就赶紧答应个明天还得反悔的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They start down the wall side and wait for a narrow patch to clear.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基沿墙这侧走开，到一段窄处等人过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go on. I'm happy here a second.
beats.chinese: 你先过。我在这儿站一下挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie opens the chat, types slowly and puts the phone back in a pocket.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基点进聊天，慢慢打完字，又把手机放回口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wasn't saying yes, I wrote. No need to move anything for me. She's heard worse than that from me.
beats.chinese: 我写，我刚不是答应，不用为了我挪东西。比这难听的话她都听我说过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lean away from the brick and look in the direction they were walking.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基离开砖墙，往刚才要走的方向看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll knock with the plant. We can just have a chat about the plant.
beats.chinese: 我拿着花去敲门。咱俩就说说花也行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later walk, Frankie recognizes you near the brick wall. They have a little cutting in an upturned palm.
beats.chinese: 后来有一回散步，弗兰基在砖墙边认出了你，摊着一只手，掌上托了根带叶的嫩枝。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Look what came out by itself. I didn't even move it into the light this time.
beats.chinese: 嗨。看，它自己长出来了。这回我都没搬它去晒光。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn a leaf over with a finger, leaving the pale underside showing.
beats.chinese: 弗兰基用一个手指把叶子翻过来，浅色的反面朝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't tell my big plant. I've been fussing over it for a month and it hasn't done a thing.
beats.chinese: 别告诉我家那盆大的。伺候它一整个月了，还一点动静都没有。

causality.presenceReason: 走运河去给邻居送家里剪下的植物枝，尚未到约定时间
causality.placeAttitude: 傍水但墙边有空间可以停下想一想
causality.stayingConstraint: 手上纸袋不适宜被风往外顶，远离水沿
causality.currentGoal: 在自己答应对方之前先弄清请求内容
causality.currentState: 愿意帮邻居，不想因为没立刻说不就把后半天全搭上
causality.contactTrigger: 一个招呼语被当成答应，朝经过的玩家问听见的是哪几个字
causality.characterContinuity: 会等一等再答，拒绝时说清楚，愿意在能做的范围内帮忙
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 只答应送枝条。ab 给出自己愿意做的具体时段。ba 先不接。bb 直接把误会说清
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程仓库墙侧，桥下方仅观察，不摆工具也不进水边
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢碰到的是今天剪的另外一枝

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A small paper box pops open in Drew's hand as he walks beside the old warehouse. He steps against the wall to close it.
beats.chinese: 德鲁沿旧仓库走，手里的小纸盒啪一下弹开。他让到墙边去合。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look at that. The thing I've made to hold my keys is trying to get rid of them.
beats.chinese: 瞧瞧。我做来装钥匙的，正想把钥匙吐出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He catches the keys in the palm beneath the box and lifts a folded tab.
beats.chinese: 他在盒底下用掌心接住钥匙，掀起一片折进去的纸舌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's done. There's another one in the bag that's for a job. That one's staying in the bag.
beats.chinese: 这个做完了。袋里还有一个是给客户的。那个就让它待袋子里。

choices.english: Ask to try opening the box he uses at home.
choices.chinese: 问能不能试开他自己用的这只盒。

choices.english: Ask what the one in the bag is for.
choices.chinese: 问袋里那只具体是做什么的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shakes the keys out into his hand and offers the empty box well away from the water side.
beats.chinese: 他把钥匙倒到手上，站得离水边远远的，把空盒往前递了递。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go on. Thumb under here. If you get that look my mate got, pass it back and I'll do it.
beats.chinese: 试吧，拇指放这底下。你要像我朋友当时那样下不去手，递回来我来开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the edge steady without pressing the tab himself.
beats.chinese: 他只托稳盒边，没亲手按纸舌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It'll crease. I've had a thumb in there every night for a week.
beats.chinese: 会起折痕。我连着一礼拜，每天晚上都往里伸拇指了。

choices.english: Try the fold the way he showed you.
choices.chinese: 照他示意的位置试开。

choices.english: Ask him to open it while you watch.
choices.chinese: 请他自己开，你在旁边看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the paper box back into his palm and leaves the other bag zipped.
beats.chinese: 他把纸盒收回手心，另一个袋子的拉链没开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A display sample. They've got a meeting tomorrow. I don't mind this one's corners going soft, but theirs need to be square when they see them.
beats.chinese: 展示样品。他们明天要开会。我这只的角磨软了没事，人家那只，看到的时候四个角得方方正正。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the paper box towards himself, squinting at one folded corner.
beats.chinese: 他把纸盒转向自己，眯眼看一处折角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're allowed to leave both alone, you know. I forget sometimes I'm the one who fancies squeezing a box.
beats.chinese: 两只都不碰也行。我有时候脑子一热，忘了就我自己爱捏这些盒子。

choices.english: Let the job sample stay in the bag.
choices.chinese: 客户的样品留在袋里。

choices.english: Let him put the other box away as well.
choices.chinese: 让他连自己的盒也先收了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The tab comes away with a small crackle. Drew puts the keys in once the lid is up.
beats.chinese: 纸舌轻轻一响松开了。盖掀起来，德鲁把钥匙放进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's it. You've got it farther than I did on my first go.
beats.chinese: 就是这么开。你掀得比我第一次还到位。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes it slowly and hands the whole thing back by its base.
beats.chinese: 他慢慢合上，托着盒底重新递过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now try shutting it with the keys in. That's the bit that'll show me why they fell out.
beats.chinese: 再试试装着钥匙合上。就这一下，才看得出它们刚才怎么掉的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses up from below the tab. One corner bends in with a soft sound.
beats.chinese: 他从纸舌下头往上一顶，有个角轻轻响了一下，往里面弯了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. It's softer than yesterday. I'd rather cut that corner back now than start opening it with a knife at home.
beats.chinese: 嗯，比昨天又软了点。我现在宁愿把这个角剪短，也不想回家还得拿刀撬。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the corner over and makes a crease with one thumbnail.
beats.chinese: 他把那个角翻过来，用拇指甲压道痕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's where it'll get cut. You're welcome to try it after I've made it easier.
beats.chinese: 回头就裁到这儿。等我改顺手了，你想试再试。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the zipped bag a fraction and lets it hang flat again.
beats.chinese: 他拎起拉好的袋子一点，又让它平垂下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. They'll open it at the meeting. If there's a flaw, I'd rather it was one I sent.
beats.chinese: 明天开会他们自己会打开。要有哪儿坏着，我希望那是我原样交出去的问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He steps closer to the brick, holding the finished box one last time in the open.
beats.chinese: 他又贴近砖墙一步，最后把自己那只盒敞着拿了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one can have a day off from being a sample.
beats.chinese: 这只就不用非演示给人看了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts his keys in a pocket and slips the box into a different one.
beats.chinese: 他把钥匙放进一个兜，纸盒收进另一个。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair. I stopped wanting to play when someone handed me a clay cup that still had a wet bit.
beats.chinese: 也是。有一回人家递给我个泥杯，底下有一点还湿着，我也一下不敢上手了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks where he is on the path and stands aside until it's clear.
beats.chinese: 他看看脚底站哪儿，往边上站了站，等路空出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll try it on the table at home. At least I can pick keys up there.
beats.chinese: 回家拿桌子试。至少钥匙掉了有地方捡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few days later, Drew recognizes you on the towpath, carrying a cup on a shallow folded tray.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，德鲁在运河边认出了你，浅浅的折纸托里端了杯东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I've tried it three times with a cold cup. Today I'm giving it tea. That'll find a new way out.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我拿冷杯试了三回。今天往里放杯茶，准能给它找个新漏法。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the tray level and puts his free hand under the lowest fold.
beats.chinese: 他把托端平，空着的手垫到最低一道折下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you see me speed up, it's because it's working.
beats.chinese: 我要是突然走快了，那就说明它挺管用的。

causality.presenceReason: 从工作会出来，带一个另一批已做完的纸模顺路走
causality.placeAttitude: 旧砖墙和上方铁栏让他的做法有可比较的地方
causality.stayingConstraint: 样品仍旧得原样拿去客户，在袋中别碰
causality.currentGoal: 让人试一个归家用的纸盒到底能不能用
causality.currentState: 遇到皱眉不急着劝，嫌别人的小心也有点好笑
causality.contactTrigger: 纸制小盒弹开露出折层，靠墙后请玩家看看是否把它当成只能观赏
causality.characterContinuity: 完成的物件能拿来用，样件有边界，没人要按规定夸
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 在许可下自开成功。ab 他先演示并改一个折角。ba 分清样品只看不动。bb 收回未试，接受玩家小心
causality.spatialContinuity: 只在砖墙侧，水边没有护栏所以不靠近
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一次拎纸杯底托，没提旧样品

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the Wolfson Reading Room a man folds his notebook inwards so there's room at the edge of the table.
beats.chinese: 沃尔夫森阅览室里，一个男人把本子往自己这边一折，桌沿腾出了空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. I'm taking up two spaces to write one line.
beats.chinese: 不好意思。我就写一行字，把俩位置都占了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A short crossed out line ends at the very edge of the paper.
beats.chinese: 有一小行划掉的字，一直写到纸边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got room for kettle or pot. The longer one sounds better. Can you see how much paper I'm arguing over?
beats.chinese: 这儿写水壶也行，写锅也行。长的好听些。你瞧，我在跟多大一块纸较劲？

choices.english: Ask where he needs the joke to land.
choices.chinese: 问他笑话最要紧的是哪几个字。

choices.english: Tell him there is room to continue underneath.
choices.chinese: 告诉他下一行还写得下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the point of his pen under the last two words.
beats.chinese: 他把笔尖抵在末尾俩词底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: In the boot. A man gets all the way home before he finds the kettle in there. It doesn't want another line after that.
beats.chinese: 在后备厢。人都到家了，才在那儿找着水壶。说到这儿，就不该再往下添了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He covers the start of the line with his left thumb.
beats.chinese: 他拿左手拇指盖住那行的开头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could lose his street. It isn't the funny bit. I used to live on it, that's all.
beats.chinese: 可以把他住的那条街删掉。又不好笑，也就是我以前住那儿。

choices.english: Take the street out and keep the kettle.
choices.chinese: 删街名，留水壶。

choices.english: Leave the last line unfinished for his friend.
choices.chinese: 留着最后一行，让朋友接。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at the fresh line, then holds the page up towards the overhead light.
beats.chinese: 他瞧瞧下一行，把那页举到顶灯底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could. Used to set menus. Chips going over on their own line made it look like you could have just chips. Mind, they usually did.
beats.chinese: 能啊。我以前给学校排菜单。光让薯条另起一行，看着就像能只要薯条。他们也确实老这么吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings the book back down and holds the pen without uncapping it.
beats.chinese: 他把本子放回来，拿着笔，没开盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got what I meant, anyway. It can sit there till the book gets picked up.
beats.chinese: 反正该写的我自己知道了。就在这儿留着，等有人翻本子吧。

choices.english: Let him keep it the way he wrote it.
choices.chinese: 让他照原来那样留着。

choices.english: Suggest leaving the spare line entirely blank.
choices.chinese: 建议干脆把多的那一行空着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He makes a little mark above the street name, then starts the line again farther down.
beats.chinese: 他在街名上头做了个小记号，换到底下重写那行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fits. Turns out you can have a car without saying where it's parked.
beats.chinese: 写得下。原来写了辆车，也能不交代在哪儿停的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He caps the pen and marks the page with a scrap of newspaper.
beats.chinese: 他扣好笔盖，找片报纸夹在这页当记号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Priya'll ask why it's a kettle. I don't know yet. I can leave her that much.
beats.chinese: 普丽娅准问为什么是水壶。我也不知道。这点就留给她想吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws a short dotted line, then stops halfway across.
beats.chinese: 他画了小半行点，到页面中间停了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If she's in the mood, she'll make it about a duck instead. I can stand that.
beats.chinese: 她有兴致的话，准能给我改成一只鸭子的事。我也能忍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shuts the notebook and pulls it clear of the edge of the table.
beats.chinese: 他把本子一合，从桌沿往里收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I won't tell her what I was trying to do. She'll see what I did.
beats.chinese: 不用告诉她我原想怎么写。写成什么样，她自己瞧得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the pen down beside the crossed out words.
beats.chinese: 他把笔放在划掉的字旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave the whole thing there. Some mornings a man can bring a kettle home without doing it beautifully.
beats.chinese: 就这样吧。有时候一个人把水壶带回家就是带回家，又不必写得多好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns to the next page and goes back to the crossword he'd folded there.
beats.chinese: 他翻到下一页，接着看夹在那儿的填字题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Four letters. Now that's an amount of room.
beats.chinese: 四个字母。这就知道有多少地方能填了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves the pen off the page altogether.
beats.chinese: 他干脆把笔从纸上拿开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Blank's good. I don't want her finishing it just because I've given her dots.
beats.chinese: 空着好。我不想给她画一排点，搞得她非接着写不可。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the book but leaves a finger inside so it opens at that page.
beats.chinese: 他把本子合起来，还留根手指在里头，打开就是这页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She might write eggs there. We do need eggs.
beats.chinese: 她没准就在这儿写鸡蛋。倒也确实该买了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another morning in the reading room, Albert sees you and shifts a slanted slip of paper out of the way.
beats.chinese: 又一天早上，艾伯特在阅览室看见你，把一小张斜边纸片收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Morning. That's my bookmark. I cut it twice and got it crooked twice.
beats.chinese: 早。这是我书签。裁了两回，两回都裁歪了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the slip between two pages. Its crooked edge sticks out.
beats.chinese: 他把纸片夹到两页中间，歪的那条边露在外头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still tells me where I am.
beats.chinese: 该翻哪页，倒还是知道的。

causality.presenceReason: 来阅览室看报，带本子给朋友留半首打油诗
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢安静处能慢慢数完一行的空位
causality.stayingConstraint: 不用等朋友回话，晚点自己回家
causality.currentGoal: 少写两个词，保住笑话
causality.currentState: 写了又划几遍，有点恼自己舍不得一个词
causality.contactTrigger: 把本子移开给玩家让位置，压低声问两个尾词哪个字长
causality.characterContinuity: 按行找空间，不催朋友，不对陌生人发表长篇意见
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 找更短的说法。ab 留半行。ba 自己不改了。bb 允许空着交给朋友续
causality.spatialContinuity: 一直在围中央设施的阅览桌旁低声
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢只有认识与当天出现的纸条

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At a table in the reading room, a woman shuts a photo book on a slip with a film title on it.
beats.chinese: 阅览室一张桌旁，一个女人合上画册，夹住一张写了片名的纸条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pardon. Do you know this film? I told my nephew it was rubbish before I'd ever seen the end.
beats.chinese: 打扰一下，你知道这部吗？我跟我外甥说它烂的时候，连结尾都没看过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws the book in so it won't catch your sleeve at the corner of the table.
beats.chinese: 她把书往里拖，免得从桌角蹭到你袖子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Saw it properly last night. He's about to buy tickets for something else because I told him I hated it.
beats.chinese: 昨晚才从头到尾看了一遍。他听我说不喜欢，正要去买别的票呢。

choices.english: Ask what she made of the ending.
choices.chinese: 问她看完觉得结尾怎么样。

choices.english: Ask if her nephew has bought the tickets yet.
choices.chinese: 问外甥票买了没有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls the slip out with two fingertips to keep the book from opening again.
beats.chinese: 她用两根指尖把纸条抽出来，没让书整个翻开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It didn't tell you where she'd gone. I was cross when it cut to black. Ten minutes later I was still thinking about where she'd get off the bus.
beats.chinese: 没告诉你她去了哪儿。刚黑屏，我还挺火大。过了十分钟，我还在琢磨她会在哪站下车。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps her voice down as a chair moves at the next table.
beats.chinese: 隔桌一张椅子挪了一下，她把声音压低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can tell him I changed my mind. I don't have to tell him which woman on which bus.
beats.chinese: 我得告诉他我改主意了。又不用说哪辆车上哪个女人。

choices.english: Suggest telling him exactly what surprised her without giving away the plot.
choices.chinese: 提议只说没想到会一直惦记结尾，剧情先别漏。

choices.english: Suggest asking him to see the same film with her.
choices.chinese: 提议约他一起看这部。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks her phone below the edge of the table.
beats.chinese: 她在桌沿下面看了眼手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's on the page. Sent me a picture of it like it's a doctor's result.
beats.chinese: 购票页都开好了。他还给我截了屏，跟发个化验结果似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the phone down on her closed book.
beats.chinese: 她把手机搁在合好的书上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Either one's on late too. I'll go out in the morning. I've got fish and a perfectly good telly for after tea.
beats.chinese: 两部都有晚场。我上午愿意出门。吃完饭我家有鱼缸看，还有好端端一台电视。

choices.english: Let her return the book and check the tickets herself.
choices.chinese: 让她先去还书，票自己再看。

choices.english: Suggest telling him she'll come for a morning showing only.
choices.chinese: 建议现在就跟他说，只去上午那场。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She writes a little note to her nephew and checks the screen once before sending.
beats.chinese: 她给外甥写了句话，发之前又检查一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said it got better on the walk home. It might've done even if I hadn't liked it.
beats.chinese: 我说走回家的路上才觉得好看。没准就算不喜欢，我也会想一路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the slip back in while a reply appears on the screen.
beats.chinese: 回复冒出来的时候，她把纸条又夹回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's sent me a picture of a pig flying. I did ask for that.
beats.chinese: 他发了张猪在飞的图。我也是自找的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She texts the title to him straight off the slip.
beats.chinese: 她照纸条把片名发给他。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one, please. I'll sit through the part I used to fast forward. He can elbow me when it comes up.
beats.chinese: 麻烦买这部。我原来快进那一段，这回坐那儿看完。他看到这儿可以拿胳膊肘捅我一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the slip into her bag and holds the book by its spine.
beats.chinese: 她把纸条叠好收进包，拎住画册的脊。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or he can just watch it. I forget he has his own opinions about films.
beats.chinese: 要不他看他的也成。我老忘了，他看电影也有自己的想法。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the phone away and lines up the book with the edge of her arm.
beats.chinese: 她收起手机，把书贴着胳膊抱齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd better get this back while I remember it isn't mine.
beats.chinese: 我得趁还记得不是自己的，赶紧给书还了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She walks around the central part of the room, then turns back briefly.
beats.chinese: 她绕过阅览室中间那一片，又很短地回了个头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't look up the ending if you do see it. I wish I hadn't spent the whole time wanting one.
beats.chinese: 真去看的话，别先查结局。我要早知道，就不会坐那儿一直盼着它给个结局了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She points at the morning showing on the phone, then types it out underneath the picture.
beats.chinese: 她指着手机上的上午场，在截图下面把时间打了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I sent the early one. He can get himself coffee if he wants to complain about it.
beats.chinese: 我给他发早场了。要嫌早，他自己去弄杯咖啡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the slip out of the book and leaves it in her hand.
beats.chinese: 她抽出画册里的纸条，攥在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I won't go at nine at night just to be agreeable. Not even for a very good bus ride.
beats.chinese: 我可不会为了好说话，晚上九点还跑出去。电影里那趟公交再好看也不行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another afternoon, Patricia spots you beside the reading room tables with a little book about aquariums open in her hand.
beats.chinese: 改天下午，帕特里夏在阅览桌附近瞧见你，手上摊开一本不大的鱼缸养护书。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. My fish watched me fall asleep in front of the worst film I've seen all year.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。我那缸鱼看着我对着今年最烂的一部片睡着了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips a finger between two pages as she closes the book.
beats.chinese: 她合上书，留了根手指夹着页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I switched it off when I woke up. They were all at that end of the tank. They can watch their own films next time.
beats.chinese: 醒来我就关了。它们全挤在缸那头。下回让它们自己挑片看吧。

causality.presenceReason: 来阅览室还一本借来看旧照片的书
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢翻图时不必马上表达意见
causality.stayingConstraint: 外甥晚点买周末电影票
causality.currentGoal: 告诉他自己对老电影改了口
causality.currentState: 不同意旧说时有点想笑，也真怕外甥花冤枉钱
causality.contactTrigger: 把书挪开时一张写着影院片名的纸露出来，她问同桌读没读过简介
causality.characterContinuity: 能变心，别用体贴骗住朋友，不把晚间让人预订
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 借小地方解释改变。ab 定看老片。ba 完成交还。bb 要外甥别定晚场
causality.spatialContinuity: 阅览室桌边低声，电影院只在聊天里
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来聊当日鱼缸，无须认得电影

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman in the reading room shifts a printout clear of the seat beside her. She's got a fingernail under one sentence.
beats.chinese: 阅览室里，一个女人把打印出来的文章从旁边座位移走。她指甲还掐着其中一句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just this line. It says dogs never pretend to be asleep. Would you put never in there?
beats.chinese: 就这句，说狗从来不会装睡。换你会写从来吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the sheet steady against the table so you don't have to take it.
beats.chinese: 她把纸按在桌上给你看，不用接到手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm meant to argue against the essay I liked. Maureen's on her way, and I think I've just been handed the whole case.
beats.chinese: 说好了，喜欢哪篇，就得替反面说。莫琳还在路上，这一句倒给我把整场的题送来了。

choices.english: Ask which dog made her doubt the writer.
choices.chinese: 问她想到哪只狗，才觉得作者说得不对。

choices.english: Ask if she liked the piece enough to leave that line alone.
choices.chinese: 问她会不会喜欢到愿意放过这句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She traces a crooked little underline someone else made in pencil.
beats.chinese: 她沿着别人划的一道歪歪扭扭的铅笔线摸了摸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A spaniel at work shuts both eyes before you say bath. One eye comes open when you say biscuit.
beats.chinese: 单位有只西班牙猎犬，你洗澡俩字还没说，它先把俩眼一闭。一说饼干，就睁开一只。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She leaves the page flat and sets her pencil down beside the margin.
beats.chinese: 她让纸平放着，把铅笔搁到页边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Then again, it may be asleep and very quick at waking up. That's what she'll say.
beats.chinese: 再一想，它也可能是真睡了，就是醒得快。莫琳肯定会这么说。

choices.english: Allow for the dog being asleep and alert at the same time.
choices.chinese: 把两种可能都留着，不急着判狗装睡。

choices.english: Ask her to bring the spaniel up when Maureen arrives.
choices.chinese: 请她等莫琳来，把那只狗的事讲给她听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the paper at the page break, hiding the sentence.
beats.chinese: 她沿着分页处把纸折起来，盖住了那句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. The rest is about an old dog taking longer on the stairs. That got me. One silly word didn't spoil it.
beats.chinese: 愿意啊。剩下的都在说一只老狗上楼，要比以前慢些。我看到那儿挺难受的。一个傻词不碍事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the fold down with two fingers and glances at the aisle.
beats.chinese: 她用两根手指压住折痕，朝过道瞧了瞧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could tell her that first. It doesn't get me out of buying tea if I lose the argument.
beats.chinese: 可以先跟她说这个。争输了，茶还是得我买。

choices.english: Let her keep her objection private.
choices.chinese: 让她自己保留这点异议。

choices.english: Suggest telling Maureen what part got to her.
choices.chinese: 建议告诉莫琳，哪段她看着挺难受。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pencils a small question mark beside the sentence without crossing any of it out.
beats.chinese: 她拿铅笔在句子边上写个小问号，一个字也没划。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give the dog both. It won't fill in the form either way.
beats.chinese: 那两种都算上。反正狗也不会亲自来给这表打勾。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves the sheet to the end of the table for her friend to take.
beats.chinese: 她把纸移到桌子那头，好让朋友来拿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a better argument. Same tea at the end of it.
beats.chinese: 这么讲有意思多了。讲完倒还是喝一样的茶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the pencil off the article and writes on a narrow scrap of her own.
beats.chinese: 她把铅笔从文章旁移开，换在自己一小条纸片上写。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Spaniel, both eyes. That's all I need. I know which dog I'm talking about.
beats.chinese: 猎犬，两只眼。就记这几个字。我知道说的是哪只。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the scrap beside the spare chair and nudges it away from the corner with one finger.
beats.chinese: 她把纸片放到空椅子边，用一根手指把它从桌角推回来一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If she comes with a greyhound, I'll have to start from scratch.
beats.chinese: 她要也带个灰狗的例子来，我又得从头说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the folded pages under the cover of a plain notebook.
beats.chinese: 她把折好的纸收进素色本子的封皮底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. She can bring her own quarrel. I'm not obliged to arrive with one.
beats.chinese: 成。她有想争的就带过来。我不用非得自带一个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the empty chair and gives you a tiny nod.
beats.chinese: 她看了眼空椅子，轻轻朝你点个头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll save that seat. Ta for being quiet with me.
beats.chinese: 这位我留着。谢你陪我轻声说了两句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the paper again to the part after the fold and taps one paragraph.
beats.chinese: 她把纸翻回折过去那一段，点了点其中一节。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll say that bit there. Before she thinks the dog argument is the only thing I've got to say to her.
beats.chinese: 我就讲这儿。省得她以为我看完只想跟她争狗的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She leaves the page open and draws back as somebody comes up to the table.
beats.chinese: 她就那样摊着纸，等有人走近桌边，往后让了让。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Morning, Maureen. No, I'm not starting with the spaniel.
beats.chinese: 早，莫琳。没，我不先讲猎犬。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later afternoon, Patricia greets you by a table. She's smoothing a little sheet with two columns of pencil marks.
beats.chinese: 后来一个下午，帕特里夏在桌边招呼你。她面前一张小纸，上面两列铅笔记号，纸正被她捋平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. These are the scores from Thursday. We agreed it was five, then somebody took the paper home and made it six.
beats.chinese: 你好。这是周四记的分。都说了是五，有人拿回家给改成六了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the sheet along the space between the two columns.
beats.chinese: 她沿两栏中间把纸一折。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It was me. I remembered a kick we didn't write down. Now I need to find somebody else who does.
beats.chinese: 改的是我。我想起有一脚没记。现在还得找个也记得的人。

causality.presenceReason: 和莫琳在阅览室约换随笔，早到先读半页
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢有安静的人作伴，不需要全都同意
causality.stayingConstraint: 等朋友带下一篇来
causality.currentGoal: 试一下文章里一项立不住的前提
causality.currentState: 遇见句子漏洞就精神，知道低声
causality.contactTrigger: 指着页上从没两个字，向附近的人开口问是不是漏看了条件
causality.characterContinuity: 好争辩但不会拿人婚史或私事做例子，肯自己输
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 给文章留例外。ab 给朋友留反例。ba 自己保留不赞同。bb 直接告诉朋友真喜欢这篇
causality.spatialContinuity: 坐阅览桌旁谈两句，四路都不打扰读者
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天来自运动计分纸

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man near the statue reaches for Camille's folder. She holds it just beyond his fingers.
beats.chinese: 雕像旁，一个男人伸手要接卡米耶的文件夹。她往回一收，刚好够不着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Afternoon I can give you. What'd you say about tomorrow morning?
beats.chinese: 下午可以给你。明早那句怎么说的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He backs off a couple of steps to take a call. Camille looks at you.
beats.chinese: 他往后退两步去接电话。卡米耶转来看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He said a few minutes. In his mouth that can be the entire first film.
beats.chinese: 人家说就几分钟。从他嘴里出来，那可能就是头一整场电影。

choices.english: Ask what he needs covered.
choices.chinese: 问具体哪段要人顶。

choices.english: Ask why she's keeping tomorrow morning clear.
choices.chinese: 问她为什么把明早空着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the folder along one edge. Two columns are crossed out.
beats.chinese: 她从边上打开文件夹。里头有两列被划掉了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Doors open at nine. He means from nine till eleven. He's asked me to do the same shift every year since I started.
beats.chinese: 九点开门。他说的是从九点到十一点。我刚开始管排班时他就喊我顶这班，一年没落。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She leaves a finger between the pages.
beats.chinese: 她留根指头夹在页间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He might only need the first bit. He's got to say if he does.
beats.chinese: 他也许只缺开头一点时间。要真这样，得他自己说。

choices.english: Get that two hour request out in the open.
choices.chinese: 把那整整俩钟头直接问明白。

choices.english: Find out if he already has part of it covered.
choices.chinese: 问问他其中一段是不是已经找到人顶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Camille fits both corners of the paper inside the folder and presses it shut.
beats.chinese: 卡米耶把纸两个角塞好，按上文件夹。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm swimming. I go slow and nobody asks me to cover anything for an hour.
beats.chinese: 我要游泳。慢慢游，一个钟头里没有人喊我顶班。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She watches the man end his call.
beats.chinese: 她看那男人把电话挂了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He'll hear that as maybe Tuesday. There isn't any Tuesday in it.
beats.chinese: 他准能听成周二也许行。哪儿来的周二？

choices.english: Leave her to finish the handover.
choices.chinese: 留她把文件交接完。

choices.english: Tell her to lead with the no.
choices.chinese: 建议先把不行俩字说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the folder towards the returning man and runs a finger down the whole morning column.
beats.chinese: 她把夹子转给回来的男人，手指沿整个上午那一列划下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nine to eleven. That's two hours. I can't give you those two.
beats.chinese: 九点到十一点，俩钟头。这俩钟头我顶不了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He nods once and takes his keys instead of the folder.
beats.chinese: 他点了下头，拿起自己的钥匙，没接文件夹。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That's a thing he can ask somebody else now.
beats.chinese: 好了，这下能拿这事去问别人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slides a spare page underneath the morning sheet.
beats.chinese: 她拿张空页垫到上午那张下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tell me which part you still need. Okay, ten to eleven. I can show you the list. I'm not on it.
beats.chinese: 你告诉我哪段还没找到人。好，十点到十一点。我给你看名单，里边没我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shows him the lower row, then gives him the folder.
beats.chinese: 她指给他底下一排，才把夹子给他。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Call before supper. People are much nicer before they've sat down.
beats.chinese: 赶在晚饭前打电话，人还没坐桌边的时候好说话多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the folder closed until the man is right beside her.
beats.chinese: 直到男人走到正跟前，她都没再打开文件夹。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here you go. Everything I said I'd bring is in there.
beats.chinese: 给。说好拿给你的，全在这儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks past the statue towards the patch of grass.
beats.chinese: 她越过雕像往前头的草地瞧去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm walking the rest of the square without it.
beats.chinese: 广场剩下这截，我就不用挟着它走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the folder flat between them for a moment.
beats.chinese: 她把夹子平放在两人之间，停了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can't do tomorrow morning. Do you still need this today?
beats.chinese: 明早我不行。这夹子今天还用得着吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes it. Camille takes a longer step away from the edge of the path.
beats.chinese: 他接了，卡米耶迈开一步，离步道边远了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thought I'd have to say it three times. Guess I don't.
beats.chinese: 还以为得说三遍呢，倒不用。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Days later at Jackson Square, Camille sees you and holds a schedule with the printed side against her wrist.
beats.chinese: 过几天在杰克逊广场，卡米耶看见你，她把排班纸印着字的一面贴向手腕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Nine festivals on paper and I just found a soup recipe on the back of number four.
beats.chinese: 嗨，九届影展的单子。刚在第四届那张背后找着个汤的做法。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds that side out to read it.
beats.chinese: 她特地把那面折出来看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's no salt written. I remember whose this is now.
beats.chinese: 没写放盐。这我想起来谁写的了。

causality.presenceReason: 来广场等接班人取电影节排班资料
causality.placeAttitude: 想在轴线上走一圈再交材料
causality.stayingConstraint: 交接可以，不能接明早的班
causality.currentGoal: 让对方说清到底要换哪段时间
causality.currentState: 对方连着问了多年还是有点烦
causality.contactTrigger: 同伴伸手接文件又加问明早的班，她把文件收回，等他接电话时向身旁的人开口
causality.characterContinuity: 能体谅却不拿游泳时间换班
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 指出对方其实需要两小时。ab 问清真正空档。ba 结束讲排班。bb 直接拒绝，第二天照游
causality.spatialContinuity: 雕像和教堂之间的公共路径
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 换一天才看见旧纸上留字

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Near the grass at Jackson Square, Emile turns a flask lid until it gives a little hiss. He holds it away from both of you.
beats.chinese: 杰克逊广场草地边，埃米尔拧动保温壶盖，嘶了一小声。他把壶朝你俩都够不着的地方拿开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hot. There's still a little in there. Didn't think I'd hear it after that walk.
beats.chinese: 烫的，还有一点。我走了这一路，没想到开盖还有这声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets the closed flask level on one palm.
beats.chinese: 他把壶扣好，平端在掌上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My neighbour needs a lid. I brought the whole flask. She's going to try to pay me for one of those things.
beats.chinese: 邻居缺个盖。我连壶都拿来了。等会儿她准想为这俩东西挑一个给我钱。

choices.english: Ask why he brought the rest of the flask.
choices.chinese: 问他为什么连壶都拿来。

choices.english: Ask whether the neighbour knows it's on loan.
choices.chinese: 问邻居知不知道他本来想借给她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shows the thread on the loose cap without tipping the flask.
beats.chinese: 他给你看刚拧松的盖上的螺纹，壶还直直端着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Same cap, but the seal sits better on this body. No sense handing her the half that won't hold.
beats.chinese: 同样的盖，扣在这个壶身上才严实。不能光拿个不一定合用的半拉给她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes it again and frees the hand with the cloth.
beats.chinese: 他重新拧好，把拿布那手空出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll offer her some out of it when she gets here. Then she can see what she's borrowing.
beats.chinese: 人来了先倒点给她喝。她就知道借的东西好不好用。

choices.english: Ask if he'll have some of it too.
choices.chinese: 问他自己也喝口吗。

choices.english: Let her take the flask and see for herself.
choices.chinese: 让人拿回去，自己用用看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He wraps the cloth round the hot metal without covering the cap.
beats.chinese: 他用布裹着热壶身，没裹住盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She knows. She wants it to be money anyway. I still got her folding chair from last August.
beats.chinese: 她知道。就是非要折成钱给我。我那儿还留着她去年八月借的折椅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the flask out a little farther from his own coat.
beats.chinese: 他把壶拿得更离自己外套远一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not putting a price on the two of us knowing each other.
beats.chinese: 俩人都这么熟了，我不想算价钱。

choices.english: Tell him he can leave the favour where it is.
choices.chinese: 跟他说，帮完这忙就搁着吧。

choices.english: Ask if he can wait to see what his neighbour actually needs.
choices.chinese: 问能不能等邻居说清楚缺什么再给。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds out the little drinking cap to someone coming up the path and takes his own tin cup from his bag.
beats.chinese: 他把喝水用的小盖递给从小路走来的人，又从自己袋里拿出个铁杯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Half each. It's not quite noon. Don't tell me that's too late for coffee.
beats.chinese: 一人一半。还没到中午呢。别跟我说这会儿喝咖啡晚了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pours a little into each cup and puts the flask back upright.
beats.chinese: 他两个杯里各倒一点，把壶重新竖好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The clean cloth's for you. I know where mine's been.
beats.chinese: 干净那块布是给你的。我这块之前擦过啥，我心里有数。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tightens the lid and puts the wrapped flask against his side.
beats.chinese: 他把盖拧紧，裹着布的壶贴住身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can have it till she knows. I'll ask how it did next time she calls me over.
beats.chinese: 借给她，用明白了再说。下回她喊我过去，我再问好不好用。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks towards the far side of the path and lifts the flask a little.
beats.chinese: 他转脸看路那侧，把壶稍稍往上举。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is. Looks like she had room for a whole flask after all.
beats.chinese: 她来了。看来身上还真有地方装我这一整只壶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the folded cloth under the handle so it won't fall.
beats.chinese: 他把叠好的布塞进手柄底下，免得掉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If she brings cash, she's taking it home. I don't charge a woman who still has my good screwdriver.
beats.chinese: 她带钱来，还得把钱带回去。我那把好螺丝刀还在她家，怎么算得清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down at the cap for a second. A small laugh comes out late.
beats.chinese: 他低头瞧了眼盖，隔了片刻才笑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I lent that one on purpose.
beats.chinese: 那可是我故意借的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the flask upright by the handle and stops taking the cap off.
beats.chinese: 他握着提手把壶端直，不再去卸盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Maybe hers needs nothing but the rubber. I can wait and look at it with her.
beats.chinese: 也对。没准她那只就该换个胶圈。可以等人来了，我俩一块看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts to the other side of the path as a group goes by.
beats.chinese: 一群人过去，他让到了步道另一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Easier than coming with a bill for something she didn't ask for.
beats.chinese: 也比提着她没要的东西，等人给钱好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day beside the statue, Emile holds up a little envelope when he sees you.
beats.chinese: 改天在雕像旁，埃米尔见到你，举了一下小信封。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. There's a leaf printed on this. We mail one back and forth. I never put what tree it was.
beats.chinese: 嗨。上头印了片叶子。我俩来回寄这个，我从来不写是哪棵树的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns it over and runs a finger round the flap.
beats.chinese: 他翻过去，用指尖沿封口走了一圈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She always puts something different. I can let her wonder like I do.
beats.chinese: 她每回都换一种寄。我猜多久，也让她猜多久。

causality.presenceReason: 来广场老邻居一起走，拿自己的保温壶送过来
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢路上碰着就把东西用上
causality.stayingConstraint: 不靠帮忙结清以前的事
causality.currentGoal: 借给对方一个还好用的杯盖
causality.currentState: 手早备好，听见要算账有点执拗
causality.contactTrigger: 壶试盖发出响，他提醒经过的人当心有热汽
causality.characterContinuity: 只肯直说怎么用，不给人出主意，不要被还情
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 各拿壶里的一半。ab 让对方用着再说。ba 不收找钱。bb 自己先留杯盖
causality.spatialContinuity: 雕像旁公共路内，热壶留到人站定才开
