beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman walking beside the grass takes a phone somebody offers her, then gives it right back, screen untouched.
beats.chinese: 草地旁走着的一个女人接过别人递来的手机，屏幕没碰，又递回去了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, I don't need to read all that. Did he ask me to cook or did he say he liked the pie?
beats.chinese: 不用，不看这么多。人家是请我做饭，还是说了句喜欢那馅饼？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other walker moves off to make a call. She looks at you.
beats.chinese: 另一个人走开了点儿去打电话。她转过来瞧你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Well now. I know what he said to me. Nothing. Had enough people on the night line who wanted me to fill in what they meant.
beats.chinese: 哎。我知道他亲口跟我说的是什么。一个字也没有。以前上夜班，老有人等我替他把要说的补全。

choices.english: Ask what she'd ask the person himself.
choices.chinese: 问要是本人在，她会问什么。

choices.english: Ask whether she even wants to make a pie.
choices.chinese: 问她到底愿不愿意烤馅饼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds one finger out, stopping halfway into a second.
beats.chinese: 她伸出一根指头，下一根才伸到一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Do you need a pie, and when. I can spare him those two questions. I'm not going to guess the answer to either.
beats.chinese: 要馅饼吗，什么时候要。就这俩问题我能问。哪个都不会替他猜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She bends the second finger away and looks up the path.
beats.chinese: 她收起第二根指头，顺步道往上望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's only tonight or there isn't. These people don't need to hold a meeting around my oven.
beats.chinese: 有空做也就今晚，没空就没空。甭绕着我家烤箱开会。

choices.english: Wait for the caller to put the right person on.
choices.chinese: 等打电话的人把正主请来讲。

choices.english: Tell her to state what she can do upfront.
choices.chinese: 建议先把自己能做的说清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a receipt out of her pocket and checks the blank back.
beats.chinese: 她从兜里摸出张小票，瞧了眼空白的背面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I did until all these people started quoting me about it. I haven't put my name on a pie yet.
beats.chinese: 本来想，直到一堆人开始说我早答应了。我还一块都没认领呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the receipt back up and rests her hand along her pocket.
beats.chinese: 她把小票叠回去，一只手搭在兜边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might make one Sunday and put too much nutmeg in it again. That's one thing I have agreed to.
beats.chinese: 我周日没准自己烤一块，又把肉豆蔻粉放多。这件事倒是说定了。

choices.english: Don't take anyone else's word for it.
choices.chinese: 不接别人代传的话。

choices.english: Ask if the Sunday pie is for her own recipe contest.
choices.chinese: 问周日那块是不是给自家比手艺用的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other walker returns, holding the phone out at an angle. She accepts it this time.
beats.chinese: 另一个散步的人回来了，斜着递出手机。这回她接了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Do you want me to bring a pie? Oh. You want the recipe. I can do that right now.
beats.chinese: 喂，你是想让我带一块去？哦，你要的是方子。这就能给你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hands the phone back and heads towards the middle of the public path.
beats.chinese: 她把电话还回去，朝步道中间走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good thing I hadn't warmed the oven.
beats.chinese: 还好我没先给烤箱预热。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends a message of her own and holds the phone away from her body.
beats.chinese: 她自己发一条消息，把手机拿得离身子远远的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wrote I can bring one after supper, if it's wanted. Didn't say enough for everybody between here and Esplanade.
beats.chinese: 我写的是，真要的话我饭后能带一块。没说从这儿到埃斯普拉纳德大道上的人都归我喂。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her phone away and waits for the other walker to finish.
beats.chinese: 她把手机收好，等另一个人打完。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: When he wants it, he's got my number.
beats.chinese: 真想要，让他往我号上打。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pats the phone back into her pocket and heads towards the open part of the path.
beats.chinese: 她拍拍口袋里的手机，朝空出来的步道那头走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Nobody's asked me yet. Nice to have a minute in which that's true.
beats.chinese: 成，这会儿没人请我做。能有一分钟踏实这么说，挺好的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slows down when the cathedral comes fully into view.
beats.chinese: 大教堂整个露出来，她放慢了步子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can walk a little without bringing dessert to any of it.
beats.chinese: 还能就走上这么一截，不用为了这里头谁，拿一份甜点过来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls the receipt out again and smooths it on her palm.
beats.chinese: 她又抽出小票，在掌心里摊平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's our Sunday thing, yes. I keep losing. As long as they bring me another recipe to ruin, I'll stay in it.
beats.chinese: 嗯，我家周日就玩这个。我老输。只要还有人拿新方子来任我祸害，我就接着比。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She points at two ingredients pencilled at the bottom.
beats.chinese: 她指了指纸下面拿铅笔记的两样。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Those two I can ask you about. Nobody needs you to tell me what they think of me.
beats.chinese: 这两样吃的我倒可以问你。甭找你替别人说他们怎么看我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another morning in Jackson Square, Yvonne recognises you and brings a little bottle out of her bag.
beats.chinese: 又一天早上，伊冯在杰克逊广场认出你，打袋里掏出个小瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Vinegar. My brother won with a dish that had none, and I was the one who told him to leave it out.
beats.chinese: 嘿，醋。我哥那盘一点没放就赢了，还是我叫他别放的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She screws the cap down tight.
beats.chinese: 她把盖子拧紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep mine till the end. I don't have to help him twice.
beats.chinese: 我这瓶留到最后再看。也用不着帮他两回。

causality.presenceReason: 来广场等表亲说会儿话，被递了绕了一圈的消息
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意沿绿地走，不肯让一整个午后被误会占住
causality.stayingConstraint: 正主未接通，可以结束转述
causality.currentGoal: 弄清是否真的想她做菜带去
causality.currentState: 忙完早上的事，没想破案，敢承认自己想赢
causality.contactTrigger: 对方当着玩家说别人想怎样，她当场问能否联系当事人
causality.characterContinuity: 要求直接说，不追问别人的私事
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 等本人说清。ab 先摆清自己能做的范围。ba 不接转述。bb 以一道菜收束
causality.spatialContinuity: 广场公共步道，人物不跨绿地
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢话题是新一次兄妹比菜

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Near the statue, René listens as an old friend starts a sentence about a bus and a cardboard suitcase. René mouths the word suitcase at exactly the same time.
beats.chinese: 雕像旁，雷内在听老朋友讲长途车和纸板箱。那人刚说到箱子，雷内嘴里刚好也念了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oops. I know this much. I don't know why he put it on the bus empty.
beats.chinese: 哎，这一截我听过。他干吗要拎个空箱上车，我就不知道了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend makes a little motion with both hands and keeps talking.
beats.chinese: 朋友两手轻轻比画，没停，接着往下讲。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can stay for the empty part if you like. That's where it gets me too.
beats.chinese: 你想听可以留到空箱子那儿。我也就是那里没闹明白。

choices.english: Stay to hear what he wanted the suitcase for.
choices.chinese: 留下听他空箱子拿来干什么。

choices.english: Ask René if they ought to say they've heard the story.
choices.chinese: 问雷内该不该说自己听过了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René rocks back onto their heels but does not take their eyes off the friend.
beats.chinese: 雷内身子往脚后跟晃了晃，眼睛没离开那个讲故事的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Last time I heard it the suitcase was red. He's got a picture now. It's brown as the ground.
beats.chinese: 上回给我讲，箱是红的。这回拿了照片。跟地上土一个褐色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend holds the photo up. René lets the next sentence come without correcting him.
beats.chinese: 朋友举着相片，雷内等他再讲一句，没插嘴去纠正。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can see there's another trip in this story. I might have put the two together myself.
beats.chinese: 听着还有另一趟。我可能自己把两趟攒成一趟记了。

choices.english: Let the friend separate the two trips himself.
choices.chinese: 让朋友自己把两趟说开。

choices.english: Ask what ended up in the suitcase.
choices.chinese: 问到底什么放进了箱子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René takes a slow breath. The friend holds up a photograph of the suitcase.
beats.chinese: 雷内慢慢换了口气，朋友这时举起一张箱子的照片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I will, if I recognise the end. I don't like lying to a man who's still halfway through.
beats.chinese: 听出结尾是熟的，我就说。别人正讲到一半，我不喜欢在这儿装。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their friend pauses to find a name. René does not supply it.
beats.chinese: 朋友停下来想个人名。雷内没有替他说。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Though I don't need to keep you waiting for it if you've got somewhere to be.
beats.chinese: 不过你有事就先走，不必跟着等他想起来。

choices.english: Take the chance to keep walking.
choices.chinese: 趁这会儿接着走。

choices.english: Hear them tell the friend plainly what they remember.
choices.chinese: 留下听雷内直接说自己记住了哪些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René points at the suitcase handle. The old friend shifts the photo a little.
beats.chinese: 雷内指了指箱子的把手。老朋友挪了下相片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one went to Baton Rouge. The red one went clear to Texas. Oh, I owe you an apology.
beats.chinese: 这只去了巴吞鲁日。红的那只一直到得州。噢，我得跟你赔个不是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their friend lowers the photograph. René waits for him to start again.
beats.chinese: 朋友把照片放低。雷内等着他接上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go on. I've got the right bag in my head now.
beats.chinese: 你接着讲。我脑子里这回有对的箱子了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend finally opens both hands as big as the box in the photograph. René lets out a low laugh.
beats.chinese: 老朋友终于把两手摊到跟照片里的箱子一样大。雷内低低笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A cake. I thought it was papers. He packed his trousers in a grocery bag so the cake could travel like a person.
beats.chinese: 是块蛋糕。我还以为装文件呢。他拿购物袋装裤子，倒让蛋糕像个人一样乘车。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They take hold of the photograph and study the scuffed side.
beats.chinese: 雷内拿住相片，细看箱子磨花的那边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That is the nicest thing I've heard about a cardboard suitcase.
beats.chinese: 纸板箱的事儿我听得多，就这个最好听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René takes a half step away from the public path so you can pass.
beats.chinese: 雷内从公用步道上侧开半步，让你过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. We can stand here through another wrong turn or two.
beats.chinese: 你去吧。我俩还能在这儿多讲岔一回两回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend finds the name and gestures towards René again.
beats.chinese: 朋友把名字想起来了，又朝雷内比画。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the one. I wasn't going to help you, but that's the one.
beats.chinese: 就这人。我不打算帮你想的，但就这人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René angles the photo back towards the friend and leaves one finger on the edge.
beats.chinese: 雷内把照片转回朋友面前，一根手指还留在边上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I got as far as the empty case last time. Go on from there. I want the rest.
beats.chinese: 上回听到空箱就没了。从那儿往下讲吧，后头我想听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend clicks a tongue, then leans closer instead of turning away.
beats.chinese: 朋友啧了一下，没走开，反倒凑近了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He likes it better when he knows which bits he's said. Took him thirty years to tell me that.
beats.chinese: 人家知道我听过哪段，讲得还舒服些。他花了三十年才告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later afternoon, René sees you near the cathedral holding a small paper bag in both hands.
beats.chinese: 后来一个下午，雷内在教堂附近看见你，两只手提着个小纸袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. A friend gave me this to carry. Said it weighed about like a book. I've been thinking what kind of book for twenty minutes.
beats.chinese: 嘿，朋友给我拎的。说差不多一本书重。我琢磨是什么书，琢磨二十分钟了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They set the bag against a knee. One corner holds perfectly square.
beats.chinese: 雷内把纸袋贴上膝盖，有一角方得齐齐整整。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Probably a brick. I'll wait for the long version when he gets here.
beats.chinese: 多半是块砖。等人来了，我听个从头讲到尾的版本。

causality.presenceReason: 来广场和前同事见面听他讲两次长途搬家
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意路边听完，不代人补故事
causality.stayingConstraint: 见面前可收到语音开头，不知道真实结尾
causality.currentGoal: 如实承认听过，但不抢在朋友说前
causality.currentState: 听熟了也感兴趣，别人叫快点会有点不乐
causality.contactTrigger: 旁边熟人开始复述，雷内拿出一个不同的旧照片，顺口邀玩家听一小段
causality.characterContinuity: 不假装头回听，也不抢出笑点
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 把另一回记忆还给对方。ab 让讲者最后改口。ba 让玩家离开。bb 一句话提前表明已听过
causality.spatialContinuity: 广场公共步行轴线，听故事者可走

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside one of the clubs, a man turns a sheet so a patch of streetlight falls across the top. Music comes through the door behind him.
beats.chinese: 一家俱乐部外，一个男人转动纸页，让街灯的光落到上面一截。身后的门里传出音乐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: First question. What's the worst thing that ever happened to you. Look, I thought they wanted to ask about the set.
beats.chinese: 头一个问题，你这辈子碰过最糟的事是什么。你瞧，我还当人家要问舞台布景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds that part out of sight and keeps the back of the sheet showing.
beats.chinese: 他把那一截折到里面，只让背面露出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I work up in the rigging. Soon as somebody hears I got hurt, they decide what kind of story I am.
beats.chinese: 我在舞台上头做吊装。人家一听我受过伤，立刻就想好了拿我讲个什么故事。

choices.english: Ask which question he actually wants to answer.
choices.chinese: 问他真正愿意答的是哪一句。

choices.english: Ask if he wants to do the interview at all.
choices.chinese: 问他到底还想不想做这个采访。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the sheet closer to the light and slips one finger down the list.
beats.chinese: 他把纸拿近亮处，一根手指沿单子往下找。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: How do you know when the set is ready. That's one. I know what I check. I don't know why they put that after did it change your life.
beats.chinese: 你怎么知道布景已经备好了。这句行。我知道我要查哪些地方。搞不懂怎么就排在它改变了你一生吗那句后面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps the question again, then turns the paper all the way over.
beats.chinese: 他又点点那一句，把纸整个翻面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or I'll show them what I draw. Nobody's got a true story for a coast I made up in my kitchen.
beats.chinese: 不然就给他们看我画的。就我在厨房编出来的海岸，谁也不能拿它讲真人真事。

choices.english: Offer to help pick the question about the work.
choices.chinese: 就挑做活的这一问。

choices.english: Ask to see part of the map instead.
choices.chinese: 问能不能看看地图的一部分。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the whole sheet into a size he can close his fist around.
beats.chinese: 他把整张纸折到一拳就攥得住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I'd said yes to talking about work. I haven't said yes to sitting under a light telling how brave I was.
beats.chinese: 不想。答应的是聊干活儿。我没答应去灯下头坐着，说我那时多勇敢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A phrase of music from the door ends. He lets the next one start before speaking.
beats.chinese: 门里的乐声收住一小节。他等下一节都起来了才张嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm already where I wanted to be tonight. Don't know why I'm reading that here.
beats.chinese: 今晚想来的地方，已经来了。我干吗还在这儿读这个。

choices.english: Say he can turn them down with one sentence.
choices.chinese: 跟他说，回一句不参加就行。

choices.english: Leave the paper folded and listen for a while.
choices.chinese: 纸先叠着，就听会儿音乐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finds the number on the bottom and types once, using his sleeve to keep the paper in place.
beats.chinese: 他找到最下面的号码，用袖口顶着纸，打了一条消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ask about the work or ask somebody else. There. I want to be there for it if they get to that one.
beats.chinese: 要么问工作，要么另找个人。成。真讲我的活儿，我愿意去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shrugs the paper into the back of his bag and turns to the door.
beats.chinese: 他把纸送进包后头，转向那扇门。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can answer that with the lights on or off.
beats.chinese: 这句开灯关灯我都答得出。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the other cover. A little coast bends round under a pencil line.
beats.chinese: 他打开另一层封皮。铅笔线下面，一小段岸往里弯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I made this on my kitchen table. Had ships come in this way till I realised there wasn't room for them to turn round.
beats.chinese: 在我厨房桌上画的。原先画船从这头进来，后来才瞧见，到里头连掉头的地儿都没。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds it under the light a second longer.
beats.chinese: 他把那页又留在灯底下一秒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See, that doesn't need me getting hit by anything.
beats.chinese: 看吧，说这个又不用我让什么东西砸一回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a reply with the paper still shut between his fingers.
beats.chinese: 他夹着合起来的纸，打了条回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm out. Didn't put in tell me if you need anybody else. That would be how they get me a second time.
beats.chinese: 我不去了。我也没加有别的需要跟我说。人家想再套我一回，就靠我加那句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the folded sheet deep in his bag.
beats.chinese: 他把纸往袋子深处塞了塞。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Let's have the street back now.
beats.chinese: 现在好好看看这条街吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He flattens the fold hard against his palm and puts it away.
beats.chinese: 他拿掌心狠压一下纸的折痕，把纸收了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a trombone. Been hearing it and not listening to it till now.
beats.chinese: 是长号，一直传过来，我到这会儿才听出是它。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stands out of the doorway while the next note trails off.
beats.chinese: 他没站住门口，等下一个音慢慢散了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. There it is again.
beats.chinese: 啊，又来一声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another evening along Frenchmen Street, Emile recognises you and moves a map into a patch of streetlight.
beats.chinese: 后来一个晚上在法国人街，埃米尔认出了你，把手上一张地图移到街灯照着的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. My coast moved six inches while I was eating supper. I left the pencil down at one end and picked it up at the other.
beats.chinese: 嘿。我吃个晚饭，海岸线挪了六英寸。笔是从这头放下的，抬手却从那一头又画上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the page over, checking how large the coast looks through the paper.
beats.chinese: 他翻过纸，瞧那片岸从纸背透出来有多大。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep it. There's somewhere to put a harbour now.
beats.chinese: 就留这么画了，现在有地方放港口了。

causality.presenceReason: 下班经过法国人街，等朋友下场再走
causality.placeAttitude: 从亮着的路上看出来哪些是声音，哪些是振动
causality.stayingConstraint: 不在场外参与别人演出布置
causality.currentGoal: 领到自己被采访的预选题，决定怎么办
causality.currentState: 一看开头要写受伤逆袭就烦
causality.contactTrigger: 夹在画板上一张打印题被风卷起，险些擦到行人，他截住后给玩家看非私人那一角
causality.characterContinuity: 不分享事故励志故事，答应一件东西就自己管到头
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 限定只谈可谈的职责。ab 换成虚构地图。ba 直接退邀。bb 放回口袋先听街上
causality.spatialContinuity: 夜里 600 街区人行道，临街俱乐部内不进入
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天是新画的岸线

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman comes down the lit sidewalk with a cloth bag in each hand. The shorter handle catches on her sleeve.
beats.chinese: 街灯照着的人行道上，一个女人两手各提一个布袋走来。短点儿的提手勾住她袖子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See the loop, dawlin'? Is it on the button, or have I got myself in a proper knot?
beats.chinese: 瞧见那根带没有？是挂纽扣上了，还是被我绕成死结了？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds both bags still as people move towards an open door.
beats.chinese: 有人往开着的门里走，她把两只袋子都拿稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: These are for a friend. I'd like to hear the band before my other friends find a third bag for me.
beats.chinese: 给一个朋友的。我想趁别的朋友还没给我找来第三个袋，先听乐队吹会儿。

choices.english: Point out where the handle caught.
choices.chinese: 给她指出提手勾在哪。

choices.english: Ask if her friend is inside listening already.
choices.chinese: 问那个朋友是不是已经在里头听了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She follows the seam of the sleeve with one eye. The button just shows below the loop.
beats.chinese: 她眯一只眼沿着袖缝瞧，纽扣从提手底下刚露出点儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There it is. Hold still a second. Not you, me.
beats.chinese: 找着了，别动一秒。不是你，是我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls the cloth down over the button with a knuckle.
beats.chinese: 她用指关节把布从扣眼上头拨了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I can go find her. I can also listen while I've still got two hands full.
beats.chinese: 这下能找人了。也可以先两手满满地听一会儿。

choices.english: Regrip the bags and go meet the friend.
choices.chinese: 重新提稳袋子，去见朋友。

choices.english: Stay by the music and hand the bags over afterwards.
choices.chinese: 先听，完了再把袋子交了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the stuck loop in place and looks towards the light at the door.
beats.chinese: 她没硬拽勾住的带，看着门口亮灯那儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Probably. She only needs two tablecloths. My phone thinks I still need to know who's got sheets at a guesthouse next Tuesday.
beats.chinese: 八成在呢。那人就要两块桌布。我这手机倒觉得下周二哪家旅店还有床单，现在也得归我知道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her screen lights for a moment and goes dark below the loose cloth.
beats.chinese: 她手机的屏幕在松散的布下亮了一瞬，又暗了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If they need the pickup time, it's ten. I can tell them ten or I can keep my hands full like this.
beats.chinese: 要问几点取，十点。我可以告诉人家十点，也可以继续两手提满，没手回。

choices.english: Send only the time they need.
choices.chinese: 只回他们要的那个时间。

choices.english: Put work away for the evening.
choices.chinese: 今晚先别回工作的消息。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts both handles into her right hand and opens the sleeve button with her left.
beats.chinese: 她把两个提手都换到右手，左手解开袖扣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Done. Now if she asks me to go dancing with the bags, I'm saying maybe after the first tune.
beats.chinese: 好了。要是她叫我提着这俩去跳舞，我就说先等人家吹完一首。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She catches sight of someone on the lit pavement ahead and speeds up.
beats.chinese: 她看见前面亮着的道上有人，一下走快了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, hold up. I'm bringing you things with no instructions attached.
beats.chinese: 哎，等一下！给你捎了东西，不附使用说明啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lays a bag flat against the wall without setting it in the doorway, then slides its handle farther up her wrist.
beats.chinese: 她把一只袋子贴在墙这边，没摆在门口，又把提手在腕上套深一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bass is coming through now. I'll wait till that stops. Gives everybody else a chance to be late.
beats.chinese: 低音这会儿传出来了。等这一段完了再说，省得别人没机会迟到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to face the club entrance and leaves the message alone.
beats.chinese: 她转向俱乐部入口，消息就这么搁着没看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can stay right here. There's no list for standing out here.
beats.chinese: 你想留就留，这外头又不用登记。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gets her phone out with two fingers and sends a very short reply.
beats.chinese: 她两根手指抽出手机，只回了一个时间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten. That's it. If they ask which ten, somebody else can have a go.
beats.chinese: 十点，得了。要再问是哪个十点，让别人也练练手。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She can just get the phone into her coat without taking the bags off.
beats.chinese: 她没卸袋子，正好能把手机塞回外套。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. My hand's busy again.
beats.chinese: 成了，我这手又腾不出了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns off the sounds without opening the message, then frees the cuff with a quick turn of her wrist.
beats.chinese: 她没点消息就静了音，手腕飞快翻一下，袖口也松开了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. They've got their answer for tonight. No jingle.
beats.chinese: 好。今晚给人家的回复就这个，不响了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a moment to move aside when the doorway fills.
beats.chinese: 门口一时人多，她等着往边上让开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, I know that tune. Bags can come with me for it.
beats.chinese: 哦，这首我会。袋就提着一块儿听吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another night on Frenchmen Street, Odile sees you and holds out a little square of folded linen.
beats.chinese: 后来一天晚上，奥迪尔在法国人街见到你，拿出一小方叠好的亚麻布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, baby. This was half a curtain. I know because I caught the same flower upside down on a pair of napkins.
beats.chinese: 嘿。这个以前是半扇窗帘。我怎么知道呢，前几天我还看见同样的花倒着印在一对餐巾上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the flower back in and slips the piece into her pocket.
beats.chinese: 她把花朝里折回去，把布片放回兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to leave it one thing at a time. It's a cloth tonight.
beats.chinese: 一样一样来吧，今晚它就只是一块布。

causality.presenceReason: 带去给合唱朋友的旧布顺路赴现场音乐约会
causality.placeAttitude: 每步都有事，到笑得舒服才真坐下听
causality.stayingConstraint: 包重，约人不该在门口还被调度叫走
causality.currentGoal: 把几样活放下，确定朋友亲口说告诉她何时进
causality.currentState: 习惯不停，总想把晚班的事再安排两句
causality.contactTrigger: 提手在她袖口绊住，她停到壁边跟玩家借一点眼力
causality.characterContinuity: 爽快热心，不聊婚姻私史，真愿停下来听音乐
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 自己重新提袋。ab 选听完音乐再送。ba 回一句实际安排。bb 没把半晚切给工作
causality.spatialContinuity: 有街灯的人行道边，音乐从俱乐部门内传来
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来找到一块原料花布，不预设初遇看过

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A coin runs from Remy's fingers into a loose sleeve. They stop moving right outside the reach of a club door.
beats.chinese: 一枚硬币从雷米指间滚进松袖口。雷米定在一家俱乐部门边，刚好不挡门。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay. Would you believe it went where I wanted if I stopped there?
beats.chinese: 好。要我现在就停，你会不会以为这正是我要它去的地方？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They shake the sleeve until the coin settles against their wrist.
beats.chinese: 雷米晃了晃袖子，硬币落到了手腕边上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It was a very good disappear. I just hadn't planned to do it into a shirt.
beats.chinese: 消失得倒挺好，我没打算让它消失到衬衫里去。

choices.english: Offer to look away while they finish the trick.
choices.chinese: 说可以先扭头，等雷米变完。

choices.english: Tell them the disappearing part worked.
choices.chinese: 告诉雷米，消失那一截确实成功了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy lowers the arm without letting the coin fall out.
beats.chinese: 雷米放低胳膊，没让硬币掉出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're good at leaving people alone while they're doing a thing. That's actually a skill. My friend shouted when I did it right once.
beats.chinese: 你挺会在人家忙活的时候不干扰。那可是真本事。有回我刚变对，我朋友在旁边大叫了一声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn towards the streetlight so the inside of the sleeve is dark to you.
beats.chinese: 雷米转向街灯，从你的方向看不见袖里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can finish it. Or I can just get the coin out. I am allowed to have a sleeve without a show in it.
beats.chinese: 要变完，可以。直接拿出来，也可以。我袖里又不一定非得排一场演出。

choices.english: Wait for the trick to finish.
choices.chinese: 等着看怎么收尾。

choices.english: Let them empty the sleeve and have a break.
choices.chinese: 让雷米倒出来，先歇歇。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy catches the coin by folding the cuff back.
beats.chinese: 雷米把袖口一折，摘下那枚硬币。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, thanks. I got a roller clean on the first pass at work today, too. Nobody saw that part either.
beats.chinese: 诶，谢啦。我今天上班有根辊子，第一遍就弄干净了。那一下也没人看见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pause with the coin between two fingers and look over at you.
beats.chinese: 雷米拿两根手指夹着硬币，停了一会儿看过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look at me. Soon as you said something nice I got three more things to tell you.
beats.chinese: 瞧我。你才说了一句好话，我马上又有三件事想讲。

choices.english: Ask what went right on the first pass.
choices.chinese: 问第一遍做对了哪一步。

choices.english: Say there doesn't need to be a good story behind it.
choices.chinese: 说变成这样，也不用再配个厉害故事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: When Remy opens their hand, the coin is resting on the back of the other wrist.
beats.chinese: 雷米张开手时，硬币已经平搁在另一只手的手背上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. On purpose that time. If we go inside I can tell my friend the shirt did the first one.
beats.chinese: 喏，这回是故意的。等进去，我跟朋友说头一回是衬衫变的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They hand the coin over for a moment to show it's the same one.
beats.chinese: 雷米暂把硬币递过来一下，让你看还是原来那枚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It wasn't the coin's fault, either way.
beats.chinese: 反正两回都不怪硬币。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They shake the coin out into the palm of the other hand and zip it into a pocket.
beats.chinese: 雷米把硬币抖进另一只手的掌心，放进带拉链的兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. My friend can play some drums first. I've been getting nervous on her behalf for about a half hour.
beats.chinese: 成，先让我朋友打会儿鼓。我都替她紧张半小时了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They step up to the doorway as another group clears it.
beats.chinese: 门口一群人散开，雷米走到门边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She never asked me to worry. I've been doing it for free.
beats.chinese: 她都没叫我替她操心。我还白替她急了半天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy rubs the edge of the coin on a trouser seam, then looks up all at once.
beats.chinese: 雷米拿硬币边蹭蹭裤缝，一下子抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I let the machine tell me when it was ready. Usually I pull it out too early just to show somebody.
beats.chinese: 我这回老老实实等机器报好了。平常为了急着给别人看，我老提前抽出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their free hand goes up as if to start in on the rest, then drops again.
beats.chinese: 雷米空着那只手举起来，像要接着讲，又放下了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was enough. Thanks for asking about the actual thing.
beats.chinese: 就这个。谢啦，你问的是我真干了什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy turns the coin until it disappears between two curled fingers, then puts it away.
beats.chinese: 雷米转了转硬币，两个指头一弯让它看不见，又收了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. I'll go in and listen. I can take my turn telling something when I've got something.
beats.chinese: 嗯，我进去听会儿。有想讲的，再轮到我讲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The door shifts inward when somebody steps through, letting a bit of music out.
beats.chinese: 有人进去，门朝里动了动，放出一截乐声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that took me right out of my own head.
beats.chinese: 噢，这下脑子里总算不是我自己了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another evening, Remy recognizes you under a streetlamp, holding an old curtain ring in one hand.
beats.chinese: 又一天傍晚，雷米在街灯下认出了你，一手攥着个旧窗帘环。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Two years in a junk drawer. I gave it a full minute of thought and put it in my pocket instead.
beats.chinese: 嘿。在杂物抽屉放两年了。我整想了一分钟，没扔，搁兜里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the ring once with a thumb and put it back into the pocket.
beats.chinese: 雷米用拇指转了一圈，把环放回口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Different drawer. Technically I've made progress.
beats.chinese: 换了个抽屉。这么一算，也有进展嘛。

causality.contactTrigger: 硬币从掌心滚到袖口，他们一僵，看到玩家也看见了

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Josephine stands between two clothing displays while a friend behind her asks for one more picture. Josephine stays right where she is.
beats.chinese: 约瑟芬站在两排衣物中间。后头的朋友说再拍一张，她一步也没挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. I'll be the person behind you who's looking for dish soap.
beats.chinese: 拍吧。我就当你背后那个想买洗洁精的人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits for the friend to finish, then catches your eye over one hanging sleeve.
beats.chinese: 她等朋友拍完，越过一截垂下的袖子和你对上了眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They're visiting. I said half the day here, half a day somewhere I can buy something without being asked if it's a souvenir.
beats.chinese: 他们是来玩的。我说半天在这儿，另外半天得找个买了东西不会有人问是不是纪念品的地方。

choices.english: Ask what she'd do with her half of the day.
choices.chinese: 问她那半天打算怎么用。

choices.english: Ask whether her friends want to stay here longer.
choices.chinese: 问她朋友是不是还想多待会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves her shopping bag down off her elbow and holds it by the handles.
beats.chinese: 她把购物袋从臂弯放低，换成提着袋把。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ride a bus to a supermarket I haven't been to. See what they've put next to the potatoes. See nobody who knows me.
beats.chinese: 坐公交去一家我没去过的超市。看看土豆旁摆了什么。一个认识人也别见着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend has already turned back towards a long row of clothes.
beats.chinese: 朋友先转过去看长长一排衣服了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They could come if they want. I couldn't sell it with a straight face.
beats.chinese: 人家想来就来。我可没办法一本正经把这种行程推销出去。

choices.english: Suggest splitting up for a while.
choices.chinese: 提议先分开逛一阵。

choices.english: Invite her to pitch the ordinary trip honestly.
choices.chinese: 让她按真实情况问朋友要不要去那种超市。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks at the friend's feet. Neither has moved farther along the passage.
beats.chinese: 她看了看朋友的脚。两个人都还没再往过道里走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yep. And I did like that shirt two stalls ago. I can give them another ten minutes without promising another day.
beats.chinese: 想啊。隔两个摊那件衬衫我也挺喜欢。我还能给十分钟，不用连明天也给了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She touches the clock on her phone without opening anything else.
beats.chinese: 她点亮手机瞧时间，其他什么也没开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: After that I'm out. They can stay with the shirts.
beats.chinese: 那之后我就走了。他们可以留下看衬衫。

choices.english: Give the friend the extra ten minutes.
choices.chinese: 先给朋友那十分钟。

choices.english: Say she's free to take the bus on her own.
choices.chinese: 说她可以自己去坐车。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Josephine says something to her friend across the display. The friend lifts a hand without looking away from the clothes.
beats.chinese: 约瑟芬隔着陈列跟朋友说了一句。人家眼睛还放衣服上，就把手挥了挥。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We both said yes awfully fast. Probably should've done that at breakfast.
beats.chinese: 我俩答应得真快。吃早饭的时候说就好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts down the clear side of the passage.
beats.chinese: 她沿过道没人挡的一侧走开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I can spend an unreasonable amount of time looking at sponges.
beats.chinese: 现在可以尽情挑海绵了，挑多久都不用解释。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits till her friend puts a shirt back, then lifts her own empty bag.
beats.chinese: 她等朋友把一件衬衫挂回去，抬了抬自己的空袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Groceries, on a bus. No photographs unless you see a truly remarkable potato.
beats.chinese: 坐公交，买菜。除非看见特别出众的一只土豆，不用拍照。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her friend puts their bag on their shoulder. Josephine's brows lift.
beats.chinese: 朋友把包挂上肩，约瑟芬眉毛挑高。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. You're coming. All right, I won't tell you which potato to pick.
beats.chinese: 哦，你还真来。成，土豆该挑哪个我不会管的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the time and puts the phone away where it won't show.
beats.chinese: 她看过时间，把手机揣进看不到的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten minutes. I'll look at the shirt I liked again. The wearer doesn't need to know we both liked it.
beats.chinese: 十分钟。我再去看眼刚才那件衬衫。最后谁穿上，也不用知道我俩都喜欢过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She follows the edge of the displays, stopping clear of the people shopping.
beats.chinese: 她沿陈列边走了几步，避开正在挑东西的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could be a very good shirt. I'll know in ten minutes.
beats.chinese: 说不定还真挺好。十分钟以后就知道了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks she can get through behind the friend and steps out of the waiting space.
beats.chinese: 她看了眼能从朋友背后过去，从等人的地方走开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll tell them where to find me later. I don't have to spend another hour telling them how much fun I'm having.
beats.chinese: 晚点在哪儿见，我会跟他们说。省得又待上一个钟头，光说我玩得可有意思了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises a hand in farewell without asking the friend to stop browsing.
beats.chinese: 她抬手告个别，没叫朋友放下手里看的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They've got the right to like it here. I got a bus to catch.
beats.chinese: 人家喜欢这里挺好的。我还有车要赶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another visit, Josephine sees you beneath the market roof and moves her bag in from the edge of a line.
beats.chinese: 改天，约瑟芬在市场棚下看见你，把袋子从队伍边上往里收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I came here for one sandwich and found a line where nobody's trying to make friends. That's a very good line.
beats.chinese: 嘿，来买个三明治，正好排进一条谁也不想认识谁的队。这队比哪儿都好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Someone ahead moves a step. Josephine follows at once.
beats.chinese: 前面的人挪了一步，约瑟芬立刻跟上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look, it's even moving. I might have to start recommending this place.
beats.chinese: 瞧，还真往前走呢。看来我得开始给人推荐这儿了。

causality.presenceReason: 陪外地亲友来市场划掉半日清单
causality.placeAttitude: 看东西可以，日常店里的安静更吸引
causality.stayingConstraint: 亲友在前头淘衣服，还有半日自由
causality.currentGoal: 决定是否去陌生超市逛
causality.currentState: 有点受够在出名地方看到工作宣传，不迁怒游客
causality.contactTrigger: 游客和朋友错认同一件衣，她把自己要找的普通东西说给旁边人
causality.characterContinuity: 不上班的时间不谈水族馆业务，不要求友人一整天陪她
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 各逛各的。ab 约下一段一起。ba 把时间给朋友。bb 自己走，不假装高兴
causality.spatialContinuity: 棚廊公共通道，超市在别处，仅作之后的去向
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来排队的新事不依赖旧约

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A wooden door the size of a hand opens inside Reginald's shopping bag. He pushes it closed and it opens again.
beats.chinese: 雷金纳德购物袋里，一扇巴掌大的木门弹开了。他往回按，手一松又开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's not broken. That right there is a door with a strong opinion.
beats.chinese: 没坏啊。你眼前这是扇特有主意的门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shows you the little model before it can swing into a rack of clothes.
beats.chinese: 他让你看那模型，没让小门晃到挂衣服的架子上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm filming it. I said I wouldn't buy new stuff this month. Then I stood right here thinking about glue for a full minute.
beats.chinese: 拍动画用的。我说了这个月不买新材料。然后就在这里，为买不买胶想了整一分钟。

choices.english: Ask why it won't stay closed.
choices.chinese: 问为什么关不上。

choices.english: Ask what else he's got left to use.
choices.chinese: 问他手边还剩什么材料。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses each corner in turn. The lower one touches before the upper one.
beats.chinese: 他挨个去按门角。底下那只角先碰到框，上头还够不着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Old panel, damp air. Look, the thing's been in a shed. So have I and I don't shut any better.
beats.chinese: 旧板，再加上空气潮，在棚里放过一阵嘛。我也在棚里待过，出来一样不省心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops with a finger on the crooked edge.
beats.chinese: 他把手指停在歪斜的边上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or I put it on crooked. The camera'd see it even if I didn't say it.
beats.chinese: 也可能就是我装歪了。我不说，镜头又不是拍不出来。

choices.english: Give the crooked corner a closer look.
choices.chinese: 再仔细瞧一眼歪的地方。

choices.english: Make the door's bad fit part of the film.
choices.chinese: 把门关不上这件事拍进片里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the model steady over the mouth of the bag.
beats.chinese: 他把模型稳稳托在袋口上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Card, foam, a piece of wood nobody wanted. I can always shoot it from an angle where that corner's at the back.
beats.chinese: 硬纸板、泡沫，还有块谁都不要的木头。我也可以找个角度拍，把那只角留背面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A corner opens again. He lets it.
beats.chinese: 又弹开一角，他没再去按。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not buying glue to fix a door on a thing that doesn't have an inside.
beats.chinese: 我不为了给一个压根没有里面的东西关门，就去买胶。

choices.english: Put it away and see how it looks on camera.
choices.chinese: 先收起来，拍的时候再看效果。

choices.english: Try one of the bits he's already got.
choices.chinese: 试试现成那些边角料。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the model sideways, lining the edge up with the flat of his hand.
beats.chinese: 他把模型侧过来，让那条边和手掌对齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. It's me. I fit it with the top leaning in. That's exactly the face my choir director makes at me.
beats.chinese: 嗯，是我。我安的时候上头朝里歪了。合唱指挥就老给我你现在这个脸色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at the corner again and doesn't take it indoors to buy anything.
beats.chinese: 他又细看了看那个角，没往摊里走去买东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Well. My note was flat, and my door isn't.
beats.chinese: 行，我的音唱低了，门又装斜了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the box level, then lets the little door spring out this time.
beats.chinese: 他把盒端平，这回由着小门弹出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That's the whole third scene. He kicks it, it opens behind him, and he thinks he fixed it.
beats.chinese: 瞧，第三场全有了。他踢一下，门在他背后弹开，他还当自己修好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Reginald holds the next position for an imaginary frame, smiling.
beats.chinese: 雷金纳德笑着把门保持在下一格该在的位置，像真有个镜头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I know that man. I do his voice and everything.
beats.chinese: 我认识那个人。他说话什么的，我也会学。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the model into the bag with the door facing out.
beats.chinese: 他把模型滑进袋里，门朝外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it open on the table tonight. The camera can be the first one to tell me if it's that bad.
beats.chinese: 今晚让它敞着搁桌上。真有那么歪，就让镜头第一个告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves the bag open, keeping a hand around the top.
beats.chinese: 他没合袋口，一只手拢在上面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still got my money. That I can tell without a close up.
beats.chinese: 钱还在手里。这个一眼就看得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He feels along a piece of folded card at the bottom of his bag.
beats.chinese: 他顺袋底摸过一张叠好的硬纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough to hold it out of sight between frames. If it's ugly I'll turn the lamp down. I've got a lamp already.
beats.chinese: 这点够拍的时候在背面垫住。要是难看，灯调暗点儿。灯我总有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets the model down snugly beside the card.
beats.chinese: 他把模型放稳，正挨着那张纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The curtain of darkness, brought to you by stuff I already paid for.
beats.chinese: 等会儿一黑到底，器材全是以前就掏过钱的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later day under the market roof, Reginald spots you and shows a blank corner of a folded page.
beats.chinese: 后来有一天，雷金纳德在市场棚下瞧见你，给你看折页的一处白角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I'm writing the credits. I wrote somebody else directed my stubborn little door on account of that being the easier man to blame.
beats.chinese: 嘿，写片尾演职员呢。我给那个破门的故事安了另外一个导演，这样有事好赖人家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He flattens the sheet and puts a pencil down where the name will go.
beats.chinese: 他把纸捋平，铅笔点在该写名字的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I guess I can put mine. Heard worse in the choir.
beats.chinese: 还是写自己吧。合唱的时候，比这狠的话我都听过。

causality.presenceReason: 和家人走市场楼廊，自己不买新手工材料
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢旧货和边角，不想被冲动支配
causality.stayingConstraint: 买卖可看但不买
causality.currentGoal: 解决旧料样模的柜门关不上
causality.currentState: 被戳穿以前一个地方没做对就先找借口
causality.contactTrigger: 他举旧柜门用的模型时纸角在衣架前转开，玩家看到了合不上
causality.characterContinuity: 习惯把错误推给老料，在合唱里倒愿意认，仍守这个月不买
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 瞧见拧歪了自己认一次。ab 换成片中动作。ba 原样收回。bb 用剩料做方案
causality.spatialContinuity: 棚廊顾客侧，只玩安全的无电纸模，不提维修步骤
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来写一段影片字幕

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile stops by a row of clothes. His sister catches up and holds two fingers up for him to see.
beats.chinese: 埃米尔在一排衣服旁停住。他妹妹追上来，竖起两根指头给他看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two jobs, yeah. Both about done. Don't put those two fingers so close together.
beats.chinese: 两份活儿，对，都快完了。你别让那俩指头靠这么近。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shows him a piece of paper. Both lines end with the same day. She leaves him with it and takes a step down the aisle.
beats.chinese: 她给他看张纸。两行最后是同一天。纸往他手上一搁，人沿过道迈出去一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You heard any of that? I told two people Thursday. I only have one Thursday.
beats.chinese: 你听到没？我跟俩人都说周四拿。我手里就一个周四。

choices.english: Ask what's actually ready now.
choices.chinese: 问现在到底做好什么了。

choices.english: Ask if his sister is going to help with the work.
choices.chinese: 问他妹是不是准备帮他干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the sheet, then closes it before he reads the second line again.
beats.chinese: 他掀开纸，第二行还没重看，就又合上了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The rolls are on the rack. I got the lengths down. That's what I got done.
beats.chinese: 两卷料上了架，长度我记下了。目前做完的就是这些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the fold between two fingers until the paper bends under its own weight.
beats.chinese: 他两根指头夹住纸的折缝，纸靠自己的分量往下一弯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can call somebody and change the date. I could also say not cut yet without saying ninety per cent first.
beats.chinese: 可以打给其中一个，把日期改了。也可以先说还没裁，不先说做了九成。

choices.english: Call now and move one of the deadlines.
choices.chinese: 现在就打，先改一份的日期。

choices.english: Just tell the customers what's actually been done.
choices.chinese: 照实告诉人家真干到哪儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls the sheet back when his sister motions towards it.
beats.chinese: 妹妹朝那张纸伸手，他把纸往回一拉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. She doesn't do this work. She can keep asking whether my numbers add up. She wouldn't want the scissors.
beats.chinese: 不啊，她不干这个。她可以接着问我数加不加得上。剪刀她才不要拿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the sheet again. This time it fits inside his shirt pocket.
beats.chinese: 他又折了一次，这回能装进衬衫兜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's going to ask if both have been cut. Might be a shorter conversation than she thinks.
beats.chinese: 她肯定问两份是不是都已经裁了。我俩说的可能比她想的短。

choices.english: Give him room to go handle the work himself.
choices.chinese: 给他留点空，让他自己处理活儿。

choices.english: Ask him to tell his sister the short version now.
choices.chinese: 请他现在就跟妹妹讲那句短的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finds the first number and dials it without walking away.
beats.chinese: 他找到头一个号码，原地拨了过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm calling about the canvas. No, it's not ready to pick up. Can you wait till Monday? If you can't, tell me now.
beats.chinese: 是我，您那块帆布还不能来取，对。能等到周一吗？等不了，就现在告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He listens until the call has ended before looking at either line again.
beats.chinese: 他一直听着，等电话挂了，才再看其中那两行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She'll get it somewhere else. I knew that could happen. Still don't like hearing it.
beats.chinese: 她去别处做了。我知道有可能。真听到了还是不舒服。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He writes two separate messages and pauses after the first few words of each.
beats.chinese: 他分开写了两条消息，每条起头才打几个字就停一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I have the cloth. It isn't cut. Lord, I should've put that in the first one.
beats.chinese: 布拿到了。还没裁。老天，我头一回怎么就没这么写呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends both messages and leaves the sheet open on his hand.
beats.chinese: 他两条都发了，纸在手掌上留着没合。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I'll let them decide what they want to do with Thursday.
beats.chinese: 现在看他们想怎么过这个周四吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the paper in the pocket and takes the edge of the aisle, behind his sister.
beats.chinese: 他没再摸纸，沿过道侧边去跟在妹妹后头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yep. I'm the one who said I'd do both. I can lose a customer without asking her to stand there and watch.
beats.chinese: 嗯。说两件都能做的是我。我丢个客人，不至于还得把我妹喊来现场看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits for a group to clear the next stretch.
beats.chinese: 前头一拨人把路让空了些，他等在那儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Renée. I'm going back to the shop after this.
beats.chinese: 蕾妮，这边完了我回工间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the sheet out and holds it flat when his sister comes back.
beats.chinese: 妹妹一回来，他就抽出纸摊平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Neither. I didn't cut either one. Don't ask me to say it twice before I go ring them.
beats.chinese: 都没裁。俩都没裁。别叫我再说一遍，先让我去打电话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His sister lets her hands fall and puts a cup in the free one he has out.
beats.chinese: 他妹放下手，把一只杯子塞进他伸着的那只空手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Coffee. That's the first thing anybody's handed me that's ready today.
beats.chinese: 咖啡，今天总算有人把真做好的东西递给我了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A different day under the roof, Emile recognises you as he turns a lined notebook to a fresh page.
beats.chinese: 改天在棚廊下，埃米尔认出你，翻开横线本上新的一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I drew the first half of this trip. I've only driven the first half, which is why I ran out of ink at lunch.
beats.chinese: 嘿，这趟路我画了前半程。我也就真开过前半程。于是画到吃午饭，笔就像没墨了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the empty half open with his little finger.
beats.chinese: 他拿小拇指抵着空着的半页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll drive it before I tell anybody it's a good way home.
beats.chinese: 剩下的得先开一趟，再告诉别人这条路好不好走。

causality.presenceReason: 走市场等妹妹把客人的来话原样捎来
causality.placeAttitude: 能边走边保持淡定，常在货面前被逼明说
causality.stayingConstraint: 出了棚廊迟些又要开工，今天给真日期
causality.currentGoal: 让提前许下的两份活儿排出次序
causality.currentState: 说顺了就想再编个进度，看到两条信息撞上开始沉默
causality.contactTrigger: 妹妹把两个期限写在一张纸上，恰好被刚经过的玩家听见
causality.characterContinuity: 看料准但好夸进度，不接受陌生人盯在手边
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 打电话改一个日期。ab 说清只完成准备。ba 不请人检查。bb 向妹妹承认两份都没裁
causality.spatialContinuity: 法国市场棚廊顾客位，帆布在工间
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来路线图承认只画实际的一段

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the foot of the museum steps, a woman lifts her palm just before her neighbour finishes a sentence.
beats.chinese: 博物馆台阶底下，一个女人赶在邻居一句话讲完前把手掌一抬。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No names! I missed the last part. Give me twenty minutes when I get home.
beats.chinese: 别说人名！后面我还没听。让我到家先听二十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The neighbour shuts her mouth and steps towards the entrance. Achieng catches your eye and gives a little laugh.
beats.chinese: 邻居合上嘴，朝入口走了一步。阿钱看见你正好在瞧，忍不住笑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's the radio detective. I heard a man washing a cup after the police had gone. That's all I've got to work with.
beats.chinese: 电台那个侦探故事。我听见警察一走就有个男的开始洗杯子。手里就这一条。

choices.english: Ask what she made of the sound.
choices.chinese: 问她觉得洗杯子这一声有什么古怪。

choices.english: Leave the mystery alone until she's heard the end.
choices.chinese: 等阿钱听到结局再聊谜底。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the corner of a little cloth bag and folds it over her thumb.
beats.chinese: 她捏住小布袋一个角，在拇指上折过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He washed it twice. I thought he'd left something on it. Then I remembered I wash mine twice when there's milk in the tea.
beats.chinese: 洗了两遍。我原想是他把什么留杯子上了。后来想起来，我茶里放了奶，杯也过两遍水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks back at the steps where the neighbour stopped.
beats.chinese: 她望回邻居停住的台阶那头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could give her my guess. If her face does anything, that's my own fault.
beats.chinese: 可以跟她说我猜谁。她脸上要有点儿什么，那得怪我自己看了。

choices.english: Ask the neighbour not to react to the guess.
choices.chinese: 请邻居听见猜测也别露表情。

choices.english: Let Achieng offer her guess and watch her own reaction.
choices.chinese: 让阿钱先猜，再想自己听着成不成立。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws the bag against her side and smiles at the neighbour without speaking to her yet.
beats.chinese: 她把袋子收在身侧，冲邻居笑笑，没直接开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. Last week a man told me the detective's brother did it before I'd even put the radio on. I had to listen as if the brother was a surprise.
beats.chinese: 也好。上周有个人在我连收音机都还没开的时候，就说是侦探他弟干的。我还得听得好像真没想到是他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A pointed wooden beak sticks out over the flap of the bag.
beats.chinese: 袋盖上面支出一截尖尖的木头鸟嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got this to hand over, anyhow. They only asked me for the one bird.
beats.chinese: 反正我还得去把这个交了。人家就叫我做一只鸟。

choices.english: Ask about the carving instead.
choices.chinese: 换个话题，只问木头鸟。

choices.english: Leave her to get the bird where it needs to go.
choices.chinese: 让她先去把道具鸟交了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds a hand up to the neighbour and leans in just enough to be heard.
beats.chinese: 她向邻居抬了只手，再稍微凑近一点儿，好让人听清。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I think it's the one who washed the cup. Don't give me your eyebrows.
beats.chinese: 我猜洗杯子那位。你的眉毛可别动啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The neighbour covers her eyebrows at once. Achieng bursts out laughing.
beats.chinese: 邻居一下把眉毛捂住了。阿钱扑地笑了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's worse. I'll have to go home as fast as I can now.
beats.chinese: 这下更糟。我现在要赶紧回家听了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She watches a pair of shoes come down the museum steps before she says it aloud.
beats.chinese: 她看着一双鞋从博物馆台阶走下来，才把话说出口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The man with the cup. No, there was another person in the kitchen, wasn't there? Listen to me trying to change my answer before anybody says a word.
beats.chinese: 拿杯子那个。不对，厨房里是不是还有一个人？瞧我，人家一句还没说，我已经忙着改答案了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses her hand flat against the bag and steps to the courtyard side.
beats.chinese: 她把手掌按平在袋子上，往庭院那边站一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll live with being wrong once. Haven't even heard it yet.
beats.chinese: 猜错一回也没事。再说我还没听呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the flap until the bird's one large painted eye is visible.
beats.chinese: 她放低袋盖，露出鸟那只画得老大的眼睛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It needs to read as a bird from the back row. First one everybody read as a glove on the floor.
beats.chinese: 要让最后一排也看出是鸟。头一只看着像地上掉了个手套。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She brings the flap up before the beak can touch the strap.
beats.chinese: 她赶在鸟嘴碰到包带前把袋盖拉回来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We'll see how far away it can get before it turns into a glove again.
beats.chinese: 看看这回得坐多远，它才又变回手套。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the bag by the middle instead of the handle and moves towards the entrance side.
beats.chinese: 她没拿袋把，从中间托着包，往入口一侧走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll meet the people who wanted this. If she comes after me to tell me the ending, I'll keep walking.
beats.chinese: 我去找要这个的人。她要追上来告诉我结局，我就接着往前走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The neighbour calls out something that isn't a name. Achieng raises a single finger without stopping.
beats.chinese: 邻居喊了句，倒没叫任何人名。阿钱竖起一根指头，脚步没停。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still no hints!
beats.chinese: 提示也不许给！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day in the museum courtyard, Achieng recognises you with a wooden bird tucked face in against a bag.
beats.chinese: 又一天在博物馆庭院，阿钱拿着只木头鸟，鸟脸朝里挨着袋子，正好认出你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I cut the new beak a little shorter. From the front he looks annoyed. From the side he looks like he's waiting to be fed.
beats.chinese: 你好。新嘴给削短了点。正面看像不高兴，侧着看又像在等人喂饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the bird a few inches and tilts her own head with it.
beats.chinese: 她把鸟转过去一点，自己的头也跟着歪过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I didn't plan either. They can have both.
beats.chinese: 哪一个也不是我特地做的。两个样子都给他们吧。

causality.presenceReason: 门外等邻居，准备给附近排戏的人送道具鸟
causality.placeAttitude: 博物馆入口外可以边等边留心人
causality.stayingConstraint: 不打扰入口通行，私事不当谜题猜
causality.currentGoal: 确认邻居能不能等她补听结局
causality.currentState: 气自己先没忍住试探，猜错也接受
causality.contactTrigger: 邻居差点说出凶手，她紧急打断，又向听到的玩家说明
causality.characterContinuity: 热爱推理，不剧透没听完的人，不把真实损失拿来做谜题
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 对方不给答案。ab 自己猜完当场改口。ba 换个安静话题。bb 去交道具不听谜底
causality.spatialContinuity: 外庭院和入口斜坡分开，不在梯中站谈
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新做的道具鸟有自己的造型经过

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru stands clear of the ramp and writes one line on a pad. She looks up before taking the pen off the paper.
beats.chinese: 万吉鲁站在不挡斜坡的地方，在便签本上写了一行，笔没抬起来，人先抬头了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Did you hear the man say he brought his good shoes and left his good knees at home?
beats.chinese: 你听见刚才那位说没？好鞋倒穿来了，好膝盖忘家里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets her thumbnail at the end of the unfinished line.
beats.chinese: 她把拇指甲放在还没写完的行尾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I write a little column. That's exactly the kind of line I take home without asking. The man's still right over there.
beats.chinese: 我写个小专栏。这种顺耳的句子，我老是不问就记回家。说话的人就在那儿呢。

choices.english: Suggest asking him before using his words.
choices.chinese: 拿人家的话去登之前，先问他一声。

choices.english: Tell her something said out loud can still be private.
choices.chinese: 跟她说，不是在人前说了就能登。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She brings the pad up but does not move towards the man yet.
beats.chinese: 她把本举起来，没马上朝男人那儿走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can ask him. What I liked was that he didn't stop going up the steps when he said it.
beats.chinese: 可以问。其实我最喜欢的是，他边说边往台阶上走，一步也没停。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the pen down in the fold of the pad.
beats.chinese: 她把笔放进本子的折缝。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't need his name. I also don't need to put his knees in the paper if he doesn't want that.
beats.chinese: 不用写他叫什么。他要不愿意看见自己的膝盖上报，我也不必非写。

choices.english: Keep the ordinary movement without making him identifiable.
choices.chinese: 只记人走台阶那一下，让人认不出是谁。

choices.english: Find something of her own instead of the quote.
choices.chinese: 换成她自己的事，不用那句话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru moves the pen back behind the last complete word.
beats.chinese: 万吉鲁把笔尖退回最后一个写完的词后边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: True. My son says not for print before he even says hello on Sundays. He shouldn't have to.
beats.chinese: 确实。我儿子星期天来电话，回应我的第一句连你好都没有，先说这可不许登。他本来不用这么提防我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks at the man, still near the entrance, then back at the pad.
beats.chinese: 她望了眼还在入口附近的男人，又看回本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can leave the sentence here and just see whether he wants to talk.
beats.chinese: 我可以把这句先搁下，就问他愿不愿意聊两句。

choices.english: Ask her to cross the line out.
choices.chinese: 请她把那句话划掉。

choices.english: Suggest putting the notebook away while she listens.
choices.chinese: 建议把本收了，听的时候别拿着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She goes over to the steps, gets the man's attention and listens to him before making another note.
beats.chinese: 她走到台阶旁，叫住那位，先听人说完，才再记字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He said the shoes can go in. He picked them out himself and stepped over the puddle in one try.
beats.chinese: 他说鞋可以写。他自己挑的，地上有滩水，他一步就迈了过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws one line through the words about knees.
beats.chinese: 她沿关于膝盖的那几个词划一道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep the step. No name, no knees.
beats.chinese: 就记迈那一步。不写名字，也不写膝盖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to a clean page and puts the first pad under her arm.
beats.chinese: 她翻到干净的纸，把原来那本挟到胳膊底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll write what I did in my good shoes today. I stood at the bottom of the steps to finish a sentence.
beats.chinese: 写我自己穿双好鞋做了什么吧。我站在台阶底下，就为写完一句话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks at the top of the steps and sticks the pen into her bag.
beats.chinese: 她往台阶顶望了望，把笔插进包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It may get better if I go somewhere after that.
beats.chinese: 后头我再往哪儿走一趟，兴许就有点意思了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She crosses the rest of it out, using two strokes so she can't read it through the ink.
beats.chinese: 她把剩下的也划了。特地划两道，透过墨也再读不出。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Gone. He can say it again in five minutes and it'll still be his.
beats.chinese: 没了。五分钟后他再说一遍，也还是他自己的话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shuts the pad and looks towards the ramp to find her friend.
beats.chinese: 她合上本子，朝斜坡那边找朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to see if her good shoes made it.
beats.chinese: 我去看看，我朋友的好鞋是不是也来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She clips the pad shut, then gives the man a quiet greeting from a few steps away.
beats.chinese: 她把本扣好，隔几步远轻声跟男人打个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've put the book away, yes. I can hear you from here.
beats.chinese: 我把本子收起来了，对。你站那儿说我也听得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The man turns to face her. She keeps both hands where he can see that they are empty.
beats.chinese: 男人转身朝她说话。她两只手就那么空着，让他看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Everything was out of his pockets but the thing he came to show me. I'll be here again Thursday if he wants to show me.
beats.chinese: 兜里什么都掏出来了，偏偏原本想给我看的没带。他还想给我看，我周四会再来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week, Wanjiru sees you outside the museum holding a piece of fabric up by two corners.
beats.chinese: 过几天，万吉鲁在博物馆外看见你时，正捏着俩角举一块布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. That's a leaf print. There was still a piece of leaf inside when I took the cloth off the press.
beats.chinese: 你好，这个是叶印。从压板底下揭布的时候，里面还夹着一块叶子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tilts the cloth. A red shape shows through both sides.
beats.chinese: 她把布斜过来。一个红色的叶形从两面都看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I pulled it out. The bit I wanted stayed.
beats.chinese: 叶子撕下来了。我想留下的那一点还在。

causality.presenceReason: 等参观朋友从斜坡一侧进入，收集社区报的小细节
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢门外看人怎样接手一件普通事
causality.stayingConstraint: 还没取得对方同意，停笔也可以
causality.currentGoal: 确认陌生人愿不愿意把一句话给她写
causality.currentState: 一开口老把报上普通细节直接视为可用
causality.contactTrigger: 她笔刚落到便笺，玩家随意见到，先止住解释用途
causality.characterContinuity: 明确不许登就照做，不接受临时免费培训别人
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 只记无身份动作。ab 放弃原话改记自己的事。ba 划去。bb 收起笔听独立故事
causality.spatialContinuity: 入口外，保持斜坡不被挡

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man near the museum ramp has one hand inside a tightly packed daypack. A folded umbrella handle sticks out.
beats.chinese: 博物馆斜坡附近，一个男人一手伸进塞得鼓鼓囊囊的小包。里头支出一把折伞的柄。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend sent, does Peter have an umbrella. Not hello. Not are you here.
beats.chinese: 朋友发的，彼得带伞了吗。没问你好，也没问我到了没。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the bag by its base so the zipper stops pulling.
beats.chinese: 他从包底往上托住，拉链没再绷那么紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Peter has one, yes. He has also got a walk home.
beats.chinese: 彼得带了，是。他自己还有一段路要走回家呢。

choices.english: Ask if he needs to keep his umbrella today.
choices.chinese: 问今天是不是得留着自己用。

choices.english: Ask if the friend has checked with anybody else.
choices.chinese: 问那人有没有问过别人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peter straightens the umbrella against the opening and puts the handle back in.
beats.chinese: 彼得沿包口把伞放正，露出的伞柄也塞回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. It's a small one. Last time I stayed right under it, I got one dry shoulder.
beats.chinese: 是。小的。上次我站它正底下，回家也就一个肩膀没湿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances towards the sloped approach, where another pair is coming through.
beats.chinese: 他瞧向斜坡上来的地方。又有两个人一起走过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If we're going the same way, she can walk with me a bit. If she's taking it away, what am I meant to use?
beats.chinese: 要顺一段路，我俩能一起走走。她要整个拿走，我又拿什么呢？

choices.english: Tell him to keep it for himself.
choices.chinese: 让他这次留给自己。

choices.english: Offer the part of the walk they actually share.
choices.chinese: 提议只共用顺路的那一段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses the pack shut with one hand and reads the group message back.
beats.chinese: 他用一只手把包按合，重新读一遍群消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: First person she asked was me. She didn't even put my name in that message. It says does he have one now.
beats.chinese: 她第一个就问我。后头名字都忘了写，就剩一句他现在有没有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the bag closed.
beats.chinese: 他把包口合住没动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could say I've got what I need. I don't need to lay the contents out for everybody.
beats.chinese: 可以说我就带了自己要用的。也不用把包里的东西件件摆给人看。

choices.english: Don't open the bag for the group.
choices.chinese: 别替群里一件一件找。

choices.english: Let the friend ask the whole group first.
choices.chinese: 请那位也先把群里其他人问一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He zips the pack and adjusts one strap at the shoulder.
beats.chinese: 他拉上包，肩上调了一边背带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I need mine today. I put today on the end because tomorrow I might have a bigger one.
beats.chinese: 我今天要用我这把。特地写今天，明天说不定我带个大的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the entrance sign and starts across the courtyard.
beats.chinese: 他看一眼入口标识，迈步穿过庭院。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's not much of an emergency. I can go on and look at the museum now.
beats.chinese: 没多大点急事。我现在也能踏实看博物馆了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends a message before pushing the second strap up his arm.
beats.chinese: 他发一条消息，才把第二根带子往胳膊上提。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can try till we split off. Tell her I'm keeping the drier shoulder. No, I won't write that last bit.
beats.chinese: 分开以前可以试试。告诉她，干的那边肩归我。算了，最后那句我不写。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The little handle reappears when he opens the top pocket a crack.
beats.chinese: 他把顶袋拉开一条缝，那段小伞柄又露出来了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll hand it to her when we start. I duck better than she does.
beats.chinese: 动身了让她撑。我比她会低头。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps his hand on the closed zipper, then moves it to the strap instead.
beats.chinese: 他一开始还搭着拉好的拉链，后来干脆换到背带上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If they ask what else is in there, it's my lunch. They don't need to know what kind.
beats.chinese: 再问里头有什么，那是我午饭。什么午饭就不用知道了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finds a clear place on the courtyard side and waits there.
beats.chinese: 他在庭院一侧找到块不挡路的地方，在那儿等。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Somebody who came to see me can still come and see me.
beats.chinese: 谁原本是来找我本人的，还是可以来找我本人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps the original message and replies where the rest of the group can see it.
beats.chinese: 他点那条原消息，在其他人也能瞧见的地方回。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ask anybody who hasn't left home. I said that. Didn't volunteer anybody's spare.
beats.chinese: 我回的是，问问还没出门的人吧。没替谁答应借备用的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the phone beside the handle and pulls the same zipper shut.
beats.chinese: 他把手机放到伞柄旁，拉上原来那个拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Between all of them somebody ought to know where they've put their umbrella.
beats.chinese: 这么多人，总得有一个知道自家伞放哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another morning outside the museum, Peter is turning a little torch in his hands when he sees you. He switches it off just as you approach.
beats.chinese: 另一个早上，彼得在博物馆外手里正翻着把小手电，一见你走近便摁灭了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. It works. I've had three people ask if it works. None of us thought to press the button until now.
beats.chinese: 你好，能亮。已经三个人问我能不能亮了。到现在咱们才有个人想起来按一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the cap once and drops the torch in his pack.
beats.chinese: 他检查了一回尾盖，把手电丢进包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I won't lend it to the first person who says they want to check again.
beats.chinese: 第一个说还想再试的人，我不借给他。

causality.presenceReason: 值班外来门前接朋友，背着自己的长程包
causality.placeAttitude: 斜坡口空间够，在庭院说话再放东西
causality.stayingConstraint: 当日还要走一段无处补东西
causality.currentGoal: 选择能不能把仅剩的东西借给朋友
causality.currentState: 被问得习惯性要找包，却确实得留自己用
causality.contactTrigger: 手机一亮，他往包里找时顶住拉链，身边玩家正瞧见
causality.characterContinuity: 能借就借，确实需要就说不，不用他人守着自己的库存
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 自己留伞。ab 一起走一段。ba 不替别人逐件翻。bb 同意转发找其他人
causality.spatialContinuity: 人站入口外庭院，斜坡旁不挡路
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 修灯是另一次独立小事

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: From the courtyard, Baraka draws a broad grey stripe beneath the entrance in a little sketchbook. Then several pairs of feet cross their view.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡站在庭院里，在速写本上给入口下面画了道宽宽的灰带。转眼，好几双脚经过那块地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And the dark part's gone. Got the people instead. Looked for a second like the whole front had moved.
beats.chinese: 暗的那截没了，换成了一排人。就那一秒，看着像整个门面都往前动了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tip the pencil point away from the book and glance over at you.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡把铅笔尖拿离本子，朝你瞟了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a story about a cinema where the light did that. Are you looking at the door or have I caught you on the way in?
beats.chinese: 我知道有家电影院，光也这么走过一回。你是在看门口，还是已经要进去了？

choices.english: Stay and hear one bit of the cinema story.
choices.chinese: 留一会儿，听电影院的那一段。

choices.english: Say you were watching the actual footsteps.
choices.chinese: 说你正看眼前的人是怎么走的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka closes the sketchbook through a finger to hold the drawing in place.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡留根手指夹着画，合到那一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: '84. People spent the first five minutes going back out for somebody's coat. In the booth I could see the beam change on every person.
beats.chinese: 八四年。开头五分钟，老有人又出去替谁拿外套。我在放映间，能看见光挨个人身上换了样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look at you for a second before loosening the cover.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡先看你片刻，才把封皮松开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The film was going the whole time. If you've seen a better picture with people just walking, I can leave the film out.
beats.chinese: 电影一直没停。你要见过光是走几个人就更好看的画面，那部片我也可以不讲。

choices.english: Ask what the people did to the light.
choices.chinese: 问那几个人怎么把光弄变了。

choices.english: Tell them about the view from your side.
choices.chinese: 转过来，说说你站这边看到的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka lowers the book. The pencil stays in the fingers holding its spine.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡放下了本子，铅笔还捏在扶着书脊的那只手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. That's the thing we're both looking at. I can leave '84 where it was.
beats.chinese: 好，就看咱俩都在看的这一层。八四年的事先留在八四年。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They track another visitor as far as the entrance sign.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡望着又一位来客一直走到入口标识那儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can stop drawing if there's somebody here I ought to be listening to.
beats.chinese: 真有人该让我听听他说什么，我也可以先停笔。

choices.english: Leave them to draw the entrance.
choices.chinese: 留巴拉卡继续画入口。

choices.english: Ask if they want to see the view from here.
choices.chinese: 问巴拉卡想不想换到你这边看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka opens the sketchbook at the dark stripe and runs a pencil tip down one part of it.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡把本打开到灰条那一页，拿铅笔尖在一处往下比了比。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Black when it hit the coat first. Then blue on one man's shirt. He was still looking for a seat and managed to look like the star.
beats.chinese: 起先照着大衣，黑的。后来落一个男人衬衫上就成了蓝的。他还在找座，倒照得跟主演似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The pencil rests as the museum entrance clears.
beats.chinese: 博物馆入口人影散了，笔尖也就停在那儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the bit I remember. The film I couldn't tell you.
beats.chinese: 我记住的就这一点。电影是哪部，我倒真说不上来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka keeps the book down and listens without looking back at the door.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡把本放低，听的时候没回头看门。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: From where you are the feet get there before the face. Right. I drew it the other way.
beats.chinese: 从你那儿看，脚先到，脸还看不见。是了，我把它画反了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They open the page, erase the first inch of the grey stripe and stop.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡翻开那页，把灰带开头一英寸擦了，就停下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can leave that piece out. You don't have to make another point for me.
beats.chinese: 这截空着就可以了。你不用再替我找第二处。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They close the book and let another walker cross in front before they move.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡合上本，等又一个行人从前头走过才动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'll come back to it when there's room for the pencil to catch up.
beats.chinese: 谢了。等有空让笔追上我看的，再回头画。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They walk two steps along the courtyard and look straight at the opening.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡沿庭院走两步，朝那道入口直直望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Door's right where I left it.
beats.chinese: 门倒还在我刚看的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They move along the level part of the courtyard to stand just to the side of you.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡在庭院平地那段走动，站到你旁边一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. That stripe isn't as thick from here. Let's not tell the person drawing over there what we've just worked out.
beats.chinese: 哦，从这儿看灰带没那么粗。刚弄明白的这点，别跑去告诉在那儿画画的人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The book stays shut while the next walker comes through.
beats.chinese: 下一个人经过，本子也没再打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just watch. I can draw at home.
beats.chinese: 就看看吧，回家还能画。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week at the museum, Baraka spots you as they shade a little paper cutout with an open hand.
beats.chinese: 过几天在博物馆，巴拉卡瞧见你时，正摊开一只手给手里一小块刻过的纸遮光。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I cut out the whole front of an old cinema and found I can get it with three holes in a piece of paper.
beats.chinese: 你好，我刻了座老影院整个前脸，才发现，其实一片纸上开三个洞就够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift the cutout a little and let three ovals of light fall on their shirt.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡把剪纸提起来一点，三个椭圆形的亮斑正落到衬衫上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That would have saved me a great deal of glue.
beats.chinese: 早知道，能省我好些胶。

causality.presenceReason: 到博物馆外画一眼入口亮面与阴面
causality.placeAttitude: 能坐不坐，喜欢步道换方向看外立面
causality.stayingConstraint: 还约了姐姐迟点见，只画靠外的一张
causality.currentGoal: 试出来纸模型里要不要加一层暗
causality.currentState: 察觉对方有在听才接着讲，没人听就停住
causality.contactTrigger: 上台阶的一群人盖住影子，他把刚举的图收下来看玩家反应
causality.characterContinuity: 听别人把话讲完，不靠自己有老电影院故事逼人听
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 从当前影子认出来一道有趣的边。ab 改听玩家说实物。ba 暂时收纸。bb 欢迎另一个视角但不硬讲
causality.spatialContinuity: 庭院、入口外、不声称进入固定展区
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来在室外看自家的纸模型

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Brian counts up to eight under his breath on the dirt path, then turns almost straight into you.
beats.chinese: 布莱恩在土路上低声数到八，一转身差点直冲你过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. That was meant to be ten. And that was meant to be the other way.
beats.chinese: 不好意思。本来得数到十。人也该往另一边转。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves both shoes back into line with the path.
beats.chinese: 他把两只脚挪回来，朝正对着路的方向站好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dance class. Apparently I know it if there's a whole row of people in front of me.
beats.chinese: 舞蹈课学的。前头有一整排人让我跟着，我倒会。

choices.english: Ask which foot starts the turn.
choices.chinese: 问转身哪只脚先动。

choices.english: Keep walking and see if he can follow the path instead.
choices.chinese: 先沿步道走，看他顺着路走会不会舒服些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks his shoes one at a time and moves the left one an inch.
beats.chinese: 他两只鞋挨个看过，左脚往外挪了一英寸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Left. That's my left, so it's correct until I see the teacher do it from the front.
beats.chinese: 左。这是我的左边。在我看到老师正面示范以前，肯定都对。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His fingers do a little count beside his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他在衣兜外用几根指头数了数。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could be I added two steps because there was space. I do that with bicycle racks too.
beats.chinese: 也可能是地方够，我自己凭空添了两步。在单位给车架算位置我也会这样。

choices.english: Mark the count where the left foot needs to move.
choices.chinese: 把左脚该动的是第几拍记住。

choices.english: Try the turn once without numbers.
choices.chinese: 别数了，转一次看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Brian steps on the packed middle of the path and stops counting.
beats.chinese: 布莱恩脚踩回压实的路中间，不数了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I know how to do this part. No one gives out a mark for following a path.
beats.chinese: 也是。这段我会。顺一条路走，还没人给分。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A patch of light falls between the branches. He closes his hand where he'd been keeping count.
beats.chinese: 树枝间漏下一块光。他把刚才数拍的那只手握上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can walk the rest. Or pick one tree to face the next time I get confused.
beats.chinese: 可以接着走。或者找棵树，下回糊涂了就朝它站。

choices.english: Leave him to enjoy the walk.
choices.chinese: 让他自己接着走。

choices.english: Let him pick the tree without walking off the path.
choices.chinese: 让他只站在路上，自己挑棵树。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He touches his left toe to the dirt on the last beat.
beats.chinese: 他数到最后一拍，左脚尖点了下地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eight. If I write ten in my head again, please knock two off.
beats.chinese: 八。我要脑子里又记成十，你就帮我减两个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lets a walker go ahead before he tries changing direction gently.
beats.chinese: 他先让一位行人走过去，再轻轻试着变了个方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's it. I finished with a person still standing on both feet. Good class.
beats.chinese: 成了，我转完还有人两脚好好站着。这课没白上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts his weight without moving his lips, and turns before he has a chance to reach the extra beat.
beats.chinese: 他嘴唇没动，身子重心一换，还没机会数多出来那拍就转过去了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Feet remembered. I keep giving them paperwork.
beats.chinese: 啊，脚自己记得。是我一直给它们派文书活儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds both palms empty and starts walking normally.
beats.chinese: 他摊着两只空手，按平常的步子走起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can leave those two numbers here.
beats.chinese: 多出来那俩数，就留这儿吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He falls behind a measured couple of paces and then slows a little more.
beats.chinese: 他先落开两步，又把速度放慢了点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go on. I'll stop trying to bring the class along with me.
beats.chinese: 你先走。我不一路带着那堂课了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His feet disappear around the curve before his voice carries again.
beats.chinese: 走到转弯，那双脚已经看不见了。他声音又远远传来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seven. Ah, never mind.
beats.chinese: 七。哎，算了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at a small tree nearest the bend, then puts his feet parallel on the path.
beats.chinese: 他看着靠弯道最近的一棵小树，两只脚在路上并排站齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one's the front. If I look behind me and it's still there, I'll know what I've done.
beats.chinese: 就那棵算正面。我要看背后发现树还在那儿，就知道自己又怎么转的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps his eyes on it until the next footfall is past.
beats.chinese: 他一直看着树，等下一声脚步走过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tree'll have to stay where I put it.
beats.chinese: 这树最好老老实实待在我给它放的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day, Brian sees you on the forest path and makes a short mark with one toe in loose dirt.
beats.chinese: 换一天在林间路上，布莱恩看见你，鞋尖在松土上划了一小道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Person behind me at dance class thought I was standing in front on purpose. Thought I knew the steps.
beats.chinese: 嘿，舞蹈课站我后边那个，还以为我故意到前排的。以为我会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Brian rubs the mark out with the same toe.
beats.chinese: 布莱恩用同一只鞋尖把印蹭掉了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I had the wrong end of the room. He had a worse afternoon than me.
beats.chinese: 我认反了屋子两头。那一下午他比我还惨。

causality.presenceReason: 下班来林间把舞课新步子缓慢走一回
causality.placeAttitude: 泥上不适合带器材，适合脚下试半步
causality.stayingConstraint: 路上行人优先，树丛不踩进去
causality.currentGoal: 查清自己为什么总朝错方向
causality.currentState: 工作时有把握，到舞课很没把握
causality.contactTrigger: 他数步时差点朝玩家转，先站住才笑自己
