beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At a wide spot in the dirt track, one walker calls for Baraka to tell another walker something. All three are close enough to hear.
beats.chinese: 土路一处宽点的地方，有个散步的人喊巴拉卡替他跟另一个说句话。三人离得够近，全都听得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's right there. You can tell her yourself.
beats.chinese: 人就在那儿，你自己说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Both walkers stop. Baraka looks across the space they've left, towards you.
beats.chinese: 俩人都停住了。巴拉卡越过他们让出的空看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I fixed a drum and suddenly I'm the person who carries the conversation too.
beats.chinese: 我就修了面鼓，怎么一下还得我扛着他俩对话走。

choices.english: Ask what he actually promised about the drum.
choices.chinese: 问他关于鼓到底答应了什么。

choices.english: Say the other two sound quite able to talk.
choices.chinese: 说那俩人听着完全能自己聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stays at the track edge, out of the space between the two people.
beats.chinese: 他站在土路边，没挪进两人中间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They can pick it up tomorrow. They'll both hear that from me. They won't hear a report on what one did to the other.
beats.chinese: 鼓明天拿。这句他俩都能从我嘴里听见。谁对谁做了什么，我不替人汇报。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A walker comes round the bend. Baraka makes room without moving towards either friend.
beats.chinese: 弯道有人过来。巴拉卡给人让路，没往任何一个朋友那儿靠。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Time only, or nothing for now. I don't need the payment he keeps trying to offer.
beats.chinese: 要么只说时间，要么先什么都不说。他一直要给钱，我也用不着。

choices.english: Ask him to say only when the drum is ready.
choices.chinese: 让他就说什么时候能把鼓拿走。

choices.english: Leave both of them to contact him for themselves.
choices.chinese: 让两人之后各自联系他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka folds his hands once and waits without looking at either walker.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡交握起双手，等着，谁也没看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. They can be cross out loud. Having a man in the middle doesn't make it much quieter.
beats.chinese: 是啊，生气可以说出来。中间夹一个人，也安静不了多少。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One of the walkers tries his name again. Baraka lifts his head.
beats.chinese: 有个人又试着喊了他一遍。巴拉卡抬头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could say I don't like being called like that. That's my part. After that I'm done.
beats.chinese: 我可以说，不喜欢你们这么喊我。这归我说。说完我就算了。

choices.english: Take the path away and give them a moment.
choices.chinese: 顺路离开，留那两位一点空。

choices.english: Let him tell them his own grievance once.
choices.chinese: 让他当面把自己的不高兴说一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits until they're both looking at him.
beats.chinese: 他一直等到两人都转过来看他。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Drum's ready tomorrow. Come for it any time after lunch. Mine's the house with the drum in it, that's all.
beats.chinese: 鼓明天修好。午饭后随时来拿。我家就是放鼓的地方，别的没有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He steps to the side and leaves them facing each other.
beats.chinese: 他向一侧迈步，把俩人留在面对面的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I can hear the trees again.
beats.chinese: 好了，这又听得见树上的声了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shakes his head once at a new question and puts his chin back level.
beats.chinese: 又听见有人要问，他摇了下头，下巴放平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Text me about the drum when you know. I'll answer you both. I won't forward the bit before that.
beats.chinese: 知道了怎么领鼓，给我发消息。俩人我都回。前头那些话我不转。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits for the dust left by a passing group to settle.
beats.chinese: 一拨人过了，尘土扬着，他等它落下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's got a nice sound when it isn't in a conversation.
beats.chinese: 鼓不在吵嘴里头的时候，声音挺好听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka starts along the clear side of the path and doesn't look back when one of the other walkers moves.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡从空着的那侧走开。有一个人也动了，他没回头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. They know each other's names.
beats.chinese: 好啊。他俩又不是不知道对方叫啥。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the same pace when the voices behind him get fainter.
beats.chinese: 后面的声音小下去，他步子还跟刚才一样。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I hadn't noticed how dark it was under here today.
beats.chinese: 今天树底下这么暗，我都没注意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts a foot firmly down before he speaks, low and fast.
beats.chinese: 他站稳一只脚，说得低而快。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't call me over again to tell a person standing in front of you something. I don't like it. That's it.
beats.chinese: 别再喊我过来，替你跟正站你眼前的人说话。我不喜欢。就这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives them a moment to reply. Then he steps out of the gap.
beats.chinese: 他留了点时间给那俩回话，才从空隙里走开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Done. Shall we walk?
beats.chinese: 说完了。走走不？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon on the Karura path, Baraka greets you while tapping twice against the back of a finger.
beats.chinese: 换一天下午，巴拉卡在卡鲁拉林间路上招呼你，一根手指背上敲了两下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. A friend wants his drum back tonight. I put the skin on this morning. I'll give it a night before I tell him how it sounds.
beats.chinese: 你好。我朋友今晚想把鼓拿回去。鼓皮今早刚蒙上。我先搁一宿，等明天才告诉他什么响。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps once more, then closes the hand.
beats.chinese: 他又敲一下，把手合上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My finger says fine today. My finger doesn't get a vote.
beats.chinese: 我这手指说今天就行。它说了不算。

causality.presenceReason: 在林里见一对也想把鼓取走的朋友，想一个人走完一段
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意听人，林子里不帮忙把争执搬回家
causality.stayingConstraint: 如果两人自己在场，就退出
causality.currentGoal: 让人自己说鼓的取回时间
causality.currentState: 不因别人抬高嗓门升级，也受够被用作传话
causality.contactTrigger: 朋友从两边叫他，他抬手停住，面前玩家随后经过
causality.characterContinuity: 愿免费修鼓，不调停也不泄露私人本子
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 把可交付时间单独说清。ab 切断传话。ba 走开。bb 直接说不满以后不翻旧账
causality.spatialContinuity: 公共土路，不跳进密林，不现场修鼓
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新鼓面独立，没有任何争执记录可读

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the dirt path, Kiptoo holds a key ring by a loop of fabric. Someone just ahead calls that the small one sticks.
beats.chinese: 土路上，基普图捏着布圈提一串钥匙。前头有人喊，小的那把有时候卡。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It sticks in what? You gave me these to carry.
beats.chinese: 卡在哪儿？你叫我帮你拿着的啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend keeps walking. Kiptoo turns the ring away from the soil and looks over at you.
beats.chinese: 朋友接着走。基普图把钥匙转向不会碰土的一边，抬眼看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See, at a show they'd tell me which gate before they handed me the keys. That's a person's house he's talking about.
beats.chinese: 真在演出，他们会先说这是哪道门，再把钥匙给我。人家说的可是自己家。

choices.english: Call after the friend and ask exactly what he wants.
choices.chinese: 喊住朋友，把托付问清楚。

choices.english: Tell him he can carry the keys without agreeing to go inside.
choices.chinese: 跟他说，能帮着拿，又不等于答应进屋。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kiptoo raises the ring a little. The friend has stopped at the next tree by the path.
beats.chinese: 基普图把钥匙稍举高。朋友在步道旁下一棵树那儿站住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He wants the keys back when we get out. The part about letting myself in was in his head till right now.
beats.chinese: 他说出去了再把钥匙还他。刚才让我自己开门进去那一截，一直只在他脑子里呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kiptoo puts one finger through the cloth loop rather than sorting the keys.
beats.chinese: 基普图只拿一根手指勾着布圈，没去分哪把是哪把。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can ask when and what for. Or he can have them back and let me in himself.
beats.chinese: 可以问几点进去、进去干什么。要不还给他，让他自己开门迎我。

choices.english: Find out what he wants you to do inside.
choices.chinese: 问清进去以后希望你干什么。

choices.english: Carry them until the end of the walk, nothing more.
choices.chinese: 只帮拿到走完这一路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kiptoo holds the keys by his side where they make no noise.
beats.chinese: 基普图把钥匙垂在身旁，让它不再响。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. A key won't go and open a door on its own. I'll keep my hand out of his cupboards too.
beats.chinese: 也是，钥匙又不会自己跑过去开门。我手也不会自己摸人家柜子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks towards his friend, without speeding up to catch him.
beats.chinese: 他瞧着朋友那头，没有加快步子赶上去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He can take them or tell me what he's asking when we get there.
beats.chinese: 到时候他可以拿回去，也可以把想让我干什么说清楚。

choices.english: Hand them back at the next pause in the walk.
choices.chinese: 下回停步时，把钥匙还回去。

choices.english: Ask him again at the house before doing anything.
choices.chinese: 到他家了再问一遍，没问先别动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kiptoo lets two walkers pass and speaks down the track to his friend.
beats.chinese: 两个行人过去之后，基普图顺着土路跟朋友说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only get the bag from behind the door? All right. I thought you wanted me to pick through your sitting room.
beats.chinese: 就拿门后的包？那成，我还当你让我在你客厅到处翻一翻。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes his palm around the ring, with the loop left out.
beats.chinese: 他把钥匙收进掌心，布圈露在外头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. A person's bag that I already know. That I can find without rearranging his house.
beats.chinese: 行，哪只包我知道。用不着把人家家里翻一遍也找得到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the ring onto one finger and keeps walking towards his friend.
beats.chinese: 他把钥匙圈套到一根指头，接着朝朋友走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll carry them through the forest. Anything with a door attached is his job today.
beats.chinese: 这一段林路我可以帮他拿。今天但凡带门的活儿都归他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend opens a hand as if to take them early. Kiptoo holds them up and laughs.
beats.chinese: 朋友像是想提前拿回去，伸开手。基普图举着钥匙笑起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can have your work back early if you like.
beats.chinese: 你要乐意提前拿回自己的活儿，也成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: When the friend stops, Kiptoo puts the fabric loop into his palm.
beats.chinese: 朋友一站住，基普图把布圈放进对方手心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. I'll knock the way I knocked last week. If you laugh, at least you'll be there to do it.
beats.chinese: 给。我还像上礼拜那样敲门。你想笑，起码能在门后头自己笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend pockets the ring and moves so the two of them can walk abreast.
beats.chinese: 朋友揣起钥匙，往旁挪了挪，两人可以并排走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Less noise in my pocket, anyway.
beats.chinese: 反正我兜里这下没那么响了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He threads the keys into his zipped pocket and pats it once.
beats.chinese: 他把钥匙送进带拉链的兜，拍了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask at the door. Not on the phone from here while he looks at a bird and says eh to everything.
beats.chinese: 等到门口再问。省得我在这儿打个电话，他瞧着只鸟，什么都嗯嗯。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks ahead and waves when his friend starts up again.
beats.chinese: 他望向前面，见朋友又走了，朝那头挥挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll catch him. We already agree about the part that doesn't have a door.
beats.chinese: 我去追上他。没门这段路，咱俩倒早商量好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week, Kiptoo recognises you on the forest path while rolling a paper wristband into a tight curl.
beats.chinese: 后来几天，基普图在林间路认出了你，手里正把纸腕带卷成小小一圈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Hottest sound on stage yesterday was me saying one, two while I checked the wrong switch.
beats.chinese: 嘿，昨天台上最响的声，是我试错开关时候念的一、二。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He unrolls the middle so the wristband stands as a little ring.
beats.chinese: 他把中间放开，让腕带立成小环。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At least the people at the back heard me for once.
beats.chinese: 至少后排的人难得听见我一回。

causality.presenceReason: 与同组朋友来卡鲁拉散步，临时被托一串钥匙
causality.placeAttitude: 公共地方跟人说笑容易，谈到进别人家就会拘谨
causality.stayingConstraint: 钥匙没有授权就不带走
causality.currentGoal: 弄清对方是只求保管还是要进屋
causality.currentState: 笑出声以后又确认一遍，怕漏了礼数
causality.contactTrigger: 他拿的钥匙被误当成自己的，玩家从旁经过，他顺口自己是临时保管
causality.characterContinuity: 不擅自进别人家或动人家的东西，别人觉得好笑也不装
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 求得明白授权。ab 不进只帮带钥匙。ba 原主拿回。bb 到约好时间再问
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程只站连续土路，两侧不踏进树丛
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新的一天回忆节目后台的分贝差

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside City Market a woman takes one end of a bright cloth. She lets go when the person beside her offers the rest.
beats.chinese: 城市市场外，一个女人捏住一块亮色布的一头。旁边人把剩下的也递过来，她松了手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, no. I said I liked it. I wanted you to buy it for you.
beats.chinese: 哎，不是。我说好看，是想让你自己买了用。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The other woman leaves the cloth hanging between her hands. Wanjiru looks over at you.
beats.chinese: 另一个女人让布垂在两手间。万吉鲁转头看看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said the edge was the nicest bit in the market. You'd think I said I had no cloth to my name.
beats.chinese: 我说这条边是整个市场最好看的。怎么听着倒像我家里一块布都没有了。

choices.english: Ask what she liked about the edge.
choices.chinese: 问她到底喜欢那条边的哪里。

choices.english: Tell her you understood it as a compliment.
choices.chinese: 告诉她你听着就是在夸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts one finger near a stripe without touching the cloth again.
beats.chinese: 她把指尖凑近一道条纹，没再碰布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That red is narrow there, then wide here. She didn't see it till I pointed. It looks good on her arm.
beats.chinese: 红的那头窄，这头宽。我指给她，她才看见。搁她胳膊上好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend turns the red part out over her own hand.
beats.chinese: 朋友把红的那一段转过来，搭在自己手上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. She could get more for herself if she wants. That doesn't mean I need some.
beats.chinese: 就这样。她想自己再买点也成。可不等于我要。

choices.english: Let her friend keep it for herself.
choices.chinese: 布留给原来买它的人自己用。

choices.english: Look together without accepting anything.
choices.chinese: 两人再看看，东西就不收了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru folds her empty hands and stands a little farther from the entrance.
beats.chinese: 万吉鲁两只空手合起来，站得离入口远一点儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'd rather she had heard that. I'll say it one more time.
beats.chinese: 谢了，就该让她也听成这样。我再跟她说一回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks at her friend, who hasn't folded the cloth yet.
beats.chinese: 她看朋友，人家还没把布叠上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Then I'm going for my walk. She can come if she wants, with the cloth, without the cloth.
beats.chinese: 然后我自己走走。她愿意来就来，带不带这块都行。

choices.english: Suggest explaining why she stopped to look.
choices.chinese: 建议说清自己为什么停下来看。

choices.english: Invite her friend to walk on without settling the gift.
choices.chinese: 先请朋友一起走，这礼的事就别再说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru lifts both hands towards the friend without reaching for the cloth.
beats.chinese: 万吉鲁两手朝朋友抬起来，没去接布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Put it on your chair. I want to see it there next time I come.
beats.chinese: 搭你家椅子上吧。下次我去就想看它在那里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend folds the cloth with the red edge on top. Wanjiru nods once.
beats.chinese: 朋友把布叠好，红边留在上头。万吉鲁点了下头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That bit now. That's yours.
beats.chinese: 好，就这一块，归你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She bends at the waist to get a look without asking the friend to turn the cloth over.
beats.chinese: 她弯点腰看，没叫朋友整块翻过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, there's a thin yellow line on the other side. That's all. I hadn't seen it from here.
beats.chinese: 噢，反面有一条细黄边。没别的了，从这儿原来没看见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens and takes her eyes off it first.
beats.chinese: 她直起身，先把视线移开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It can stay pretty when I go home empty handed.
beats.chinese: 我两手空空回家，它照样好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She points once at the cloth and then lowers her hand.
beats.chinese: 她指了一下布，把手放下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like a nice thing for as long as it takes me to look at it. Then I like the next thing.
beats.chinese: 看见好看的，我就喜欢到看完。在下面看见别的好的，我再喜欢别的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend slides the cloth back into a bag. Wanjiru looks towards the sidewalk.
beats.chinese: 朋友把布滑回袋，万吉鲁朝人行道看过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. No more parcel in my hand. I can walk properly.
beats.chinese: 好，我没又多抱个包裹，能好好走路了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She leaves the cloth in the other woman's hands and moves one pace along the front of the market.
beats.chinese: 她让布留在另一位手上，沿市场外墙走了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Come. Tell me what you paid, if you're that keen to tell me something about it.
beats.chinese: 走吧。非要讲这块，好歹告诉我你花了多少。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend closes the bag and comes level with her. Wanjiru laughs at the first figure she hears.
beats.chinese: 朋友合好包追上。万吉鲁一听交代的那个数，就笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You did well. Now take it all the way home.
beats.chinese: 买得挺好。现在，给我一路拿回你自家去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another walk past City Market, Wanjiru greets you and loosens her fingers from an empty shopping bag.
beats.chinese: 改天走过城市市场，万吉鲁朝你打招呼，松开刚一直捏着空购物袋的手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I brought a bag because somebody told me a nice roll of cloth was here. I looked. It is very nice.
beats.chinese: 你好。有人说这儿有卷好看的布，我还带袋子来了。看过了，确实好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the empty bag down to the size of her palm.
beats.chinese: 她把空袋叠到手掌大。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the whole trip. I've still got hands free for dancing tonight.
beats.chinese: 这趟就这点儿事。晚上跳舞还能空着两手去。

causality.presenceReason: 路过市场入口看朋友带出来的布
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢看而不必占有
causality.stayingConstraint: 等下要自己去散步
causality.currentGoal: 拒绝不必要的当面送礼
causality.currentState: 夸东西太投入，被误会时本人不想难为朋友
causality.contactTrigger: 朋友买完想递给她，她刚伸手就停下，玩家在旁见到
causality.characterContinuity: 只欣赏不接受因夸奖而送来的东西，照过自己的傍晚
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 留下原主买来自己用。ab 代着看清颜色但不带走。ba 说清原意。bb 边走边聊
causality.spatialContinuity: 市场外步行区，车辆通道不进
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 后来自己只看看卷布

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside City Market, Baraka turns an empty saucer over. A pale line runs from its rim towards the middle.
beats.chinese: 城市市场外，巴拉卡把空碟子翻过来。一线淡白从碟沿往中间走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Did you see that from the other side? My friend wants me to keep that line, but he also wants to put hot things in this.
beats.chinese: 另一面也看见了吗？我朋友想留这道线，还想往里面装热的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets the saucer flat on his palm without pressing on the mark.
beats.chinese: 他把碟子平放在手上，没拿手按那道印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like a mark too. I don't like it better than somebody's thumb.
beats.chinese: 我也喜欢留道印。总不能比人家大拇指还要紧。

choices.english: Ask how he knows if the line goes through.
choices.chinese: 问他怎么确定是不是贯穿了。

choices.english: Ask what the friend needs to use the saucer for.
choices.chinese: 问他朋友究竟想拿碟子干什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He angles the dish towards the light, then brings it back level.
beats.chinese: 他把碟朝亮处斜了斜，又端回来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The line's on the back as well. I'm not giving that back to somebody to hold under hot tea.
beats.chinese: 背上也能看见这条。我不会让人拿回去，端着它在底下接热茶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rests one finger on the solid part of the rim.
beats.chinese: 他一根手指搭在碟沿完好的那一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It can sit on a shelf. Or my friend can have something else for his tea.
beats.chinese: 可以摆架上看。真喝茶，我朋友换件拿着。

choices.english: Let this one have a dry use only.
choices.chinese: 这只只拿来装干东西。

choices.english: Find a different saucer to use with tea.
choices.chinese: 另外找一只配茶杯。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shakes his head at the uneven rim and wraps the saucer halfway up.
beats.chinese: 他朝不匀的碟沿摇摇头，把碟裹上一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He wants the old one. Then he wants to rinse it every day. I should ask which part he cares about more.
beats.chinese: 他又要这只旧的，又要每天拿去洗。我得问他哪一点更要紧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the paper loose around the piece.
beats.chinese: 他松松地在碟外拢着纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I tell people to keep every trace. Sometimes they just want to stop looking at what broke.
beats.chinese: 我老劝人，印子全留着吧。有时候人家就是不想再瞧见坏的是哪儿。

choices.english: Ask what he can offer without choosing for the friend.
choices.chinese: 问他不替朋友选的话，能给出什么选项。

choices.english: Let him keep this one if nobody needs it to be useful.
choices.chinese: 朋友真要拿来用，就让他自己收好这只。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He writes dry on the wrapping paper and circles it once.
beats.chinese: 他在包碟的纸上写了个干字，圈了一回。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put my keys in it while he decides. They'll give it something else to complain about.
beats.chinese: 等他想明白以前，我拿来装钥匙吧。它还可以换点东西嫌烦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He covers the cracked edge last, without folding the paper over the marked word.
beats.chinese: 他最后包住有裂纹的碟沿，没拿纸盖住刚写的那个字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No tea. I can promise him that much.
beats.chinese: 不盛茶。这句我可以保证。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the saucer safely into the bottom of a bag and sights along the entrance.
beats.chinese: 他把碟稳妥塞进袋底，沿入口那边瞧过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask if he'd go for a plain one. Then he can put it down without checking where the crack is.
beats.chinese: 我问他换个素的肯不肯。换了人家就能随手搁，不用老瞄缝在哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls the bag strap tight on his wrist.
beats.chinese: 他把袋带往手腕上收紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He should be able to put his tea down with both hands full.
beats.chinese: 他就算两手都拿着东西，也该能顺手把茶搁下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the paper again only far enough to see the rim.
beats.chinese: 他重新掀开纸，只开到刚能瞧见碟沿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He can have the pale line on one that isn't cracked. I could paint it. I'll say painted up front. He might like that.
beats.chinese: 可以挑只没裂的，也让上头有道浅线，我画就行。会先跟他说是画的。他没准就喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the paper and lets the saucer rest against his thigh.
beats.chinese: 他合好纸，让碟贴着大腿靠住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And if he hates it, I don't have to bring him another speech.
beats.chinese: 他要嫌难看，我也不用再带一套说辞找他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the saucer into his own bag with the wrapped parcel upright.
beats.chinese: 他让纸包竖着，把碟塞进自己的包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fine. I'll keep it on my own shelf. He can tell me what he wants without having mine in front of him.
beats.chinese: 好，我先搁自己架上。他想要什么，眼前没有我的这一只，也能说清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He steps away from the entrance side as the pavement clears.
beats.chinese: 人行区渐渐空出来，他从入口这边离开几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I make a worse salesman when it's my favourite thing.
beats.chinese: 越是自己最喜欢的东西，我越不会给人推销。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon, Baraka sees you outside the market carrying a shallow bowl in a cloth wrap.
beats.chinese: 改天下午，巴拉卡用布兜着一只浅碗，在市场外面看到你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. This does a lovely job of holding change. Found that out after it did a terrible job of holding water.
beats.chinese: 你好，这只放零钱特别合适。我是发现它盛水特别不行之后，才知道的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts the bowl, and several coins slide round to the low side.
beats.chinese: 他动了动碗，几枚硬币顺着滑到低的一头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stick with change. It's all there when I lift it up.
beats.chinese: 还是只放零钱吧。端起来看，钱倒一个没漏。

causality.presenceReason: 来市场口接以前买的碟子，不审别人带来的委托
causality.placeAttitude: 爱看曾经在桌上用过的东西
causality.stayingConstraint: 先在外边看清白圈再往后走
causality.currentGoal: 把朋友随口想要的修补限定到确实能用
causality.currentState: 急着说留条缝有味道，又看见朋友其实只想用
causality.contactTrigger: 小碟翻在手里，站邻近的玩家瞧见背面，主动向你确认看到的是哪一面
causality.characterContinuity: 客户细节保密，不能因为好看让危险的修补冒充能用
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 不装热的。ab 给人另找能用的。ba 说清想要的视觉效果。bb 自己保留旧物
causality.spatialContinuity: 外侧通行空间，碟未搁地、未进车行面
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 零钱碟来自新的一天

stories.titleZh: 今天有人听见两种声音

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zawadi calls out that a goal was offside before she's reached her friend. Then she sees a woman by the entrance and finishes the sentence much more quietly.
beats.chinese: 扎瓦迪离朋友还有几步就喊那球越位。再一眼看见入口旁站了个女人，后半句一下低了好多。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was offside. I didn't change what I said. I changed the entire person saying it.
beats.chinese: 还是越位。我没换自己要说的，换了一整个人来说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her old friend laughs and the woman at the entrance waves. Zawadi looks between them and you.
beats.chinese: 她老朋友笑了，入口旁那位挥挥手。扎瓦迪在你们几个之间来回看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh God. I told each of them I'd come here for lunch. I didn't realise I'd promised the same lunch.
beats.chinese: 天哪。我跟俩人都说了来这儿吃午饭。没想起来答应的是同一顿午饭。

choices.english: Ask if she wants the three of them to eat together.
choices.chinese: 问她想不想三个人一块儿吃。

choices.english: Ask if she'd rather see them one at a time.
choices.chinese: 问她想不想分开各见一趟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zawadi opens her mouth towards the friend who laughed, then looks at her coworker.
beats.chinese: 扎瓦迪朝刚笑的朋友张了张嘴，又转去看同事。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Maybe. My mate's going to say I talk like this all the time. My coworker's going to wait to see if she's allowed to interrupt me.
beats.chinese: 也许吧。我朋友肯定说我平常就这么大声。我同事又得先等一下，看我让不让人插话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts both eyebrows and stops looking back and forth.
beats.chinese: 她眉毛一抬，不再来回看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can let them find out. I don't have to do the introduction as two separate people.
beats.chinese: 让她俩自己看看吧。我又不用把自己扮成两个人，各介绍一遍。

choices.english: Start with the goal all three just heard about.
choices.chinese: 就从三人刚听见的进球聊起。

choices.english: Meet them without explaining the change in her voice.
choices.chinese: 跟两个人打招呼，声音变了不非得解释。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks over the market wall and lets the first friend close the distance.
beats.chinese: 她瞧了眼市场的外墙，等头一位朋友走近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might. I do want to have lunch with her. I wanted a quiet one with my coworker as well. I meant both.
beats.chinese: 有可能。我真想跟她吃饭，也是真想跟我同事安安静静吃一顿。两边都是真心的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her phone away instead of checking her calendar.
beats.chinese: 她没去翻日历，把手机先收了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I haven't got to make something up because I can't eat two plates at once.
beats.chinese: 我一口气吃不了两份饭，又不必为这事给人现编个理由。

choices.english: Say which time she can actually give each person.
choices.chinese: 说清各自能约什么时候。

choices.english: Tell them what kind of lunch she needs today.
choices.chinese: 今天就想吃个什么样的午饭，照直讲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises her voice just enough to bring both friends round together.
beats.chinese: 她声音抬到刚够把两位朋友一块儿叫过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Did either of you see the goal she keeps telling me about? I want to hear both answers before I get loud again.
beats.chinese: 她老跟我讲的那球，你俩有谁看见了？我想先听完两个答案，再由我喊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Both of them begin at once. Zawadi pulls her head back and laughs.
beats.chinese: 两人同时开口。扎瓦迪头往后一仰，笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, okay. Maybe I don't have to introduce anything.
beats.chinese: 好嘛，看来什么都不用我介绍了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zawadi walks to where the two women can both see her face and lifts a hand.
beats.chinese: 扎瓦迪走到俩人都瞧得见她脸的地方，抬手招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I did say lunch to both of you. Anybody got a place in mind?
beats.chinese: 嗨，我是跟你俩都说了来吃午饭。有谁已经想好去哪儿吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The woman at the entrance asks how long they have. Zawadi answers her at an ordinary volume.
beats.chinese: 入口旁的同事问能吃多久。扎瓦迪拿平常的声音答她。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See? I can just use the voice that's there.
beats.chinese: 瞧，出来什么声就用什么声也成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to each friend in order, giving one of them a later time.
beats.chinese: 扎瓦迪挨个转向两个朋友，给其中一位说了个晚点的时间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lunch now, tea after. Is tea after any good to you? You don't have to be terribly nice about it.
beats.chinese: 现在吃饭，晚点喝茶。晚点你方便不？不用为了我非说方便。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits through the answer without following with an excuse.
beats.chinese: 她等着听完回答，没再补借口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay. Next time I'll put down two different times before I walk out of the house.
beats.chinese: 好。下次出门以前，我得先记两个不一样的时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts to make a joke, closes her lips and says the next bit more slowly.
beats.chinese: 她本来张嘴要逗一句，又把嘴合上，下面说得慢了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm a bit done in today. Can I eat somewhere we don't have to talk over everybody? Then tell me about the goal later.
beats.chinese: 我今天有点累了。能找个吃饭的时候不用比谁都大声的地方不？那球晚点再跟我讲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One friend waves the other a little farther from the entrance. Zawadi follows.
beats.chinese: 一位朋友招手让另一位离入口再远一点。扎瓦迪跟过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. You didn't need me to be funny first.
beats.chinese: 啊，原来不用先逗你俩笑才行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later on another market day, Zawadi sees you outside and flicks a folded scrap of paper with a fingertip.
beats.chinese: 后来一个逛市场的日子，扎瓦迪在外头见到你，一根指头弹了弹折好的小纸片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I told my volleyball lot I was staying at the back. I played at the front. Nobody else has filed a complaint.
beats.chinese: 嘿，我跟一块儿打排球的人说我站后头，最后又站前面了。也没哪个上来告我一状。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the paper smaller without looking at it.
beats.chinese: 她没看纸，又把它折小一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I liked it up there. I might like the back better next week. Let me live.
beats.chinese: 在前头我是挺喜欢。下礼拜没准我又觉得后头好。你们放过我吧。

causality.presenceReason: 和同事来市场接表妹，碰到熟人也在附近
causality.placeAttitude: 同地碰上两拨人反而手足无措
causality.stayingConstraint: 要自己出面讲今天准备怎么见
causality.currentGoal: 不把朋友支来支去，决定午饭要否拼一桌
causality.currentState: 跟旧朋友话快，换到同事立刻慢，会自己点破
causality.contactTrigger: 同一句球赛话在两个对象面前说法变了，玩家又恰好听到
causality.characterContinuity: 不编借口，不承诺此后全一样
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 两边一起讲一截。ab 自己不解释。ba 定两个时段。bb 说清今天需要安静
causality.spatialContinuity: 市场外侧步行空间，不靠车行面
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新的一天谈她允许自己改变球的位置

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the courtyard paving at Fort Charles, Cynthia calls to her friend near one of the gun bays. The friend points at the old cannon without looking round.
beats.chinese: 查尔斯堡的石铺庭院上，辛西娅喊了炮位前的朋友一声。人家指着旧炮，也没回头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She'll be a while. I was just trying to drag her out on her own birthday and she doesn't even know that part yet.
beats.chinese: 她还要看一会儿呢。我正打算哄她生日那天自己出趟门，连这点她都还不知道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cynthia stops a few paces short of the arch and turns to you.
beats.chinese: 辛西娅没走到拱门底下，隔几步站住，转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could buy something and give it to her. I'd rather find out what makes her stop walking.
beats.chinese: 可以自己买一样给她。我倒更想看看，走着走着什么东西能叫她停住脚。

choices.english: Ask what kind of outing her friend would enjoy.
choices.chinese: 问她朋友什么样的出门最乐意去。

choices.english: Ask if the friend even wants a present.
choices.chinese: 问她朋友到底想不想收礼物。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cynthia glances back at the friend, whose eyes are still on the gun carriage.
beats.chinese: 辛西娅回头看朋友，人家眼睛还在炮架上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This, apparently. I was thinking patties and a shop. She might rather look at a cannon for half an hour and eat after.
beats.chinese: 看样子是这个。我刚还想吃肉馅饼，再逛一家店。人家兴许宁愿看半个钟头的炮，再去吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She flattens one hand over the invitation she was holding.
beats.chinese: 她一手平平盖在刚才拿着的请帖上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can ask her, and we can start with whatever she says. The patty can come in later.
beats.chinese: 可以问嘛。她说什么就从什么开始。馅饼晚点再吃也行。

choices.english: Ask her to offer the whole outing upfront.
choices.chinese: 请她把想约人出门的事照直讲。

choices.english: Let her friend pick the first stop.
choices.chinese: 第一站干脆叫朋友挑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the little card along its fold.
beats.chinese: 她沿折痕把小卡合上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She said don't buy me anything. I heard her. I didn't hear don't come out with me.
beats.chinese: 她说了别买东西给我。我听见了。可没听见别陪我出门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend takes a step back from the brick bay, then looks over at Cynthia.
beats.chinese: 朋友从红砖炮位那儿退了一步，好朝辛西娅这边看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We could keep one afternoon without a thing wrapped up at the end.
beats.chinese: 可以就留一下午，到了末尾也没有个包得好好的东西非得拿走。

choices.english: Respect the request and skip gifts.
choices.chinese: 照朋友说的，这回不送。

choices.english: Leave the surprise at a meal together.
choices.chinese: 惊喜留到俩人一起吃一顿就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the card into a pocket and speaks when her friend is level with her.
beats.chinese: 她把卡折进兜，等朋友站到跟前才开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You and me, one afternoon. What do you want to do in it?
beats.chinese: 你跟我，空个下午。想拿它做点儿什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend answers into her shoulder. Cynthia waits, then lets out a quick laugh.
beats.chinese: 朋友挨着她肩膀说了句什么。辛西娅听完，短促地笑了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ay, you can say lie down. I won't follow you home with a cake.
beats.chinese: 嗐，想躺着就说想躺着。我不会端块蛋糕追到你家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the folded card out like a blank ticket.
beats.chinese: 她把折好的卡伸出来，像拿张还没写字的票。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You pick where we start. If you say come back here, I'll know to bring a little more time.
beats.chinese: 从哪儿开始你挑。你要说再来这儿，我就知道得多留点时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her friend folds the card once more and keeps it.
beats.chinese: 朋友把卡再折一下，自己收了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And after is after. We'll go when you stop looking.
beats.chinese: 后头的事后头再管。等你看够了咱再走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the card in the bottom of her bag without opening the flap again.
beats.chinese: 她把卡收到袋底，没有再去掀开彩页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. She says nothing, she gets nothing. Except me, if she wants me there.
beats.chinese: 成。她说什么也不要，我就真不给东西。要是想见我，我倒可以来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stands with both feet in the clear part of the courtyard and calls softly to her friend.
beats.chinese: 她双脚站在庭院空的一块，压低点声喊朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take your time. We're not late for a thing.
beats.chinese: 慢慢来，又没什么等着咱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out a receipt and straightens it instead of opening the card.
beats.chinese: 她摸出一张小票抹平，卡没打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just something to eat. She can choose what. If I order anything sweet it'll be because I wanted some.
beats.chinese: 就吃点什么，让她挑。我要点甜的，那就只因为我自己想吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her friend comes through the courtyard and Cynthia makes a space for her alongside.
beats.chinese: 朋友走过庭院，辛西娅在身旁留了个空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Come tell me what you saw. I was making plans again.
beats.chinese: 来跟我讲讲你刚看着什么。我脑子里又光顾着安排事儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later in the week Cynthia sees you on the Fort Charles paving and lets her folded arms fall.
beats.chinese: 过了几天，辛西娅在查尔斯堡石路上看到你，把抱着的胳膊放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. Somebody invited me out. Told me not to bring a thing except myself. I went all the way to my kitchen before I remembered that.
beats.chinese: 你好。人家约我出门，说就把自己带上，什么也别拿。我都走进厨房到处找东西了，才想起来这句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shows you both empty hands and opens one wider than the other.
beats.chinese: 她把两只空手摊给你看，一边张得比另一边还开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See? This time I followed instructions.
beats.chinese: 你看，这回我还真听话了。

causality.presenceReason: 和朋友看堡庭院，另有一个朋友要过生日
causality.placeAttitude: 想让朋友真逛，不替她规划整天
causality.stayingConstraint: 院内先看，不在展品旁往外传照片
causality.currentGoal: 决定是带人去挑，还是拿猜来的礼物过去
causality.currentState: 兴致好，忍不住先替人打算一趟
causality.contactTrigger: 朋友看炮位，她往庭院通行区退，把话顺到旁边的玩家
causality.characterContinuity: 愿意一起逛，没礼单、不记账，听人拒绝就停
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 当面约。ab 只让对方挑走向。ba 不送。bb 蛋糕照吃，礼物不猜
causality.spatialContinuity: 固定炮位外的石铺通行区
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 当天被朋友反过来邀请，不用记得生日

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A shard of bright pink light flashes off Marcia's brooch as she crosses the courtyard. Her sister turns round and calls it by the name of an expensive stone.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅穿过庭院，胸针突然闪了一片亮粉色。她姐回头，脱口说了个挺贵的宝石名。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's plastic. I gave up pretending when one of the petals bent in my bag.
beats.chinese: 塑料的。我有片花瓣在包里给压弯了，就再不用装了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia shows you the bent petal without taking the brooch off.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅没摘胸针，只给你看看那片弯的花瓣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I spend enough money on glass for work. I want that much pink without having to go and get it insured.
beats.chinese: 我上班在玻璃上花够多钱了。我就想戴这么大一块粉的，还犯不着先去买保险。

choices.english: Ask if she'd put the bent side up front.
choices.chinese: 问要不要干脆把弯的那一头转出来。

choices.english: Ask what colour she'd use for a window.
choices.chinese: 问真做扇窗，她会用什么颜色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the brooch against her shirt, bringing the petal up where it catches more light.
beats.chinese: 她在上衣前转转胸针，把那片花瓣竖到更能照着光的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Now it's pretending to be a flower that grew that way.
beats.chinese: 瞧，这下是在装一朵本来就这么长的花。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her sister looks back at the gleam, then waits beside the clear part of the paving.
beats.chinese: 姐姐又回头瞧那片反光，在石路空着的地方站下来等。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could put it straight. I don't think I will.
beats.chinese: 摆正也行。可我看不必。

choices.english: Leave the bent petal on show.
choices.chinese: 就把弯花瓣露出来。

choices.english: Look at the colour from another angle.
choices.chinese: 换个角度看看这颜色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia gives the brooch one small push to check the pin.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅轻推胸针，看看别针牢不牢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Depends whose window. I don't fit my own taste for a living. I fit what will be there when I've gone home.
beats.chinese: 看谁家的窗。干活儿不能照我自己的口味。装完我就回家，人家还得天天对着看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks beyond the brick arch to where her sister stopped.
beats.chinese: 她越过红砖拱形炮位，望姐姐停下来的那处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Today I'm going out with her. Nobody has a window in their bag for me to discuss, I hope.
beats.chinese: 今天就是陪我姐出来。我希望没人背包里装了扇窗等着叫我看。

choices.english: Keep the conversation on the brooch.
choices.chinese: 就说胸针，工作不聊了。

choices.english: Let her catch up with her sister.
choices.chinese: 让她赶上姐姐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens the pin so the wonky petal stays at the top.
beats.chinese: 她把针别正，故意让歪掉那瓣留在上面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. When she asks why, I'll say I paid extra for the bend.
beats.chinese: 挺好。她问起来，我就说这点弯的要加钱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She walks forward and calls to her sister from the open stone path.
beats.chinese: 她往前走，在空着的石路上喊姐姐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See it now? It's worth exactly what it was worth before.
beats.chinese: 现在看着了吧？跟刚才值一模一样的钱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She changes her angle to the sun. The sharp spot of colour disappears.
beats.chinese: 她换个角度对着太阳，颜色最亮的那点儿没了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, it's nearly orange from here. They could've charged me twice if they'd known.
beats.chinese: 哟，站这儿看快成橙的了。人家知道能收我两回钱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She walks a little way back into the light, then leaves it.
beats.chinese: 她往亮处走回一小段，没再挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pink's the one I came out in. I'll take the other colour home.
beats.chinese: 出来的时候戴的是粉的。到家还能变个色看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smooths a shirt fold away from the brooch.
beats.chinese: 她把胸针旁边那道衣褶捋开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. If somebody says it's pretty I'll just say yes. I won't say it took years of training to buy it.
beats.chinese: 成。要有人说好看，我就说是啊。可不讲学了多少年手艺，才会掏钱买这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sweeps her fingers once over the pink petals.
beats.chinese: 她拿指头扫过几片粉花瓣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Do you know how pleased I was for that little money?
beats.chinese: 就花那么点儿，你知道我乐成什么样吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns to follow her sister, staying on the stone walk outside the cannon bay.
beats.chinese: 她转过身追她姐，脚还走炮位外的石路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, I'm off. She'll do the bit where she tries to remember why it's famous. I'm allowed to just look.
beats.chinese: 行，我过去了。她又要琢磨这地方为什么有名。我只看看也成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She breathes out a quick laugh before taking another step.
beats.chinese: 她轻轻笑了一声，才迈下一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm very good at looking, provided nobody asks me to put it in stained glass.
beats.chinese: 我可会看了，只要没人马上叫我给看见的东西做扇花玻璃窗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One afternoon later at the fort, Marcia sees you and holds a little gold clasp up against the paving.
beats.chinese: 后来一天下午，玛西娅在堡里看见你，把个小金色扣子举到石路前比了比。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. This was on a brooch I liked. Today it gave up pretending to be gold and fell off.
beats.chinese: 嗨，原来装在我喜欢的一只胸针上。今天它不装金的了，直接掉下来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the clasp in a pocket instead of pinning it back.
beats.chinese: 她把扣揣起来，没往回别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll find another clasp. I still like the awful thing.
beats.chinese: 重新找个扣呗。我还是喜欢它难看成那样。

causality.presenceReason: 陪姐姐来堡里看看，自己戴了一枚便宜胸针
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢看看庭院的自然光，不必做讲解
causality.stayingConstraint: 姐姐已走在前头，等她回头再走
causality.currentGoal: 看才买的胸针是否歪斜
causality.currentState: 有人当真是她做的贵玻璃，忍不住笑出声
causality.contactTrigger: 胸针一闪，友人以为是贵料，她扶正后告诉玩家怎么回事
causality.characterContinuity: 认真做修复，私下审美自己说了算，不当传承代表
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 让最廉价的一面朝外。ab 看清实际颜色。ba 自己玩味。bb 把工作话结束随后跟姐姐走
causality.spatialContinuity: 庭院通行区，未凑摸炮位、未编馆内窗
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 独立的新胸针后来掉扣

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne lifts a phone towards the red brick arch, sees you cross the paving and lowers it before the shutter goes.
beats.chinese: 伊冯把手机举向红砖拱门，看见你要过石铺庭院，快门还没按就放低了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go through. I can wait. I took one before my sister went past. Now I'm trying to take another with the shadow where it was.
beats.chinese: 你过去吧，我能等。我姐过去之前照过一张。我想再来一张，让影子还在原来那儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down at the pale patch next to the old cannon's plinth.
beats.chinese: 她低头看旧炮基座旁那一块浅亮。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course the shadow didn't agree to that.
beats.chinese: 可影子没答应我啊。

choices.english: Ask what she wanted to keep in the picture.
choices.chinese: 问她想在这张图里留下什么。

choices.english: Keep moving as she asked.
choices.chinese: 照她说的，从这里走过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She traces a line towards the red brick with her finger, stopping clear of the cannon bay.
beats.chinese: 她朝红砖那头用手指描了一道，人在炮位外站住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That line when it reached the floor. It was so straight it looked printed.
beats.chinese: 那条线原来一直到地上。可直了，看着像印上去的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another visitor's shoe passes through the new light before Yvonne can lift the phone.
beats.chinese: 伊冯手机还没抬，另一位游客的鞋已经从刚换过来的光底下走过去了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could wait thirty seconds. Or try a different frame after they've gone.
beats.chinese: 可以再等半分钟。或者等他们走了，换个画面拍。

choices.english: Wait until the path is clear.
choices.chinese: 等过道没人了再拍。

choices.english: Keep the new light instead of the old one.
choices.chinese: 拍现在这道光，不追原来那道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the phone low while you come level. The camera stays pointed down.
beats.chinese: 你走到跟她并排的时候，她手机一直放低，镜头也一直朝下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. People come through a courtyard. My sister's always having to remind me people sit down at a lunch, too.
beats.chinese: 这就好。庭院本来就有人要过。我姐也老得提醒我，吃午饭的人本来就是要坐下的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She taps the thumb of the hand holding the camera against the other palm.
beats.chinese: 她拿握手机那只手的拇指轻敲另一手掌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not going to ask for an empty picture of everything.
beats.chinese: 也不能什么都非得等到没人，才给它留张照。

choices.english: Put the phone away and go find her sister.
choices.chinese: 收手机，去找姐姐。

choices.english: Suggest a tighter frame without any people in it.
choices.chinese: 建议取近一点，只收没人的一角。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits until the visitor is out of sight, then lifts the phone without leaning in.
beats.chinese: 等游人走出这段视野，她才把手机举起来，人没往前探。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One. There. I can crop the bit that's moved. I've got the two sides I wanted.
beats.chinese: 一张，成了。挪过的那块可以裁，我想留的两条边已经有了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops looking at the picture when her sister raises an arm farther across the courtyard.
beats.chinese: 她姐姐在庭院另一头举了手，伊冯也就从照片上抬起了眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I'll go stand in her way for a change.
beats.chinese: 现在换我去挡一下她的光吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The new patch of light touches the base without reaching the floor. Yvonne frames only that corner and taps once.
beats.chinese: 新的亮块照到基座，没落地。伊冯只把那一角框进去，按了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It turns out that part was there before and I never looked at it.
beats.chinese: 原来这地方本来就在，我都没瞧过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks up from the little preview and takes in the entire arch.
beats.chinese: 她抬头离开那张小预览，把整道拱门看了看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Better stop while I have one I like.
beats.chinese: 趁手里还有张喜欢的，先停吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses the screen off and slips both hands into her pockets.
beats.chinese: 她把屏幕摁灭，两手一起插到兜里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. She went to read the sign. I'll go hear whether it's any good.
beats.chinese: 成。她去看说明牌了，我去听听讲得怎么样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes an open route across the paving, leaving the cannon bay untouched.
beats.chinese: 她走过石铺地空着的一段，没朝炮位里去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The phone will be here if she wants to take something herself.
beats.chinese: 她自己想拍的话，手机我还带着呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the phone upright and brings one edge of the arch into the picture.
beats.chinese: 她把手机竖起来，只取了一边拱门进画面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. You can walk straight through and all I'll get is bricks.
beats.chinese: 这就行了。你随便从这儿走，我也只拍得到砖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes one picture, checks the nearest edge and puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 她拍了一张，检查离自己最近那条边，收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. Nobody in that by mistake.
beats.chinese: 好，这回没把谁误拍进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing at Fort Charles, Yvonne recognises you and touches one loose corner of the cloth over her bag.
beats.chinese: 改天在查尔斯堡碰见，伊冯认出你，摸了摸盖在包上的布翘起来那角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I took a picture of my table after people went home. One plate on its side. Somebody left a shoe under a chair.
beats.chinese: 你好。我在人走了之后拍了张桌子。有只盘子侧着，椅子底下还丢了一只鞋。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lets the cloth corner fall over the edge instead of straightening it.
beats.chinese: 她让布角搭过包边，没往回捋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one's going next to the nice one. I'll find out whose shoe when they need it.
beats.chinese: 这张挨着那张好看的放吧。谁的鞋，到他要穿的时候就知道了。

causality.presenceReason: 朋友在庭院休息时想留一张没人的画面
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢东西原先整齐，知道人来了应由他们走
causality.stayingConstraint: 能等，整完投影也下午了
causality.currentGoal: 拍庭院一角自己留用
causality.currentState: 越想复现光越怕人经过，想了一下改口
causality.contactTrigger: 拍之前看到玩家走进取景，先放手机表明可通行
causality.characterContinuity: 没允许不拍客人，不擅自搬别人东西
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 等人后按。ab 把画面的变化留下。ba 不等。bb 同意照片只拍石墙边
causality.spatialContinuity: 拍红砖拱位和旧炮从庭院外的路，不触摸展品
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢另一个人的桌布问题

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the courtyard path, Dwayne reads one sentence in a sharp voice that hardly carries past the paving. He lowers the sheet and reads it back gently.
beats.chinese: 庭院的路上，德韦恩板着声读了一句，刚够石铺路这儿听见。他放低纸页，又用很软的声音读了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tell me your shoes got wet. Did that sound like two people? It's still one woman.
beats.chinese: 告诉我，你鞋弄湿了没有。像不像两个人说的？其实就一个女人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He parts the corner of a second page from the first and holds both against his arm.
beats.chinese: 他把第二张一角从头一张分开，两张都按到胳膊上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She wrote that to her nephew fifty years ago. My friend wants a little note about me to go before it. I've told him good luck.
beats.chinese: 五十年前她写给外甥的。我朋友要在前面附一段我自己的介绍，我说那你够呛。

choices.english: Ask which way he wants people to hear the line.
choices.chinese: 问他想让人听出这句是什么口气。

choices.english: Ask what happens without the note about him.
choices.chinese: 问不放他的介绍会怎么样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings the paper closer to his face and looks at the gap between the last two words.
beats.chinese: 他把纸拿近，瞧末尾两词之间空多少。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She put a line break right after shoes. Next word's wet. If I rush that I lose what she did with the paper.
beats.chinese: 她写完鞋，另起一行，才写湿。要念太快，纸上这一下就听不着了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits until a pair of steps across the courtyard has faded.
beats.chinese: 一对脚步声从庭院过去，已经淡了，他还等了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could do it one more time. I could also leave those two words to read quietly.
beats.chinese: 可以再来一遍。也可以把那两个词留给人自己默读。

choices.english: Read it with him, keeping the pause.
choices.chinese: 和他一块念，把停顿留着。

choices.english: Let the words stay on the page without a performance.
choices.chinese: 这两个字不演，留在纸上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dwayne brings the pages together and rests them tight against his chest.
beats.chinese: 德韦恩把两张纸一合，紧贴自己胸口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They'll still have the letter. I'm not part of the exhibit.
beats.chinese: 信还在。我又不是展品。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks across the courtyard for his friend and speaks at a normal volume again.
beats.chinese: 他越过庭院找朋友，声音也放回平时聊天那点大小。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can help him get the voices right. I've got choir in the evening. I haven't got half the night to explain myself.
beats.chinese: 我能帮他找对声音。我晚上唱合唱，没有半个晚上解释我这人。

choices.english: Let the friend introduce the letter himself.
choices.chinese: 让朋友自己介绍这封信。

choices.english: Suggest making a short rehearsal time before choir.
choices.chinese: 建议合唱之前只约一小会儿练。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He listens through the first half of the line, holding up a finger until the gap has passed.
beats.chinese: 他先听完那行的前半截，竖着一根指头，等中间停的那一下过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I can read her the way I hear her while you read the line as it sits.
beats.chinese: 很好。你照纸上写的念，我就照自己听着像她的样子来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the second page against the first, then opens it right at the break.
beats.chinese: 他把二页往一页上一合，再刚好打开折行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Give her the space and she does the rest herself.
beats.chinese: 这截空留给她，剩下的她自己会讲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the paper below the sentence so the two words can still be seen.
beats.chinese: 他沿句子下面折起纸，那两个词还看得见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. They can put that where people have to stop to read it. I won't have to raise my voice.
beats.chinese: 说得对。让人到那儿得站定，自己好好读。我也不必扯嗓子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the page at reading height for a second without speaking.
beats.chinese: 他举到读信合适的高度，一秒没说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That worked better than I thought.
beats.chinese: 还真比我想的好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the first sheet where his friend can take it, but keeps the other one folded in his hand.
beats.chinese: 他把第一张递到朋友能接的位置，另一张还折在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Read the one she wrote. You can say her name. Don't make time to fit me in, too.
beats.chinese: 念她写的那封，人名也能报。就别再匀空非把我也挤进去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The friend turns the sheet over and starts to read. Dwayne listens without speaking over him.
beats.chinese: 朋友翻过纸开始念，德韦恩听着，没抢声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the line. Keep that sound.
beats.chinese: 就这句。照这个声念。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He circles a short time on his own folded notice and puts the pen away.
beats.chinese: 他在自己折好的通知上圈了段不长的时间，收起笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Before choir, fifteen minutes. If he brings a piece about me we get fourteen.
beats.chinese: 合唱前，一刻钟。他要带一篇说我的东西来，只剩十四分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the original pages back up and faces his friend squarely in the courtyard.
beats.chinese: 他把原稿重新举起，在庭院正对朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Let's begin with what she actually wrote.
beats.chinese: 先从她真写出来的字开始吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another day at the fort, Dwayne spots you and places a folded cord carefully in his palm.
beats.chinese: 改天在堡里，德韦恩瞧见你，把一截叠好的编绳小心放到掌心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. Someone asked what to put under my name on a label. I said the date was long enough.
beats.chinese: 嗨。有人问我标签上名字底下添什么。我说写个日期就够长了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits till the cord stops slipping between his fingers.
beats.chinese: 绳在他指缝里滑了滑，等它不再动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They can write about the cord when I've given it away. Nobody has to write about me while I'm giving it.
beats.chinese: 这绳送出去以后，怎么写它都可以。我正送东西呢，谁也不用非在那儿写我。

causality.presenceReason: 来庭院等同伴练一段准备好的朗读
causality.placeAttitude: 声音在通行区不抢过人，轻声就够
causality.stayingConstraint: 合唱时段不能挪，自己不接受被写成展品
causality.currentGoal: 确认现在念谁的字，谁不该被写进去
causality.currentState: 讲到信立刻有戏，说到自己干脆冷下来
causality.contactTrigger: 同伴叫他按水音模仿，他缓过来问玩家说听见几个人
causality.characterContinuity: 乐于读他人一段经许可的字，拒绝被采访与占晚上的合唱
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 分角色低声读。ab 留句不读。ba 同伴自己上。bb 约晚前见面不替人写自述
causality.spatialContinuity: 院内石铺路，旧炮固定，声音不制造现场历史
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新的一天有人问胸牌下一行，初遇没要求

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Shanice holds a little piece of wood across two fingers on the path by the blue mahoe. When she turns it, a pale ring shows.
beats.chinese: 蓝马霍树旁的园路上，沙尼斯两根手指托着小木片，转一转，才显出一圈浅印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hold on. Did it disappear from where you're standing? I can still see it if I tilt it this much.
beats.chinese: 等会儿，你站那儿瞧，它没了吗？我斜这么点儿，还看得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her fingertip just inside the ring, away from the edge.
beats.chinese: 她把指尖点在浅圈里面一点，离边上还有一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Old radio cabinet. Somebody put a cup down. You could take the mark out, but this is how thin the good wood is.
beats.chinese: 旧收音机的壳，人家以前搁杯子留下的。印也能去掉，可好木头现在就这么点厚。

choices.english: Ask if she's leaving any of the old colour.
choices.chinese: 问原来的颜色还留不留。

choices.english: Ask if it really needs fixing today.
choices.chinese: 问是不是非得今天把它弄好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rolls the wood onto its edge, showing the fine dark layer just under the surface.
beats.chinese: 她把木片侧过来，好看清表面薄薄一层深色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This strip stays. I tried a bit by the back first. Took it too far and it looked like a new bit of badly matched furniture.
beats.chinese: 这条留着。我先拿背后一小截试。磨过了，跟又拼了块配不上的新家具一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws her nail gently along the strip once.
beats.chinese: 她拿指甲顺那一条轻轻划了一回。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can leave enough to see what it was. I could also just mark where I'm stopping.
beats.chinese: 可以多留一点，好看出原来什么样。或者就记下来我准备停在哪。

choices.english: Leave a little of the ring intact.
choices.chinese: 留小半圈原样。

choices.english: Mark the limit before touching anything else.
choices.chinese: 先标清做到哪儿，不往别处动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She brings the wood flat against her hand and stops turning it.
beats.chinese: 她把木片重新放平在手上，不再转来转去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. Fifty years people had that ring. A week more won't make it late.
beats.chinese: 不用今天弄。那圈印人家都有五十年了，多等个礼拜不算晚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The folded cloth is still open on her bag. She lays the wood on it.
beats.chinese: 袋上的布还摊着。她把木片搁回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't want to see another picture of it in a message asking if I've decided.
beats.chinese: 不想再收到张它的照片，底下跟一句，你想好了没有？

choices.english: Suggest putting it away and going on with the walk.
choices.chinese: 建议收起来，接着走。

choices.english: Ask whether she can tell the owner she'll decide next week.
choices.chinese: 问能不能直接说下礼拜再决定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses one fingertip on the unstained part and leaves the ring in the light.
beats.chinese: 她拿指尖按住没有印的部分，让浅圈留在光里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. It can show from this side. I'm not going to chase it round every corner.
beats.chinese: 就这样。这边能看出来，也不用到四角都追着那印磨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She wraps the edge first and leaves the middle flat.
beats.chinese: 她先裹边，留着中间不压。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: When he sees it, I'll ask where he's going to put his cup.
beats.chinese: 壳子还回去，我得问他下回准备把杯子搁哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws a little stop mark on the wrapping paper beside the wood.
beats.chinese: 她拿笔在裹木片的纸边上标了个留手的记号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's all there is to do here. Remember that part about it being thin, now, when I get home.
beats.chinese: 在这儿弄到这儿。等回家千万记着，那一层已经很薄了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the little package by both ends on her palm.
beats.chinese: 她托起小纸包时，用掌心接住两头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's small enough for me to lose, so I'll put it somewhere stupidly obvious.
beats.chinese: 小得转头就找不着。我找个显眼到离谱的地方放。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Shanice folds the cloth twice and puts the sample at the bottom of the bag.
beats.chinese: 沙尼斯把布叠两下，连小样收进袋底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I said I'd take a slow ride, not bring a job outdoors and hurry it up.
beats.chinese: 也是。说好了出来慢慢骑，不是把活儿搬到外头赶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a few steps along the path beside the hedge.
beats.chinese: 她沿花篱旁的园路走了几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the nicest part of the day so far.
beats.chinese: 今天到现在，就这一小段最好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gets a message box open and types with one thumb.
beats.chinese: 她点开消息，用一根拇指打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I won't know before next week. There. No hoping it looks better by Thursday.
beats.chinese: 下礼拜之前我定不下来。成。也不用光指望到周四自己就看着顺眼了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the bag with one hand still holding the phone.
beats.chinese: 她一手还握着手机，另一只手把袋合好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now if a picture comes in I can leave it till supper.
beats.chinese: 这下有图片发过来，也可以晚饭再看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon by the blue mahoe, Shanice lifts a small mask by its cord when she spots you.
beats.chinese: 另一个下午在蓝马霍树旁，沙尼斯提着挂绳举起一张小面具时看见了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I was going to change the cord. Then I saw the knot was tied from the front, all backwards. Mine would be all neat and quiet.
beats.chinese: 你好。本想换绳，才发现这个结是从正面打的，全反着来。我要自己系，肯定又弄得规规矩矩的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls at the free cord without tightening it.
beats.chinese: 她拽了拽松出来的绳头，没把结收紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll hang it this way. The person who did it could see better from there.
beats.chinese: 就照这样挂吧，当初打结的人说不定从那边看得更清楚。

causality.presenceReason: 沿公园路骑完一段慢车后停下，手里拿给朋友看过的小块旧木
causality.placeAttitude: 蓝马霍树旁有清楚的自然光，能看见旧漆
causality.stayingConstraint: 给朋友示意颜色后再走
causality.currentGoal: 说明是否把水圈都磨掉
causality.currentState: 有人催她说做到几成时反而做不下去
causality.contactTrigger: 自然光把小样上表面显出两层，玩家经过时她先问是否方便看一眼
causality.characterContinuity: 自己试过才评价，不因为有人着急就说能交
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 留一小块原色。ab 把边界记在纸上。ba 不给意见先停。bb 把还没决定的交期说清
causality.spatialContinuity: 园路边与草地清楚分开，不进草地或园界铁栏外
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 新的面具旧挂绳与木样无关

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlon stops beside the blue mahoe. A shadow has lined up with the park railings, and one square of light is moving out of the pattern.
beats.chinese: 马龙在蓝马霍树旁停住。一道影子正好对上园界栏杆，其中一小方亮光在往图案外挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Wait. If you're looking at the path, don't look up yet. There's one square missing.
beats.chinese: 等等。要正看地上，先别抬头。少一块方的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They hold their hands loosely behind their back as the square slips away.
beats.chinese: 那块光溜过去时，马龙的手松松地背在后头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now it's gone. That took all morning to happen for about half a second.
beats.chinese: 现在没了。整整一上午才弄成这么半秒。

choices.english: Stay and see what made the square.
choices.chinese: 留下看看，方块是哪里照出来的。

choices.english: Say you missed it and need to keep walking.
choices.chinese: 告诉马龙你没看见，还得继续走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They shift half a step without crossing the edge of the path. A second small gap appears in the shadow.
beats.chinese: 马龙在路上挪半步，没有跨出边界。影子里又多出一小块空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a leaf. There's another one behind it. Both would have to move at once if you wanted the square back.
beats.chinese: 是一片叶。后头还有一片。想把那小方块再弄出来，两片得同时动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their eyes stay on the ground as one of the leaves lifts.
beats.chinese: 其中一片叶子抬了抬，马龙还是看地上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We could wait till it does. I could put one square in my notebook from memory.
beats.chinese: 可以等叶子又一起动。我也能凭印象在本上记这一格。

choices.english: Give the two leaves time to line up again.
choices.chinese: 等两片叶子有机会再对上。

choices.english: Let them keep only a drawing of what was there.
choices.chinese: 让马龙只画看到过的那一格。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They step away from the shadow and let you have the path.
beats.chinese: 马龙从影子边上退开，把路腾给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair. It didn't stay long enough for introductions.
beats.chinese: 也是，那东西还没来得及打招呼就走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their hand touches the notebook where it sits in a back pocket, but leaves it there.
beats.chinese: 马龙碰了后兜里的本子，没掏出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can tell somebody else. I can also be the only person who saw the whole thing.
beats.chinese: 我可以找别人说，也可以就我自己把整段都看见。

choices.english: Move on without making them explain it.
choices.chinese: 先走，不要求马龙再解释。

choices.english: Ask for one detail to take with you.
choices.chinese: 请马龙只给你说一样，好记着走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another outline passes across the old pattern. There is a square now, but it is bright instead of dark.
beats.chinese: 又一道影横过原来那片图。方块倒出来了，这回是亮的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a different one. Keep looking at that. The first one doesn't have to come back.
beats.chinese: 是另一块。就瞧这块吧，头一块也不必再回来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They move an arm out of your view, watching until the square goes again.
beats.chinese: 马龙把胳膊移出你的视野，一直看到方块又没了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two now. I wasn't going to get two on my own.
beats.chinese: 这就俩了。本来我自己只会数到一个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They draw one little square near the edge of a blank page.
beats.chinese: 马龙在空白页靠边画了一小方块。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave out what it was attached to. That's the bit the light could do and I can't.
beats.chinese: 它连着的别的我就不画了。那是光能弄出来、我弄不来的部分。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tilt the notebook for you to see before covering it.
beats.chinese: 马龙把本朝这边斜了斜给你看，才把它合住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's a little thing. I'm glad you stood still for it.
beats.chinese: 就这么点事。你肯停着看，还挺好的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The notebook stays in their pocket as they begin to walk again.
beats.chinese: 马龙接着走，本子还在兜里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Some things happen without a second pair of eyes.
beats.chinese: 好吧。没第二双眼睛看，有些事也还是发生了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pass the last edge of railing in the shadow without looking down.
beats.chinese: 马龙经过栏杆影最后那一截，没有往下看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can go home now without drawing it from the wrong end.
beats.chinese: 现在可以回家了，也不用非要倒着把它画一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They look back at the patch just long enough to find where the square was.
beats.chinese: 马龙朝那块光影看一眼，刚好找回方块原来的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One side was a leaf. The other side was the bars. Neither one knows it made a square.
beats.chinese: 一边是叶，一边是栏杆。两样都不知道自己弄了个方块出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They hold a thumb and forefinger a little way apart, then relax the hand.
beats.chinese: 马龙拇指食指比了短短一截，手又放松了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. You can take that with you without taking a picture.
beats.chinese: 行了，不拍照也能记着这点走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a different day, Marlon notices you near the blue mahoe and tips a pencil drawing towards you.
beats.chinese: 改天，马龙在蓝马霍树旁看见你，将一张铅笔画朝你斜过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. I tried to put back one square on an old game picture. My cat came over and sat on the bit I fixed.
beats.chinese: 嘿。我想给一张旧游戏的图补回一小格。家里猫走过来，正坐我改好的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They keep a thumb over a crease where the little figure ends.
beats.chinese: 马龙拿拇指盖住小人画到头的一道折痕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the closest I got to a review.
beats.chinese: 也就这个意见算是收到过。

causality.presenceReason: 来公园散步记一件小观察，不一定给谁讲
causality.placeAttitude: 同一片树影会改，喜欢先看再开口
causality.stayingConstraint: 想说了就说，别人没空不追
causality.currentGoal: 让另一个人也看看叶影与栏杆怎么合
causality.currentState: 被当成考知识会收声，笑话没落地也会停
causality.contactTrigger: 有人脚步停在影子一边，他们向玩家轻声说明自己没堵路
causality.characterContinuity: 真愿和人共享观察，被敷衍会失落，不拿知识争高下
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 留相同图案到影里。ab 只记眼睛这次得到的。ba 不再说。bb 记住没说出口的半句
causality.spatialContinuity: 蓝马霍园路，铁栏为园界仅看不碰
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢交代猫对游戏图案的反应

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha pulls the last length of wool through a sock, puts the needle away and stands on the path with her bag closed.
beats.chinese: 凯米莎抽紧袜子最后那一截毛线，收了针，合着袋站在园路上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All done. That's what I told my friend last time. She thought I meant I was done with her.
beats.chinese: 完了。上回我就这么跟朋友讲。她以为我连她也不想见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha looks around the blue mahoe, then back down at the closed bag.
beats.chinese: 凯米莎绕着蓝马霍树看了一圈，又低头瞧着扣好的包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was thinking about my heel. I finished the heel.
beats.chinese: 我说袜子的后跟。后跟做好了。

choices.english: Ask whether she wants to stay a bit with her friend.
choices.chinese: 问她想不想留下陪朋友待会儿。

choices.english: Ask if she needs to be somewhere else.
choices.chinese: 问她是不是还有别处要去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the bag upright against her leg and leaves the catch closed.
beats.chinese: 她把袋竖着靠腿，搭扣还关着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do. There's usually something I can finish while we talk. This time I'd have to just be there.
beats.chinese: 想啊。平常说话时我总能顺手做完点什么。这次恐怕除了陪她待会儿，也没什么要做的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks up at the blue mahoe and curls one finger round the handle.
beats.chinese: 她抬头看蓝马霍树，一根指头勾住提手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can ask if she wants to walk around. No need to find another sock to start.
beats.chinese: 可以叫她一起走一圈。不非得再找一只袜子起头。

choices.english: Stay and walk a little together.
choices.chinese: 留下来一起走一小截。

choices.english: Leave the bag closed while she waits.
choices.chinese: 袋子先这么关着，就等人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha checks the time, then closes the flap back over her wrist.
beats.chinese: 凯米莎看看时间，把袖口盖回手腕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I think I keep acting like there's a second place I have to get to. Most of the time there isn't.
beats.chinese: 没有。我好像老当下一站必须赶过去。多数时候还真没有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lets a pair of walkers come by before taking another step.
beats.chinese: 她让两个散步的人先经过，才接着迈步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could go, though. I can ask to see Althea tomorrow if she wants to.
beats.chinese: 不过也可以走啊，问阿尔西娅愿不愿意明天见也行。

choices.english: Let her go if that's what she wants today.
choices.chinese: 今天真想走，就走。

choices.english: Suggest an invitation that doesn't involve finishing something.
choices.chinese: 提议约个不用做完什么的见面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha carries the closed bag alongside you. She takes the bend at the same pace.
beats.chinese: 凯米莎合着袋跟你并排走，转弯也没换速度。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I want to see where the hedge changes colour before I turn. I never wait that long if my hands are busy.
beats.chinese: 我想走到花篱换颜色那截再转。手上老有活儿，我一次也没等看到那儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Althea lifts a hand on the path ahead. Kemesha keeps the bag shut as she waves back.
beats.chinese: 前面园路上，阿尔西娅抬手。凯米莎挥了挥，没再掀袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can finish this walk, too. It's a different sort of finish.
beats.chinese: 我还可以把这趟一起走完。也算弄完件事，只是不太一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pushes the closed catch once to test it, then takes her hand away.
beats.chinese: 她按了一下扣，试过没开，就把手拿开了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Closed. Well. I'll show her the heel when she asks. I'll say something else first.
beats.chinese: 关了。嗯，等她问我，我再给她看后跟。先说点别的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Footsteps pause beside the tree. Kemesha lifts her head.
beats.chinese: 树旁的脚步停了。凯米莎抬头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. How did you get on this morning?
beats.chinese: 哎，你今早怎么样？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls the strap over her shoulder and starts down the path, already using the phone with her free hand.
beats.chinese: 她把肩带挂上肩，沿路走开，空出来那只手已经在用手机了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll say I feel like going home. That's all I've got today. It won't be about the sock.
beats.chinese: 就说今天想回家。我这会儿就这个劲儿了。跟袜子没关系。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits for the message to go, then puts the phone in the bag with the knitting.
beats.chinese: 她等消息发出去，把手机跟织东西的家什一块儿塞进袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask her tomorrow. If she's busy I'll just have another go the day after.
beats.chinese: 明天我再问她。她忙就后天再问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha takes a step towards the grass, stops at the paving edge, and looks back up the path.
beats.chinese: 凯米莎往草地那头迈一步，在石铺边上停住，沿园路回望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tea. That's a thing I can ask for. She needn't bring her knitting, and I needn't make a reason for the tea.
beats.chinese: 喝茶，可以就约喝茶。她不用带毛线来，我也不用给这杯茶找个什么理由。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the empty hand open by her side.
beats.chinese: 她把空的那只手摊开放在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I think I'd ask even if she said it first.
beats.chinese: 她要是先问，我想我也还是得问一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Some days later, Kemesha sees you on the park path with one small blue sock rolled loosely in her hand.
beats.chinese: 过几天，凯米莎在园路上瞧见你，手里松松地卷着一只小蓝袜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I haven't started the second one. I said I'd sit with my friend first.
beats.chinese: 你好。第二只还没起头。说好了先陪朋友坐坐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the loose end once without starting another stitch.
beats.chinese: 她把散出来的线头往里掖了一下，没有起下一针。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I brought the first one in case she wanted to see it, though. I'm still me.
beats.chinese: 不过第一只还是带来了，万一她想看呢。我也还是我啊。

causality.presenceReason: 提前到树旁见阿尔西娅等人，带一只才做完的袜子
causality.placeAttitude: 园路能遇见朋友又留出通路
causality.stayingConstraint: 时间还有一截，不急走
causality.currentGoal: 决定没有活可做是否还留下
causality.currentState: 习惯做完就走，被问何必走时有点卡住
causality.contactTrigger: 她收完袋却站原地，玩家刚经过，自己先把两种意思分清
causality.characterContinuity: 干完会开心，不评别人慢下来，愿意承认想喝茶
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 两人共同留一会。ab 袋留好不用返工。ba 真离开。bb 改邀而不答应工作
causality.spatialContinuity: 只在树旁园路，不把草地设成座位
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 另一天有一只不同颜色的半成品

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: By the waterfront pavilion, Marcia holds a small recorder away from herself. A bit of wind plays through its speaker.
beats.chinese: 海滨的凉亭旁，玛西娅把小录音机往外拿。扬声器里放出了一小段风声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one sounds like a flat tire. I might not play it for Pearl.
beats.chinese: 那段像轮胎漏气。我不一定放给珀尔听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She switches it off and looks towards the seats, then at you.
beats.chinese: 她关掉录音机，朝座位看了一眼，又转过来瞧你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said come for some sounds and a puppet. Now every time I say it I make it sound like some long thing nobody can leave.
beats.chinese: 我说来听点声音，再看个皮影。每回讲出来，倒跟个很长的节目似的，人挨到完场才能走。

choices.english: Ask what a visitor would actually see and hear.
choices.chinese: 问真去了会看着什么、听着什么。

choices.english: Ask what happens if somebody walks out.
choices.chinese: 问人坐不到最后就走会怎么样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds up two fingers, then brings them close together.
beats.chinese: 她举起两根手指，又拢到一起。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A bit of rain on zinc. Then a bird on a sheet. There's enough story for about five minutes if the bird behaves.
beats.chinese: 一小段雨打铁皮的声，再在布上投只鸟。鸟配合的话，整个故事五分钟左右。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She uses one finger to move the recorder's switch back to the middle.
beats.chinese: 她用一根手指把开关拨回中间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could say five minutes. Or I could send Pearl this bit of rain and let her decide if she wants more.
beats.chinese: 可以就说五分钟。也能先发这段雨给珀尔，她自己听听想不想再听。

choices.english: Say the little story out loud, without a long introduction.
choices.chinese: 不讲长开场，就把小节目是什么说出来。

choices.english: Send Pearl a piece of the sound first.
choices.chinese: 先发一小段给珀尔听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia lowers the recorder until it brushes the side of her leg.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅把录音机放到碰着腿边那么低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nothing. I do it too. Soon as I feel like I've stayed too long, time to take my shoes and go.
beats.chinese: 没事，我也这么干。一觉得待够了，鞋拿上就走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks along the waterfront path without waving anybody over.
beats.chinese: 她沿海滨步道看过去，没招手留谁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you want to pass right now, you can. That's the easiest part to explain.
beats.chinese: 你这会儿想走就走。这一句倒最好说。

choices.english: Take her at her word and carry on.
choices.chinese: 就听她这句，接着走。

choices.english: Ask if a guest could arrive partway through too.
choices.chinese: 问能不能中途来也成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a breath and speaks faster than she did the first time.
beats.chinese: 她吸口气，这次开口比头一遍快。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pearl, five minutes. Rain first, bird after. If you don't see the bird, ask me which way the beak's facing.
beats.chinese: 珀尔，五分钟，先听雨再看鸟。没看出是鸟，就问我嘴朝哪边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the recorder steady for a second and grins.
beats.chinese: 她端稳录音机停了一秒，咧嘴笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. No long thing at all.
beats.chinese: 喏，这不就一点儿也不长了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She leans the recorder safely against her bag and finds one clip on the phone.
beats.chinese: 她将录音机稳妥靠着包，在手机上翻出一段。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one's real rain. I don't need to send her the bit that sounds like a tire.
beats.chinese: 这段是真下雨，不必给她发那段轮胎似的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends it and picks up the recorder again by its strap.
beats.chinese: 她发过去，再提起录音机的带子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She might want to hear the tire next. That'd be her choice.
beats.chinese: 她没准下一个就要听轮胎，那就由她选吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia steps away from the opening of the pavilion, leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅从凉亭开口处往旁边退，空出条路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, go on. See how easy that was?
beats.chinese: 好，去吧。你看多容易。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the recorder back towards the waterfront, holding it still.
beats.chinese: 她重把录音机朝向海边，拿稳了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Let me get the sound after the footstep this time.
beats.chinese: 这回我来录脚步之后那一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She switches the recorder off and sits by the pavilion facing the path.
beats.chinese: 她关掉录音机，在凉亭旁面朝路坐下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They can come in when the puppet's halfway across. I'll tell them it's a bird, same as I'd say somebody's name.
beats.chinese: 皮影走一半来了也行。就说那是只鸟，跟我告诉人名字一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She makes a short bird shape with one hand and then lets it fall.
beats.chinese: 她拿一只手比了下鸟，再放下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nobody has to know where the bird started.
beats.chinese: 又不用非知道鸟是从哪儿走过来的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another evening by the pavilion, Marcia sees you and holds up a scrap of seat fabric cut into a shape.
beats.chinese: 又一天傍晚，玛西娅在凉亭旁瞧见你，举起一小块裁过形状的座椅布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. My aunt knew it was a bird. Said she knew from the one leg nobody liked.
beats.chinese: 嗨。我姨一看就知道是鸟。说是认出那条大伙儿都不喜欢的腿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the other leg down to see how it looks on its own.
beats.chinese: 她把另一条腿折下去，看看只剩一条是什么样。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it. She saw it standing the way I meant.
beats.chinese: 留着吧。她看出来了，我就想要它那么站。

causality.presenceReason: 来海滨听风，等朋友佩尔定一个小聚
causality.placeAttitude: 座位和凉亭让她试说邀请的话，有人听也有退出空间
causality.stayingConstraint: 不替朋友承诺小聚曲目，把解释缩短
causality.currentGoal: 说清可以中途走
causality.currentState: 怕讲太多烦人，一急又短得听不明白
causality.contactTrigger: 录音机响了一点含糊声音，见玩家停下就试说聚会会干什么
causality.characterContinuity: 不让人不问就帮忙，愿意让别人自己走，听见不明白肯再讲
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 把小聚说具体。ab 让朋友自己试听。ba 不用接着讲。bb 接受对方从中途经过
