stories.titleZh: 最后一块先给前面的人

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A shopper sits down by the pavilion and shakes an empty bag open. The person on the next seat is eating something in a paper sleeve.
beats.chinese: 凉亭旁，有个人坐下抖开空袋。旁边座位上的人正从纸套里拿东西吃。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the last patty. I know that fold. The man in front of me got it fair and square.
beats.chinese: 那是最后一只馅饼，那个纸怎么折我认得。站我前面那位买去的，也是该轮着他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Shanique looks at the bag in her own hand and bursts out laughing.
beats.chinese: 沙妮克低头看自己手里的空纸袋，一下笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wanted a place people would notice. Then people noticed it, and here I am with a bag full of nothing.
beats.chinese: 我还想他们家生意有人看见呢。人家真看见了，我倒在这儿拿一个专门装空气的袋。

choices.english: Ask what she likes about the patty there.
choices.chinese: 问她喜欢那家的馅饼哪一点。

choices.english: Ask why she waited if she knew the owner.
choices.chinese: 问她认识老板，怎么也去排队。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes one corner of the bag tightly between two fingers and bends it.
beats.chinese: 她两根手指捏紧袋角，折进去一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The edge, when it's gone brown but doesn't break and spill in your lap. The woman knows exactly when to take them out.
beats.chinese: 边儿烤成棕的，又不会一掰碎满腿。人家哪会儿从炉里起，她心里特明白。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She props the bag against her knee.
beats.chinese: 她把袋子抵在膝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can like that bit without knowing where I go. Or you can tell me when you usually get hungry and I'll give you a head start.
beats.chinese: 光知道好吃在哪儿，不用非知道我去哪家。要不你说你平常什么时候饿，我可以给你支个早点去的招。

choices.english: Let her keep the place to herself.
choices.chinese: 那家让她自己留着。

choices.english: Ask when she'd go back herself.
choices.chinese: 问她自己下回想什么时候去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She watches the corner of the other person's bag disappear behind a coat.
beats.chinese: 她瞧旁边人那只袋的一角藏到了外套后头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a person I like, not a fast lane. She gets a queue, I go to the back of it.
beats.chinese: 那是我喜欢的人，又不是条快速通道。她家有人排，我就在最后站。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the empty bag inside the larger one.
beats.chinese: 她把空纸袋塞进大一些的袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can eat the rest of what I bought. Or let my friend go and see what's so good about the wait.
beats.chinese: 手里别的买了也能吃。或者让朋友也自己去看看，究竟什么值得等。

choices.english: Put the missed snack out of mind and eat what she has.
choices.chinese: 馅饼先不想，吃已经买来的。

choices.english: Let a friend try it without promising any special treatment.
choices.chinese: 让朋友自己去试，不保证有什么照应。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tears a bad corner off the bag and rolls it between her fingers.
beats.chinese: 她把袋上坏了的一角撕下，拿指头搓起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can give you the edge. If you find it somewhere else it still counts.
beats.chinese: 我就跟你说那口边儿有多好吃。你在别家碰着一样的，也算。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the scrap in her hand instead of dropping it.
beats.chinese: 她一直把纸片捏在手里，没往地上扔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look at me sharing the recipe for a thing I will not be making.
beats.chinese: 瞧我，自己肯定不做，倒在这儿给人讲做法。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens her coat pocket to look at her phone clock.
beats.chinese: 她掀开外套兜，瞧了一眼手机上的时间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Twenty minutes earlier. Long enough to get the last one if the same man has the same idea tomorrow.
beats.chinese: 早二十分钟。那人要明天还动一样的心思，我也够抢在前头买到最后那只。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She leaves the clock alone and folds her hand back over the bag.
beats.chinese: 她没再看时间，把手重新搭回纸袋上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll still stand at the back. I'll just be at the back earlier.
beats.chinese: 后头还是排后头。我早点在后头站就是了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gets a piece of bread out of the other bag and breaks it over the paper.
beats.chinese: 她从另一个袋拿出块面包，在纸上掰开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This'll do. There's no reason for the bread to suffer because I had my mind on a patty.
beats.chinese: 这个也好。我刚光顾着想馅饼，不能叫面包白受罪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She eats a corner and looks out beyond the pavilion.
beats.chinese: 她吃了一个角，越过凉亭往外瞧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Don't tell it I was going to have it second.
beats.chinese: 可别叫它知道，我原本打算第二个吃它。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out her phone and writes a quick question to someone she knows.
beats.chinese: 她拿出手机，飞快给熟人写了句问话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I told her to go if she's hungry. I didn't say use my name. My name's not buying her a patty.
beats.chinese: 就说饿了可以去。我可没说报我的名。就我这名，也换不来馅饼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps watching the waterfront while she waits for the phone to buzz.
beats.chinese: 她还是朝海滨外望，顺便等手机振。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can find out if there's a reason I came all the way back with an empty bag.
beats.chinese: 她倒能去瞧，我空着一只袋都走回来了，值不值。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Later one evening near the waterfront seats, Shanique sees you and tucks a used paper sleeve into her bag.
beats.chinese: 后来一天傍晚，在海滨座位附近，沙妮克看见你，把个用过的纸套塞进袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. The woman saw me at the back of the line. Just lifted her chin and sold six more before I got there.
beats.chinese: 嘿，那人见我排在最后面，抬下巴给我打声招呼。我没到跟前，她照样先卖了六只。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down at the little grease mark left on her thumb.
beats.chinese: 她低头看拇指上留的一小点油。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tasted lovely. Would have tasted funny if she passed it over six heads.
beats.chinese: 真好吃。她要从六个人头上越过去递给我，吃着才别扭。

causality.presenceReason: 从店那边排完队出来在海滨歇一小会
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢走一段再吃，不急着找熟人招呼
causality.stayingConstraint: 没买到馅饼还有别的选择，不回去讨人情
causality.currentGoal: 把遗憾说出来，想不想告诉一个人店在哪
causality.currentState: 既高兴店好，也嫌人挤
causality.contactTrigger: 她坐下闻到另一个人的纸袋，轻轻一笑，跟身旁玩家说自己慢了一位
causality.characterContinuity: 不插队、不让熟人优待，不随便把私藏的地方推成打卡点
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 分享一件没写店名的细节。ab 改天排早一点。ba 自己吃别的。bb 让朋友亲自去试
causality.spatialContinuity: 凉亭、座位与通道可用，买饼场所不在取景范围
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 重逢说的是另一条队

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Near the pavilion, a voice on Tia's phone says one, two. She puts a square of fabric over the speaker before it says three.
beats.chinese: 凉亭旁，蒂娅手机里有人念一、二。念三以前，她把一方布覆到扬声器上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Was the three gone, or just softer? I'm listening so hard I can hear the number before it comes.
beats.chinese: 那个三是没了，还是变小声了？我听得太用力，数字还没出来脑子里已经听着了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the fabric over the phone till the recording stops.
beats.chinese: 直到录音停掉，布还盖在电话上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was supposed to do this with a friend. She didn't come. So you're getting whatever the phone can manage.
beats.chinese: 本来说跟朋友一起试，她没来。你刚听的就只有这手机能放出来的那点。

choices.english: Say which sound you actually heard.
choices.chinese: 照实说听见的是哪个声音。

choices.english: Ask if the friend said why she didn't come.
choices.chinese: 问朋友有没有解释怎么没来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the cloth over and tests how much light shows through a corner.
beats.chinese: 她把布翻个面，看看角上透出多少光。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. Softer is different from gone. I've got a thicker square at home if I want to hear gone.
beats.chinese: 好。小声和没有不是一回事。我要听什么叫没了，家里有块更厚的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tia separates two layers of cloth with the side of her thumb.
beats.chinese: 蒂娅拿拇指侧面分开两层布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could test that one next. Somebody who doesn't know the words would be more use than me.
beats.chinese: 下回就可以试那块。找个不知道放的是什么词的人，比我再听管用。

choices.english: Leave her one clear thing to test at home.
choices.chinese: 给她留一项回家能自己试的。

choices.english: Find another listener who doesn't know what to expect.
choices.chinese: 找一个不知道会放哪句的人听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the cloth around the phone, then takes it off again.
beats.chinese: 她拿布把手机裹住了，又抖开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I asked once already. I don't want to do that trick where we pretend I didn't wait the whole time.
beats.chinese: 没有。我已经问过一回。不想再玩那种装我没傻等全程的游戏。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the phone next to the fabric rather than underneath it.
beats.chinese: 她把手机放到布旁边，没再藏在底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can come another time if she asks. I can say I wanted her here today, too.
beats.chinese: 改天她来问，也能来。至于今天我原本想她过来，这句我也能说。

choices.english: Don't make a second plan now.
choices.chinese: 这会儿就别再约第二个时间。

choices.english: Allow another try without brushing off the wait.
choices.chinese: 可以再约，但刚才等人的事不用装没发生。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She writes a numeral on the tag at the corner of the lighter swatch.
beats.chinese: 她在薄一些那块角上的小标上写了一个数字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll test three at home in the quiet. Same voice, same number. The cloth can be the part that changes.
beats.chinese: 回家静一点，我就试这个三。同一个声，同一个数，只换布。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the square up once more to see it against the light.
beats.chinese: 她又举一下小方布，把它对着光看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. It's nice when somebody says what came through instead of how clever I am.
beats.chinese: 谢啦。有人告诉我实际过来什么声，比夸我脑子灵好听多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops the playback and switches to a different recording without playing it aloud.
beats.chinese: 她停止播放，换到另一段录音，没外放。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I asked my grandmother to read a grocery list once. I'll use a list nobody else has heard.
beats.chinese: 我以前叫我姥姥念过购物单。下回换张别人都没听过的单子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She writes a little circle beside the file name on her pad.
beats.chinese: 她在手写本的文件名外圈了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Then if all they hear is onion, I'll know what they heard.
beats.chinese: 这样人家要只听见洋葱，我就知道是真听到洋葱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She locks the phone and folds the cloth into four.
beats.chinese: 她锁了手机，把布叠成四层。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay. I can go home and put this away. She knows how to find me. I've got a game Thursday anyway.
beats.chinese: 好，我能先回家收了这个。人家知道到哪儿找我。周四我反正还要去打球。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stands on the walk and checks how far the cloth sticks out of her bag.
beats.chinese: 她站到步道上，看那块布在袋口还露了多长。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can finish the day without checking the phone again.
beats.chinese: 一天剩下这点时间，我不再看手机了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She types two short lines and reads only the first one back.
beats.chinese: 她打了两行短话，只念了第一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I waited and went home. No, wait. I'm still here. I'll send it when I'm actually leaving.
beats.chinese: 我等了一会儿就回家了。不是，我还在这儿呢。我真要走的时候再发。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the phone still while the wind lifts one corner of the fabric.
beats.chinese: 风掀起一个布角，她拿着手机没动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The second line's Saturday, if you want. I can say both.
beats.chinese: 第二行就写，你想来就周六。俩都可以说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another afternoon near the waterfront, Tia sees you and slips a racket cover off one shoulder.
beats.chinese: 改天下午，蒂娅在海滨附近见到你，把球拍套从一边肩上卸下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. Thursday I got there first. Didn't wait to warm up. A woman came over and told me exactly why my backhand was going into the floor.
beats.chinese: 嗨，周四我先到，没等人就热身了。有个女的走过来，直接说明了我反手怎么老打到地上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts the cover so the racket handle sits nearer her hand.
beats.chinese: 她挪挪拍套，让球拍柄贴近手边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She didn't say I was gifted once. I'm playing with her again.
beats.chinese: 从头到尾没夸我一句有天分。下回还跟她打。

causality.presenceReason: 拿一块布样到海滨找熟人试听
causality.placeAttitude: 风和声不能当正式检验，但可以先发现一眼容易听出来的区别

causality.currentGoal: 求具体哪一下丢了，而非人天分好
causality.currentState: 本来和一人约了试布，没来就直说一句
causality.contactTrigger: 她拿布贴在手机扬声器前播放三声玩家恰好听到
causality.characterContinuity: 对泛泛夸奖会追实际用途，对失约只点一次
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 留布做自测。ab 让另一双耳朵听。ba 暂不复约。bb 给对方新时间但不抹掉缺席
causality.spatialContinuity: 凉亭与公共座位旁，不碰办公楼
